en.description: Each segment marks different spellings or tokenization positions of the Ap string, but high activations are also scattered across multiple unrelated fragments; the main pattern appears to be the Ap character/subword fragment, rather than a unified semantic concept.

patterns.name: Contiguous Ap letter fragment
patterns.context: Uppercase or lowercase Ap appears at the beginning or inside longer words or abbreviations; it may be tokenized into Ap and a following word fragment.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedicine, place names, Portuguese, and sports texts; spans 1–10

patterns.name: Apoptosis word family
patterns.context: In biomedical contexts, terms beginning with Ap; activation falls on the Ap substring rather than only on a complete word.

patterns.name: Ap in the ApoE name
patterns.context: The initial Ap fragment of a gene or protein name; adjacent to contexts about genetic risk and Alzheimer’s disease.

patterns.name: Ap in personal or place names
patterns.context: Ap is a character fragment inside or at the beginning of a proper name, with no medical meaning required.
patterns.domain: Entertainment reporting, geographic encyclopedias, football encyclopedias

patterns.name: AP in transcription factor names
patterns.context: The uppercase abbreviation AP-1 appears in descriptions of transcriptional regulation.

patterns.name: ap in Portuguese words
patterns.context: Ap occurs at the beginning of the Portuguese word apesar (although), surrounded by continuous Portuguese text.

patterns.name: Uncovered non-Ap trigger words
patterns.context: The locations of these high-activation fragments have no clear proximity to the Ap string and cannot be explained by the same explicit word-meaning pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, cell experiments, and biographical encyclopedias

2_149.description: 各段都标出了 Ap 字符串的不同拼写或切分位置，但高激活还散落在多个无关片段；主要规律像是字符/子词 Ap，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: Ap 连续字母片段
patterns.context: 大小写 Ap 出现在更长词或缩写的词首/内部；可能被分词拆成 Ap 与后续词片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、地名、葡语及体育文本；覆盖 1–10

patterns.name: apoptosis 词族
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中，Ap 开头的术语；激活落在 Ap 子串而非仅某个完整词。

patterns.name: ApoE 名称中的 Ap
patterns.context: 基因或蛋白名称的开头片段 Ap；与遗传风险、阿尔茨海默病语境相邻。

patterns.name: 人名或地名中的 Ap
patterns.context: Ap 是专名内部或开头的字符片段，不要求医学含义。
patterns.domain: 娱乐报道、地理百科、足球百科

patterns.name: 转录因子名称中的 AP
patterns.context: 大写缩写 AP-1 出现在转录调控描述中。

patterns.name: 葡语词中的 ap
patterns.context: Ap 位于葡语词 apesar（尽管）开头，周围是葡语连续文本。

patterns.name: 未覆盖的非 Ap 触发词
patterns.context: 这些高激活片段所在位置与 Ap 字符串没有明显邻接关系，无法由同一明确词义模式解释。
patterns.domain: 百科、细胞实验及人物百科

en.description: Primarily responds to the “Ap” substring and following word fragments across multiple text types; it also responds to the “road” fragment related to roads. Other frequent words and numeric annotations are scattered, making it difficult to identify them as independent patterns.

patterns.name: Ap string and following fragments
patterns.context: Activates when “Ap” appears in English words, proper names, or abbreviations; typically a subword fragment, with no fixed meaning required. It recurs in segments 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, and 10, often with high intensity.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, proper-name narratives, encyclopedia entries, and general web text

patterns.name: road substring
patterns.context: The “road” word fragment activates when describing vehicle off-road capability, road tests, or race tracks; both “road” annotations are strong.
patterns.domain: Military vehicle encyclopedias, driving research abstracts, racing encyclopedias

patterns.name: Number 4 and adjacent fragments
patterns.context: Appears as scattered numeric or common word-fragment activations; these examples do not establish stable independent contextual conditions.

2_149.description: 主要对“Ap”子串及其后续词片段反应，覆盖多类文本；另对道路相关的“road”片段反应。其余高频词和数字标注分散，难以确定为独立模式。

patterns.name: Ap 字符串及其后续片段
patterns.trigger: “Ap”及其后续被拆分的词片段，如“Ap nea”“Ap oE”“Ap na”“Ap opt”“Ap enn”“Ap oll”
patterns.context: “Ap”在英文词语、专名或缩写中出现时激活；通常是子词片段，不要求固定词义。第 1、2、3、5、8、9、10 段中反复出现，强度也较高。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专名叙述、百科条目及一般网页文本

patterns.name: road 子串
patterns.context: 在描述车辆越野能力、道路测试或赛道时，“road”一词片段激活；两处“road”标注很强。
patterns.domain: 军事车辆百科、驾驶研究摘要、赛车百科

patterns.name: 数字 4 及与其邻接的片段
patterns.trigger: 第 2 段的“E4”以及第 6 段的“180”中的“6”标注；此外多段中可见标注为 4 的高频功能词或词片段
patterns.context: 表现为零散的数字或常见词片段激活，无法从这些例子中确认稳定的独立上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与体育百科

en.description: Primarily activates at the case-sensitive “Ap” character fragment across disease, gene, place-name, plant, book-title, and Portuguese vocabulary contexts; there are also several scattered subword or spacing-format activations that cannot be grouped into a single semantic theme. No matching trigger is observed in segment 6.

patterns.name: Ap string/subword fragment
patterns.context: The contiguous case-sensitive characters Ap occur in the spelling of different words; often at a word beginning or subword boundary, with no specific semantic or syntactic context required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including medical abstracts, place-name and botanical entries, novel catalogs, Portuguese academic texts, etc.

patterns.name: Non-Ap tokenization/formatting activations
patterns.context: Subword fragments within words or special formatting in their respective texts; they have no clear connection to a shared semantic theme and may be incidental morphological, tokenization, or formatting triggers.
patterns.domain: Project abstracts, botany, old-book catalog formatting, Portuguese philosophy texts

2_149.description: 主要在大小写敏感的“Ap”字符片段处激活，跨越疾病、基因、地名、植物、书名和葡萄牙语词汇；另有若干零散子词或空格格式激活，无法归为同一语义主题。第6段未见相同触发。

patterns.name: Ap 字符串/子词片段
patterns.context: 在不同词的拼写中出现大小写敏感的连续字符 Ap；常处于词首或子词切分边界，不要求特定语义或句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括医学摘要、地名与植物学条目、小说目录、葡萄牙语学术文本等

patterns.name: 非 Ap 的分词/格式激活
patterns.trigger: «L»（[2] Leveraging）、«Tab»（[7] Tabernaemontana）、«io»与空格串 «        »（[8] 目录页）、«ade»/«desc»/«rit»/«a»/«cap»/«az»/«es»/«le»/«var»（[9] 葡萄牙语）
patterns.context: 存在于各自文本中的词内子词片段或特殊排版；与共同语义主题无明显联系，可能是附带的词形、分词或格式触发。
patterns.domain: 项目摘要、植物学、旧书目录排版、葡萄牙语哲学文本

en.description: The most consistent pattern is sensitivity to the Ap substring and its occurrences in various words across fields such as medicine and geography; there are also activations for headings, chapter formatting, and several isolated word fragments that cannot be grouped into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Ap/Apo string and word fragments
patterns.context: Trigger locations span various complete words and word boundaries, often in words beginning with Ap; activation is concentrated on the subword fragment «Ap», with no specific syntactic or semantic context required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedicine, geography, news, Portuguese, etc.

patterns.name: Opening headings and proper-name word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in opening headings such as project abstracts or paper titles; apart from these word fragments, there is no clear context shared with other highly activated segments.
patterns.domain: Research project titles, medical paper titles

patterns.name: Chapter and catalog formatting
patterns.context: Appears in chapter headings, catalog-like descriptions, and line-break formatting in novel text.

patterns.name: Other scattered word-fragment activations
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different word and semantic setting. Apart from some biomedical terms, there is insufficient evidence for a unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Military equipment descriptions, biomedical abstracts, Portuguese academic texts

patterns.name: Dialogue narrative word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in character dialogue and program-related narration; occurs in the same segment as the Ap substring, but the trigger relationship is unclear.

2_149.description: 最一致的模式是对 Ap 子串及其在多种词中的出现敏感，跨越医学、地理等领域；另有标题、章节排版和若干孤立词片段激活，无法归并为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: Ap/Apo 字符串与词片段
patterns.context: 触发位置跨越多种完整词及词界，常见于 Ap 开头的词；激活集中在子词片段 «Ap»，并不要求特定句法或语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、地理、新闻、葡萄牙语等

patterns.name: 段首标题与专名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在项目摘要或论文题目等段首标题中；除这些词片段外，缺少与其他强激活段共享的明显上下文。
patterns.domain: 科研项目标题、医学论文标题

patterns.name: 章节与目录排版
patterns.context: 出现在小说正文中的章节标题、目录式说明与换行排版。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段激活
patterns.context: 各自处于不同词语和语义环境，除部分与生物医学词汇相关外，没有足够证据支持统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 军事装备说明、生物医学摘要、葡萄牙语学术文本

patterns.name: 对话叙事词片段
patterns.context: 出现在人物对话及节目相关叙述中；与 Ap 子串同段出现，但其触发关系不明。

en.description: Activations are mainly concentrated on strings beginning with Ap, including ApoE, sleep apnea, place names, and personal names; the ApCMin mouse name and a separate strong activation on hope are also observed, with no unified semantic theme or domain.

patterns.name: Abbreviations or word forms beginning with Ap
patterns.context: Activation falls within words or abbreviations beginning with the Ap string; meanings and following spellings vary greatly, as does capitalization.
patterns.domain: Multiple text types, including biomedicine, geography, sports, and classics

patterns.name: ApCMin mouse name
patterns.context: Appears as the name of a mouse model in cancer research; it differs from other Ap-initial word forms.

patterns.name: Local lexical activation on hope
patterns.context: Appears in the everyday narrative “Let’s hope Imran takes that well”, with no clear Ap-form trigger.

2_149.concept: Ap 开头字符串及偶发词汇
2_149.description: 主要激活集中于 Ap 开头的字符串，涵盖 ApoE、睡眠呼吸暂停、地名及人名等不同词；另有 ApCMin 小鼠名和单独的 hope 强激活，未见统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: Ap 开头的缩写或词形
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Ap 字符串开头的词或缩写内部；词义和后续拼写差异很大，大小写也不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、地理、体育和古典学等多种文体

patterns.name: ApCMin 小鼠名称
patterns.context: 作为癌症研究中的小鼠模型名称出现；与其他 Ap 开头词形并不相同。

patterns.name: hope 的局部词汇激活
patterns.context: 出现在“Let’s hope Imran takes that well”的日常叙述中，没有明显的 Ap 词形触发。

en.concept: Queue words and several occasional substrings
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on queue/queues and queue terms such as QUEUE_SIZE, across code, message communication, and task scheduling; other independent triggers include the directional word bottom, the compound-word usage, and a proper-name fragment from Geico.

patterns.name: queue and related terminology
patterns.context: Appears in message-queue identifiers and comments in code, or in technical text discussing task, communication-message, or job queues; contexts involve creation, scheduling, priority, time ranges, or queuing.
patterns.domain: Software code, communication-system patents, scheduling documentation

patterns.name: Directional word bottom
patterns.context: Appears as bottom (e.g., bottom-right, bottom-left) when describing interface layout, control positions, or graphic character vectors; in this set, it also occurs in segments separate from queue activations.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, Q&A; graphic character descriptions

patterns.name: usage suffix
patterns.context: Appears in compounds such as outdoor-usage and indoor-usage to describe product applications; no queue or interface-layout semantics are observed.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, lamp structure descriptions

patterns.name: Geico proper-name fragment
patterns.context: An internal substring in a proper name in quoted text; surrounding text is a forum-style quotation and discussion of TSA, with no semantic similarity to other highly activated patterns.

2_149.concept: 队列词及若干偶发子串
2_149.description: 强激活主要落在 queue/queues 及 QUEUE_SIZE 等队列词上，覆盖代码、消息通信和任务调度；另有 bottom 方位词、复合词 usage，以及 Geico 专名片段等独立触发。

patterns.name: queue 及其相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在代码中的消息队列标识和注释，或技术文本中对任务、通信消息、作业队列的讨论；上下文涉及创建、调度、优先级、时间范围或排队。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、通信系统专利、调度说明

patterns.name: bottom 方位词
patterns.context: 描述界面布局、控件位置或图形字符向量时，出现 bottom（如 bottom-right、bottom-left）；本组中也与 queue 激活段落分别出现。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、问答；图形字符说明

patterns.name: usage 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 outdoor-usage、indoor-usage 这类复合词中，描述产品适用场景；未见 queue 或界面布局语义。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，灯具结构描述

patterns.name: Geico 专名片段
patterns.context: 引用文本中的专名内部子串；周围为论坛式引用和关于 TSA 的文字，未显示与其他高激活模式相同的语义。

en.description: The main pattern is code and technical contexts around handler/handlers: including method names, macros, event handlers, exception handlers, signal handlers, and discussions of handlers; although the term is absent from segment 6, it contains an Android click-listener interface.

patterns.name: handler word and structure
patterns.context: Declarations, calls, types, bindings, or uses of handlers in code or technical discussion; this is the main shared pattern, though not every fragment is triggered by the same specific meaning of handler.
patterns.domain: Programming languages, framework code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Android click listener
patterns.context: Implements a click-listener interface in a Java Android class declaration; the fragment does not contain the complete word `handler`.

2_149.description: 主要模式是围绕 handler/handlers 的代码与技术语境：包括方法名、宏、事件处理器、异常处理器、信号处理器及处理器讨论；第6段虽无该词，但有 Android 点击监听接口。

patterns.name: handler 词及其结构
patterns.trigger: `handler`、`handlers`、`handler()`，常出现在 `catch handler`、`event handler`、`handler for` 等结构中
patterns.context: 代码或技术讨论中，围绕处理器的声明、调用、类型、绑定或用途；是主要共同模式，但并非所有片段都由同一种具体处理器含义触发
patterns.domain: 编程语言、框架代码及技术问答

patterns.name: Android 点击监听器
patterns.context: Java Android 类声明中实现点击监听接口；片段未出现完整的 `handler` 一词

en.concept: Temporary variables and operations in code
en.description: Activates mainly on code snippets, especially variable names with temp followed by a number or type suffix; function calls, control flow, comments, numeric processing, and collection declarations also appear. There are also unrelated headings and medical terminology.

patterns.name: Identifier temp and numeric suffixes
patterns.context: Temporary variable names in code, often with numeric or type/purpose suffixes; they frequently co-occur with assignments, numeric operations, or stream operations.

patterns.name: Function or method calls
patterns.context: Function names, method names, or call expressions in code; this also includes a question title about a call that has not yet been executed.

patterns.name: Control flow and structural symbols in code
patterns.context: Statement boundaries, control statements, or parentheses/braces in code snippets; typically accompanied by indentation or line breaks.

patterns.name: Title-style English phrases
patterns.context: Promotional or article titles consisting of capitalized title words with a colon and hyphen; not a code context.

patterns.name: Medical research terminology
patterns.context: Abstract-style titles/phrases containing medical terms such as individualized adjustment, target range, and high dose.

patterns.name: Decimal numeric processing
patterns.context: Numeric types and operations involving precision, rounding, or conversion; adjacent to temporary-variable assignments.

patterns.name: Code comments and docstrings
patterns.context: Comments or docstrings in code that describe operations or act as text-block delimiters.

patterns.name: List types and collection initialization
patterns.context: Declares and initializes a generic list, alongside a temporary collection variable.

2_149.concept: 代码中的临时变量与操作
2_149.description: 主要激活于代码片段，尤以 temp 加数字或类型后缀的变量名为突出线索；也见函数调用、控制流、注释、数值处理及集合声明。另有不相干的标题和医学术语。

patterns.name: 标识符 temp 及数字后缀
patterns.context: 代码中的临时变量名，常带数字或类型/用途后缀；多处与赋值、数值运算或流操作同现。

patterns.name: 函数或方法调用
patterns.context: 代码里出现函数名、方法名或调用表达式；其中也包含调用尚未执行的提问标题。

patterns.name: 代码中的控制流与结构符号
patterns.context: 代码片段中的语句边界、控制语句或括号/花括号；通常伴随缩进或换行。

patterns.name: 标题式英文短语
patterns.context: 大小写标题词与冒号、短横线构成的宣传或文章标题，不是代码语境。

patterns.name: 医学研究用语
patterns.context: 摘要式标题/短语，含个体化调整、目标范围和高剂量等医学术语。

patterns.name: 十进制数值处理
patterns.context: 数值类型及精度、舍入或转换操作；与临时变量赋值相邻。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档字符串
patterns.context: 代码中的注释或文档字符串，说明操作或作为文本块分隔符。

patterns.name: 列表类型与集合初始化
patterns.context: 声明并初始化泛型列表，同时出现临时集合变量。

en.description: Activations occur mainly on compound identifiers, type names, and method names in code; other scattered patterns include fitting/transforming, color graphics, time, probability calculations, permutation tests, and UI interaction. There is no stable unified trigger across languages and tasks.

patterns.name: Fitting and transformation in machine learning
patterns.context: Appears in code and explanations describing an estimator that has not yet been fitted, the effect of calling fit, or transformer/transformer components; activation is concentrated on fit- and transform-related words.

patterns.name: Compound words and naming fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur inside compound identifiers in code, such as class names, type names, method names, or UI class names; the trigger is not fixed to a particular programming language or naming style.

patterns.name: Class- and object-related identifiers
patterns.context: Near type declarations, type names, or object-related definitions; beyond the keywords struct/class, activation also falls on components of specific class names.

patterns.name: Color and graphics-transformation words in names
patterns.context: Code concerning color matrices, color transformation, or drawing vectors; color-related words and some graphics-operation identifiers activate.

patterns.name: Time measurement and collection filling
patterns.context: Code computes elapsed time using a monotonic clock and prints seconds, followed by a definition containing fill_set; activation occurs on time words and function-name fragments.

patterns.name: Permutation and mask tests
patterns.context: Test code checks whether shuffle/permute operations and their masks are correct; activation falls on test names and explanatory comments.

patterns.name: Periodic registration in database migrations
patterns.context: In Rails-style migration or model code, sets table_name and configures a migrated object; a periodicity term and ActiveRecord name co-occur.

patterns.name: Bayesian probability calculations
patterns.context: Code updates a model, calculates log-likelihood and priors, and returns a reshaped scalar; triggers are concentrated on probability and statistics terminology and the return expression.

patterns.name: Interactive interface events and transitions
patterns.context: Interface code or documentation describes a focus-event listener, or sliding between adjacent content panels after clicking a message title; activation involves UI components and behavior words.
patterns.domain: Android/UI code and jQuery web documentation

patterns.name: Common declarations and control words in code
patterns.context: These words occur in function, namespace, access-control, or generated-code declaration contexts, but activations are weak and scattered, so no stable trigger condition can be identified independently.

2_149.concept: 代码标识符与技术术语
2_149.description: 激活主要出现在代码中的复合标识符、类型名与方法名；另有拟合/变换、颜色图形、时间、概率计算、置换测试及界面交互等分散模式。不同语言和任务间没有稳定统一触发词。

patterns.name: 机器学习中的拟合与变换
patterns.context: 出现在描述 estimator 尚未拟合、调用 fit 的效果，或 transformer/transformer 组件的代码与说明中；激活集中于 fit、transform 相关词。
patterns.domain: Python 机器学习 / StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的复合词与命名片段
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、类型名、方法名或 UI 类名等复合标识符内部出现激活；触发位置并不固定在某一种编程语言或命名风格。

patterns.name: 类与对象相关的标识符
patterns.context: 类型声明、类型名或对象相关定义附近；除关键字 struct/class 外，激活也落在具体类名的组成部分上。

patterns.name: 名称中的颜色与图形变换词
patterns.context: 代码围绕颜色矩阵、颜色变换或绘图向量；颜色相关词及部分图形操作标识符被激活。
patterns.domain: 图形、界面或视觉处理代码

patterns.name: 时间测量与集合填充
patterns.context: 代码计算单调时钟的经过时间并打印秒数，后续定义含 fill_set；激活出现在时间词和函数名片段上。

patterns.name: 置换与掩码测试

patterns.name: 调试日志中的 Hello World 响应

patterns.name: 进程创建失败消息

patterns.name: 时间周期乘法

patterns.name: 密码查询回退

patterns.domain: Unix/Linux 代码注释与 Go 代码

patterns.name: GitHub 归档与提交下载日志
patterns.context: 记录从课程下载的提交数量；上下文涉及 archive/course

patterns.name: 实际与预期差异比较
patterns.context: 断言实际差异与预期差异相等，并输出两者

en.description: Activations appear in code across multiple languages, leaning toward loop control, variable assignment, file path operations, UI/graphics code, and data reading/writing; keywords, punctuation, and neighboring identifiers often occur together.

patterns.name: while loops and their conditions/iteration variables
patterns.context: A while loop appears in code, often with a loop condition, counter, or body; activation falls on while and nearby punctuation or variables

patterns.name: File path and filename handling
patterns.context: Extracts a filename or directory from a path, checks whether a file exists, and may rename it if there is a name collision

patterns.name: UI controls, views, and drawing styles
patterns.context: UI code sets control dimensions, borders, or background colors, loads WebView content, or creates drawing-related objects
patterns.domain: Mobile and desktop UI development code

patterns.name: Data reading/writing and download logs
patterns.context: Downloads course submission data and records logs, or performs SQL writes and queries and reads results

patterns.name: Routine variable initialization and assignment
patterns.context: Declares and initializes a state variable or counter in a code block; this local pattern does not require a specific domain

patterns.name: Importing Android graphics and application classes
patterns.context: Consecutive imports of Android application, context, and graphics-related classes at the beginning of a Java file

2_149.description: 激活出现在多语言代码中，偏向循环控制、变量赋值、文件路径操作、UI/图形代码及数据读写；多为关键字、标点和邻近标识符共同出现。

patterns.name: while 循环及其条件/迭代变量
patterns.context: 代码中出现 while 循环，常伴随循环条件、计数器或循环体；激活落在 while 及邻近标点、变量上

patterns.name: 文件路径与文件名处理
patterns.context: 从路径提取文件名或目录、检查文件是否存在，并可能在重名时改名
patterns.domain: Java / JavaScript 等编程问答或代码

patterns.name: UI 控件、视图与绘制样式
patterns.context: 界面代码中设置控件尺寸、边框或背景颜色，加载 WebView 内容，或创建绘制相关对象
patterns.domain: 移动与桌面 UI 开发代码

patterns.name: 数据读写与下载日志
patterns.context: 下载课程提交数据并记录日志，或执行 SQL 写入、查询并读取结果

patterns.name: 常规变量初始化与赋值
patterns.context: 代码块中声明并初始化状态变量或计数器；该局部模式不要求特定领域

patterns.name: 导入 Android 图形与应用类
patterns.context: Java 文件开头连续导入 Android 应用、上下文及图形相关类

en.description: Activations occur mainly in programming contexts, highlighting while loops, Objective-C/iOS APIs and declarations, Java/Android constructors, and code punctuation. A few other patterns include PHP/MySQL queries and the Is symbol in mathematical text; these cannot be attributed to a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Loop control and iteration
patterns.context: A loop keyword appears in code, followed by a condition or iteration expression.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A code (JavaScript, file operations, PHP)

patterns.name: Objective-C methods and property declarations
patterns.context: Cocoa types, properties, methods, or logging calls in Objective-C/iOS code; activation falls on identifiers and API fragments.

patterns.name: Java/Android constructors and stack traces
patterns.context: A Java constructor name or a constructor represented by compiled output, especially in Android exception stack traces or bytecode.
patterns.domain: Java, Android logs, and disassembled code

patterns.name: Code punctuation and statement boundaries
patterns.context: Near semicolons at the ends of code statements and closing braces, usually interspersed with other code activations; insufficient to determine semantics independently.

patterns.name: Mathematical set symbol Is
patterns.context: In a mathematical paper, Is denotes an ideal-related object in a discussion of sets and rings.

patterns.name: PHP database query code
patterns.context: PHP variables and mysqli query calls, including insert or select statements.

patterns.name: Ordinary English variable-name fragments
patterns.context: English prose mixed with code, involving canvas updates, arrays, and data; the activation target may be an identifier or API-related word.
patterns.domain: Natural language and code mixed in programming Q&A

patterns.name: Other code types and API identifiers
patterns.context: Code identifiers such as type, property, or API names, without a more unified trigger than programming context.

2_149.concept: 代码标识符与语法片段
2_149.description: 激活主要出现在编程语境，突出 while 循环、Objective-C/iOS API与声明、Java/Android构造器及代码标点；另有PHP/MySQL查询和数学文本中 Is 符号等少数模式，不能归为同一语义触发。

patterns.name: 循环控制与迭代
patterns.context: 代码中出现循环关键字，后接条件或迭代取值表达式。
patterns.domain: 编程问答代码（JavaScript、文件操作、PHP）

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法与属性声明
patterns.context: Objective-C/iOS 代码中的 Cocoa 类型、属性、方法或日志调用；激活落在标识符和 API 片段上。

patterns.name: Java/Android 构造器与堆栈跟踪
patterns.context: Java 构造器名或由编译产物表示的构造器，尤其出现在 Android 异常堆栈或字节码中。
patterns.domain: Java、Android 日志及反汇编代码

patterns.name: 代码标点与语句边界
patterns.context: 代码语句末尾分号及闭合花括号附近，通常与其他代码激活交织；不足以独立确定语义。

patterns.name: 数学集合符号 Is
patterns.context: 数学论文中，以 Is 表示理想相关对象的符号，出现在集合与环的论述中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文（抽象代数）

patterns.name: PHP 数据库查询代码
patterns.context: PHP 变量与 mysqli 查询调用，包含插入或选择语句。

patterns.name: 普通英文变量名片段
patterns.context: 英文说明与代码混排，涉及更新画布、数组和数据；激活对象可能是标识符或 API 相关词。
patterns.domain: 编程问答中的自然语言与代码混合文本

patterns.name: 其他代码类型与 API 标识符
patterns.context: 类型、属性或 API 名称等代码标识符，未呈现比编程语境更统一的触发条件。

en.description: Activation samples are almost all from code or technical text, landing on identifier fragments, syntax punctuation, method/property access, length counts, and assertions; another sample is a LaTeX mathematical formula. There is insufficient evidence to identify a narrower common trigger condition.

patterns.name: Type/variable names and property chains in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in source code lines, often including object member access, method calls, parameters, and statement punctuation; no specific language is required
patterns.domain: Source code or code examples in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Counts, lengths, and assertions in code
patterns.context: Code expresses collection size using length or count and may check the result with an assertion or condition

patterns.name: Special syntax tokens and formatting structures in code
patterns.context: In source code, activation may fall on keywords, subword fragments of identifiers, punctuation, or line breaks and indentation; no single fixed syntax structure is evident
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple languages, test code, and code snippets

patterns.name: Symbols and operators in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Embedded in a LaTeX mathematical expression containing indexed variables, functions, and operators

patterns.name: Code-introduction context in developer forums
patterns.context: Forum text introduces a following code example; activations remain concentrated in definitions and length calculations in the example code

patterns.name: Natural-language documentation titles and type declarations
patterns.context: In Go source code, a documentation comment title is adjacent to a type declaration involving a slice and type name

patterns.name: Download logs and error branches in code
patterns.context: A conditional branch and logger.info formatted log call in an archive function

2_149.description: 激活样例几乎都来自代码或技术文本，落在标识符片段、语法标点、方法/属性访问、长度计数与断言等处；另有一段 LaTeX 数学公式。没有足够证据确定更窄的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的类型/变量名与属性链
patterns.trigger: 如「tvPageNum.setText」「isiWebView.getSettings().setJavaScriptEnabled」「button.frame」「self.source」「node.alternatives」；激活常落在标识符片段、点号及括号附近
patterns.context: 出现在源码代码行中，常包含对象成员访问、方法调用、参数和语句标点；不要求特定语言
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源码或代码示例

patterns.name: 代码中的计数、长度与断言
patterns.context: 代码用长度或计数表达集合大小，并可能通过断言或条件比较检查结果

patterns.name: 代码中的特殊语法 token 与格式结构
patterns.context: 在源码中，激活可落在关键词、标识符的子词片段、标点或换行缩进上；未显示单一固定语法结构
patterns.domain: 多语言源码、测试代码及代码片段

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号与算子
patterns.context: 嵌入 LaTeX 数学表达式，包含带下标的变量、函数与算子

patterns.name: 开发者论坛中的代码介绍语境
patterns.context: 论坛文字引出后续代码示例；激活主要仍集中在示例代码中的定义与长度计算

patterns.name: 自然语言文档标题与类型声明
patterns.context: Go 源码中，文档注释标题紧邻类型声明，且声明涉及切片与类型名
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 源码

patterns.name: 代码中下载日志及错误分支
patterns.context: 归档函数中的条件分支与 logger.info 格式化日志调用

en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of code and a mathematical formula: prominent log calls and their contents, method/function definitions, and pagination UI updates. There is also a formula for the cosine of a phase and the real part of a complex number; these have no clear common trigger feature.

patterns.name: Log calls and log content
patterns.context: Code calls a logging interface and passes a string, format placeholder, or variable; text about logging-related questions may also trigger.
patterns.domain: Objective-C, Python code, and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Method or function definitions in programming languages
patterns.context: Near class method or function definitions, commonly in object-oriented code; the passage may also contain other initialization or rendering logic.
patterns.domain: Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, and other code

patterns.name: Pagination UI and page number display
patterns.context: A method receives the current page and total page count, then updates page-control text or color.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression for complex phase and cosine
patterns.context: The formula writes the cosine of the sum of several phases as the real part of a product of complex numbers.

2_149.concept: 代码结构与日志相关 token
2_149.description: 激活见于多类代码和一段数学公式：突出日志调用及其内容、方法/函数定义，也覆盖分页界面更新；另有余弦相位与复数实部公式，彼此缺乏明确共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 日志调用与日志内容
patterns.context: 代码中调用日志接口并传入字符串、格式占位符或变量；日志相关问题文本也可能触发。

patterns.name: 编程语言中的方法或函数定义
patterns.context: 类方法或函数定义附近，常见于面向对象代码；片段中也可能含其他初始化或渲染逻辑。

patterns.name: 分页界面与页码显示
patterns.context: 方法接收当前页和总页数，并更新页面控件文本或颜色。

patterns.name: 复数相位与余弦的数学表达式
patterns.context: 公式中将多个相位之和的余弦写成复数乘积的实部。

en.description: Most spans activate on the word-initial substring «Ne», but the following words and domains vary widely; one span also activates on a period. A more specific shared semantic pattern cannot be determined from context.

patterns.name: Ne subword at the start of a sentence or word
patterns.context: The letter sequence Ne is at the activation site, usually at the beginning of a following full proper name or term; subsequent characters vary.
patterns.domain: Multidomain English corpora, including medicine, law, and news

patterns.name: Specific sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: A period appears after the phrase “Film thickness of die coating agents”, followed by a line break and a repetition of the phrase.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract titles or formatted text

2_258.description: 绝大多数片段激活在词首子串«Ne»，但其后词语与领域差异很大；另有一段激活句号。无法从上下文确定更具体的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首或词首的 Ne 子词
patterns.context: 字母串 Ne 位于激活位置，通常是后续完整专名或术语的开头；周围后续字符各异。
patterns.domain: 多领域英文语料，包括医学、法律、新闻等

patterns.name: 特定句末标点
patterns.context: 句号出现在短语“Film thickness of die coating agents”之后，接着换行并重复短语。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要标题或排版文本

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on the word-initial subword fragment “Ne”, in words including Madin, Nebraska, Neisseria, neurons, neurofilament, Neuropeptide, and Neuropathologically; one instance falls on the word-initial fragment of “Die”.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “Ne”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the first subword fragment of words beginning with Ne; subsequent word meanings and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Multidomain, primarily biomedicine, also law and general text

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “Die”
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “Die coating agents” as the beginning of the word Die; the following text discusses plaster models for dental restorations.

2_258.description: 激活主要集中在词首子词片段“Ne”，涵盖 Madin、Nebraska、Neisseria、neurons、neurofilament、Neuropeptide、Neuropathologically 等不同词；另有一次落在“Die”的词首。

patterns.name: 词首片段“Ne”
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Ne 开头的词的首个子词片段；后续词义和上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: 多领域，主要为生物医学，也见法律和一般文本

patterns.name: 词首片段“Die”
patterns.context: 出现在短语“Die coating agents”中，作为单词 Die 的开头；后文谈牙科修复用石膏模型。

en.concept: Mixed: mathematical symbols and local word forms
en.description: Strong activation is concentrated in algebra problems containing 102, operators, and instructions involving derivatives or expansions; activation also occurs in Mad-initial drug names, cell lines, and place names, and on process in a patent chemical-preparation context.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and differentiation exercises
patterns.context: Occurs in math problems involving polynomials, variables, powers, or derivative instructions; several math passages also contain “102” in a formula-number-like format
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra problems and differentiation exercises

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments beginning with Mad
patterns.context: Activation falls on the token “Mad” at the beginning of a proper name, followed respectively by “opar”, “in-Darby”, or “ras”; the contexts differ
patterns.domain: Biomedical drug/cell-line names and historical place names

patterns.name: Process terminology in patent chemistry text
patterns.context: A patent background passage discusses known methods for preparing compounds of a general formula, with nearby words including “formula” and “producing”

2_258.concept: 混合：数学符号与局部词形
2_258.description: 强激活主要集中于含102、运算符及导数或展开指令的代数题；另在Mad开头的药物、细胞系和地名中激活，并在专利化学制备语境的process上激活。

patterns.name: 数学符号与微分练习
patterns.context: 出现在多项式、变量、幂次或导数指令组成的数学题中；多个数学段还出现公式编号式的“102”
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，代数题及微分练习

patterns.name: Mad 开头的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名开头的 token“Mad”，后续分别接“opar”“in-Darby”或“ras”；语境并不相同
patterns.domain: 生物医学药物/细胞系名称及历史地名

patterns.name: 专利化学表述中的过程词
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，谈及制备通式化合物的已知方法，附近还有“formula”“producing”等词
patterns.domain: 专利、化学与法律技术文本

en.description: The digit string “102” appears and is marked in all passages. It can occur independently in mathematical expressions or as part of a longer number, name, or citation; other contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Digit string 102
patterns.context: The digit string 102 occurs; no specific syntax or neighboring words are required. In math problems it is often embedded in sequences, coefficients, or algebraic expressions; in other contexts it appears in patent numbers, experimental line names, or literature citations.
patterns.domain: Primarily DM Mathematics; also patent backgrounds, NIH biomedical text, and PubMed Central articles

2_258.description: 各段都出现并标记了数字串“102”，既可独立出现在数学表达式中，也可作为更长编号、名称或引用的一部分；其他上下文差异较大。

patterns.name: 数字串 102
patterns.context: 出现数字串 102；不要求特定句法或邻近词。数学题中常嵌在数列、系数或代数式里，其他语境中嵌在专利号、实验线名称或文献引用中。
patterns.domain: 主要为 DM Mathematics；也见于专利背景、NIH 生物医学文本和 PubMed Central 文献

en.concept: Word-internal fragments and heterogeneous text features
en.description: Activation is primarily associated with the Mad string fragment and the word-internal clim fragment in climatic/climates; there are also sporadic activations on numeric/alphanumeric strings and the phrase Neural network, as well as several annotations that are difficult to summarize.

patterns.name: Madras/Madr- place-name fragments
patterns.context: The trigger is the word-internal Mad string fragment; it occurs in Madras, Madzh…, Madop… ([3]), and Madagascar, among other continuations, and does not always refer to the same place.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in climatic
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-internal prefix fragment in climatic/climates; contexts discuss climate variables, seasons, or tropical climates.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Numeric/alphanumeric identifier fragments
patterns.context: Triggers within alphanumeric strings such as cell-line names or literature citations; local evidence is weak, so it is unclear whether they share a mechanism.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Neural network phrase
patterns.context: Triggers at the beginning of the phrase Neural network AI; no clear connection to the place-name or climatic fragments in other passages.

patterns.name: Other sporadic in-text highlights
patterns.context: These annotations appear near dosage/word strings in Madopar, Haskovo after a place name, and an article in election text; available context is insufficient to identify a distinct, stable trigger condition.

2_258.concept: 词内片段与异质文本特征
2_258.description: 主要对 Mad 字符串片段和 climatic/climates 的 clim 词内片段起反应；另有数字/字母数字串及 Neural network 短语的零散激活，还有若干难以归纳的标记。

patterns.name: Madras／Madr- 地名片段
patterns.context: 触发点是词内的 Mad 字符串片段；出现在 Madras、Madzh…、Madop…（[3]）和 Madagascar 等不同续接中，并非都指同一地点。

patterns.name: climatic 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 climatic/climates 的词内前缀片段；上下文讨论气候变量、季节或热带气候。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及 PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: 数字／字母数字标识符片段
patterns.context: 在细胞系名称或文献引用等字母数字串中触发；局部证据较弱，不能确定是否是同一机制。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: Neural network 短语
patterns.context: 触发于 Neural network AI 这一短语开头；与其他段落的地名或 climatic 片段无明显联系。

patterns.name: 文内其他零散高亮
patterns.context: 这些标记出现在 Madopar 附近的剂量/词串、地名后的 Haskovo，以及选举文本中的冠词；现有上下文不足以确定独立且稳定的触发条件。

en.description: The primary pattern is parsing-related word fragments beginning with Pars, found in Q&A, code, entries, and error logs; there are also the clim stem, formula commands, and multiple local activations in single passages that cannot all be grouped into one semantic class.

patterns.name: Parsing identifiers or words beginning with Par-
patterns.context: The trigger is a word or identifier fragment beginning with Pars, especially parsing/parser-related terms; it can occur in questions, code, error text, or category names.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, source code, software error messages, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Parsing-related parse word family
patterns.context: Forms of parse/parsing occur in identifiers or prose; in passage 7 it is part of a Java class name, in passage 4 it appears in SkipFlagParsing, and in passages 1 and 2 it appears as Parsing in questions.

patterns.name: clim- stem
patterns.context: The clim stem occurs in climate-related words concerning climate adaptation or climate factors.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Typesetting commands in formula environments and mathematical expressions; activation is distributed around formula symbols and commands.

patterns.name: Other local word fragments
patterns.context: These word fragments occur in ordinary biomedical discussion, with no clear shared morphological or semantic connection.

patterns.name: Command- and parameter-related words
patterns.context: Code comments describe command-line subcommands, how flags are parsed, and parameter handling; these appear in the same passage as the Pars word family, but the words themselves are also marked.

patterns.name: Category and person-classification terms
patterns.context: A category list in an encyclopedia entry includes birth years, people, and football-player categories; these occur near Pars in the same category entry.

patterns.name: Facebook SDK error fields
patterns.context: The SDK name, error code, and hexadecimal user-information field in an error message; these occur in the same passage as ParsedJSONResponseKey.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments with no shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: These occur in hierarchical descriptions, questions, or command-line error messages; aside from appearing in the same passage as Pars-initial words, no consistent condition is evident.

patterns.name: Formula fragments with no shared trigger pattern

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual natural language, legal and parliamentary texts, and code. Local patterns include the Italian word segments “iz” and “ries”, the Latvian “str”, the title/name fragment “ED”, as well as CSS properties, code identifiers, function names, and assembly registers; there is no single stable shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Romance-language “iz” stem
patterns.context: The trigger falls on a segment beginning with “iz” in Italian words, especially the noun “iniziativa” and inflected forms of the verb “analizzare”; the segment itself is marked as a split token.

patterns.name: Latvian “str” segment
patterns.context: Occurs inside the Latvian word “ izstrādā” (drafts, formulates), in formal statements about parliamentary bodies and treaties.

patterns.name: Italian “ries” segment
patterns.context: The segment “ries” is activated in inflected forms of the Italian verb “riuscire”; it appears in an academic book review and a chat conversation.

patterns.name: “ED” in a court title
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a U.S. court appeal case as the beginning of the name EDWARD; the title is in all caps.

patterns.name: right in code identifiers
patterns.context: Appears as a right-coordinate variable in a Java method parameter list; there is also CSS property «right»8 (6), but the two code contexts and uses differ.

patterns.name: CSS positioning property position
patterns.context: Used as a property name in a CSS declaration, followed by a colon and the value “absolute”; appears alongside positioning properties such as top, right, and bottom in the same passage.

patterns.name: puts in code
patterns.context: A puts function call that outputs a string in C/C++-style code; nearby are code comments and statements for thread joining and handler allocation.

patterns.name: Assembly register ah
patterns.context: The 8-bit register ah used as an operand in x86 assembly instructions; repeated in adjacent and, xor, and other instructions.

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax fragments in other code
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across Java method structures, code comments, and assembly opcodes; there is no clear shared local trigger word.

2_696.description: 激活分布在多语种自然语言及法律、议会文本和代码中。可见局部模式包括意大利语词段“iz”“ries”、拉脱维亚语“str”、标题人名“ED”，以及 CSS 属性、代码标识符、函数名和汇编寄存器；没有单一稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 罗曼语词干“iz”
patterns.context: 触发点落在意大利语词中以“iz”开头的词段，尤其是名词“iniziativa”和动词“analizzare”的屈折形式；词段本身被拆分标注。

patterns.context: 位于拉脱维亚语“ izstrādā”（拟定、制定）一词内部，出现在议会机构及条约的正式陈述中。

patterns.name: 意大利语“ries”词段

patterns.domain: 意大利语散文与网络聊天

patterns.name: 法院标题中的“ED”

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 right
patterns.context: 出现在 Java 方法参数列表中的 right 坐标变量；另有 CSS 属性 «right»8（6），但两处代码语境和用途不同。

patterns.name: CSS 定位属性 position

patterns.name: 其他代码中的标识符与语法片段
