en.description: Primarily activates on the ach substring within words across languages and genres; there are also localized strong activations on the assembly register ah, Polish ube, and Portuguese af. The latter cases may be incidental word fragments or code features.

patterns.name: ach substring across word boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs within complete words; it may be a stem or an in-word segment, while following letters and word meaning are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Cross-lingual natural language; parliamentary texts, email, forums, literature, and academic texts

patterns.name: Assembly register ah
patterns.context: Appears as a register name in x86 assembly code, in an instruction operand position.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Polish
patterns.context: Appears inside “ubezpieczenia” (insurance), surrounded by formal Polish text about medical treatment in member states.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in an African context
patterns.context: Appears in “africanas” and “desafios”, concerning intra-African trade and challenges, respectively.

2_696.description: 主要激活于单词内部的 ach 子串，横跨多语种与文体；另对汇编寄存器 ah、波兰语 ube、葡语 af 有局部强激活。后几类可能是偶然的词片段或代码特征。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 ach 子串
patterns.context: 在完整单词内部出现；可作为词干或词中片段，后续字母及词义并不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨语种自然语言；议会文本、邮件、论坛、文学及学术文本

patterns.name: 汇编寄存器 ah
patterns.context: x86 汇编代码中作为寄存器名出现，位于指令操作数位置。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“ubezpieczenia”（保险）一词内部，周围是波兰语关于成员国医疗待遇的正式表述。

patterns.name: 非洲语境词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“africanas”及“desafios”中，分别涉及非洲内部贸易和挑战。

en.concept: Local subword fragments and formal text markers
en.description: Activations occur on subword fragments in multilingual parliamentary text, court names and personal names in court headers, and local fragments in insurance, reviews, and business emails. There is no shared semantic trigger across corpora.

patterns.name: Continuation of tokenized “-ta/-ra” in European Parliament speeches
patterns.context: In multilingual European Parliament speech text, activations land on split subword fragments, especially word-final or intraword fragments; formal forms of address, policy content, or speech transitions often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, formal parliamentary speeches in French, Dutch, Italian, and other languages

patterns.name: OF / OF APPEALS in court names
patterns.context: A U.S. court document title or header prints the court level and name in uppercase; activations concentrate on fragments of the court name.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in insurance-related terms
patterns.context: A Polish sentence discusses the insurance scheme covering someone who works in another member state; the trigger fragment occurs in “ubezpieczenia” (insurance).
patterns.domain: EuroParl, social security / cross-border employment policy

patterns.name: “inc” in newspaper or war-reporting language
patterns.context: Italian academic or critical prose discusses a workplace becoming an information center and mentions the concerning “incidenza” (impact / incidence).

patterns.name: English word ending “ach” / achieve
patterns.context: A business email discusses the feasibility of an outsourcing model; the activation lands on the fragment at the start of “achievable.”

patterns.name: Initial ED- fragment in a name
patterns.context: A U.S. federal or state appellate court document prints a party’s name in uppercase; the activation lands on a name fragment beginning with ED.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, legal case headers and party names

2_696.concept: 局部词片段与正式文本标记
2_696.description: 激活分布于多语种议会文本的词片段、法院页眉中的法院名称与姓名，以及保险、评论和商业邮件中的局部词片段。跨语料没有统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言中的分词「-ta/-ra」续接
patterns.context: 多语种欧洲议会演讲正文中，激活落在被拆分的词片段上，尤其是词尾或词内片段；周围常有正式称呼、政策内容或讲话衔接。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，法语、荷兰语、意大利语等正式议会发言

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 OF / OF APPEALS
patterns.context: 美国法院文件的标题或页眉，以大写格式排印法院层级和名称；激活集中在法院名称片段。

patterns.name: 保险制度相关词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子谈及在另一成员国工作者的保险所属制度；触发片段位于「ubezpieczenia」（保险）一词中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，社会保障／跨境就业政策

patterns.name: 报刊或战争报道用语中的「inc」
patterns.context: 意大利语学术或评论性文字中，谈工作场所成为信息发布中心，并提及令人担忧的「incidenza」（影响／发生率）。

patterns.name: 英语词尾「ach」/ achieve
patterns.context: 商业邮件讨论外包模式的可行性，激活落在英语「achievable」词首的词片段。

patterns.name: 姓名中 ED- 的开头片段
patterns.context: 美国联邦或州上诉法院文件中，大写排印当事人姓名；激活落在以 ED 开头的姓名片段。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，法律案件页眉及当事人姓名

en.description: The first four passages share the English interjection “ugh,” with a few activations on common English words as well; the remaining passages are in Dutch, French, Italian, and Polish, with activations scattered across intraword fragments, function words, and punctuation. No clear, consistent cross-language semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: English conversational interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: A standalone interjection, often in forum replies or personal narratives; in passage 4 it is embedded in a quotation.

patterns.name: Common words and word boundaries in English phrases
patterns.context: Common words in continuous English text; trigger locations vary, including complete words and fragments adjoining surrounding text.

patterns.name: Dutch intraword fragments and word endings
patterns.context: Activations occur on intraword fragments, complete short words, and punctuation in Dutch political sentences.

patterns.name: French intraword fragments and grammatical connectives
patterns.context: Occurs in French political or parliamentary sentences; activations cover intraword fragments, common function words, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Italian intraword fragments
patterns.context: Activations mostly land on fragments within longer Italian words, as well as common short words.

patterns.name: Polish intraword fragments and inflectional markers
patterns.context: Occurs in Polish sentences, triggering intraword fragments and letter sequences related to inflection.

2_696.description: 前四段共同出现英语“ugh”感叹词，另有少量英语常见词激活；其余段落分属荷兰语、法语、意大利语、波兰语，激活散布于词内片段、功能词和标点，未见跨语种一致的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语口语感叹“ugh”
patterns.context: 独立感叹词，常出现在论坛回复或个人叙述中；第4段嵌在引语里。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛文本、个人博客

patterns.name: 英语短语中的常见词与词边界
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中的常见词；触发位置并不一致，既有完整词，也有与周围文本相接的词。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段与词尾
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语政治句子中的词内片段、完整短词及标点。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与语法连接词
patterns.context: 出现在法语政治或议会语句中，激活涵盖词内片段、常见功能词和标点。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活多落在意大利语较长词的内部片段，也包括常见短词。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 意大利语学术文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段与词形标记
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语句子中，触发词内片段以及词形变化相关的字母片段。

en.description: The clearest high-activation patterns are the expression of disgust “ugh” and complaint-related “rant”; other passages include fragments within French words in European Parliament text and one Spanish “ries,” alongside scattered English function words and punctuation that do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: A standalone interjection in comments or reposts, often in contexts of complaint, disappointment, or disgust; sometimes followed by the target of the evaluation or a reason.

patterns.name: Forms related to “rant”
patterns.context: The stem rant appears in contexts of complaint or criticism, including noun and verb forms and phrases in titles.

patterns.name: French intraword subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations land on subword fragments within French words in parliamentary speeches, debates, explanations, policy, and economic texts; the triggered fragments do not appear to share a clear pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish intraword subword fragment
patterns.context: An activation occurs on an intraword fragment in the Spanish word «riesgos»; the sentence discusses risks.

patterns.name: Scattered English function words and punctuation
patterns.context: These fragments are scattered across ordinary English sentences, punctuation, and line breaks; no stable shared semantic or contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: HackerNews posts and comments, Pile-CC book reviews

2_696.description: 最明确的高激活模式是表达嫌弃的“ugh”和抱怨相关的“rant”；另有多段欧盟议会文本中落在法语词内的片段及一处西语“ries”，以及分散的英语功能词和标点，后者难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: ugh 感叹
patterns.context: 作为评论或转帖中的独立感叹词，常出现在抱怨、失望、嫌弃的语境中；有时后接评价对象或理由。

patterns.name: rant 相关词形
patterns.context: 词干 rant 出现在抱怨或批评的语境中，包括名词、动词形式，以及标题中的短语。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词内部的子词片段，涉及议会发言、辩论、解释、政策与经济文本；触发片段彼此不明显统一。

patterns.name: 西语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在西语单词 «riesgos» 的词内片段，句子讨论风险。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语议会记录

patterns.name: 零散英语功能词与标点
patterns.context: 这些片段分散在普通英文句子及标点、换行中，未见稳定的共同语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖文与评论、Pile-CC 书评

en.description: Strong responses include the expression of disgust “ugh” in comments, but also occur on English function words, Italian and French subword fragments, and punctuation; these fragments alone do not indicate a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Interjection “ugh”
patterns.context: Used alone at the start after a comment divider, or in a quotation as a reaction of disgust or surprise; no specific topic is required.

patterns.name: English function words and common word fragments
patterns.context: In continuous English text, triggers occur in ordinary syntactic structures; no unified semantic pattern or fixed phrase is apparent.

patterns.name: English adverb ever
patterns.context: Appears in the superlative evaluation “pieces ... I ever read.”

patterns.name: Italian intraword fragments
patterns.context: Triggers land within Italian words or on common short words, with no apparent shared meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: French fragments and parliamentary formulas
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speeches, covering punctuation, forms of address, and intraword fragments; some fragments occur near applause markers and the presiding officer’s title.

2_696.concept: 多语言词片段与感叹词
2_696.description: 强响应包含评论中的厌恶感叹词“ugh”，但也分散触发于英语功能词、意大利语和法语词片段及标点；仅凭这些片段看不出统一语义。

patterns.name: ugh 感叹词
patterns.context: 单独作为评论分隔线后的开头或引述中的厌恶、惊讶反应；不要求特定主题

patterns.name: 英语功能词与常见词片段
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中，触发点分布在普通句法结构里；未见统一语义或固定短语
patterns.domain: 网络评论、法律文本、博客

patterns.name: 英语副词 ever
patterns.context: 出现在“pieces ... I ever read”这一最高级评价表达中

patterns.name: 意大利语内部词片段
patterns.context: 触发点落在意大利语词内部或常见短词上，未显示统一词义或句法位置

patterns.name: 法语词片段与议会套语
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，覆盖标点、称谓和词内片段；部分片段处在掌声标记及议长称呼附近

en.description: Activations occur across mathematical terminology, legal titles and narrative, multilingual European Parliament text, and conflict reporting. Many markers are intraword fragments or ordinary function words; apart from mathematical terminology, they do not form a unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: English Weyl / group theory terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical papers contain terms such as Weyl group, Heisenberg groups, or related representation theory terminology; activations sometimes land on subword fragments within terms.

patterns.name: Legal document title and fees
patterns.context: The legal document title “DECISION ON ATTORNEYS’ FEES,” especially its uppercase words and intraword fragments.

patterns.name: English function words and intraword fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary conjunctions, modal verbs, prepositions, articles, or sentence-final punctuation in English legal narrative; the fragments shown are insufficient to determine a specific syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Multilingual intraword subword fragments
patterns.context: Intraword fragments in Romance and Slavic languages, often within longer words; the triggered meanings and positions vary.

patterns.name: Common word fragments in European Parliament text
patterns.context: Short function words and initial fragments of longer words in French debate speeches.

patterns.name: English reporting on conflict or the Islamic State
patterns.context: News narratives about Syrian cities, conflict, and ISIL; activations include proper-name abbreviations, common words, and punctuation.

2_696.description: 激活分布于数学术语、法律标题及叙述、欧洲议会多语种文本和冲突新闻。许多标记是词内片段或普通功能词，除数学术语外难以归为统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 英语 Weyl / 群论术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现 Weyl group、Heisenberg groups 或相关表示论术语；激活有时落在术语内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与费用
patterns.context: 法律文件标题“DECISION ON ATTORNEYS’ FEES”，尤其是标题中的大写词及其词内片段。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及词内片段
patterns.context: 英语法律叙述中普通连接词、情态词、介词、冠词或句末标点；可见片段不足以确定具体句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语种词内子词片段
patterns.context: 罗曼语族及斯拉夫语族文本中的词内片段，常落在较长词语内部；触发词义和位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会文本中的常见词片段
patterns.context: 法语辩论发言中短功能词及较长词的开头片段。

patterns.name: 涉及冲突或伊斯兰国的英语报道
patterns.context: 报道叙利亚城市、冲突与 ISIL 的新闻叙述；激活包括专名缩写、普通词和标点。

en.description: Activations mostly land on letter fragments within words in different languages, often z/iz and adjacent characters; Italian iz/inizio and English inqui also appear. Samples are scattered across parliamentary and legal texts, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italian intraword iz/inizio
patterns.context: Activations occur in Italian words, especially forms such as iniziare and inizio meaning “to begin”; nearby text describes parliamentary procedure.

patterns.name: Multilingual intraword spelling fragments such as z/ž
patterns.context: Within words in Slovak, Slovenian, Latvian, Danish, Romanian, and other languages, activations land on z, iz, or adjacent letter fragments; there is no shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Italian intraword forms related to intensification / -ization
patterns.context: Activations occur inside Italian nouns, including modernamento and uguaglianza; there is only one instance, so it is unclear whether meaning or morphology triggers it.

patterns.name: English intraword inqui
patterns.context: An activation lands on the initial intraword fragment in English inquiry; the context concerns a formal investigation, but there are no repeated examples.

2_696.description: 激活多落在不同语言词内部的字母片段，常见 z/iz 及其邻近字符，也见意大利语 iz/inizio、英语 inqui；样本分散于议会与法律文本，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内 iz/inizio
patterns.context: 激活出现在意大利语词中，尤其是表示开始的 iniziare、inizio 一类形式；周围是议会发言中的程序叙述。

patterns.name: 多语种词内 z/ž 等拼写片段
patterns.context: 在斯洛伐克语、斯洛文尼亚语、拉脱维亚语、丹麦语、罗马尼亚语等词内部，激活落在 z、iz 或与其相邻的字母片段上；没有统一语义环境。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内强化/化类词形
patterns.context: 激活位于意大利语名词内部，涉及 modernamento、uguaglianza 等词；仅有单例，无法确认是否由词义或词形触发。

patterns.name: 英语词内 inqui
patterns.context: 激活位于英语 inquiry 一词开头的词内片段；上下文谈及正式调查，但缺乏重复例证。

en.description: Activations mostly land on short subword fragments within words across languages, including Central European z/az, Italian iz, Romanian ose, yl in Weyl, and ube in insurance-related terms. No unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments such as z/az in Central European languages
patterns.context: Occurs within Slovak, Czech, or Romanian words; there is no clear shared syntactic position.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments iz/ose
patterns.context: Within Romanian or Italian words.

patterns.name: yl in Weyl
patterns.context: The final part of the proper name Weyl in mathematical text.

patterns.name: UBE fragment in insurance-related terms
patterns.context: In words related to member-state health insurance, cross-border healthcare, or implementation of directives.

patterns.name: Other scattered intraword fragments
patterns.context: Within words across languages, with no shared semantic or syntactic condition.

2_696.description: 激活多落在多语种词语内部的短子词片段；包括中欧语 z/az、意大利语 iz、罗马尼亚语 ose、Weyl 的 yl及保险词 ube。未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: z/az 等中欧语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在斯洛伐克语、捷克语或罗马尼亚语词内部；没有明显统一的句法位置

patterns.name: iz/ose 词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语或意大利语单词内部

patterns.name: Weyl 中的 yl
patterns.context: 数学文本中专名 Weyl 的词尾部分

patterns.name: UBE 保险词片段
patterns.context: 与成员国医疗保险、跨境医疗或指令实施相关的词语中

patterns.name: 其他分散的词内片段
patterns.context: 各语种词语内部，未见共同语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及摘要

en.description: Activations are associated mainly with individual intraword fragments in different languages. “iz” recurs in Italian “iniziativa” and in Latvian and Slovenian words; the other fragments are scattered and do not share meanings.

patterns.name: Slovak “oz”
patterns.context: The Slovak word “označuje”; the activation occurs in a passage about the previous century.

patterns.name: Czech “z”
patterns.context: The Czech word “nezávislý” in a context of resolving conflicts according to rules.

patterns.name: “iz” in iniziativa
patterns.context: Occurs in a fragment of the word “iniziativa” in a discussion of the Commission and its initiative.

patterns.name: “iz” in other Slavic words
patterns.context: Parts of words meaning proposing proposals and production; they share no meaning with Italian “iniziativa”.

patterns.name: French “ions”
patterns.context: A French subjunctive form of the verb “avoir” in a sentence about unwanted events.

patterns.name: “ap” in “Neapolitan”
patterns.context: A fragment of a proper or derived name in a description of a musical work and dance.

patterns.name: “ir” in “irlandais”
patterns.context: Part of a language name in a discussion of Gaelic and interpretation.

patterns.name: “ose” in “deosebită”
patterns.context: Part of a Romanian adjective in an appeal to pay particular attention to problems.

2_696.description: Aktivácia sa viaže najmä na jednotlivé vnútroslovné fragmenty v rôznych jazykoch. „iz“ sa opakuje v talianskom „iniziativa“ aj v lotyšskom a slovinskom slove; ostatné fragmenty sú roztrúsené a ich významy sa nezhodujú.

patterns.name: Slovak „oz“
patterns.context: Slovak slovo „označuje“; aktivácia sa vyskytuje v úseku o minulom storočí.

patterns.name: České „z“
patterns.context: České slovo „nezávislý“ v kontexte riešenia konfliktov podľa pravidiel.

patterns.name: „iz“ v iniciatíve
patterns.context: Vyskytuje sa vo fragmente slova „iniziativa“ v diskusii o Komisii a jej iniciatíve.

patterns.name: „iz“ v iných slovanských slovách
patterns.context: Časti slov oznaczających opracowywanie propozycji oraz produkcję; brak wspólnego znaczenia z włoskim „iniziativa“.

patterns.name: Francuskie „ions“
patterns.context: Francúzsky podmieňovací tvar slovesa „avoir“ vo vete o nežiadaných udalostiach.

patterns.name: „ap“ v „Neapolitan“
patterns.context: Úsek vlastného/odvodeného názvu v opise hudobného diela a tanca.

patterns.name: „ir“ v „irlandais“
patterns.context: Časť názvu jazyka v diskusii o gaelčine a tlmočení.

patterns.name: „ose“ v „deosebită“
patterns.context: Časť rumunského prídavného mena vo výzve venovať osobitnú pozornosť problémom.

en.description: Most strong activations land on iz fragments within words across languages; there are also the musical term Neapolitan, scattered intraword fragments, and the answer label A. No stable semantic or syntactic connection is apparent among the scattered fragments.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment iz
patterns.context: Highlighted fragments occur inside words in different languages, often as part of an affix or stem in longer words; surrounding meanings and parts of speech vary.
patterns.domain: Primarily multilingual European Parliament text, also English legal and musical text.

patterns.name: Musical term Neapolitan
patterns.context: Occurs in the musical mode or form term Neapolitan; one instance discusses minuets and Italian dances, another introduces the Neapolitan Minor scale.

patterns.name: Other intraword fragments
patterns.context: Each is embedded in a different word, with no clearly shared meaning or syntactic condition; in passage 10, the two «a»4 instances are the Romanian preposition a.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or paragraph label A
patterns.context: A label for an answer in StackExchange Q&A, followed by a colon.

2_696.concept: 词内 iz 片段偏好
2_696.description: 多数强激活落在多语种词内的 iz 片段；另有 Neapolitan 音乐术语、零散词内片段及答案标签 A。零散片段间看不出稳定语义或句法联系。

patterns.name: 词内片段 iz
patterns.context: 高亮片段出现在不同语言词语内部，常见于较长词的词缀或词干部分；周围语义和词类并不固定。
patterns.domain: 以欧洲议会多语种文本为主，也见于英语法律文本和音乐文本。

patterns.name: 音乐术语 Neapolitan
patterns.context: 出现在音乐调式或曲式术语 Neapolitan 中；一处谈小步舞曲与意大利舞曲，一处介绍 Neapolitan Minor 音阶。

patterns.name: 其他词内碎片
patterns.context: 各自嵌在不同单词中，没有清楚可见的共同词义或句法条件；第 10 段两个 «a»4 位于罗马尼亚语介词 a。

patterns.name: 句首或段落标记 A
patterns.context: 作为 StackExchange 问答中答案的标签，后接冒号。

en.concept: Tokenized subword fragments in formal text
en.description: Primarily occurs in formal multilingual European Parliament text concerning policy, governance, legislation, and institutional affairs; activations often land on intraword fragments or short function words. Another passage is an English music entry, with activations on fragments in minor and Neapolitan.

patterns.name: European Parliament multilingual administrative, policy, and legislative text
patterns.context: Formal EU parliamentary discussion of EU institutions, resolutions, policy implementation, governance, finance, agriculture, or member-state affairs; activations often land on split intraword fragments, as well as short function words.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, multilingual formal political and administrative text

patterns.name: Music genres and dance names
patterns.context: Describes musical keys, movement structure, and music such as the Roman saltarello and Neapolitan tarantella.

2_696.concept: 正式文本中的切分词片段
2_696.description: 主要出现在多语种欧盟议会正式文本，涉及政策、治理、立法及机构事务，激活常落在词内片段或短功能词；另有一段英语音乐条目，激活于 minor 与 Neapolitan 的片段。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种行政、政策与立法文本
patterns.trigger: 多段在斯洛伐克语、拉脱维亚语、斯洛文尼亚语、意大利语、捷克语、罗马尼亚语、丹麦语中激活；包括词内的«iz»、«pr»、«dom»等片段，以及« a»、« na»、« do»等短词片段
patterns.context: 欧盟议会正式论述中，讨论欧盟机构、决议、政策执行、治理、财政、农业或成员国事务；激活常落在被切分的词内片段，也有短功能词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，多语种正式政治与行政文本

patterns.name: 音乐体裁与舞曲名称
patterns.context: 介绍小调、乐章结构及罗马盐塔雷洛舞和那不勒斯塔兰泰拉舞等音乐内容。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科，音乐描述

en.description: All examples contain the Apache 2.0 license’s “AS IS” disclaimer. “BASIS” shows especially consistent strong activation; paths, version numbers, and comment formatting also occur but have weaker effects.

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 disclaimer text
patterns.context: Fixed wording in the Apache License 2.0 disclaimer, with strongest activation around “BASIS” and the subsequent “WITHOUT WARRANTIES”; no specific comment marker or indentation is required.

patterns.name: License path and version number
patterns.context: Often appears alongside the disclaimer text; the path fragment itself shows some activation, but much less than “BASIS” in the text.
patterns.domain: GitHub file paths and license references

patterns.name: Comment formatting and layout
patterns.context: Appears when the license text is embedded in code comments or uses different formatting; these symbols activate weakly, and formatting changes do not prevent the text pattern from appearing.

2_778.description: 所有样例都含 Apache 2.0 许可证的“AS IS”免责声明，尤其“BASIS”稳定强激活；路径、版本号及注释排版伴随出现但作用较弱。

patterns.name: Apache 2.0 免责声明正文
patterns.trigger: “Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing”及“distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS”
patterns.context: Apache License 2.0 免责声明中的固定措辞，尤其在“BASIS”及后续“WITHOUT WARRANTIES”附近激活最强；不要求特定注释符或缩进。

patterns.name: 许可证路径与版本号
patterns.context: 常与免责声明正文并列出现；路径片段本身有一定激活，但强度远低于正文中的“BASIS”。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文件路径、许可证引用

patterns.name: 注释格式与排版
patterns.context: 许可证正文被嵌入代码注释或采用不同排版时出现；这些符号只弱激活，格式变化并未阻止正文模式。

en.description: All segments concern open-source software license disclaimers, especially “AS IS” and warranty disclaimers; most also contain a legal exception clause. Paths, versions, comment markers, and formatting vary by file; the second segment additionally mentions preserving license notices.

patterns.name: License disclaimer text
patterns.context: Appears in software license disclaimers, typically following “software distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS”, and listing warranty disclaimers.
patterns.domain: GitHub open-source license files (Apache License 2.0 style)

patterns.name: License legal-conditions clause
patterns.context: Legal exception conditions at the beginning of the disclaimer text, explaining that applicable law or a written agreement may provide an exception.

patterns.name: License file path and version
patterns.context: The context is a license file path or filename in a repository; it often co-occurs with the disclaimer text but is not itself a trigger phrase in the text.
patterns.domain: GitHub repository file paths and license metadata

patterns.name: Comment formatting and paragraph layout
patterns.context: The license text is placed in comments in different languages or formatted as plain text; these prefixes and line breaks vary by file format, while the core disclaimer remains the same.
patterns.domain: Source-code comments and plain-text license files

patterns.name: License notice reminder
patterns.context: Indicates that the license may appear below or be provided with the file, and requires preserving the license notice; found in only one segment, not as shared text across all segments.
patterns.domain: License and copyright notices in software file headers

2_778.description: 所有段均围绕开源软件许可证免责声明，尤其是“AS IS”及无担保条款；多数还含法律例外句。路径、版本、注释符和排版随文件而异；第2段另有保留许可通知的提示。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明正文
patterns.context: 出现在软件许可证的免责声明中，通常接续“software distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS”，并列出无担保条款。
patterns.domain: GitHub 开源许可证文件（Apache License 2.0 风格）

patterns.name: 许可证法律条件句
patterns.trigger: «Unless»« required»« by»« applicable»« law»« or» agreed to in «writing»
patterns.context: 免责声明正文开头的法律例外条件，说明适用法律要求或书面约定可能构成例外。
patterns.domain: GitHub 开源许可证法律文本

patterns.name: 许可证文件路径与版本
patterns.context: 上下文是仓库中的许可证文件路径或文件名；常与免责声明正文同现，但并非正文触发词。
patterns.domain: GitHub 仓库文件路径与许可证元数据

patterns.name: 注释格式与段落排版
patterns.context: 许可证正文被放在不同语言注释或纯文本排版中；这些前缀与换行随文件格式变化，核心免责声明仍相同。
patterns.domain: 源代码注释、纯文本许可证文件

patterns.name: 文件许可通知提示
patterns.trigger: «license»« below»、«license»« accompanying»« this»« file»、«Do»« not»« remove»« or»« modify»« any license»« notices»
patterns.context: 提示许可证可能在下方或随文件提供，并要求保留许可通知；只见于一段，未延续为各段共有正文。
patterns.domain: 软件文件头部的许可与版权通知

en.description: All samples come from Apache 2.0 license files on GitHub. The core triggers are “Unless required...” and fixed disclaimer wording such as AS IS and WITHOUT WARRANTIES; license paths, comment formatting, or a notice-preservation header often accompany them.

patterns.name: Apache license disclaimer text
patterns.context: The disclaimer paragraph in the license text beginning “Unless required...”, especially fixed phrases such as AS IS BASIS and WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS; usually preceded by Markdown, C++, or other comment markers
patterns.domain: GitHub open-source license files, especially Apache License 2.0

patterns.name: License file path and identifier
patterns.context: A file path or license identifier appearing adjacent to the license text; this cue often appears with the disclaimer paragraph

patterns.name: License file management note
patterns.context: Header text describing the license source or requiring retention of the license notice; occurs in the same context as the disclaimer text

2_778.description: 所有样本都来自 GitHub 的 Apache 2.0 许可证文件，核心触发是“Unless required...”及 AS IS、WITHOUT WARRANTIES 等固定免责声明；常伴随许可证路径、注释格式或保留声明的文件头。

patterns.name: Apache许可证免责声明正文
patterns.trigger: “Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing”以及“distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”
patterns.context: 许可证文本中以“Unless required...”开头的免责声明段落，尤其是 AS IS BASIS 与 WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS 等固定措辞；通常带有 Markdown、C++ 或其他注释前缀
patterns.domain: GitHub 开源许可证文件，尤其 Apache License 2.0

patterns.name: 许可证文件路径与标识
patterns.context: 紧邻许可证正文出现的文件路径或许可证标识；该线索常与免责声明段落一起出现
patterns.domain: GitHub 仓库中的许可证文件

patterns.name: 许可证文件管理说明
patterns.trigger: “license below”“license accompanying this file”及“Do not remove or modify any license notices”
patterns.context: 说明许可证来源或要求保留许可证声明的文件头文字；与正文免责声明同处一段上下文

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the “as-is” distribution and warranty disclaimer in Apache-2.0-style licenses; paths, comment markers, and formatting vary. Two other examples—literary statements about fate and a clinical home-rehabilitation context—cannot be explained by the license pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in license disclaimers
patterns.context: The neuron responds strongly to this license disclaimer, especially “the License”, “BASIS”, and the latter part of the disclaimer; license file paths, line breaks, and comment markers often precede it.
patterns.domain: License files or source-code comments in GitHub software repositories, mainly Apache-2.0-style legal text.

patterns.name: Use of destiny in Homeric works
patterns.context: After the title “Homeric prayer”, the text discusses humanity’s indirect control over fate in Homeric works; strong activation is concentrated on “the”.

patterns.name: Home-rehabilitation context in a medical paper
patterns.context: In the Background section of a medical paper, describes the benefits of early supported discharge and ongoing rehabilitation at home; strong activation occurs on “the”.

2_778.description: 主要对 Apache-2.0 风格许可证中的“按现状”分发及无担保免责声明强烈响应，路径、注释符和排版可变。另有文学命运表述与临床居家康复背景两例，均无法由许可证模式解释。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明固定措辞
patterns.trigger: “Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS”
patterns.context: 该神经元在这段许可证免责声明中强烈响应，尤其是 “the License”、“BASIS” 和免责声明后半句；前面常有许可证文件路径、换行及注释符。
patterns.domain: GitHub 软件仓库中的许可证文件或源代码注释，主要是 Apache-2.0 风格法律文本。

patterns.name: 荷马作品中的 destiny 表述
patterns.trigger: “In the Homeric works humans indirectly control their destiny”
patterns.context: 标题为 “Homeric prayer” 后，正文谈及荷马作品中人类对命运的间接控制；强激活集中在 “the”。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式文学或古典学说明。

patterns.name: 医学论文的居家康复背景
patterns.trigger: “Early supported discharge (ESD) with continued rehabilitation in the home”
patterns.context: 医学论文 Background 段落中，描述早期支持性出院及居家持续康复的益处；强激活出现在 “the”。

en.description: All segments are repeated text near version 2.0 license disclaimers on GitHub: after the path and version identifier, they first state legal or written-agreement exceptions, then provide the software “as is” with no warranty; comment markers vary by file format.

patterns.name: License disclaimer phrase
patterns.context: Appears in software license text, especially the disclaimer “distributed … on an ‘AS IS’ BASIS”; BASIS is the strongest activation point in the phrase.
patterns.domain: GitHub software license legal text (mostly license disclaimers)

patterns.name: Disclaimer warranty clause
patterns.context: Immediately follows “AS IS BASIS” and lists warranties or conditions that are not provided; this clause appears in every segment.

patterns.name: License file path and version
patterns.context: The file path and version identifier at the beginning of the license text; some segments have a period before the path, and path formatting varies slightly.

patterns.name: Legal exception conditions
patterns.context: Exception conditions preceding the disclaimer, stating that applicable law or a written agreement may provide an exception.

patterns.name: Comment-format markers
patterns.context: The same license text is formatted in different repositories as a Markdown heading, comment lines, or plain text; these markers appear alongside the text.

2_778.description: 所有片段均为 GitHub 上 2.0 版许可证免责声明附近的重复文本：路径与版本标识之后，先写法律或书面约定例外，再写“按现状”提供及不作担保；注释符号随文件格式变化。

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明短语
patterns.context: 出现在软件许可文本中，尤其是“distributed … on an ‘AS IS’ BASIS”这一免责声明；短语中的 BASIS 是最强激活处。
patterns.domain: GitHub 软件许可证法律文本（多为许可证免责声明）

patterns.name: 免责声明的无担保条款
patterns.context: 紧接“AS IS BASIS”之后，列明不提供担保或条件；各段均出现这一条款。
patterns.domain: GitHub 软件许可证法律文本

patterns.name: 许可证文件路径与版本
patterns.context: 许可证文本开头的文件路径和版本标识；部分段落路径前有点号，路径写法略有差异。

patterns.name: 法律例外条件
patterns.trigger: Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing
patterns.context: 免责声明之前的例外条件，说明法律要求或书面约定时可能例外。

patterns.name: 注释格式标记
patterns.context: 同一许可证正文被不同仓库格式化为 Markdown 标题、注释行或纯文本；这些标记与正文并列出现。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的许可证排版

en.concept: Specific string fragments and code markers
en.description: Activation centers on the string fragment “eenth”, which occurs in ordinal numbers; another clear pattern is “<!” in HTML declarations. There are also isolated responses to the name “James” in a legal citation and “eighteenth” in a boundary description.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in “nineteenth”
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinal numbers, especially “Seventeenth Judicial Circuit” and “mid-nineteenth century”; activation centers on the “eenth” fragment and does not depend on specific sentence meaning.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia entries, and general discussion

patterns.name: HTML document declaration prefix
patterns.context: In GitHub code, immediately precedes “DOCTYPE”; an HTML document type declaration follows.

patterns.name: “James” in a name
patterns.context: At the beginning of a person’s name in a legal case citation, followed by the uppercase surname “HEATH”.

patterns.name: “eighteenth” in a boundary description
patterns.context: An ordinal street name marks a boundary in a legal property description; the same passage also includes directions, distances, and a waterline description.

2_778.concept: 特定字符串片段与代码标记
2_778.description: 激活以字符串片段“eenth”为主，在序数词中出现；另一明显模式是 HTML 声明的“<!”。此外，单独响应法律引文人名“James”及界址描述中的“eighteenth”。

patterns.name: “nineteenth”中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在序数词中，尤其是“Seventeenth Judicial Circuit”和“mid-nineteenth century”；激活集中于“eenth”片段，不要求特定句意。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科条目及一般讨论

patterns.name: HTML 文档声明前缀
patterns.context: GitHub 代码中，紧邻“DOCTYPE”；其后有 HTML 文档类型声明。

patterns.name: 姓名中的“James”
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中，作为人名开头，后接大写姓氏“HEATH”。

patterns.name: 界址描述中的“eighteenth”
patterns.context: 地产法律描述中，以街道序数标示边界；同段还出现方位、距离和水位线描述。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on the word-internal fragments -eenth and -less, and also occurs in various legal-text formats and specific terms; other examples concern property, politics, economic history, and encyclopedia lists, with dispersed topics.

patterns.name: -eenth ordinal fragment
patterns.context: A split ordinal suffix within a word; the surrounding context often includes centuries or dates
patterns.domain: Legal documents, historical discussion, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: -less ending
patterns.context: A word-internal suffix that forms adjectives or nouns; meanings concern lacking something, being unfounded, or being useless

patterns.name: Legal appellate document format
patterns.context: Standard heading, case number, and jurisdiction formatting in formal decisions or appellate case records

patterns.name: Land development and terrain alteration
patterns.context: Describes developers leveling land, clearing vegetation, and changing drainage; also mentions market demand for flat lots

patterns.name: Unfounded appeal
patterns.context: Discusses a legal rule allowing appeals from non-final orders and says safeguards can prevent unfounded appeals

patterns.name: Legal lease relationship and party changes
patterns.context: Describes a commercial lease and changes in landlord identity and lease amendments

patterns.name: Statute and defamation exception
patterns.context: Cites a statute describing conditions for closed meetings and avoiding damage to a person’s reputation

patterns.name: Crime and political-organization allegations
patterns.context: Reports that lawless acts continue to be committed by a security group associated with the ruling party

patterns.name: Excessive borrowing and home buying
patterns.context: Uses borrowing to buy an old house as an example, contrasting it with investing in business projects that create jobs

patterns.name: Capitalism and leisure time
patterns.context: Discusses reduced free time alongside rising income and compares working hours in the nineteenth century

patterns.name: Encyclopedia disambiguation list
patterns.context: Lists senses of names, organizations, publishing brands, and digital collections item by item

2_778.concept: 词内后缀及法律文本片段
2_778.description: 激活主要落在词内 -eenth 与 -less 片段，也出现在多种法律文本格式和特定术语中；其余例子涉及地产、政治、经济史及百科列表，主题分散。

patterns.name: -eenth 序数词片段
patterns.context: 词内被拆分的序数词后缀；周围常有世纪或日期等上下文
patterns.domain: 法律文书、历史论述、百科条目

patterns.name: -less 词尾
patterns.context: 词内后缀，形成形容词或名词；语义涉及缺乏某物、无根据或无用

patterns.name: 法律上诉文书格式
patterns.trigger: “Appeal from the Circuit Court”“Appellees”“No. 4D…”及法院、县名
patterns.context: 正式判决或上诉案卷的固定标题、案号和管辖地格式

patterns.name: 土地开发与地形改变
patterns.trigger: “sell plots of land”“flatten the site”“eliminate the vegetation”“drainage patterns”
patterns.context: 描述开发商整平土地、清除植被及改变排水；并提及市场对平坦地块的需求

patterns.name: 无根据的上诉
patterns.context: 讨论允许对非终局命令上诉的法律规则，并称保障措施可防止无根据上诉

patterns.name: 法律租赁关系与当事人变更
patterns.context: 叙述商业租约及房东身份变更、租约修订

patterns.name: 法律条文及名誉损害例外
patterns.context: 引用法规，说明闭门会议及避免损害个人名誉的条件

patterns.name: 犯罪与政治组织指控
patterns.context: 报道执政党关联的治安团体继续实施违法行为

patterns.name: 过度借贷与购房
patterns.context: 以借款买老房为例，对比投资企业项目创造就业

patterns.name: 资本主义与休闲时间
patterns.trigger: “abundance of leisure”“capitalism raised their incomes”“working hours”
patterns.context: 讨论收入提高伴随时间减少，并比较十九世纪工作时长

patterns.name: 百科消歧列表
patterns.trigger: “East Calhoun Community Organization”“Ecco Press”“ECCO”“Eighteenth Century Collections Online”
patterns.context: 逐项列举名称、组织、出版品牌和数字馆藏的释义

en.description: All segments mark the spelling fragment “und”, appearing in different word forms or proper names; the trigger does not depend on a shared meaning or style. Other marked words show no consistent shared condition.

patterns.name: unbundling
patterns.context: Appears in electricity regulation provisions describing rate unbundling requirements.
patterns.domain: Energy policy, contracts, or regulatory text

patterns.name: unfunded
patterns.context: Appears when describing tasks, research, or projects that lack funding.

patterns.name: inundated
patterns.context: Means overwhelmed by information or flooded; used for a flood of television content and for water inundating a settlement.

patterns.name: und in legal vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in legal discussion referring to redundant hours or improper delay.

patterns.name: Proper names containing und
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in a person’s or place’s name and does not reflect an obvious shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, email recipients, historical encyclopedia

2_778.description: 所有段都标出拼写片段“und”，位于不同词形或专名中；触发不依赖统一语义或文体。其他标记词未显示一致的共同条件。

patterns.name: unbundling
patterns.context: 出现在电力监管条款中，描述费率分拆要求。
patterns.domain: 能源政策、合同或监管文本

patterns.name: unfunded
patterns.context: 出现在描述未获资金支持的任务、研究或项目时。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、医疗研究资助

patterns.name: inundated
patterns.context: 表示被大量信息或水淹没；分别用于电视内容涌入和水位淹没聚落。

patterns.name: 法律词汇中的 und
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述中，指冗余工时或不当延误。

patterns.name: 含 und 的专名
patterns.context: 触发位置属于人名或地名，不体现明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、邮件收件人、历史百科

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the judicial title “Justice” in U.S. legal texts, including combinations with names, the title Chief Justice, and opinion attributions; contexts include quoted views, judicial opinions, and signatures.

patterns.name: Judicial title
patterns.context: Appears before or after a judge’s name, commonly in judicial opinion signatures, introductions of opinion authors, or quotations of a judge’s views.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal opinions

2_778.description: 激活集中出现在美国法律文本中的法官头衔“Justice”，包括其与姓名、首席法官头衔及意见署名的组合；上下文涵盖引述观点、裁判意见和署名。

patterns.name: 法官头衔
patterns.context: 出现在法官姓名之前或之后，常见于裁判意见署名、意见作者介绍或引述法官观点处。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律意见

en.concept: Judge names and the title Justice
en.description: This neuron responds strongly to the forms surrounding judges’ titles and names in various court decisions, especially a judge’s name before Justice; the material includes decision text, signatures, and opinion letterhead.

patterns.name: Name preceding the title Justice
patterns.context: A judge’s name and the title Justice appear in a legal opinion or decision; the name may precede the title or act as a possessive modifier

2_778.concept: 法官姓名与 Justice 职衔
2_778.description: 该神经元在各类法院判决中对法官称谓及其姓名周边结构强烈激活，尤其是 Justice 前的法官姓名；材料涵盖判决正文、署名和意见书版头。

patterns.name: Justice 职衔前的姓名
patterns.trigger: “Justice»10”，以及前面的法官姓名，如“Justice Hunter”“Justice LONG”“Justice TUNKS”“Justice Clifford's”
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决文本中出现法官姓名与 Justice 职衔；姓名可在职衔前，也可作为所有格修饰词

en.concept: Judicial personnel and document structure in court decisions
en.description: Strongly responds to the title Justice and judges’ names, opinion authorship, and panel information in court decisions; also responds to counsel, legal roles and institutional details, decision titles, dates, and formatting. One example also discusses damages.

patterns.name: Justice title and name
patterns.context: Appears in judicial opinion signatures, panel lists, or indications of participation in an opinion; often adjacent to a judge’s name and terms such as delivered, concurred, or took no part.

patterns.name: Opinion authorship and panel information
patterns.context: Indicates which judge authored an opinion and whether other judges concurred or participated; this pattern occurs alongside judicial titles and names.

patterns.name: Counsel for parties and representation labels
patterns.context: After an attorney’s or law firm’s name, role, and location, identifies the party represented; common in attorney lists at the beginning of decisions.

patterns.name: Attorneys, law firms, and prosecution/defense roles
patterns.context: Appears near an attorney’s name or legal institution, indicating a legal role or affiliation.
patterns.domain: Legal personnel lists and case information

patterns.name: Court opinion layout and headings
patterns.context: Headings, case numbers, dates, rulings, or separate-opinion formatting on decision pages; frequent line breaks and blank space may occur.

patterns.name: Courts, prosecutors’ offices, and office addresses
patterns.context: Institution names appear alongside locations, floor numbers, or address information as personnel or institutional contact details.

patterns.name: Legal discussion of compensation and punishment
patterns.context: Discusses compensatory damages and punitive effects, the court’s authority, and judicial control; not an attorney list or decision-signature format.

patterns.name: Large blank spaces and layout filler
patterns.context: Blank space and divider lines around judge lists, signatures, or opinion headings; may reflect formatting rather than semantic content.

2_778.concept: 法律判决中的司法人员与文书结构
2_778.description: 强烈响应法律判决中的Justice称谓及法官姓名、意见撰写和合议庭信息；也响应律师代理方、法律职务与机构资料、判决标题日期和版式。另见一处赔偿论述。

patterns.name: Justice 职衔及姓名
patterns.context: 出现在司法意见的署名、合议庭名单或意见参与情况中；常与法官姓名、delivered、concurred、took no part 等相邻。

patterns.name: 意见撰写与合议庭信息
patterns.context: 说明哪位法官撰写意见、其他法官是否赞同或参与；该模式与法官称谓及姓名共同出现。

patterns.name: 案件当事方律师及代理标注
patterns.context: 律师或律所姓名、职务与地点后，标明其代表的诉讼一方；常见于判决开头的律师名单。

patterns.name: 律师、律所及公诉辩护职务
patterns.context: 出现在律师姓名或法律机构名称附近，标示法律职务或所属单位。
patterns.domain: 法律人员名录与判决案头信息

patterns.name: 法院意见版式与标题
patterns.context: 判决页面的标题、案号、日期、裁判结果或独立意见版式；大量换行和留白可能伴随出现。

patterns.name: 法院、检察机关及办公地址
patterns.trigger: «Cuyahoga County Prosecutor»、«The Justice Center»、«8th Floor»、«1200 Ontario»
patterns.context: 机构名称与地点、楼层或地址信息并列，属于人员或机构联系资料。

patterns.name: 赔偿与惩罚的法律论述
patterns.trigger: «capacity to inject punishment under the guise of a compensatory award»
patterns.context: 讨论补偿性赔偿与惩罚性效果、法院权限及司法控制；不是律师名单或判决署名格式。

patterns.name: 大段空白及排版填充
patterns.context: 法官名单、署名或意见标题周围的版式留白和分隔线；可能反映格式而非语义内容。

en.description: Activation primarily occurs on Justice in legal contexts (a judicial title or institution name) and the fixed phrase “Suffice it to say” in decisions; consumer-protection complaint terminology also appears.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears in court-opinion sentences discussing evidence or case procedure; “it” in the phrase activates most strongly

patterns.name: Justice title
patterns.context: Appears as a judicial title or position; activation is concentrated on Justice
patterns.domain: Court opinions, legal decisions, and related judicial texts

patterns.name: Justice department name in legal documents
patterns.context: Justice appears in a government attorney’s signature or an institution name

patterns.name: Justice Center institution name
patterns.context: Appears in the header or address of a county prosecutor’s document

patterns.name: Criminal justice terminology
patterns.context: Appears alongside offenders, intervention programs, and judicial institutions as a policy or research field term

patterns.name: Other isolated triggers in legal documents
patterns.context: Claims and damages language in a consumer-protection complaint; no clear connection to Justice or fixed judicial wording

2_778.concept: 法律语境中的 Justice/司法措辞
2_778.description: 激活主要落在法律语境的 Justice（法官职衔或司法机构名称）及判决中的固定短语 “Suffice it to say”；另有消费者保护诉状术语。

patterns.name: 司法意见固定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见讨论证据或案件程序的句子中，短语中的 “it” 激活最强

patterns.name: Justice 职衔
patterns.context: 作为法官职衔或司法职位名称出现；激活集中在 Justice
patterns.domain: 法院意见、法律判决及相关司法文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 Justice 部门名称
patterns.context: 政府律师署名或机构名称中出现 Justice

patterns.name: Justice Center 机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在县检察官文件的页眉或机构地址中

patterns.name: 刑事司法术语
patterns.context: 与犯罪者、干预项目及司法机构并列，作为政策或研究领域术语出现

patterns.name: 法律文书中其他孤立触发
patterns.context: 消费者保护诉状的请求与损害赔偿表述；未见与 Justice 或固定司法措辞的明确联系

en.concept: ertain fragment and sporadic legal words
en.description: Primarily responds to the ertain fragment: common at the beginning of a sentence as Certain, and also found in uncertain mid-sentence. Justice and treble also have isolated strong activations in legal texts, with no clear connection to the main pattern in the examples.

patterns.name: “ertain” fragment
patterns.context: Begins a new sentence or paragraph as Certain, or appears in uncertain mid-sentence; the former often occurs at the start of a patent paragraph after a line break
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, encyclopedias, emails, legal documents

patterns.name: “Justice” in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in the institution name “The Justice Center” in a prosecutor’s signature block

patterns.name: Legal damages term “treble”
patterns.context: Occurs with damages in a consumer-protection complaint’s damages claim

2_778.concept: ertain 词段及零散法律词
2_778.description: 主要响应 ertain 词段：常见于段首 Certain，也见于句中 uncertain。另有法律文本中的 Justice 和 treble 两个孤立强激活，无法从例子确认与主模式的联系。

patterns.name: “ertain”词段
patterns.context: 以 Certain 开启新句或段落，或在句中出现 uncertain；前者多在换行后的专利段落开头
patterns.domain: 专利背景、百科、邮件、法律文书

patterns.name: 法律文书中的“Justice”
patterns.context: 出现在检察官签名栏中的机构名称“The Justice Center”

patterns.name: 法律赔偿术语“treble”
patterns.context: 与 damages 连用，出现在消费者保护法诉状的赔偿请求中

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to LEGAL in legal names and the lower substring in slower; it also has sporadic activations on name, English, and German word fragments, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: LEGAL legal fragment
patterns.context: Appears in legal institution names or legal document titles; capitalization varies
patterns.domain: Legal documents, legal agreements, and institution names

patterns.name: lower in slower
patterns.context: The consecutive substring lower in slower is marked; contexts involve speed, performance, or a slower recovery process

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments
patterns.context: Fragments embedded in names, common words, or German word forms; no consistent semantic or contextual condition is evident
patterns.domain: Legal texts, technology discussions, email subjects, Q&A, and German parliamentary remarks

2_778.description: 主要对法律名称中的 LEGAL 和 slower 中的 lower 子串强烈响应；此外零散激活姓名、英语及德语词内片段，未呈现统一语义条件。

patterns.name: LEGAL 法律词片
patterns.context: 出现在法律机构名称或法律文书标题中；大小写形式不同
patterns.domain: 法律文书、法律协议及机构名称

patterns.name: slower 中的 lower
patterns.context: 词语 slower 中 lower 这一连续子串被标记；语境涉及速度、性能或恢复进程较慢

patterns.name: 其他词内片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在姓名、普通词或德语词形中；未见一致的语义或上下文条件
patterns.domain: 法律文本、科技讨论、邮件标题、问答及德语议会发言

en.description: Activations are distributed across punctuation, line breaks, and within-word fragments, spanning code prompts, email business fields and names, technical comparisons, legal/contract formatting, and German parliamentary language. Some cluster around structural boundaries or proper nouns, but the triggers and styles vary considerably, making them difficult to attribute to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: String/punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on punctuation and line breaks in code, emails, or body text; some punctuation marks occur at string or field boundaries.

patterns.name: English word-internal suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations cover subword fragments inside names or uppercase business names, often in proper nouns, institution names, or transaction records.
patterns.domain: Enron business emails, names, and entities

patterns.name: Email transaction fields and formatting
patterns.context: Email subjects, line breaks, and fields such as counterparty/credit status; activations involve both formatting markers and business terms.

patterns.name: Grammatical connectors and comparative expressions
patterns.context: When discussing technical solutions and their performance, appearance, or speed, activations fall on connectors, degree/comparative words, punctuation, and word-final fragments.

patterns.name: Legal document layout and judicial language
patterns.context: Activations occur in headings, citations, judicial titles, and formatting line breaks in court opinions or decisions.

patterns.name: Keith fragment in proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in the name Keith; found in both contract-party/personnel lists and judge-name positions.

patterns.name: Contract clauses and numbering
patterns.context: In formal contract text about dates, clause numbers, termination clauses, and meeting background, activations involve time/clause words and punctuation.

patterns.name: German parliamentary titles and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In German parliamentary remarks, activations fall on legislators’ titles, adjectives, and fragments within compounds or inflected forms.

patterns.name: Game victory prompt
patterns.context: A popup string in code expresses that the player has won; activation also occurs on sentence-final punctuation in the same passage.

2_778.description: 激活分散于标点、换行和词内片段：覆盖代码提示、邮件业务字段与姓名、技术比较表达、法律/合同格式及德语议会用语。部分共同落在结构边界或专名上，但触发词与文体差异明显，难归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 字符串/标点边界
patterns.context: 激活落在代码、邮件或正文中的标点与换行处；其中有些标点位于字符串或字段边界。

patterns.name: 英文词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖姓名或大写业务名称内部的子词片段，常位于专名、机构名或交易记录中。
patterns.domain: Enron 商务邮件、姓名及实体

patterns.name: 邮件交易字段与格式
patterns.context: 邮件主题、换行及交易对手/信用状态等字段；激活同时涉及格式标记和业务术语。

patterns.name: 语法连接词与比较表达
patterns.context: 讨论技术方案及其性能、观感或速度时，落在连接词、程度/比较词、标点以及词尾片段上。

patterns.name: 法律文书版式与裁判用语
patterns.context: 法院意见或判决文书中，标题、引注、法官头衔及排版换行处出现激活。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Keith 片段
patterns.context: 在姓名 Keith 中出现；分别位于合同当事人/人员名单和法官姓名位置。

patterns.name: 合同条款与编号
patterns.context: 日期、条款编号、终止条款和会议背景等正式合同文本中，激活涉及时间/条款词及标点。

patterns.name: 德语议会称谓及词内片段
patterns.context: 德语议会发言中，落在议员称谓、形容词及复合词/词形内部片段。

patterns.name: 游戏胜利提示
patterns.context: 代码中的弹窗字符串，表达玩家获胜；同段还在语句结束标点处激活。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on the “ith” fragment in Keith; others include “rew” in Shrewsbury/Shrewdness, “ales” in resales, “Rich” in Richter, and fragments in rating numbers and Seek, with no unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: “ith” fragment in Keith
patterns.context: The name Keith is segmented, and activation falls on the latter part of the name; commonly occurs in contexts where names appear in legal documents, emails, or signatures.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, business emails, web text

patterns.name: “rew” fragment in Shrew forms
patterns.context: Appears in the place name Shrewsbury or the book title Shrewdness, in both cases as a within-word fragment.

patterns.name: “ales” fragment in resales
patterns.context: Appears as the word-final part of resales in real estate news.

patterns.name: “Rich” fragment in Richter
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the name Richter, surrounded by information about transaction discrepancies and counterparties.

patterns.name: Highlighted numbers and asterisk formatting
patterns.context: Appears in review text with star ratings; highlighted numbers and punctuation are embedded in the rating format.

patterns.name: “ek” fragment in seek
patterns.context: Appears within the title Seek and Find as part of a catalog heading.

patterns.name: Rich-related fragment before “ter” in Richter
patterns.context: The highlighted fragment may reflect a response to a spelling fragment in Richter; evidence is weaker than for other within-name fragments.
patterns.domain: Names and transaction records in emails

2_778.description: 多数强激活落在 Keith 的“ith”片段；另有 Shrewsbury/Shrewdness 的“rew”、resales 的“ales”、Richter 的“Rich”，以及评分数字和 Seek 的词内片段，未见统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: Keith中的“ith”片段
patterns.context: 人名 Keith 被拆分后，激活落在名字后半部分；多为法律文书、邮件或署名等人名出现的语境。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、商务邮件、网页文本

patterns.name: Shrew词形中的“rew”片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Shrewsbury 地名或 Shrewdness 书名中，均是词内部的片段。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、书目目录

patterns.name: resales中的“ales”片段
patterns.context: 出现在房地产新闻中，作为 resales 的词尾部分。

patterns.name: Richter中的“Rich”片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Richter 的开头部分，周围是交易差异与交易对手信息。

patterns.name: 高亮数字与星号格式
patterns.context: 出现在带星级评分的评论文本中；高亮数字和标点嵌在评分格式内。

patterns.name: seek中的“ek”片段
patterns.context: 出现在书名 Seek and Find 的词内部，作为目录标题的一部分。

patterns.name: Richter中“ter”前的Rich相关词段
patterns.context: 该高亮片段可能反映对 Richter 拼写片段的响应；与其他人名内部片段的证据较弱。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的姓名与交易记录

en.description: High activations fall on highly disparate within-word fragments: rew, red, ales, the surname fragment erz, ing, and ary; the corpora and contexts also vary, making it difficult to group them under one semantic or stable word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word suffix “rew”
patterns.context: The triggering fragment is split by tokenization and occurs in the place name Shrewsbury.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “rew”
patterns.context: The triggering fragment appears in the book title Shrewdness, marked as a split token.

patterns.name: Word-final “red”
patterns.context: Appears in the word starred in a book-review quotation; the within-word substring is marked.

patterns.name: Word-final “ales”
patterns.context: Appears in discussion of apartment resales in the real estate market.

patterns.name: Surname fragment “erz”
patterns.context: The name Sw erz bin is marked as split; it recurs in the same email corpus.

patterns.name: “ing” in a name
patterns.context: Appears in the basketball player’s surname Swing.

patterns.name: Word-final “red”
patterns.context: Appears in an account of an actor performing with George Clooney.

patterns.name: Word-final “ary”
patterns.context: Appears in a formal description of materials and procedures required by traffic regulations.

2_778.description: 高激活落在彼此差异很大的词内片段上：rew、red、ales、姓氏片段erz、ing及ary；语料和语境也各不相同，难以归并为单一语义或稳定词形模式。

patterns.name: 词内后缀“rew”
patterns.context: 触发片段被分词拆开，位于地名 Shrewsbury 中。

patterns.name: 词内片段“rew”
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在书名 Shrewdness 内，词被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 词尾“red”
patterns.context: 出现在书评引文中的 starred 一词，词内子串被标记。

patterns.name: 词尾“ales”
patterns.context: 出现在公寓转售（resales）的房地产市场讨论中。

patterns.name: 姓氏片段“erz”
patterns.context: 姓名 Sw erz bin 被拆分标记；同一邮件语料中重复出现。

patterns.name: 名字中的“ing”
patterns.context: 出现在篮球运动员姓氏 Swing 中。

patterns.name: 词尾“red”
patterns.context: 出现在演员与乔治·克鲁尼合作演出的叙述中。

patterns.name: 词尾“ary”
patterns.context: 出现在交通法规所需材料和程序的正式说明中。

en.concept: Within-word fragments and the comical ending
en.description: Primarily responds to the ending ical in comical; it also activates on the Shrew string, split uppercase NEIGHBORHOOD fragments in legal names, several unrelated within-word fragments, and email sign-offs.

patterns.name: Ending of comical
patterns.context: The word form is comical, with activation concentrated on the ending “ical”; appears in sentences evaluating a person or thing
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, comedy reviews, and online reviews

patterns.name: Shrew string
patterns.context: Contains the consecutive letter string “Shrew,” appearing in the place name Shrewsbury and the book title Shrewdness; the contexts serve different purposes

patterns.name: Split fragments of Neighborhood
patterns.context: NEIGHBORHOOD in uppercase institutional names is split into multiple fragments; both examples are names of parties in legal cases

patterns.name: Isolated within-word fragment activations
patterns.context: Activating fragments appear within common words, but there is no clear shared condition among the fragments or their meanings
patterns.domain: Geographic descriptions, bibliographies, news headlines, business emails

patterns.name: Email thanks
patterns.context: A brief expression of thanks at the end of a business email

2_778.concept: 词内片段与 comical 词尾
2_778.description: 主要响应 comical 的词尾 ical；另对 Shrew 字符串、法律名称中拆分的大写 NEIGHBORHOOD 片段，以及若干互不相同的词内片段和邮件致谢有激活。

patterns.name: comical 的词尾
patterns.context: 词形为 comical，激活集中在词尾“ical”；出现在对人或事物作评价的句子中
patterns.domain: 百科、喜剧评论及网络评论

patterns.name: Shrew 字符串
patterns.context: 含有连续字母串“Shrew”，分别出现在地名 Shrewsbury 和书名中的 Shrewdness；上下文用途不同

patterns.name: Neighborhood 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 大写机构名称中的 NEIGHBORHOOD 被分成多个片段；两例均为法律案件当事方名称

patterns.name: 孤立词内片段激活
patterns.context: 在普通词内部出现激活片段，但片段之间及其语义没有明显共同条件
patterns.domain: 地理描述、书目、新闻标题、商务邮件

patterns.name: 邮件致谢
patterns.context: 商务邮件正文结束处的简短致谢

en.description: Strong activations mostly fall on within-word character fragments: rew, ceives, it, ical, cient, ans, uel/ty, as well as name fragments and sporadic common words. Semantics and styles are varied and cannot be explained by a single theme.

patterns.name: Within-word token fragment shrew
patterns.context: Activation falls on the «rew» character fragment inside a word; it appears in the place name Shrewsbury and the adjective shrewdness, with different surrounding characters

patterns.name: ceives character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the news headline Norway Receives Bids, with activation concentrated on a consecutive within-word character fragment

patterns.name: Within-word it character fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside a name, not on an independent word; the surname appears in both email recipient/CC lists

patterns.name: Within-word ruelty character fragment
patterns.context: Appears within the fixed institution name Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals; activation is within the word

patterns.name: Within-word ical character fragment
patterns.context: The word describes the comedic nature of a performer or person; both examples occur in evaluative narratives

patterns.name: Within-word cient character fragment
patterns.context: Describes a theoretical prediction as far-sighted; activation occurs inside the adjective

patterns.name: Within-word swan character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a philosophical logic example about possible worlds and blue swans

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word fragments
patterns.context: These activations occur in email names, technical text, review narratives, and ordinary sentences; they share no obvious local semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Emails, technical writing, reviews, and general prose

2_778.description: 强激活多落在词内字符片段：rew、ceives、it、ical、cient、ans、uel/ty，另有姓名片段及零散普通词。语义与文体分散，无法由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 词内分词片段 shrew
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 «rew» 字符片段；分别出现在地名 Shrewsbury 和形容词 shrewdness 中，周围字符不同
patterns.domain: 地理条目、书目/作品标题

patterns.name: ceives 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题 Norway Receives Bids 中，激活集中在词内连续字符片段

patterns.name: 词内 it 字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名内部，而非独立词；两段邮件收件人/抄送名单中均出现该姓氏

patterns.name: 词内 ruelty 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在固定机构名称 Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals 中，激活位于词内

patterns.name: 词内 ical 字符片段
patterns.context: 该词用于描述表演者或人物的喜剧性；两处均为评价性叙述

patterns.name: 词内 cient 字符片段
patterns.context: 描述理论预测具有先见之明，激活位于形容词内部

patterns.name: 词内 swan 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于可能世界及蓝色天鹅的哲学逻辑例句中

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.trigger: «usc»、«R»、«it»等姓名或词内片段；另有 «non»、«mu»、«near»、«much»、«easier» 等普通词/词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在邮件姓名、技术文本、评论叙述及普通语句中；彼此没有明显共同的局部语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术文、评论及一般散文

en.description: Activations most prominently fall on the “rew” character fragment in words such as Shrewsbury; other activations are distributed across spelling fragments within words, common legal-document words, formatting symbols, and abbreviations, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Letter-fragment rearrangement/completion into a word initial
patterns.context: Activation falls on a letter fragment within a word; “rew” recurs with the highest strength in the place name Shrewsbury and the title Shrewdness.

patterns.name: Within-word spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on a character sequence within a word or proper noun; forms and contexts vary, with no evidence of shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: bibliographies, papers, legal texts, news, plant descriptions, and names

patterns.name: Fixed expressions and function words in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in arguments or procedural explanations in decisions or litigation documents; several common words activate weakly, along with within-word activations in the fixed phrase “Suffice it to say”.

patterns.name: Common relational and determiner words between words
patterns.context: Mostly common function words or words in common collocations; sentences concern papers, plant descriptions, project reports, and other topics, with no uniform semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, botanical descriptions, research project reports, etc.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Markers fall on line breaks, whitespace, divider lines, or page breaks; concentrated in court docket title pages and list formatting.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic formatting, legal dockets, and electronic text formats

patterns.name: Uppercase letter combinations in abbreviations or proper nouns
patterns.context: Character fragments occur in the insurance institution abbreviation FSL-IC, the compliance abbreviation CLIA, or name spellings; they are sporadic and lack a shared context.
patterns.domain: Legal insurance documents, research reports, names

2_778.description: 激活最突出地落在 Shrewsbury 等词中的「rew」字符片段；其余激活分散于词内拼写片段、法律文书常用词、版式符号及缩写，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 字母片段重排/补全为词首
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字母片段；「rew」在地名 Shrewsbury 及书名 Shrewdness 中重复出现，强度最高。

patterns.name: 词内拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内或专名内部的一段字符，词形和语境各异；没有证据表明它们共享特定语义。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：书目、论文、法律、新闻、植物描述及人名

patterns.name: 法律文书中的固定表达与功能词
patterns.context: 出现在判决或诉讼文件的论证、程序说明中；多个常见词获得较弱激活，另有「Suffice it to say」这一固定表达的词内激活。

patterns.name: 词间常见关系词及限定词
patterns.context: 多为普通功能词或常见搭配中的词；所在句子分别涉及论文叙述、植物描述、项目报告等，语义条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、植物学描述、科研项目报告等

patterns.name: 换行与版式符号
patterns.context: 标记落在换行、空白、分隔线或分页符上；集中于法院案卷标题页及列表排版。
patterns.domain: 书目排版、法律案卷及电子文本格式

patterns.name: 缩写或专名中的大写字母组合
patterns.context: 字符片段处于保险机构缩写 FSL-IC、合规缩写 CLIA 或姓名拼写中；零散出现，缺少共同语境。
patterns.domain: 法律保险文件、科研报告、人名

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the word form conflict across academic, legal, patent, and war contexts; also shows subword-fragment activations for Stayton and Wayne, plus secondary markers such as bloody in war narratives.

patterns.name: Conflict-related noun
patterns.context: The word form conflict itself is the most stable trigger. It can refer to disagreement between opinions, interests, requirements, events, or formal systems, as well as armed conflict.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patents, legal texts, news, and historical narratives

patterns.name: Stayton in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the U.S. case name “United States v. Stayton”; no conflict-related meaning is required.

patterns.name: Name fragment of a hockey player
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the name “Wayne Simpson”; no conflict-related meaning is required.

patterns.name: Words associated with conflict
patterns.context: Appears in the context of war narratives alongside conflict, but war is unmarked in [8][10], so it cannot be considered an independent trigger. These markers are more likely local associations or secondary patterns.

2_809.description: 主要对词形 conflict 强烈响应，覆盖学术、法律、专利及战争语境；另有 Stayton、Wayne 的词片激活，以及战争叙述中的 bloody 等次要标记。

patterns.name: 冲突相关名词
patterns.trigger: «conflict»（[1][3][5][6][7][8][9][10]）；在[6]为“they conflict with”，在[9]为“conflict hypergraphs / conflict graph”
patterns.context: 词形 conflict 本身是最稳定的触发点；可指意见、利益、要求、事件或形式系统之间的不一致，也可指武装冲突。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、法律文本、新闻及历史叙述

patterns.name: 专名中的 Stayton
patterns.context: 出现在美国诉讼案名“United States v. Stayton”中；不要求有 conflict 语义。

patterns.name: 冰球运动员姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名“Wayne Simpson”开头；不要求有 conflict 语义。

patterns.name: 近冲突的议题词
patterns.context: 与 conflict 同处战争叙述语境，但 war 在[8][10]未标记，不能据此认定其单独触发；这些标记更可能是局部关联或次要模式。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the word conflict, covering interpersonal/interest conflicts, war, mathematical terminology, and scheduling conflicts; also includes proper-name fragments such as Way and Stay, plus a few sporadic markers with unclear patterns.

patterns.name: Way/Stay syllables in proper names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a person’s name or case name, without an obvious shared semantic cue in the surrounding text.

patterns.name: conflict and its word forms
patterns.context: The word conflict appears directly, referring to conflicts of interest, disagreement, armed conflict, graph-theoretic conflict, or personal scheduling conflicts; the specific meaning depends on context.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, law, patents, news, email, mathematical texts

patterns.name: Subword in the string Charuga
patterns.context: The activation marker falls near a garbled string or word beginning, followed by the movie title Charuga; the local context does not establish a stable lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on ordinary words
patterns.context: These markers do not show consistent triggers recurring across passages and may be sporadic activations or tokenization-boundary effects.

2_809.description: 主要对 conflict 一词有强反应，涵盖人际/利益冲突、战争、数学术语及日程冲突；另有 Way、Stay 等专名片段及少量零散标记，模式不明。

patterns.name: 专名中 Way/Stay 音节
patterns.context: 出现在人名或案件名称中，作为专名的一部分；周围没有明显共同语义线索。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律案件名称

patterns.name: conflict 及其词形
patterns.trigger: « conflict»（2、4–10）；« conflict» 出现在多个语义搭配中
patterns.context: 直接出现 conflict 一词，表示利益冲突、意见不一致、武装冲突、图论中的冲突，或个人日程安排冲突；具体含义由上下文决定。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律、专利、新闻、邮件、数学文本

patterns.name: Charuga 字符串中的子词
patterns.context: 激活标记落在乱码/词首附近，后文是电影名 Charuga；无法从局部上下文确定是否为稳定词义模式。

patterns.name: 通常词语的零星激活
patterns.trigger: « We»（2）、« Recent»（4）、«»1▯aruga（5）中的非 conflict 标记
patterns.context: 这些标记未呈现出跨段重复且一致的触发条件，可能是零散激活或分词边界效应。

en.description: Activations are distributed across fragments of various medical terms, particularly the suffix -ologically; there are also activations for names, conflict, simultaneous, Plasmodium, varicose veins, and statistical-indicator contexts, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: -ologically suffix in biomedical words
patterns.context: The activation falls on the spelling fragment -ologically, in words related to morphology, neuropathology, histology, and immunology.

patterns.name: Person name Bernard Grimes
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across token fragments of the name Bernard Grimes; the following text gives the nickname “Bernie”.

patterns.name: Name Wayne Simpson and hockey parenthetical
patterns.context: Activation appears on fragments of the name Wayne Simpson; the parenthetical connects him with hockey.

patterns.name: Conflict collocations
patterns.context: Conflict appears in statements of competing interests or descriptions of reports whose functions contradict one another.
patterns.domain: Medical paper disclosures and academic discussion

patterns.name: The word simultaneous
patterns.context: Used to describe simultaneous detection of antigens and antibodies; the word itself is the main activation location.

patterns.name: Plasmodium in a parasite name
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across the genus-name fragment in Plasmodium yoelii, in a context of mouse infection and circulating antigens.

patterns.name: Varicose veins and related anatomical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the Latin anatomical description of the testicular veins and the word fragment varicocele.

patterns.name: Discussion of statistical indices
patterns.context: Discusses the properties and meaning of statistical indices; activation is weak and not clearly connected to the other patterns in this example.

2_809.description: 激活分散于多种医学术语片段，尤见 -ologically 词尾；另对人名、冲突、simultaneous、Plasmodium、静脉曲张及统计指标语境有激活，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 生物医学词中的 -ologically 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写片段 -ologically 上；出现在形态学、神经病理学、组织学及免疫学相关词中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与项目摘要

patterns.name: Bernard Grimes 人名
patterns.context: 激活分散在人名 Bernard Grimes 的分词片段上，后文给出昵称 “Bernie”。

patterns.name: Wayne Simpson 姓名及冰球括注
patterns.context: 激活出现在 Wayne Simpson 的名字片段；括号将其与冰球联系起来。

patterns.name: 冲突搭配
patterns.context: conflict 出现在利益冲突声明或描述报告功能彼此矛盾的语境中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文声明与学术讨论

patterns.name: simultaneous 一词
patterns.context: 用于描述检测抗原与抗体的同步检测；该词本身是主要激活位置。

patterns.name: 寄生虫名称中的 Plasmodium
patterns.context: 激活分布在 Plasmodium yoelii 的属名片段中，语境为小鼠感染及循环抗原。
patterns.domain: 寄生虫免疫学研究摘要

patterns.name: 静脉曲张及相关解剖词
patterns.context: 激活落在睾丸静脉的拉丁解剖描述和 varicocele（精索静脉曲张）词片段中。

patterns.name: 统计指数讨论
patterns.context: 讨论统计指标的性质与含义；激活较弱，且与本例其他模式不明显相连。

en.concept: conflict token and occasional local features
en.description: The most stable pattern is the token conflict, covering conflicts of interest, facts, theories, designs, and biological competition. Other sporadic activations fall on proper names, company codes, group, workable, development, graphs, citation numbers, and place names.

patterns.name: conflict token
patterns.context: The word form conflict appears in different semantic collocations: conflicts of interest, disagreements between opinions or facts, incompatibility of theories or designs, and competitive relationships. It does not depend on a single fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Law, academic papers, patents, and biology

patterns.name: Beginning fragment of a place/proper name
patterns.context: In the name Wayne Simpson, activation is concentrated on the initial proper-name token; subsequent text is weakly marked.

patterns.name: Arabic proper-name fragment
patterns.context: An Arabic letter in an Iranian company stock code, adjacent to other Arabic letters, with the strongest activation on one of the letters.

patterns.name: Medical group phrasing
patterns.context: The word group appears after a statistical proportion in a sentence reporting a value for an early male group.

patterns.name: Fragment within workable
patterns.context: Occurs within the word “workable hypotheses,” meaning feasible hypotheses; the surrounding text discusses research literature and function.

patterns.name: Business phrasing about development
patterns.context: Occurs with property in a list of business areas for corporate expansion.

patterns.name: Graph theory terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the technical term “conflict hypergraphs”; the same passage also contains highly activated conflict.

patterns.name: Numeric fragment in a legal citation
patterns.context: Within the page number of a Florida case citation; conflict also appears in the surrounding context, but the number itself is marked as well.

patterns.name: Place name Florida
patterns.context: Appears in a species-distribution context to indicate a study location; activation is weak.

2_809.concept: conflict 词元及偶发局部特征
2_809.description: 最稳定模式是词元 conflict：涵盖利益、事实、理论、设计及生物竞争等冲突。另有零散激活落在专名、公司代码、group、workable、development、graphs、引证数字及地名上。

patterns.name: conflict 词元
patterns.context: 词形 conflict 出现在不同语义搭配中：利益冲突、意见/事实矛盾、理论或设计不相容、竞争关系；并非依赖单一固定短语。
patterns.domain: 法律、学术论文、专利及生物学

patterns.name: 地名/专名开头片段
patterns.context: 名字 Way ne Simpson 中，激活集中在专名首 token；后文标注较弱。

patterns.name: 阿拉伯文专名片段
patterns.context: 伊朗公司股票代码中的阿拉伯文字母，邻接其他阿拉伯字母，但最强激活落在其中一个字母。

patterns.name: 医学分组表述
patterns.context: 统计比例后出现 group；句中报告早期男性某组的数值。

patterns.name: workable 词内片段
patterns.context: 位于“workable hypotheses”一词内部，意为可行的假设；周边谈研究文献与功能。

patterns.name: 开发业务表述
patterns.context: 与 property 连用，列举企业扩张的业务领域。

patterns.name: 图论术语
patterns.context: 出现在“conflict hypergraphs”这一技术术语中；同段也含高激活 conflict。

patterns.name: 文献引证中的数字片段
patterns.context: 佛罗里达州判例引证的页码数字内部；上下文同时出现 conflict，但该数字本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 地点名 Florida
patterns.context: 出现在物种分布语境中，表示研究地点；激活较弱。

en.description: Activations center on the token cell: primarily in biomedical contexts involving cells and their compound expressions, but also in the non-biological senses fuel cell and cell phone; context distinguishes the meanings.

patterns.name: cell token in biology
patterns.context: Part of a biological noun referring to a cell, cell type, or cellular entity; appears in compounds, noun phrases, and life-science discussion.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, cell biology, and biochemistry abstracts/research plans

patterns.name: cell in fuel cell
patterns.context: Cell refers to a fuel cell, not a biological cell; it appears with words such as fuel, system, stack, and electrode.

patterns.name: cell in cell phone
patterns.context: Cell is part of cellular phone and refers to a mobile phone; nearby are consumer electronics such as mobile devices and media players.
patterns.domain: Patent background, electronic devices and mobile communications

2_809.description: 激活集中于词元 cell：主要出现在生物医学语境的细胞及其复合表达，也见于 fuel cell 和 cell phone 两种非生物义；语义由上下文区分。

patterns.name: 生物学中的 cell 词元
patterns.context: 作为生物学名词的一部分，指细胞、细胞类型或细胞实体；出现在复合词、名词短语及生命科学论述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、细胞生物学与生物化学摘要/研究计划

patterns.name: 燃料电池中的 cell
patterns.trigger: «cell»7、«cell»8、«cell»10；如 «fuel»1« cell»7« system»3 与 «fuel»1« cell»8« stack»
patterns.context: cell 指燃料电池，而非生物细胞；与 fuel、system、stack、electrode 等词共同出现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，燃料电池技术

patterns.name: 手机中的 cell
patterns.context: cell 是 cellular phone 的组成部分，指移动电话；邻近 mobile devices、media players 等消费电子设备。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电子设备与移动通信

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the token “cell,” across contexts including cell membranes, cell–matrix relationships, development and cell types, cell synthesis, and immunity; also responds to a word segment in “cell phones.” No corresponding trigger is apparent in paragraph 1, so it cannot be explained.

patterns.name: cell and cell-related words
patterns.context: The direct trigger is cell, commonly appearing in descriptions of cells, cell membranes, cell types, or cell–matrix relationships; paragraph 7 contains the compound cell phones.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts; also consumer-electronics background text

patterns.name: cell and membranes/membrane proteins
patterns.context: Discusses components on malignant-cell membranes or hydrophobic membrane proteins in cells and their functions.

patterns.name: cell and cell–matrix interactions
patterns.context: Extracellular matrix proteins regulate cell–matrix interactions and cell function.

patterns.name: cell and development, fate, or cell type
patterns.context: Describes cell fate specification, retinal cell-type organization, or stem cells and hematopoiesis.
patterns.domain: Developmental biology, hematopoiesis, and vision research

patterns.name: cell as the subject of cellular processes
patterns.context: Cells synthesize ribosomes, or cell is used as a modifier in a cell-mediated immunity test.

patterns.name: cell in cell phones
patterns.context: Cell is part of the name cell phones for a mobile device, not a biological cell.

patterns.name: Other biomedical contexts unrelated to cell
patterns.context: Discusses feed for weaned piglets, diarrhea, and gastrointestinal microbial ecology; cell is not present in the shown fragment.

2_809.description: 主要对 token“cell”强烈响应，涵盖细胞膜、细胞—基质关系、发育与细胞类型、细胞合成及免疫等语境；也响应“cell phones”中的词段。第1段未见相应触发词，无法解释。

patterns.name: cell及细胞相关词
patterns.context: 直接触发词为 cell，常见于描述细胞、细胞膜、细胞类型或细胞与基质的关系；第7段为复合词 cell phones
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研摘要；另有消费电子背景文本

patterns.name: cell与膜/膜蛋白
patterns.context: 讨论恶性肿瘤细胞膜上的成分，或细胞中的疏水膜蛋白及其功能

patterns.name: cell与细胞—基质相互作用
patterns.context: 细胞外基质蛋白调节细胞—基质相互作用及细胞功能
patterns.domain: 心脏生物学、细胞外基质研究

patterns.name: cell与发育、命运或细胞类型
patterns.context: 说明细胞命运指定、视网膜细胞类型组织，或干细胞及血细胞生成
patterns.domain: 发育生物学、造血与视觉研究
