patterns.name: Signal-to-noise ratio abbreviation
patterns.context: In an English technical paper, NR is part of the abbreviation SNR (signal-to-noise ratio).
patterns.domain: ArXiv, signal processing and wireless communications

patterns.name: Syllable/subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments across different languages and domains; there is no consistent meaning, grammatical position, or stable contextual condition.
patterns.domain: English sports commentary, Danish and Swedish parliamentary text, ArXiv papers, and US legal documents

2_1005.description: 最显著模式是瑞典语 kvalitet 中的 val，以及科技论文缩写 SNR 中的 NR；其余激活分散在多种语言和文体的词内片段，难以由共同词义或上下文解释。

patterns.name: 瑞典语质量词
patterns.context: 瑞典语中，词干 val 出现在 kvalitet（质量）一词内；第2、4段为 k-val-itet，第7段为 k-val-itet 的词形变体。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，公共服务、渔业、信息可及性

patterns.name: 信噪比缩写
patterns.context: 英语科技论文中，NR 是缩写 SNR（signal-to-noise ratio）的一部分。

patterns.name: 词中间的音节/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言、不同领域的词内部片段上；没有一致的词义或语法位置，也没有稳定的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 英语体育评论、丹麦语和瑞典语议会文本、ArXiv论文及美国法律文书

en.concept: Local character fragments and formatting markers across corpora
en.description: Most high activations fall on the phonetic fragment val, especially in Nordic-language kvalit(et), and also in förvaltning. Others fall on the Khmer characterើ, the igg in Ziggler, line breaks in legal text, and whitespace formatting markers; they do not share a clear semantic function.

patterns.name: Cross-linguistic morpheme sequence «val»
patterns.context: High activations often fall on the val/val phonetic fragment within words. In Nordic-language text it often occurs in kvalit(et), meaning “quality”; in Swedish it can also occur in förvaltning. It is not triggered only by one complete word.
patterns.domain: European Parliament multilingual text; also an English ArXiv paper and Hungarian parliamentary text

patterns.name: Highlighted character «ើ» in code
patterns.context: The highlighted character occurs in a Khmer string, surrounded by quoted code key-value pairs and a preview field.

patterns.name: «igg» fragment in a wrestler's name
patterns.context: An English sentence mentions the plot relationship between a character and wrestler Dolph Ziggler.

patterns.name: Formatting control characters in court citations
patterns.context: A legal decision uses indented formatting to introduce a test standard, quotations, and case names.

2_1005.concept: 多语料中的局部字形片段与格式标记
2_1005.description: 多数高激活落在 val 音形片段，尤其北欧语 kvalit(et)，也见 förvaltning；其余分别落在高棉字形ើ、Ziggler 的 igg、法律文本换行及空白排版标记，难以归为同一语义功能。

patterns.name: 跨语言词素序列 «val»
patterns.context: 高强度多落在词内的 val/val 音形片段；在北欧语文本中常处于 kvalit(et)“质量”词中，在瑞典语中也可处于 förvaltning 中；并非只由同一个完整词触发
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种文本；另有一段 ArXiv 英文论文和匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码中的高亮字形「ើ」
patterns.context: 高亮落在高棉语字符串中，周围是带引号的代码键值与 preview 字段

patterns.name: 摔角人名片段 «igg»
patterns.context: 英文句子中提到角色与摔角手 Dolph Ziggler 的剧情关系

patterns.name: 法院引文中的排版控制符
patterns.trigger: «\r\n»4 及引文中的空白/下划线标记 « »9
patterns.context: 法律判决文本以缩进排版引入测试标准、引文和判例名称

en.description: Activates on heterogeneous token fragments, often within words and names, and sometimes on formatting marks and ordinary function words. No stable semantic or thematic pattern is evident across the examples.

patterns.name: Segmented token within a word
patterns.context: Activations often fall on parts of words rather than whole words; in some cases, the fragment is within a morphologically complex word. No common linguistic or semantic function is apparent.

patterns.name: Names, surnames, and their parts
patterns.context: Fragments occur in bibliographic citations, personal names, place names, and other named entities; some examples overlap with common words or word parts.
patterns.domain: Academic text, IRC, news, medicine, law

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting
patterns.context: Some activations fall on a comma in text and on a line-break marker before a heading/link.

patterns.name: Common English function words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across ordinary English prose and dialogue, without a single stable syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Source code with comments, IRC, medical text, legal text

patterns.name: Word fragments in a Russian sorting query
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on fragments of Russian words in a question about reading a file and sorting people by their city of residence.

patterns.name: Legal list of restrictions
patterns.context: Several activated fragments occur in a list of rules for tenants and restrictions on importing property.

2_1005.description: Срабатывает на разнородные фрагменты токенов, часто внутри слов и имён, а также иногда на знаки форматирования и обычные служебные слова. Устойчивой семантической или тематической закономерности по примерам не видно.

patterns.name: Сегментированный токен внутри слова
patterns.context: Активации часто приходятся на части слов, а не на целые слова; в ряде случаев фрагмент находится внутри морфологически сложного слова. Общая языковая или семантическая функция не прослеживается.

patterns.name: Имена, фамилии и их части
patterns.context: Фрагменты встречаются в библиографических ссылках, именах людей, названиях мест и других именованных сущностях; часть примеров совпадает с обычными словами или частями слов.
patterns.domain: Научный текст, IRC, новости, медицина, право

patterns.name: Пунктуация и форматирование
patterns.context: Отдельные активации приходятся на запятую в тексте и на маркер переноса строки перед заголовком/ссылкой.

patterns.name: Общие английские служебные слова
patterns.context: Срабатывания разбросаны по обычной английской прозе и диалогу, без единого устойчивого синтаксического окружения.
patterns.domain: Исходный код с комментариями, IRC, медицинский текст, судебный текст

patterns.name: Части слов в русскоязычном запросе о сортировке
patterns.context: Активации сосредоточены на фрагментах русских слов в вопросе о чтении файла и сортировке людей по городу проживания.

patterns.name: Юридический список ограничений
patterns.context: Несколько активированных фрагментов встречаются в перечислении правил для арендаторов и ограничений на ввоз имущества.

en.description: Activations often fall on word-internal fragments across different languages and domains. Clear local patterns include Swedish fragments, proper names such as Korteweg, and fragments in personal names and watercraft. They are difficult to summarize as a single semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: Hungarian word endings and internal fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are embedded within words in continuous Hungarian text; in paragraph 1, activations concentrate on internal substrings, especially «éri».
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches or meeting records

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations cover word-internal fragments in continuous Swedish text; paragraphs 2 and 7 have different vocabulary and grammatical contexts, while «Korte» may also occur in a proper name.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text; paragraph 8 also contains a proper name in scientific literature

patterns.name: Proper name Korteweg-de Vries
patterns.context: Activation falls within the mathematician's surname “Korteweg” and related citation names; in paragraphs 4 and 5, the context is the KdV equation and related research literature, while paragraph 8 concerns a galaxy-cluster survey citation.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and physics papers, astronomy paper references

patterns.name: Name fragment in herbertsmithite
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the mineral's proper name “herbertsmithite”; nearby text discusses QSL candidates and experimental realization.

patterns.name: Name and address fragments in email
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments in email recipient names, addresses, or signatures; the different fragments show no consistent name category or position.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and personal contact information

patterns.name: Watercraft word ending
patterns.context: Activates within the token “watercraft” in a sentence listing items tenants may bring.

2_1005.description: 激活多落在不同语言及领域的词内片段；明显局部模式包括瑞典语片段、Korteweg 等专名，以及姓名和 watercraft。难以归纳为单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续文本中，这些片段嵌在词内；段1的激活集中于词内子串，尤其是«éri»。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言或会议记录

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中，激活覆盖词内片段；段2、7的词汇和语法环境不同，«Korte»也可能出现在专名中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本；段8另见科学文献中的专名

patterns.name: Korteweg-de Vries 专名
patterns.context: 激活落在数学家姓氏“Korteweg”及相关引用名的词内；在段4、5处于 KdV 方程及其研究文献语境，段8处于星系团调查引用中。
patterns.domain: 数学与物理学论文、天文学论文的参考文献

patterns.name: herbertsmithite 名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在矿物专名“herbertsmithite”的开头；邻近 QSL 候选体及实验实现的讨论。

patterns.name: 邮件姓名与地址片段
patterns.context: 激活落在邮件收件人姓名、地址或署名中的词内片段；不同片段未显示一致的名字类别或位置。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件与个人联系信息

patterns.name: 水上交通工具词尾
patterns.context: 在“watercraft”中分词内激活，句子列举租客可携入的物品。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on word-internal subword fragments across different languages and styles, including names, citation abbreviations, morphologically rich long words, and a few common words. There is no stable semantic or grammatical theme.

patterns.name: Token fragments at the ends of personal names or surnames
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within proper names or abbreviations, often in paper-author citations and also in email names; tokenization of names in different languages may affect triggering.
patterns.domain: Paper citations, email, and proper names

patterns.name: Token fragments within long words
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across subword tokens within long words rather than obvious complete words; especially prominent in Hungarian agglutinative words, German compounds, and other morphologically rich vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, especially Hungarian, German, and academic terminology

patterns.name: Word fragments related to cities or place names
patterns.context: Appears in a Russian programming question asking how to sort people by their city of residence; triggering may relate to place names or their internal tokenization.

patterns.name: English subword in a common word
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal tokenization of the English word “ballast,” in a sentence describing a person as a burden; its relationship to the other patterns is unclear.

2_1005.description: 激活主要落在不同语言和文体中的词内子词片段，涵盖姓名、引文缩写、形态丰富的长词及少数普通词；没有稳定的语义或语法主题。

patterns.name: 人名或姓氏末尾的 token 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或缩写内部的子词片段，常见于论文作者引文，也见于邮件姓名；不同语言的姓名切分可能影响触发。

patterns.name: 长词内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于长词内部的子词 token，而非明显的完整词；匈牙利语黏着词、德语复合词及其他形态丰富词汇中尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，尤其匈牙利语、德语及学术术语

patterns.name: 城市或地名相关的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在要求按居住城市对人员排序的俄语编程问题中；触发可能与地点词或其词内切分有关。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 常见词内部的英语子词
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词“ballast”的内部切分上，所在句子把人称为负担；难以确认与其他模式的联系。

en.description: Strong activations occur mainly in the multilingual stem “pers” and the English word “once”; the former appears across multiple languages and genres, while the latter occurs in dosing frequency or “once again.” No clear corresponding trigger is observed in segment 1.

patterns.name: perso- stem
patterns.context: The stem is followed by different endings to form words such as “persoană,” “perspectivas,” “persistent,” “persigue,” “persoane,” and “personeelsleden”; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual texts in Romanian, Portuguese, Spanish, English, Dutch, and other languages, covering parliamentary, medical, academic, and general narrative contexts.

patterns.name: once-related words
patterns.context: The English word once appears in oral dosing frequency expressions “once orally” and “once-daily,” as well as in the narrative phrase “once again.”
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and general English narrative.

2_1034.description: 强激活主要出现在多语种词干“pers”，以及英文“once”中；前者跨多种语言和文体，后者见于给药频率或“once again”。第1段未见明确对应触发。

patterns.name: perso-词干
patterns.context: 词干后续接不同词尾，组成“persoană”“perspectivas”“persistent”“persigue”“persoane”“personeelsleden”等词；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、英语、荷兰语等多语种文本，涉及议会、医学、学术和一般叙述。

patterns.name: once 相关词
patterns.context: 出现英文词 once，分别用于口服给药频率“once orally”和“once-daily”，以及叙述“once again”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与一般英文叙述。

en.concept: Multilingual subword fragments and specific strings
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on word fragments beginning with pers in multilingual text; there are also strong responses to the English word once and the proper noun Portland, along with several sporadic intraword fragments. The triggers lack consistent semantic or stylistic conditions.

patterns.name: Portuguese personal stem pers
patterns.context: Activations fall on stems beginning with pers in Portuguese/Romance words; the words differ in meaning and part of speech, and the activations cross intraword token boundaries.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Portuguese, Romanian, and Spanish academic text from PhilPapers

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: The English word once appears in oral dosing frequency, an expression about accompanying someone again, and the clinical term once-daily; the trigger position is the same, but the meanings and contexts differ.

patterns.name: Portland
patterns.context: The English proper noun Portland; one instance is in a Portland Trail Blazers news item, and another refers to a conference location.

patterns.name: Other sporadic multilingual word fragments
patterns.context: Each example is an intraword fragment or common word in a different language, with insufficient evidence that they share the same meaning or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, multilingual EuroParl text, Spanish academic text

2_1034.concept: 多语言词片段与特定字符串
2_1034.description: 激活主要集中于多语言文本中以 pers 开头的词片段；另对英语 once、专名 Portland 有强响应，并出现若干分散的词内片段。各触发之间缺乏一致语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语人称词干 pers
patterns.context: 激活点落在葡萄牙语/罗曼语词中以 pers 开头的词干；词义和词类不同，且跨越词内分词边界。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语、罗马尼亚语，以及 PhilPapers 西班牙语学术文本

patterns.name: once
patterns.context: 英语 once，出现在口服给药频率、再次同行的表达及 once-daily 临床用语中；触发位置相同，但含义和上下文不同。
patterns.domain: 临床摘要、新闻/体育报道

patterns.name: Portland
patterns.context: 英文专名 Portland；一处为波特兰开拓者队新闻，一处为会议地点。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、HackerNews 活动公告

patterns.name: 其他多语言零散词片段
patterns.context: 各例均为不同语言中的词内片段或常用词，没有足够证据表明它们共享同一词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、EuroParl 多语言文本、西班牙语学术文本

en.description: Activations concentrate on several local substrings: Portland, once (including once pragma and once_differentiable), Grig, ig, and jq in code comments; there is no stable, unified semantic condition across texts.

patterns.name: Portland place name
patterns.context: The complete proper noun Portland (the city in Oregon); it appears in event descriptions and sports reporting.

patterns.name: Once / single-occurrence contexts
patterns.context: The word once appears in contexts meaning “again” or “to execute once after everything is complete”; segment 7 contains the phrase “at once.”

patterns.name: once as an identifier substring
patterns.context: The code identifier once_differentiable contains once; this is not the natural-language word once.

patterns.name: once pragma in code
patterns.context: The C++ preprocessor directive #pragma once, used for header protection.

patterns.name: Name fragment Grig
patterns.context: The fragment Grig at the start of the name Gregory Smirnov; segment 10 repeats the beginning of this name.

patterns.name: Name fragment Jig
patterns.context: The character fragment jq in a code comment, in the jQPlot project header; it may be part of a specific identifier or name.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Cigarette
patterns.context: The letter fragment ig in the word Cigarette, followed by a statement about the harms of smoking.

patterns.name: Remaining source-code markers
patterns.context: Local code fragments in header filenames, preprocessor macros, and project comments; their trigger pattern is uncertain and may relate to proper names or substrings.

2_1034.description: 激活集中在若干局部子串：Portland、once（含 once pragma 和 once_differentiable）、Grig、ig 与代码注释中的 jq；不同文本中没有稳定统一的语义条件。

patterns.name: 波特兰地名
patterns.context: 专名 Portland（俄勒冈州城市）的完整词；分别出现在活动介绍和体育报道中

patterns.name: 一次性／单次语境
patterns.context: 单词 once 出现在表示“再次”或“全部完成后执行一次”等语境中；第7段则是短语“at once”

patterns.name: once 作为标识符子串
patterns.context: 代码中的标识符 once_differentiable 内含 once；并非自然语言中的 once

patterns.name: 代码中的 once pragma
patterns.context: C++ 预处理指令 #pragma once，用于头文件保护

patterns.name: 姓名片段 Grig
patterns.context: 名字 Gregory Smirnov 开头的 Grig 片段；第10段重复该姓名开头

patterns.name: 姓名片段 Jig
patterns.context: 代码注释中的字符片段 jq，位于 jQPlot 项目标头中；可能是特定标识符或名称的一部分

patterns.name: Cigarette 词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 Cigarette 内的 ig 字母片段，后接关于吸烟危害的陈述

patterns.name: 剩余源码标记
patterns.context: 头文件名、预处理宏及项目注释中的局部代码片段；其触发规律不确定，可能与专名或子串有关

en.description: Strong triggers are concentrated on Portland, C/C++ pragma once, and Height; other sporadic patterns include a public-health sentence about smoking, an Android ListView stack trace, game configuration, and test assertions, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial definite article The
patterns.context: The capitalized sentence-initial definite article The appears in English sentences or comments, but its strength and position are unstable.

patterns.name: Portland place name
patterns.context: The English place name Portland appears in team names, company names, or addresses; it is a strong trigger in all three segments.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, business email, address/search data

patterns.name: C/C++ pragma once
patterns.context: The C/C++ header-file preprocessor directive combines pragma and once; nearby code also contains include and conditional compilation directives.

patterns.name: Height string
patterns.context: Height appears in the configuration field gridHeight or the class name CGHeightDetails; nearby content concerns grid dimensions or graphics code.

patterns.name: Android ListView stack trace
patterns.context: The Java stack trace in an AndroidRuntime log includes the ListView.fillGap method and source-file line number.

patterns.name: Smoking and preventable risk
patterns.context: A public-health statement describes smoking as a preventable factor; beyond this, there is no clear shared orthographic cue.

patterns.name: Game unit configuration fields
patterns.context: JSON-like game unit configuration containing ship types and grid width and height; it overlaps with other segments only in Height.

patterns.name: Code naming and assertions
patterns.context: Assertions and comments in C++ test code; apart from occasional The/once, there is no clear consistency with other trigger patterns.

2_1034.description: 强触发集中于 Portland、C/C++ 的 pragma once，以及 Height；另有吸烟公共卫生句、Android ListView 堆栈、游戏配置和测试断言等零散模式，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 句首定冠词 The
patterns.context: 英文句子或注释中出现大写句首定冠词 The；但强度和位置不稳定。
patterns.domain: 新闻/体育叙述、代码注释

patterns.name: Portland 地名
patterns.context: 英文地名 Portland，出现在球队名称、公司名称或地址中；该词在三段里均是强触发。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、商务邮件、地址/搜索数据

patterns.name: C/C++ pragma once
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件预处理指令中，pragma 与 once 连用；相邻代码还含 include、条件编译指令。

patterns.name: Height 字符串
patterns.context: 配置字段 gridHeight 或类名 CGHeightDetails 中出现 Height；周围涉及网格尺寸或图形代码。

patterns.name: Android ListView 堆栈
patterns.context: AndroidRuntime 日志的 Java 堆栈中，ListView.fillGap 方法及源文件行号。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/Android 日志

patterns.name: 吸烟与可预防风险
patterns.context: 公共卫生陈述中，吸烟被描述为可预防因素；除此之外没有明显共享词形线索。
patterns.domain: NIH 医学/公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 游戏单位配置字段
patterns.context: 类似 JSON 的游戏单位配置，含舰船类型与网格宽高；与其他段仅部分重合于 Height。

patterns.name: 代码中的命名与断言
patterns.context: C++ 测试代码的断言和注释；除偶见 The/once 外，没有与其他触发模式明显一致的内容。

en.description: The most stable trigger pattern is `#pragma once` in C/C++ header files, which also activates on `once` in comments. Other activations are scattered across text containing Portland, address lists, health sentences, email phrasing, and JSON fields, with no evident shared semantics.

patterns.name: C/C++ header single-inclusion directive
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++ header files, usually after `#include` or at the start of a file; it can also occur next to include-guard conditional compilation structures such as `#ifndef` and `#if !defined`.

patterns.name: once in comments
patterns.context: Appears in comments requesting that an operation be performed “only ... once,” rather than in a preprocessor directive.

patterns.name: Portland place name
patterns.context: Appears as a place name in sports news sentences or emails; it also occurs in address lists.

patterns.name: Formatting signal other than once in address or postal-code lists
patterns.context: Occurs in a repeated list made up of Oregon address records and the `Exact Match` label.

patterns.name: cigarette in tobacco-health text
patterns.context: Appears as the opening word of a sentence linking smoking to its preventability.

patterns.name: Selection expressions other than once in document options and paragraph phrasing
patterns.context: Phrasing in an email discussing parts of document generation and choosing which version of a paragraph to use.

patterns.name: Grid dimensions in JSON fields
patterns.context: Appears in a list of JSON fields describing a game object, with value `16`, preceded by fields such as `gridWidth`.

2_1034.description: 最稳定的触发模式是 C/C++ 头文件中的 `#pragma once`，也会触发于注释里的 `once`。其余激活分散在含 Portland 的文本、地址列表、健康句子、邮件措辞和 JSON 字段中，未见共同语义。

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件单次包含指令
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 头文件中，通常位于 `#include` 后或文件开头；也可与 `#ifndef`、`#if !defined` 等 include guard 条件编译结构相邻。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 源码

patterns.name: 注释中的 once
patterns.context: 出现在要求某项操作“only ... once”的注释中，而非预处理指令。

patterns.name: Portland 地名
patterns.context: 作为地名出现在体育新闻句子或邮件中；也出现在地址列表里。

patterns.name: 地址或邮政编码列表中的 once 之外的格式信号
patterns.context: 处于多条俄勒冈州地址记录及 `Exact Match` 标签构成的重复列表中。

patterns.name: 烟草健康文本中的 cigarette
patterns.context: 作为句首词，连接 smoking 与其可预防性论述。
patterns.domain: NIH 健康/公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 文档选项与段落措辞中的 once 之外的选择表达
patterns.context: 邮件讨论文档生成部分的措辞及选择哪个段落版本。

patterns.name: JSON 字段中的网格尺寸
patterns.context: 出现在描述游戏对象的 JSON 字段列表中，值为 `16`，前有 `gridWidth` 等字段。

en.description: Activation peaks often fall on short character fragments in words across languages, especially fragments such as ene, but there is no stable meaning or grammatical condition; they also occur in local fragments of lucene and the product name Get Together, which are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “ene” fragment at word ends/in subwords
patterns.context: Activation peaks often fall on several character fragments at the end or within Germanic or Romance words; they are not stable complete words or fixed meanings, and the precise segmentation varies by context.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, primarily EuroParl, also including parliamentary speeches, geographical descriptions, and Estonian fragments

patterns.name: lucene in a structured JSON field
patterns.context: Appears in the value "lucene" of a JSON language field, surrounded by search-query configuration.

patterns.name: Tg ether fragment in a product name
patterns.context: Appears in the product name “Get Together,” at the start of a title or promotional phrase.

2_1034.description: 激活峰值常落在跨语言词语中的短字符片段，尤以 ene 一类片段显著，但没有稳定词义或语法条件；另在 lucene 和产品名 Get Together 的局部片段中出现，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句末/子词中的“ene”片段
patterns.context: 高亮峰值多落在德语或罗曼语词尾/词内的若干字符片段；并非稳定的完整词或固定语义，且具体切分随上下文而变。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，以 EuroParl 为主，也包括议会发言、地理说明和爱沙尼亚语片段

patterns.name: 结构化 JSON 字段中的 lucene
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 的 language 字段值 "lucene" 中，周围为搜索查询配置。

patterns.name: 产品名中的 Tg ether 片段
patterns.context: 出现在产品名 “Get Together” 中，处于标题或宣传语开头。

en.description: The most salient pattern is the ene substring appearing within words across languages and genres: it recurs in the Italian word viene and also occurs in code, Turkish, and English words. Other activations are scattered across Italian passages and are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: vene in Italian verb inflections
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring ene in Italian verb forms, especially viene; in segment 4 the word form is split, with punctuation immediately following.
patterns.domain: Italian legal text, philosophical discussion, and forum text

patterns.name: Non-Italian word-final ene
patterns.context: The same marker falls inside English code words, Turkish fragments, or English words rather than Italian viene; this does not match the Italian pattern.
patterns.domain: Code, text mixed with Turkish, and English API documentation

patterns.name: Other unmarked activations
patterns.context: In segment 1, ene is highlighted in lucene; segments 2 and 10 contain strong activations scattered across various Italian word fragments, lacking a clear local trigger consistent with viene.
patterns.domain: JSON configuration, Italian European Parliament text

2_1034.description: 最醒目的是跨语言、跨文体出现在词内的 ene 子串：意大利语 viene 中反复出现，也见于代码、土耳其语和英文词；另有意大利语段落中的其他分散激活，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 意大利语动词变位中的 vene
patterns.trigger: «vi«ene»10»、«ven«e»10»；可见完整形式包括 «viene»（段 6、8）、«viene» 的分词/变位语境 «vi«ene»10,»（段 4），以及段 2 的 «ottenere» 不属于该触发
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语动词形式中的子串 ene，尤其是 viene；段 4 中词形被切分且标点紧随其后
patterns.domain: 意大利语法律、哲学论述及论坛文本

patterns.name: 非意大利语词尾 ene
patterns.context: 相同标记落在英文代码词、土耳其语片段或英文单词内部，而非意大利语 viene；与意大利语模式不符
patterns.domain: 代码、土耳其语夹杂文本及英文 API 文档

patterns.name: 未标记的其余激活
patterns.trigger: 如 «luc»1«ene»10 实际切分中 «ene»10；以及段 2、10 的多处标记
patterns.context: 段 1 的 lucene 中 ene 被标出；段 2、10 则有强激活分散在多种意大利语词片段上，缺少与 viene 一致的明确局部触发
patterns.domain: JSON 配置、欧洲议会意大利语文本

en.description: The most prominent repeated cue is the English word gay (in literary, sexual-orientation, or identity contexts); other activations are scattered across code, mathematics, Slovenian policy text, and email lists, with no obvious shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: The word gay
patterns.context: The English word gay appears directly; it is used to describe a person's identity, discuss the sexual orientation of a fictional character, describe a parade or scene, and also appears in poetry.
patterns.domain: Novel reviews, literary texts, personal statements

patterns.name: C# property and SQL Server generation strategy
patterns.context: C# code annotates entity properties with a SQL Server value generation strategy (IdentityColumn).

patterns.name: Structured field declarations in code
patterns.context: A C/C++-like struct field list contains field names, array lengths, and integer types; other code snippets involve objects or buffer-related calls.

patterns.name: Buffer copying and setting in code
patterns.context: The processedCopy object is used to set buffer space or usage, with positional arguments such as Top and Bottom.

patterns.name: Matrix and composition terminology
patterns.context: A mathematics paper discusses Sylvester-type matrices and their description in the bivariate case.

patterns.name: Slovenian innovation-policy phrase
patterns.context: A Slovenian title or quotation discusses the EU and a broadly formulated innovation strategy.

patterns.name: Email addresses and domain list
patterns.context: Multiple comma-separated email addresses; strong activations also fall on name or username fragments within the addresses.

2_1034.description: 最突出的重复线索是英文 gay（文学、性取向或身份语境）；其余激活分散在代码、数学、斯洛文尼亚语政策文本和邮箱列表中，缺少共同的明显触发模式。

patterns.name: gay 一词
patterns.context: 直接出现英文单词 gay；分别用于形容人物身份、讨论小说人物性取向、描述游行或场景，也出现在诗歌文本中。
patterns.domain: 小说评论、文学文本、个人陈述

patterns.name: C# 属性与 SQL Server 生成策略
patterns.context: C# 代码中对实体属性添加 SQL Server 值生成策略（IdentityColumn）注解。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化字段声明
patterns.context: 类似 C/C++ 的结构体字段列表中出现字段名、数组长度和整数类型；其他代码片段则是对象或缓冲区相关调用。
patterns.domain: Github / 系统或应用程序代码

patterns.name: 代码中的缓冲区复制与设置
patterns.context: 通过 processedCopy 对象设置缓冲区空间或使用量，包含 Top、Bottom 等位置参数。

patterns.name: 矩阵与组合描述术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中讨论 Sylvester 型矩阵及其在双变量情形下的描述。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语创新政策短语
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语标题或引文中，谈及欧盟及广泛制定的创新战略。

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与域名列表
patterns.context: 多个以逗号分隔的邮箱地址；强激活还落在地址中的姓名或用户名片段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件 / 联系人列表

en.description: Activations often fall on internal morphemes, word endings, and segmentation boundaries in longer words or code identifiers, especially CamelCase names, types, and APIs in source code. They also occur in inflected German words and a few proper names and CSS selectors. There is no evidence that the feature encodes only one semantic topic.

patterns.name: Word endings/morpheme boundaries within identifiers
patterns.context: Activations often fall on final morphemes within longer identifiers or words. In code these include tokenized Spine, Subroutine, Expired, Suite, and Rotate; in text they also occur in werden, Fragen, and Frieden. The trigger is not limited to one fixed suffix.

patterns.name: Types, APIs, and structured names in code
patterns.context: In CamelCase or segmented identifiers such as class names, method signatures, API names, XML configuration, and member names, activations are distributed across name components or their endings; these fragments alone do not identify a fixed semantic category.

patterns.name: Word forms in German text
patterns.context: Appears in German sentences involving verb forms and plural or inflected nouns; activation is concentrated in part of a word rather than in a single identifiable German semantic topic.

patterns.name: Biochemical enzyme name
patterns.context: Activation falls on a proper-name/compound fragment in a PubMed abstract; this example is insufficient to infer a general biochemical topic.

patterns.name: Karma testing-related identifiers
patterns.context: In code accessing Karma test results, activation highlights Karma and related name fragments; this may be a specific instance of the internal-morpheme pattern in identifiers.

patterns.name: CSS menu selectors and styles
patterns.context: In CSS selectors and style rules, activation falls on fragments of selectors such as menu/menu-tab; this is a singleton and does not appear in other segments.

2_1034.concept: 词素片段与标识符边界
2_1034.description: 激活多落在较长词或代码标识符的内部词素、词尾及分段边界，尤其常见于源码中的 CamelCase 名称、类型和 API；也出现于德语屈折词与少数专名、CSS 选择器。没有证据表明它只编码某个语义主题。

patterns.name: 标识符内部的词尾/词素边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在较长标识符或单词内部的末尾词素上；程序代码中包括被拆分标记的 Spine、Subroutine、Expired、Suite、Rotate，文本中也见于 werden、Fragen、Frieden。触发并非只限某一个固定词尾。
patterns.domain: 代码标识符与自然语言文本

patterns.name: 代码中的类型、API 与结构化名称
patterns.context: 在类名、方法签名、API 名称、XML 配置和成员名等 CamelCase 或分词标识符中，激活分布在名称的组成部分或其词尾；仅凭这些片段无法确定固定的语义类别。

patterns.name: 德国文本中的词形
patterns.context: 出现在德语句子中，涉及动词形式与名词复数或屈折词形；激活集中于词的一部分，而非可确认的单一德语语义主题。

patterns.name: 生化酶名称
patterns.context: 激活落在 PubMed 摘要中的专名/化合物名称片段；该例不足以推断一般生化主题。

patterns.name: Karma 测试相关标识符
patterns.context: 在访问 Karma 测试结果的代码中，激活突出 Karma 及相关名称片段；可能是标识符内部词素模式的具体实例。

patterns.name: CSS 菜单选择器与样式
patterns.context: CSS 选择器和样式规则中，激活落在 menu/menu-tab 一类选择器名称的片段；单例且未见于其他段。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on short subword fragments inside words across languages and domains, especially around “en/ine/ene”; similar fragments also occur in code identifiers. Other local formatting patterns include XML configuration and song lists, with no unified semantic topic.

patterns.name: “ene” syllable/subword fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on short subword fragments across word boundaries or within words; the specific word meanings vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: English, German, Dutch, Slovenian, code, and patent text

patterns.name: Identifier suffix fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++ or similar code identifiers, attribute assignments, and near header files/namespaces; it co-occurs with code formatting and CamelCase naming.

patterns.name: XML/MSBuild test target tags
patterns.context: Test targets and configuration conditions in MSBuild XML, including debug/static/platform attributes.

patterns.name: Album or song title lists
patterns.context: A newline-separated list of musical work titles; activations fall on fragments within the titles.

patterns.name: Romanian-related word forms in parliamentary text
patterns.context: A European Parliament sentence contains word forms such as a country name, delegation, or honorific; activation lies on intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Slovenian
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within consecutive Slovenian words in a sentence about transportation and its consequences.

patterns.name: Name/greeting-like fragments in email
patterns.context: An ordinary email exchange asks whether someone has been seen recently; activation is limited to intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Fragment in a mythological figure’s name
patterns.context: The title and opening description of an encyclopedia entry give an alternate name for the moon goddess.

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在跨语言、跨领域词语内部的短子词片段，尤其是“en/ine/ene”一带；代码标识符中也出现类似片段。另有 XML 配置、歌曲列表等局部格式模式，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: “ene”音节/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词边界或词内部的短子词片段；具体词义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：英语、德语、荷兰语、斯洛文尼亚语、代码及专利文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符尾部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 或类似代码的标识符、属性赋值和头文件/命名空间附近；与代码格式及驼峰式命名共现。

patterns.name: XML/MSBuild 测试目标标签
patterns.context: MSBuild XML 中测试目标及配置条件，包含 debug/static/平台等属性。

patterns.name: 专辑或歌曲标题列表
patterns.trigger: «↵»后的歌曲名片段，如“«I»«'ve»« Se»«en»« All»« Good»« People»”，以及“«Make»« It» Easy”
patterns.context: 换行分隔的音乐作品标题列表；激活落在标题中的词片段。

patterns.name: 议会文本中的罗马尼亚相关词形
patterns.context: 欧洲议会语句中出现国家名、代表团或敬称等词形；激活位于词内部片段。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在连续的斯洛文尼亚语词语内部，句子谈及交通及其后果。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的人名/问候式片段
patterns.context: 普通邮件对话中询问是否最近见过某人；激活仅体现为词内片段。

patterns.name: 神话人物名中的片段
patterns.context: 百科条目标题及开头介绍月神的别名。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on tokenized teen/teens/teenagers forms and also broadly hit local subword fragments in ordinary words and code identifiers; across topics, languages, and styles, no stable semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: teen/teenagers forms
patterns.context: When forms such as teen, teens, and teenagers appear, especially when split into multiple subword tokens; includes plural, possessive, and capitalization variants.
patterns.domain: News, medical abstracts, adult websites, and other text

patterns.name: en subword in split words
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments in common words, with no requirement for semantic or syntactic similarity; the word may be a variable name, foreign-language text, or ordinary English.
patterns.domain: Code, Swedish parliamentary text, Spanish strings, and headings

patterns.name: Fragments in names or identifiers
patterns.context: Mixed-case identifiers such as code class names, macros/variable names, and test targets; may co-occur with activations on ordinary word forms.

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在被分词拆开的 teen/teens/teenagers 词形上，也广泛命中普通词和代码标识符中的局部子词片段；跨主题、跨语种及多种文体，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: teen/teenagers 词形
patterns.context: 出现 teen、teens、teenagers 等词形时，尤其是词被拆成多个子词 token；涵盖复数、所有格及大小写变化。
patterns.domain: 新闻、医学摘要、成人网页及其他文本

patterns.name: 拆分词中 en 子词
patterns.trigger: «de»、«it»、«and»、«art»、«line»、«hop» 等词内部或词尾被标记的子词
patterns.context: 激活落在常见词的子词片段上，不要求语义或句法相似；词本身可属于变量名、外语文本或普通英文。
patterns.domain: 代码、瑞典语议会文本、西班牙语字符串及标题

patterns.name: 名称或标识符中的碎片
patterns.trigger: «Messenger»、«Commands»、«Factory» 等拆分的标识符片段，以及 «Su»«ited»
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、宏/变量名、测试目标等混合大小写标识符；可能与普通词形激活并存。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on intra-word subword fragments resembling en/ten in multilingual text and proper names, often coinciding with subword segmentation or word-form boundaries; semantic, syntactic, and stylistic contexts vary widely, with no stable function apparent.

patterns.name: English -en/-ent morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments corresponding to the letter sequence en in English words; meanings and grammatical contexts vary. In some examples, the fragment coincides with a word ending or stem boundary.
patterns.domain: English text in code/XML, webpage titles, medical abstracts, lists, and other sources

patterns.name: Intra-word letter fragments in European languages
patterns.context: Activations occur inside words in Lithuanian, Swedish, Hungarian, and other languages, often coinciding with inflection or subword segmentation; there is no consistent lexical or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur inside the spellings of personal names, club names, or place names, especially proper names split into multiple subword tokens; not every entire proper name is marked.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia lists, place names, and entity articles

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在多语种文本和专名中形似 en/ten 等的词内子词片段，常与子词切分或词形边界重合；所处语义、语法及文体差异很大，未见稳定功能。

patterns.name: 英文 -en/-ent 形态片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词中 en 字母序列对应的子词片段上；词义和语法环境各异。部分实例中该片段与词尾或词干边界重合。
patterns.domain: 代码/XML、网页标题、医学摘要、名单等英文文本

patterns.name: 欧洲语言词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在立陶宛语、瑞典语、匈牙利语等词的内部，常与词形变化或子词切分重合；没有一致的词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名、俱乐部名或地名的拼写内部，尤其是拆分成多个子词 token 的专名；并非专名整体都被标记。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 名单、地名与实体条目

en.description: Activations are broadly distributed across words and proper names in multiple languages, often around the letter sequence en (e.g., Koenraad, Roemenië, Guénée, Seen, ontvangen), and also appear in list text; some marked spans do not clearly correspond to this sequence.

patterns.name: Dutch committee-member name fragment
patterns.context: Activations concentrate near the Dutch letter sequence “en”; the name Koenraad Dillen appears in the same form in two passages, while passage 9 also contains the common word geen.
patterns.domain: European Parliament records; passages 4 and 5 contain the same letter sequence in English content

patterns.name: Intra-word en letter sequence
patterns.context: Activations fall on the letter sequence en inside words in several European languages, including proper names, place names, and word endings or medial positions; no particular semantics are required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary text and English encyclopedia and music lists

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final en
patterns.context: Passages 6 and 7 are in Hungarian; prominent activations occur on en in “együttesen,” possibly related to the same letter sequence in Hungarian word forms.
patterns.domain: Hungarian text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: en in lists and proper names

2_1034.concept: 多语种 en 字母序列
2_1034.description: 激活广泛分布于多语种词语及专名中，常见 en 字母序列（如 Koenraad、Roemenië、Guénée、Seen、ontvangen），也出现在列表文本；部分标记与该序列对应不明确。

patterns.name: 荷兰语委员姓名片段

patterns.context: 激活集中在荷兰语字母序列「en」附近；姓名 Koenraad Dillen 在两段中以相同形式出现，而第9段也有普通词 geen。

patterns.name: 词内 en 字母序列

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾 en
patterns.context: 第6、7段为匈牙利语；显著激活出现在「együttesen」的 en，可能与该语言词形中的相同字母序列有关。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语文本

patterns.name: 列表与专名中的 en
patterns.context: 在类别标签、地名及歌曲名等英文列表文本中也出现激活，提示触发不依赖连贯句子或议会语境。

patterns.name: 缺乏一致子串证据的局部激活
patterns.context: 若干激活处与 en 的对应不够明确，或标记落在词的其他部分；仅凭这些短片段无法确定是否由同一字母序列触发。

en.description: Activations mostly occur on intra-word fragments, word endings, or compound identifiers in different languages. Clear local patterns include Dutch word endings, code directory/frequency variables, and name fragments such as Suen and Guénée, but the passages share no uniform lexical or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Dutch word endings and segmentation boundaries
patterns.context: In continuous Dutch text, activations fall near suffixes, word endings, or word boundaries; -en is common, but other intra-word fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment in Dutch

patterns.name: Path and directory identifier DIR
patterns.context: A script uses a directory variable to locate the project directory and change paths; activations are scattered around identifiers and commands.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Italian
patterns.context: In Italian prose, activations occur inside or at the ends of different words; no single stable root is apparent.

patterns.name: Suen in a personal name

patterns.name: The lunar deity Suen
patterns.context: An encyclopedia article introduces the Mesopotamian deity Nanna/Suen/Sin.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Polish

patterns.name: French surname ending

patterns.name: Frequency variable identifier
patterns.context: A shell script repeatedly uses variable names containing freq, adjacent to performance/frequency calculations.

2_1034.description: 激活多出现在不同语言的词内片段、词尾或复合标识符中；明确局部模式包括荷兰语词尾、代码目录/频率变量及 Suen、Guénée 等专名片段，但各段无统一词汇或语义触发条件。

en.description: Overall, activations favor multilingual intra-word substrings rather than stable meanings, often in inflected words, institutional terms, and proper names in formal European parliamentary text; repeated fragments also occur in drug/product names and code identifiers.

patterns.name: Frequent suffixes or morphemes at intra-word segmentation points in EU/political text
patterns.context: Across multiple languages in EU parliamentary corpora, activations fall inside segmented whole words, often on inflectional endings, derivational parts, or stem fragments; no single suffix is consistent.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European parliamentary debates, policy, and political text

patterns.name: Parliamentary procedure and member titles
patterns.context: Occurs in speeches by members, parliamentary procedure, or formal institutional titles; activations are distributed across fragments within parliament-related words.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in proper names or place names
patterns.context: Triggering fragments are embedded in proper names such as countries, cities, or personal names; not all proper names activate in the same way.
patterns.domain: Countries, locations, and personal names in parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Internal segmentation in drug/product words
patterns.context: Activations fall within apparent drug/product names, surrounded by text about purchasing, over-the-counter drugs, pills, and promotional copy.
patterns.domain: Web commercial advertisements and pharmaceutical sales text

patterns.name: Code package-name and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur inside dot-separated identifiers such as Java package and class names, recurring across adjacent identifiers.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Latvian political words
patterns.context: In formal historical or institutional narratives, activations fall on internal fragments of inflected Latvian words.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Slovenian institutional terms
patterns.context: In contexts involving reform, reports, and committees, activations fall on stem or ending fragments.

2_1034.description: 激活总体偏向多语种词内子串而非稳定词义，常见于欧洲议会正式文本中的屈折词、机构词及专名；另见药品商品名和代码标识符中的重复片段。

patterns.context: 多种欧盟议会语料语言中，激活落在被切分的完整词内部，常见于屈折词尾、派生部分或词干片段；没有一致的单一后缀。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会辩论、政策与政治文本

patterns.name: 议会程序与成员称谓
patterns.context: 在议员发言、议会程序或正式机构称谓中出现；激活分布于议会相关词的内部片段。

patterns.name: 专名或地名内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在国家、城市或人名等专名中；并非每个专名都以相同方式激活。
patterns.domain: 议会发言中的国家、地点及人名

patterns.name: 药品商品词中的内部分段
patterns.context: 激活落在疑似药品/商品名的词中，周围是购买、非处方药、药片及促销文案。
patterns.domain: 网页商业广告与药品销售文本

patterns.name: 代码包名与标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活发生在 Java 包名、类名等点分隔标识符内部，重复出现在相邻标识符中。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与许可证注释

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语政治词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在正式历史或制度性叙述中，激活落在拉脱维亚语屈折词的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会拉脱维亚语文本

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语制度词中的词内片段

patterns.domain: 欧洲议会斯洛文尼亚语政策文本

en.description: Most passages activate the letter sequence en in words across multiple languages, sometimes across morpheme boundaries; activations also occur on ens in the code identifier consenSys and ine in a repeated name in advertising text, the latter two possibly being local coincidences.

patterns.name: en in nouns or word endings
patterns.context: The character sequence en appears in whole words, word endings, or medial positions across several languages; activation positions do not always match morpheme boundaries and do not depend on a single language.
patterns.domain: Multilingual news, parliamentary text, emails, and academic text

patterns.name: ens in a software identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in a Go code import path, surrounded by package names and import syntax.

patterns.name: ine in an obfuscated drug name
patterns.context: Two repeated apparent drug or product names both contain ine, appearing in drug-promotion spam; other words such as medicine, generic, and pills may provide local context.

2_1034.description: 多数片段在多语种词中激活字母序列 en，位置可跨词素边界；另见代码标识符 consenSys 中的 ens，以及广告文本重复名称中的 ine，后两者可能是局部巧合。

patterns.name: 名词或词尾中的 en
patterns.context: 多种语言中，字符序列 en 出现在完整词、词尾或词内；激活位置不总与词素边界吻合，也不依赖单一语言。
patterns.domain: 多语种新闻、议会文本、邮件及学术文本

patterns.name: 软件标识符中的 ens
patterns.trigger: [4] «cons«ens»9«ys»，即标识符 consenSys 的 en/ens 字符序列
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 代码的导入路径中，周围为包名与导入语法。

patterns.name: 被混淆药品词中的 ine
patterns.context: 两个重复的疑似药品或商品名称均含 ine，见于药品促销式垃圾文本；其他词如 medicine、generic、pills 可能构成局部语境。

en.description: Activations broadly fall on subword fragments within words in different languages, often near word endings; they also hit name fragments and short function words. The GitHub passage instead highlights carriage returns, list markers, and paths. No stable semantic or syntactic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Suffix-like or word-final fragments at intra-word subword boundaries
patterns.context: Activations usually fall on final segments or suffix-like fragments inside whole words; however, the fragments span languages and do not always share the same morphological function.
patterns.domain: Narrative and formal text in Italian, Estonian, English, Hungarian, Slovenian, Swedish, and other languages

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in multilingual European Parliament text
patterns.context: Markers most often occur inside words in EU policy, question-and-answer, or argumentative prose; languages and word forms vary, with no stable syntactic position.

patterns.name: Proper names and their internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments inside personal names, rather than clearly marking a category of proper names.
patterns.domain: Academic introductions and legal case citations

patterns.name: Formatting markers in code repository change logs
patterns.context: Concentrated around GitHub PR lists, line breaks, and project paths, clearly distinct from natural-language intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Short function words or common fragments between adjacent words
patterns.context: Markers sometimes cover a preceding space and short word, or fall inside a common word; this occurs in only a few passages and cannot independently explain the overall activation.
patterns.domain: English legal text, Swedish text, and Slovenian text

2_1034.concept: 跨语言子词与格式片段
2_1034.description: 激活广泛落在不同语言词内的子词片段，常靠近词尾，也会命中姓名片段、短功能词；GitHub 段则突出回车换行、列表符和路径。没有稳定的语义或句法主题。

patterns.name: 词内子词边界上的后缀或词尾
patterns.trigger: 多种语言中被标记的词内片段，如«en»10、«ali»3、«jan»2、«ir»2、«ge»9、«an»7、«li»5、«gen»9
patterns.context: 激活通常落在完整词内部的末段或后缀样子片段；但片段跨语言、并不总是同一形态功能。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、爱沙尼亚语、英语、匈牙利语、斯洛文尼亚语、瑞典语等叙述与正式文本

patterns.name: 欧洲议会多语种正文中的词内片段

patterns.name: 专名及其内部片段

patterns.name: 代码仓库变更记录中的格式标记

patterns.name: 相邻词间短功能词或常见片段

patterns.context: 出现在药品及促销文本中，尤其是反复出现的“SomineX”名称内部；其他激活词较分散。
patterns.domain: 网页商品／药品促销文案

patterns.name: 议会文本中的罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记散布于罗马尼亚语词形中；段落讨论小企业如何融资、是否需要团结基金或集体解决方案。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on subword fragments inside words, often near word endings or morpheme boundaries, across languages and styles; they also occur in repeated spellings in drug advertisements and in proper names in physics papers, with no stable topic or semantic trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments inside words in multiple languages, often near word endings or at morpheme boundaries; no fixed word or meaning is required.

patterns.name: Spelling and morphological continuation
patterns.context: Activations involve continuous spelling fragments within words or derivational morphemes; in passage [4], the same word recurs with increasing intensity.
patterns.domain: English spam advertising / pharmaceutical shopping text

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activations occur inside proper names or technical terms; here they appear in a citation in a superconductivity research paper.

2_1034.description: 激活主要落在单词内部的子词片段，常见于词尾或词素边界，跨多种语言与文体；也出现在药品广告的重复拼写片段及物理论文专名中，未见稳定的主题或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词尾子词元片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种语言单词内部的子词片段，常接近词尾或处于词素边界；并不要求某个固定词或语义

patterns.name: 拼写与词素延续
patterns.context: 激活涉及词中连续拼写片段或派生词素；段[4]中同一词反复出现且强度递增
patterns.domain: 英文垃圾广告/药品购物文本

patterns.name: 专业术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于专名或专业词内部；此处出现在超导研究的论文引文中

en.description: Activation most clearly falls on matter (a legal issue or substance) and Archive strings; web markup, legal monetary wording, and sporadic URL/term highlights also appear, but it is unclear whether they share a trigger pattern. In paragraph 6, activation appears only in the matter filename.

patterns.name: matter terms and legal compounds
patterns.context: Appears in phrases such as “subject-matter jurisdiction,” “subject-matter,” or “resolving this matter”; in legal texts it often occurs near subject or jurisdiction, and can also mean an issue to be resolved.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, legal and business email

patterns.name: Scientific use of matter
patterns.context: matter means substance or an object of study, adjacent to scientific or technical words such as light, interactions, and transplant.

patterns.name: Archive strings and related names
patterns.context: Appears as a website link path, organization name, URL anchor, or code identifier; surrounding context concerns web archiving, Internet Archive, database functions, or Archive links.

patterns.name: Pill at a boundary position
patterns.context: Appears in the title “A Bitter Pill”; it is relatively close to matter triggered in a URL in the same paragraph, but evidence on its own is weak.

patterns.name: Structured HTML and link markup
patterns.context: Formatted web text around HTML anchors, closing tags, and double square brackets.

patterns.name: Judgment amounts and interest wording
patterns.context: Legal-document terms for amounts, interest, and judgments occur nearby; they appear in the same paragraph as matter activation, but are not obviously the same triggering substring.

patterns.name: Year and link-path fragments
patterns.context: Dates, numbers, and path fragments in URLs; a single example cannot establish whether they trigger independently.

patterns.name: Other sporadic terms
patterns.context: Highlighted words are distributed across sentence fragments, some missing the left-side word form; it is unclear whether ous, the, or Archive share a contextual condition.

2_1092.concept: matter 与 Archive 字符串
2_1092.description: 激活最明确地落在 matter（法律事项或物质）与 Archive 字符串；另有网页标记、法律金额措辞及零散 URL/词项高亮，无法确定都属于同一触发规律。第6段仅见 matter 文件名中的激活。

patterns.name: matter 词项与法律复合词
patterns.context: 出现在“subject-matter jurisdiction”“subject-matter”或“resolving this matter”等短语中；法律文本中常与 subject、jurisdiction 相邻，也可指待解决事项。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法律与商务邮件

patterns.name: matter 的科学用法
patterns.context: matter 作物质或研究对象，与 light、interactions、transplant 等科学或技术词相邻。

patterns.name: Archive 字符串及相关命名
patterns.context: 作为网站链接路径、机构名称、URL 锚点或代码中的标识符出现；周围语境涉及网页归档、Internet Archive、数据库函数或 Archive 链接。

patterns.name: 边界位置的 Pill
patterns.context: 出现在标题“A Bitter Pill”中；与同段 URL 中触发的 matter 相距较近，单独证据较弱。

patterns.name: 结构化 HTML 与链接标记
patterns.context: HTML 锚点、闭合标签及双中括号等标记周围的格式化网页文本。
patterns.domain: 网页目录或 HTML 片段

patterns.name: 判决金额与利息措辞
patterns.context: 金额、利息及判决等法律文书词汇相邻；它们与 matter 激活同段，但并非显然同一触发子串。

patterns.name: 年份与链接路径碎片
patterns.context: 网址中的日期、数字及路径片段；是否独立触发无法从单一例子确定。

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 高亮词分布在句子片段中，部分缺少左侧词形；不能确定 ous、the 或 Archive 是否有共同上下文条件。

en.concept: matter-related forms and a few proper names/paths
en.description: Responds mainly to matter and its compounds (especially subject-matter and light-matter), as well as Archive-related names or paths and the proper name Bay Area; in [6], activation falls on the matter link, but the word is not marked, so the trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: matter compounds or legal terms
patterns.context: Appears in compounds such as subject-matter, light-matter, and fecal-matter, or alone to mean an issue to be resolved; also occurs in the legal term subject-matter jurisdiction.
patterns.domain: Legal, scientific, news, and email text

patterns.name: Archive-related names and paths
patterns.context: Appears in website link paths, Internet Archive-related names, or web directories.

patterns.name: Area in a place name
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name Bay Area, referring to the San Francisco Bay Area.

2_1092.concept: matter相关词形及少数专名/路径
2_1092.description: 主要响应 matter 及其复合表达（尤其 subject-matter、light-matter），也响应 Archive 相关名称或路径，以及专名 Bay Area；[6] 中激活落在 matter 链接上，但该词未标出，触发原因不明。

patterns.name: matter 复合词或法律术语
patterns.context: 出现在 subject-matter、light-matter、fecal-matter 等复合表达中，或单独表示待解决事项；也出现在 subject-matter jurisdiction 法律术语中。

patterns.name: Archive 相关名称与路径
patterns.context: 出现在网站链接路径、互联网档案馆相关名称或网页目录中。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Area
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Bay Area 中，指旧金山湾区。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on Archive, the exacerbate stem, and sporadic internal word fragments; the latter two categories may reflect word-form substrings, but examples vary in meaning and domain, so no single clear condition explains all paragraphs.

patterns.name: Archive strings and related markers
patterns.context: Triggers occur in web links or titles, discussions of Internet archives, filenames/code identifiers, and C++ template type names; the specific meaning varies by context.

patterns.name: exacerbate stem
patterns.context: Embedded in English forms meaning to intensify or worsen; surrounding discussion concerns depression, economic problems, airway inflammation, or muscle weakness.

patterns.name: Irregular internal word fragments
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside longer words or identifiers without a shared obvious semantic condition; they may reflect multiple word-form/substring features.
patterns.domain: Medical, web, code, and general text

2_1092.description: 激活集中在 Archive 字样、exacerbate 词干，也散见于多种词内片段；后两类可能反映词形子串，但各例语义与领域不一，无法用单一明确条件解释全部段落。

patterns.name: Archive 字样及相关标记
patterns.trigger: «Archive»，包括路径中的 «Archive»10、代码标识符中的 «Archive»9
patterns.context: 触发出现在网页链接或标题、互联网存档讨论、文件名/代码标识符，以及 C++ 模板类型名中；具体含义随语境变化。

patterns.name: exacerbate 词干
patterns.context: 嵌在表示加剧、恶化的英语词形中；周围谈论抑郁、经济问题、气道炎症或肌无力。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 不规则词内片段
patterns.context: 片段落在较长词或标识符内部，没有共同的明显语义条件；可能反映多种词形/子串特征。
patterns.domain: 医学、网页、代码及一般文本

en.description: Activation falls mainly on the acerbate/worsen root and also appears in Archive strings; sporadic fragments occur in Wasserstein, cross-sectional, and group notation, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Forms meaning intensify or worsen
patterns.context: The root appears in contexts where a disease, symptom, or problem becomes more severe; the activated portion is segmented differently across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, informal economic discussion

patterns.name: Archive-related strings
patterns.context: Appears in web link paths or Archive identifiers in code; paragraph 8 also contains lowercase, unmarked archive.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the proper name Wasserstein
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical notation or discussion of the Wasserstein distance.

patterns.name: Long-bone cross-section term
patterns.context: Appears in a compound term describing the cross-sectional area of a long bone.

patterns.name: Suzuki group notation
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical notation for finite groups.

2_1092.description: 激活主要落在 acerbate/加重词根，也出现在 Archive 字符串；另有 Wasserstein、cross-sectional 和群记号中的零散片段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 加重与恶化形式
patterns.context: 该词根出现在疾病、症状或问题变得更严重的语境中；触发部分在各段有不同切分
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述、非正式经济讨论

patterns.name: Archive 相关字符串
patterns.context: 出现在网页链接路径或代码中的 Archive 标识符；段 8 另有小写的未标记 archive
patterns.domain: 网页目录、HackerNews 链接、代码

patterns.name: Wasserstein 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学论文对 Wasserstein 距离的记号或讨论中

patterns.name: 长骨截面术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述长骨横截面积的复合术语中

patterns.name: Suzuki 群记号
patterns.trigger: «_»（$^2B_2(q)$ 等群记号中的下标分隔符）
patterns.context: 出现在有限群的数学记号中

en.description: The strongest activations are concentrated on parallel (5 paragraphs) and placing (3 paragraphs), occurring respectively in contexts involving parallel relations and placing or positioning; there are also internal word fragments, line breaks, and scattered local activations across multiple domains, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: The word parallel
patterns.context: The word occurs in contexts describing parallel relations, parallel arrangements, or simultaneous activity; objects and domains vary.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, biomedicine, computer patents, materials and physics, mathematics, and legal texts

patterns.name: The word placing
patterns.context: Describes placing or positioning an object, or putting someone somewhere; objects include plant material, experimental animals, and witnesses.

patterns.name: Internal fragments and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word fragments, mathematical symbols, or line-break markers rather than clearly meaningful whole words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and formatted mathematical papers

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in local phrases
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common words or local phrases in specialized prose; no shared trigger as clear as parallel or placing is evident.

patterns.name: Other local function-word activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on sporadic words or fragments across paragraphs; their shared conditions cannot be determined from the available context.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and encyclopedia entries

2_1092.description: 最强激活集中在 parallel（5段）和 placing（3段），分别出现在并行/平行关系及放置、安置语境；另有词内片段、换行和分散的局部激活，跨越多个领域，未显示统一语义。

patterns.name: parallel 一词
patterns.context: 该词出现在描述并行关系、平行排列或并列进行的语境中；对象和领域各异。
patterns.domain: 化学、生物医学、计算机专利、材料与物理、数学及法律文本

patterns.name: placing 一词
patterns.context: 描述把对象放置、安置或将某人置于某处；所涉对象包括植物材料、实验动物和证人。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学及法律文本

patterns.name: 词内片段与换行格式
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词片段、数学符号或换行标记上，而非明显的完整语义词。
patterns.domain: 百科条目及数学论文格式文本

patterns.name: 局部短语中的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活分布于专业叙述中的常见词或局部短语；未见与 parallel 或 placing 同样明确的共同触发项。

patterns.name: 其他局部功能词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在各段中零散的词或片段，无法从现有上下文确认其共同条件。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述及百科条目

en.concept: penetr- stem and related spelling patterns
en.description: High activation is concentrated in the penetr- word family (penetrance or penetration/entry/depth), with additional responses to the inaccuracy family; the spelling fragment is shared, but the meanings span genetic expression, physical penetration, and measurement error.

patterns.name: penetrance word family
patterns.context: The trigger is the genetics term “penetrance,” describing genetic interactions in disease and reduced penetrance, tumorigenesis penetrance, and incomplete penetrance in autosomal dominant dystonia.

patterns.name: Penetration/entry
patterns.context: Triggers the “penetr-” stem and its variants, meaning molecules or particles entering tissue, a medium, or an internal space, or referring to penetration depth; objects and mechanisms vary.
patterns.domain: Mitochondrial biology, particle physics, neuroscience, optics, obstetrics and gynecology

patterns.name: inaccuracy word family
patterns.context: Triggers “inaccuracy” and word-form fragments referring to insufficient accuracy of measurements or methods; one example discusses disagreement between standards, while another lists errors and imprecision across different sample matrices.

2_1092.description: 高激活集中在 penetr- 词族（外显率或穿透、进入、深度），另对 inaccuracy 词族有响应；共享拼写片段，但语义分属遗传表达、物理穿透和测量误差。

patterns.name: penetrance 词族
patterns.context: 触发词是遗传学术语“penetrance”，分别描述疾病的遗传相互作用与降低的外显率、肿瘤生成的外显率，以及常染色体显性肌张力障碍的不完全外显率。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、肿瘤生物学、临床医学

patterns.name: 穿透/进入
patterns.context: 触发“penetr-”词干及其变化形式，表示分子或粒子进入组织、介质或体内空间，或穿透深度；对象和机制各异。
patterns.domain: 线粒体生物学、粒子物理、神经科学、光学、妇产科

patterns.name: inaccuracy 词族
patterns.context: 触发测量结果或方法准确性不足的“inaccuracy”及词形片段；前者讨论标准间结果不一致，后者列出不同样本基质中的误差与不精密性。

en.description: Most fragments activate on wet, covering wet weight, wet deposition, wet season, wet etching/chemistry, wet processes, and wet sludge; other non-wet activation terms occur in tent and dental contexts and cannot be explained by this word sense.

patterns.name: wetting / grain-boundary interfacial phenomena
patterns.context: Appears in “grain-boundary wetting,” describing wetting or pinning phenomena at grain boundaries or interfaces; wetting is split into a marked token.

patterns.name: wet weight measurement unit
patterns.context: Follows metabolite content and values in tissue, indicating measurement by wet weight.

patterns.name: wet deposition
patterns.context: Contrasted with dry deposition; refers to wet deposition of nitrogen- and phosphorus-containing aerosols and gases.

patterns.name: wet season
patterns.context: Contrasted with dry seasons as a seasonal comparison condition for fluoride concentrations.

patterns.name: wet etching
patterns.context: Describes a manufacturing process for etching metal layers with liquid chemical reagents.
patterns.domain: Patents, thin films, and metal processing

patterns.name: wet chemical methods
patterns.context: Appears as a technique category for synthesizing ZnO nanowires.

patterns.name: wet process
patterns.context: Describes wet processes that materials must withstand during circuit board manufacturing.

patterns.name: wet sludge
patterns.context: In the context of treating alcohol-distillation wastewater, describes sludge samples associated with suspended-solids concentrations.

patterns.name: Other highly activated content with no clear wet trigger
patterns.context: These fragments' high-activation markers do not fall on wet-related words; they concern folding tents and dental data analysis, with no obvious contextual connection to the other fragments' use of wet.

2_1092.description: 多数片段激活于 wet，涵盖湿重、湿沉降、湿季、湿法蚀刻/化学、湿制程及湿污泥；另有帐篷与牙科语境中的非 wet 激活词，无法由该词义统一解释。

patterns.name: wetting / grain-boundary界面现象
patterns.context: 出现在“grain-boundary wetting”中，描述晶界或界面的润湿、钉扎现象；wetting 被拆分为标记 token。

patterns.name: wet weight 测量单位
patterns.context: 紧接组织中代谢物含量及数值之后，表示按湿重计量。

patterns.name: wet deposition（湿沉降）
patterns.context: 与 dry deposition 对举，指含氮、磷气溶胶和气体的湿沉降。

patterns.name: wet season（湿季）
patterns.context: 与 dry seasons 对举，作为氟化物浓度的季节性比较条件。

patterns.name: wet etching（湿法蚀刻）
patterns.context: 描述用液体化学试剂蚀刻金属层的制造工艺。

patterns.name: wet chemical methods（湿化学法）
patterns.context: 作为合成 ZnO 纳米线的技术类别出现。
patterns.domain: 材料化学、纳米材料研究

patterns.name: wet process（湿制程）
patterns.context: 描述电路板制造过程中材料需要承受的湿制程。

patterns.name: wet sludge（湿污泥）
patterns.context: 在酒精蒸馏废水处理语境中，描述悬浮固体浓度所对应的污泥样品。

patterns.name: 其他无明显 wet 触发的高激活内容
patterns.trigger: « twisted»2 and « folded»1；« camping»9；« teeth»2 before and after « treatment»2
patterns.context: 这些片段的高激活标记不落在 wet 相关词上，分别涉及折叠帐篷、牙科数据分析；与其余片段的 wet 用法没有明显上下文联系。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、牙科统计研究

en.concept: Mixed word fragments and local terms
en.description: Activation is distributed across code identifiers, Debye terms, cold, and various scientific and legal word fragments; De and cold recur across paragraphs, but the whole set forms no unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: De token fragments in Deceased/Delegate
patterns.context: In C# identifiers, De and following subword fragments form DeceasedName, DelegatedAuthenticationUserDetailsService, or DelegateCommand; De is marked as strongly activated.

patterns.name: Debye token fragments
patterns.context: The term Debye appears in scientific contexts involving screening length or temperature.

patterns.name: Cold-related word contexts
patterns.context: Refers respectively to the cold phase of gas and to an atomic cloud; in the legal paragraph it appears in the fixed phrase “cold record.”

patterns.name: L marker and surrounding code symbols
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical function-space notation L^p, H^p.

patterns.name: Sporadic identifiers in code
patterns.context: A word fragment in the PHP configuration variable cache_lifetime is activated; no clearly shared semantic condition with the other paragraphs is evident.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Describes galaxy-scale simulations and gas at different temperatures; apart from cold, these word fragments occur in the same scientific sentence.

patterns.name: Other sporadic function words and term fragments
patterns.context: Appears in a legal sentence about appellate review of the weight of evidence and in case names; no stable shared trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: Other code fragments
patterns.context: Appears near PHP configuration variables and Java comment-formatting directives; fragments are scattered and lack a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Other scientific paper fragments
patterns.context: Appears in different scientific contexts, including cold-atom experiments, thermonuclear upper bounds, effective permittivity, and characteristic temperature; no common trigger condition is evident.

2_1092.concept: 词片段与局部术语混合
2_1092.description: 激活分散于代码标识符、Debye 术语、cold 及多种科学和法律词片段；De、cold 有跨段复现，但整体未形成统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: Deceased/Delegate 的分词片段
patterns.context: C# 标识符中，De 与后续子词片段组成 DeceasedName、DelegatedAuthenticationUserDetailsService 或 DelegateCommand；De 被标为强激活。

patterns.name: Debye 的分词片段
patterns.context: 术语 Debye 出现在筛蔽长度或温度的科学语境中。

patterns.name: 冷相关词语境
patterns.context: 分别指气体的冷相，以及原子云；法律段落中则是固定表达“cold record”。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、原子物理、法律

patterns.name: L 标记及其周边代码符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学函数空间记号 L^p、H^p 中。

patterns.name: 代码中的零散标识符片段
patterns.context: PHP 配置变量 cache_lifetime 的词片段被激活，未见与其他段明确相同的语义条件。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 描述星系尺度模拟及气体不同温度相；除 cold 外，这些词片段呈现于同一科学句子。

patterns.name: 其他零散功能词与术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于上诉法院审查证据权重的法律句子及判例名称中，未显示稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他代码片段
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 配置变量及 Java 注释格式指令附近，片段分散，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: em or adjacent string fragments
patterns.context: The substring em occurs inside different words or in HTML markup; the feature may be sensitive to the em character sequence, but trigger positions and word meanings are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Web, code, place names, and general text

patterns.name: GEM/Gem strings
patterns.context: Gem strings with differing capitalization or word boundaries occur in Ruby namespaces, author names, drug names/abbreviations, and comments; some examples distribute activations across adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Code, academic papers, medical texts, comments

patterns.name: Fragments inside proper nouns or words
patterns.context: Activations occur on word-internal fragments in domains, place names, personal names, or paths; the examples lack a unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web, encyclopedias, paper citations, configuration files

patterns.name: Specific common or technical words
patterns.context: Activations occur respectively in energy headlines, TLS configuration, physics, oncology, comments, and Bayesian inverse problems; no shared word meaning or syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: News headlines, configuration, physics, medicine, comments, statistics

2_1092.concept: 字符串片段与标记特征
2_1092.description: 激活分散于 em/Gem 字符串、HTML 标记、专名片段及多领域词语；有大小写、词界和 token 边界差异，无法从这些例子确认单一语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: HTML标签与标记边界
patterns.context: 激活落在 HTML 标签内部、标签文本边界或换行标记上；[1] 中还包括文件名 spacer.gif 前的 URL 片段。
patterns.domain: 网页片段、百科标记、代码

patterns.name: em 或相邻字符串片段
patterns.context: 子串 em 出现在不同词内或 HTML 标记中；可能对 em 字符序列敏感，但触发位置与词义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码、地名与普通文本

patterns.name: GEM/Gem 字符串
patterns.context: 大小写或词界不同的 gem 字符串，见于 Ruby 命名空间、作者姓名、药名/缩写和评论文本；有些例子激活分布在相邻 token 上。
patterns.domain: 代码、学术论文、医学文本、评论

patterns.name: 专名或词语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在域名、地名、人名或路径中的词内片段；现有例子缺少统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科、论文引用、配置文件

patterns.name: 特定普通词或技术词
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在能源标题、TLS 配置、物理、肿瘤学、评论和贝叶斯反问题等语境；未见共同的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题、配置、物理、医学、评论、统计学

en.description: Many activations occur on letter fragments such as em/gem, commonly in Gem names, drug names, or word-internal substrings. Other sporadic activations occur in academic terms, names, template markup, and URLs, making it difficult to group them into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: gem/related spelling fragments
patterns.context: Triggers are embedded in different words or identifiers: Ruby's `Gem::Specification`, the personal name `Gemelke`, the drug name `Gemtuzumab`, `deepGem`, the cancer drugs `gemcitabine`/`GemCis`, and truncated or cross-word fragments such as `Pem`.
patterns.domain: Code, academic papers, medical literature, forum text, web

patterns.name: em-related word-internal infix
patterns.context: Activations occur on letter fragments inside words; word meanings and syntactic conditions vary.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in paper terminology
patterns.context: In academic discussions of inverse problems and Bayesian inference, activations are distributed across multiple terms and word fragments, with no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Patent medical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of antibody-conjugated antitumor antibiotics; these words share a medical/drug context, but it is unclear whether they have a stable shared form feature.

patterns.name: Short words and markup symbols
patterns.context: Short fragments occur near encyclopedia templates, line breaks, and table fields; their connection to other activation patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Citation and author-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in academic citations or author names, resembling sporadic name/citation fragments rather than a consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Fragments in a PI3K pathway paragraph
patterns.context: Occurs in a medical paper paragraph about prostate cancer and the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway; a single paragraph is insufficient to determine the trigger condition.

patterns.name: Web address fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in the URL `rigzone.com`, surrounded by webpage image links and a news headline.

2_1092.description: 多段激活落在 em/gem 一类字母片段中，常见于 Gem 名称、药名或词内子串；另有学术词、姓名、模板标记和网址等零散激活，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: gem/相关拼写片段
patterns.context: 触发部分嵌在不同词或标识符中：Ruby 的 `Gem::Specification`、人名 `Gemelke`、药名 `Gemtuzumab`、`deepGem`、癌症药物 `gemcitabine`/`GemCis`，以及 `Pem` 等截断或跨词片段。
patterns.domain: 代码、学术论文、医学文献、论坛文本、网页

patterns.name: em 相关词中缀
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的字母片段；词义和句法条件不一致。

patterns.name: 零散论文词片段
patterns.context: 在逆问题与贝叶斯推断的学术表述中，激活分布于多个术语和词片段，未显示单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 专利医学表达
patterns.context: 出现在抗体偶联抗肿瘤抗生素的描述中；这些词语共同属于医学/药物语境，但是否存在稳定的共同词形特征不明确。

patterns.name: 短词与标记符
patterns.context: 百科模板、换行及表格字段附近出现的短片段；与其他激活模式的联系不清楚。

patterns.name: 引用与作者名片段
patterns.context: 出现在学术文献引用或作者姓名中，像是零散的姓名/引用片段，而非一致的语义触发。

patterns.name: PI3K 通路段落中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在前列腺癌与 PI3K/Akt 信号通路的医学论文段落中；单段证据不足以确定触发条件。

patterns.name: 网页地址片段
patterns.context: 嵌在网址 `rigzone.com` 中，周围为网页图片链接和新闻标题。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的网页内容

en.concept: Detection of the word-internal substring «em» (partial match)
en.description: The most prominent common clue is the word-internal fragment «em», often in gem/GEM. However, activations also mark many fragments and boundary markers that do not share this substring or meaning. They span domains and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: gem substring
patterns.context: Trigger markers occur across word boundaries or on word-internal fragments; the word need not be the sentence topic.
patterns.domain: Code, physics, place names, energy emails, biomedicine, forum comments, machine learning papers, and other styles

patterns.name: Confounding word-internal fragments
patterns.context: The shown fragments have no stable shared meaning; markers sometimes occur inside words and may be unrelated to the gem pattern.
patterns.domain: Papers, encyclopedias, email, comments, and code

patterns.name: Boundaries and special markers
patterns.context: Activation markers occur near line breaks or fragment boundaries; context does not establish whether they correspond to meaningful textual triggers.

2_1092.concept: 词内子串«em»检测（部分吻合）
2_1092.description: 最显著的共同线索是词内片段«em»，常见于 gem/GEM；但激活也标在多种不共享该子串或词义的片段及边界标记上，跨领域分布，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: gem 子串
patterns.context: 触发标记落在跨词边界或词内片段上；并不要求该词是句子主题。
patterns.domain: 代码、物理学、地名、能源邮件、生物医学、论坛评论、机器学习论文等多种文体

patterns.name: 易混淆的词内片段
patterns.context: 在所示片段里没有稳定的共同词义；标记有时位于词内部，可能与 gem 模式无关。
patterns.domain: 论文、百科、邮件、评论及代码

patterns.name: 边界及特殊标记
patterns.context: 激活标记落在换行或片段边界附近，无法从上下文确定它们是否对应有意义的文本触发。

en.description: The passages contain sporadic word-internal fragment activations, most commonly em (including word-internal positions in gem, Pembro, and Wembley), along with Wikipedia markup and various ungrouped word fragments. Beyond fragment form, no stable semantic or contextual pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal em substring
patterns.context: Activations occur inside words containing em, usually not at the beginning; no consistent word meaning or grammatical condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: code, academic papers, patents, encyclopedias, email, medical papers

patterns.name: Special markup and boundary symbols
patterns.context: Occurs on line breaks, table-of-contents, and template markers in Wikipedia transcriptions.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on word fragments or formatting markup
patterns.context: Activations occur on various word fragments, proper nouns, abbreviations, or formatting elements with no apparent shared semantics; the examples provide no verifiable unified trigger condition.

2_1092.concept: 含 em 的词内片段
2_1092.description: 各段有零散的词内片段激活，最常见的是 em（包括 gem、Pembro、Wembley 等词内位置）；另有维基标记及多种无法归并的词片段。除片段形式外看不出稳定语义或上下文规律。

patterns.name: 词内 em 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在包含 em 的词内部，且通常不是词首；但未见一致的词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：代码、学术论文、专利、百科、邮件、医学论文

patterns.name: 特殊标记与边界符
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科转录中的换行、目录及模板标记处。

patterns.name: 字词片段或格式标记的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活位于多种无明显共同语义的词片段、专名、缩写或格式元素中；各例缺乏可确认的统一触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple corpora, often on short word-internal character fragments such as em and es, and also on line breaks and several unrelated word segments. There is no stable semantic, syntactic, or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment em
patterns.context: Activations occur on the em letter sequence inside words; capitalization and position relative to word boundaries vary.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles including biomedicine, code, astrophysics, email, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment es
patterns.context: Activations occur on the word-internal sequence es, with no uniform word meaning or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Word segments and affixes in English words
patterns.context: Each occurs only once, in different English words or technical terms, with no shared semantic, positional, or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, code, email, encyclopedias, forum discussions

patterns.name: Line breaks and markup symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur only on line-break markers in paragraphs 2 and 8; there is insufficient evidence to determine whether they depend on a specific structure.

patterns.name: Number and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Local fragment forms vary and may be affected by adjacent text or annotation boundaries; they cannot be grouped into a shared condition.

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Occur once or a few times in common words, proper nouns, or technical discussions; there is no consistent semantic trigger.

2_1092.description: 激活分散在多种语料中，常落于词内短字符片段（如 em、es），也包括换行及多个不相关词段；没有稳定的语义、句法或领域模式。

patterns.name: 词内片段 em
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的 em 字母序列；在大小写与词界位置上不固定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、代码、天文物理、邮件、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 词内片段 es
patterns.context: 激活落在词内 es 序列，未见统一的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、贝叶斯方法、天文物理

patterns.name: 英语词中词段与词缀
patterns.context: 各自仅出现一次；落在不同英语单词或技术词中，未见共享语义、位置或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、代码、邮件、百科、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 换行及标记符
patterns.context: 只在段落 2、8 的换行标记上激活；没有足够证据判断是否依赖特定结构。

patterns.name: 数字与编号片段
patterns.context: 局部片段形态各异，可能受相邻文本或标注边界影响，无法归为共同条件。

patterns.name: 零散单词片段
patterns.context: 单次或少数出现，分别处于普通词、专名或技术讨论中；没有一致的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 天文物理、音乐条目、编程讨论

en.description: Activations include prime factors and primality checks in math problems, as well as symptom uses in medical and biological texts, viruses, plant miRNA, and X-ray exposure terminology; there is no unified meaning covering all passages.

patterns.name: Prime factor questions
patterns.context: Math problems asking for the prime factors of a number or variable; trigger words are often near equations, numbers, or questions.

patterns.name: Asking whether something is prime
patterns.context: Math problems asking whether a given expression or variable is prime, followed by answers such as True/False.

patterns.name: Coordinated nouns in descriptions of medical uses
patterns.context: Lists traditional or medical uses of something, with multiple symptoms, treatment purposes, and folk uses listed together.

patterns.name: Central nervous system and virus
patterns.context: Measles virus-related statements introduced by “In the central nervous system (CNS)”.

patterns.name: Plant miRNA research terminology
patterns.context: Identification of microRNAs and their targets in studies related to plant pathogens and treatment conditions.

patterns.name: Medical X-ray exposure and guidance levels
patterns.context: Discussion of medical X-ray exposure conditions based on surveys and recommended guidance levels.

2_1199.description: 激活既包括数学题中的质因数和素数判断，也包括医学、生物文本中的症状用途、病毒、植物 miRNA 及 X 射线暴露术语；没有覆盖所有段落的统一词义。

patterns.name: 质因数问题
patterns.trigger: « prime»9 factors of；«List»1 the« prime»9 factors；« prime»8 factors of
patterns.context: 数学题中询问某数或变量的质因数；触发词前后常有方程、数字或问句

patterns.name: 询问是否为素数
patterns.context: 数学题询问给定表达式或变量是否为素数，后接 True/False 等答案

patterns.name: 医学用途描述中的并列名词
patterns.trigger: « removal»、« allev»iation、« exp»ulsion、« treatment»、« parasites»、« pain»、« folk» medicine
patterns.context: 列举某物的传统或医学用途，多个症状、治疗目的及民间用途并列

patterns.name: 中枢神经系统与病毒
patterns.trigger: «In» « the» « central» nervous system «(»CNS), « measles» virus
patterns.context: 以“In the central nervous system (CNS)”引出麻疹病毒相关陈述

patterns.name: 植物 miRNA 研究术语
patterns.trigger: micro«RNAs»、« targets»、« Paul»own«ia»、« pathogen»、« methyl» methane« sulf»onate
patterns.context: 植物病原体与处理条件相关研究中，描述 microRNA 及其靶标的鉴定

patterns.name: X 射线医学暴露与指导水平
patterns.trigger: «Medical» exposures、« X»-«ray»、« proposal» of « guidance» level
patterns.context: 讨论基于调查的医学 X 射线暴露条件及指导水平建议

en.concept: The word form prime and sporadic medical terminology
