en.description: The most consistent pattern is prime in math problems, especially questions about prime numbers or prime factors; other activations are scattered across medical, patent, and plant biology texts, covering terms and phrases related to menstruation, X-rays, viruses, and treatment.

patterns.name: Prime math questions
patterns.context: The trigger appears in math problems asking whether an integer is prime, listing prime factors, or discussing primes; it is often near factors, number, a variable, or a number.

patterns.name: Herbal medicine uses and folk foods
patterns.context: Describes a substance or plant used to relieve symptoms, treat disease, or consumed as folk medicine or food.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, medical or traditional-use descriptions

patterns.name: Menstruation-related expressions
patterns.context: Menstrual syndrome appears as a subject in a study of exercise effects.

patterns.name: X-rays and guidance levels
patterns.context: Discusses X-ray technical conditions based on surveys and related guidance levels.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, medical exposure or radiation technology

patterns.name: Central nervous system virus
patterns.context: Mentions measles virus in the context of the central nervous system.

patterns.name: Plant microRNA and methyl methanesulfonate treatment
patterns.context: Studies microRNAs and their targets in Paulownia plants without phytoplasma pathogens, and mentions methyl methanesulfonate treatment.

2_1199.concept: prime 一词及零散医学术语
2_1199.description: 最稳定的模式是数学题中出现 prime，尤其是询问质数或质因数；其余激活分散在医学、专利和植物生物学文本，涵盖月经、X射线、病毒及治疗等词句。

patterns.name: prime 数学问句
patterns.context: 触发词出现在询问整数是否为质数、列出质因数或讨论质数的数学题中；常邻近 factors、number、变量或数字。

patterns.name: 中草药用途与民间食品
patterns.context: 描述某种物质或植物用于缓解症状、治疗疾病，以及作为民间药物或食物摄入。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，医疗或传统用途描述

patterns.name: 月经相关表达
patterns.context: 月经综合征作为运动效果研究中的对象出现。

patterns.name: X 射线与指导水平
patterns.context: 讨论基于调查的 X 射线技术条件及相关指导水平。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，医学暴露或辐射技术

patterns.name: 中枢神经系统病毒
patterns.context: 以中枢神经系统为语境，提及麻疹病毒。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter，生物医学研究描述

patterns.name: 植物微 RNA 与甲基化处理
patterns.context: 研究无植原体病原体的泡桐植物中微 RNA 及其靶标，并提到甲基甲磺酸酯处理。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，植物分子生物学

en.description: All fragments are labeled with the letter k; it can appear in mathematical expressions, across word fragments, or in ordinary words, with varied domains and meanings. The main shared feature is the character k.

patterns.name: The letter k or a following subword
patterns.context: Strong response to words or subword fragments beginning with the letter k; sometimes k is marked alone, and sometimes together with a following word fragment.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including mathematics, medical abstracts, patents, parliamentary texts, and academic titles

2_1199.description: 所有片段均标记字母 k；它可出现在数学表达式、跨词片段或普通词中，领域与词义各异，主要共同点是字符 k。

patterns.name: 字母 k 或其延续子词
patterns.context: 对字母 k 起始的词或子词片段有明显响应；有时 k 单独标记，有时与其后续词片段共同出现。
patterns.domain: 数学、医学摘要、专利、议会文本、学术标题等多种文体

en.description: Primarily responds to prime and its derived collocations in mathematics, including prime factors, primality testing, and prime factorization; there are also a few activations on the initial letter of kappa and on the immunological use of prime/boost.

patterns.name: Prime factors and primality testing
patterns.context: Math questions and discussions about whether an integer is prime, finding prime factors, or discussing prime factors; also includes the use of “prime divisor” in group theory.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics math Q&A; ArXiv number theory and group theory

patterns.name: Kappa/lambda light chains
patterns.context: Quantification of immunoglobulin light chains in medical abstracts; activation falls on the initial letter of “kappa,” rather than on a prime-related use.

patterns.name: Prime/boost immunization regimen
patterns.context: A vaccination regimen involving priming and booster immunization; “prime” does not mean a prime number.

2_1199.description: 主要响应数学中“prime”及其派生搭配，涵盖素因子、素数判定和素数因子化；另对kappa首字母及免疫学prime/boost用法有少量激活。

patterns.name: 素数因子与素数判断
patterns.context: 出现关于整数是否为素数、求素因子或讨论素数因子的数学问题与论述；也包括群论中“prime divisor”的用法。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学问答；ArXiv 数论与群论

patterns.name: kappa/lambda 轻链
patterns.context: 医学摘要中免疫球蛋白轻链定量语境；激活落在“kappa”首字母，而非素数相关用法。

patterns.name: prime/boost 免疫方案
patterns.context: 疫苗接种方案中先导免疫与加强免疫的语境；“prime”不是素数。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

en.concept: Multiple uses of prime and related collocations
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to prime in number theory and its collocations with factors, factorization, and coprimality; it also responds to prime in biomedicine (primary target, vaccine priming) and a few unrelated word fragments, indicating that the trigger is not a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Prime as a number-theoretic term
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical or number-theoretic contexts to mean a prime number, prime factorization, or coprimality; sometimes triggered by a phrase ending in prime.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, number theory papers and problems

patterns.name: Prime in immunology
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical texts to mean a primary target or a vaccine priming/boosting regimen; not the number-theoretic meaning.

patterns.name: Other triggers in immunological contexts
patterns.context: Descriptions of lung disease and activated alveolar macrophages in immunology passages; the activation location has no clear relation to prime.

patterns.name: Trigger in kappa light-chain quantification context
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of total kappa/lambda light chain quantification; may be triggered by a segmented kappa subword fragment.

2_1199.concept: prime 的多义用法及相关搭配
2_1199.description: 主要对数论中的 prime 及其因子、分解和互素搭配强烈响应；也响应生物医学里的 prime（主要靶点、疫苗初免）及少数无关词片段，说明触发并非单一语义模式。

patterns.name: prime 作为素数术语
patterns.context: 出现在数学或数论语境中，指素数、素因子分解，或互素关系；有时以 prime 结尾的短语触发。

patterns.name: 免疫学中的 prime
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学文本中，分别表示主要靶点，或疫苗接种的初免/加强方案；并非数论含义。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 免疫学语境中的其他触发
patterns.context: 免疫学段落中关于肺部疾病及活化肺泡巨噬细胞的描述；激活位置与 prime 无明显关系。

patterns.name: kappa 轻链量化语境中的触发
patterns.context: 出现在 total kappa/lambda light chain quantification 的医学描述中；可能由被拆分的 kappa 词片段触发。

en.concept: Specific character sequences and symbol fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from multiple domains. More evident local patterns include k followed by 9, C followed by 10, and fragments in biochemical, medical, and mathematical symbols; no stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: The letter k adjacent to the number 9
patterns.context: The number 9 directly follows the letter k; occurs in both ordinary text and mathematical notation. Activation does not require a particular domain or syntax.

patterns.name: C adjacent to the number 10
patterns.context: The number 10 directly follows uppercase C, commonly in chemical names, formulas, or abbreviations.

patterns.name: The string Le before Leu
patterns.context: The Le portion of the amino acid abbreviation Leu is activated, appearing in peptide compound names.

patterns.name: Specific EEG letter fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation EEG, but only the G is marked; the surrounding text is a title-like phrase about brain function and the post-hypoxic state.

patterns.name: Analyzed in a mass analysis term
patterns.context: Appears in the mass spectrometry term phrase “Mass-analyzed ion kinetic energy spectra”.
patterns.domain: Mass spectrometry and chemical physics texts

patterns.name: Phox cell names
patterns.context: Appears in the names of Phox2b-positive or -negative cells, in discussions of synaptic transmission blockade and rhythmogenesis.

patterns.name: Ion and fluorescent indicator symbols
patterns.context: Appears in Ca2+ and the fluorescent calcium indicators Fluo-3 and Indo-1; activation falls on chemical symbols or name fragments.

patterns.name: NF-kappa-B-related fragments
patterns.context: Appears in names of immune signaling pathways such as I-kappa-B-kinase and NF-kappa-B.

patterns.name: Mathematical graph theory notation
patterns.context: Symbol and variable fragments are activated in expressions involving the maximum genus of a graph, algorithms, and inequalities.

patterns.name: Other sporadic chemical and biomedical fragments
patterns.context: Appears in terms such as copper-zinc superoxide dismutase, bone marrow, and lymphoblasts; there is insufficient evidence to establish a more stable shared trigger pattern.

2_1199.concept: 特定字符序列及符号片段
2_1199.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，较明显的局部模式是 k 后接 9、C 后接 10，以及生化、医学和数学符号中的片段；看不出稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 字母 k 与数字 9 的邻接
patterns.context: 字母 k 后紧接数字 9；在普通文本和数学记号中均出现。激活不要求特定领域或句法。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、ArXiv 数学文本

patterns.name: C 与数字 10 的邻接
patterns.context: 大写字母 C 后紧接数字 10，常见于化学名称、化学式或缩写。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、化学相关文本

patterns.name: Leu 前的 Le 字符串
patterns.context: 氨基酸缩写 Leu 中的 Le 部分被激活，出现在肽类化合物名称中。

patterns.name: 特定 EEG 字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在缩写 EEG 中，但只标记其中的 G；周围是脑功能与缺氧后状态的标题式表述。

patterns.name: 质量分析术语中的 analyzed
patterns.context: 出现在“Mass-analyzed ion kinetic energy spectra”这一质谱术语短语中。

patterns.name: Phox 细胞名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Phox2b 阳性或阴性细胞的名称中，讨论突触传递阻断和节律发生。

patterns.name: 离子与荧光指示剂符号
patterns.context: 出现在 Ca2+ 及荧光钙指示剂 Fluo-3、Indo-1 的名称中；激活落在化学符号或名称片段上。
patterns.domain: 细胞成像与神经科学摘要

patterns.name: NF-kappa-B 相关片段
patterns.context: 出现在 I-kappa-B-kinase 与 NF-kappa-B 等免疫信号通路名称中。
patterns.domain: 免疫学与肝脏生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 数学图论记号
patterns.context: 在图的最大 genus、算法及不等式表达式中，符号和变量片段被激活。

patterns.name: 其他零散化学与生物医学片段
patterns.context: 在铜锌超氧化物歧化酶、骨髓及淋巴母细胞等术语中出现；各自没有足够证据构成更稳定的共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与生物化学摘要

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the As/as substring in varying capitalization, embedded in abbreviations such as GaAs and Asn as well as appearing as the standalone English word as; fragments of romanized names also activate.

patterns.name: AS10 subword boundary
patterns.context: High activation falls on the As/as string in varying capitalization or its initial subword; it appears in GaAs, the amino acid abbreviation Asn, and ordinary English as.

patterns.name: Romanized fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: Appears in the romanized personal name “Romanized as Khaẕar Gūr…”, rather than in ordinary syntax as as.

patterns.name: Unexplained proper-name fragment
patterns.context: Fragment 8 also activates on other character fragments in romanized names; its relationship to the main repeated As/as trigger is unclear.

2_1199.description: 最稳定触发是大小写不一的 As/as 子串，既嵌在 GaAs、Asn 等缩写中，也独立作为英语 as；另有罗马化人名片段激活。

patterns.name: AS10子词边界
patterns.context: 高激活落在大小写不同的 As/as 字符串或其开头子词上；分别出现在 GaAs、Asn 氨基酸缩写和普通英语 as 中。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、专利、议会文本

patterns.name: 人名中的罗马化片段
patterns.context: 出现在罗马化人名“Romanized as Khaẕar Gūr…”中，而非普通句法中的 as。

patterns.name: 未解释的专名片段
patterns.context: 片段8还激活于罗马化人名的其他字符片段；与主要重复的 As/as 触发关系不明。

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on uppercase O and the string But. The former occurs across many languages and domains; the latter appears both as a conjunction and embedded in chemical and bacterial genus names. There is also As in GaAs, with no apparent unified semantics.

patterns.name: Fragments related to uppercase O
patterns.context: Uppercase O appears alone or as the initial of a following word; it may be preceded by a space or span token fragments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: mathematics, medicine, Finnish/Hungarian/Italian, and EU texts

patterns.name: But as a word-initial string or standalone conjunction
patterns.context: The English conjunction But at the beginning or within a sentence; one activation also appears in the chemical name « But»10HN, possibly as an internal substring.

patterns.name: Butyricoccus initial substring
patterns.context: The substring But appears in the gut microbial genus name Butyricicoccus; this differs from the standalone conjunction But.

patterns.name: As fragment
patterns.context: Appears as the element symbol As in the chemical formula GaAs.

2_1199.description: 强激活主要落在大写 O 及 But 字符串上，前者跨多种语言和领域，后者既作转折词也嵌于化学名及菌属名；另有 GaAs 中的 As，难见统一语义。

patterns.name: 大写 O 相关片段
patterns.context: 大写 O 独立出现，或作为后续词的词首；周围可有空格，也可能跨越分词片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：数学、医学、芬兰语/匈牙利语/意大利语及欧盟文本

patterns.name: But 词首或独立转折词
patterns.context: 英语句首或句中转折词 But；另有一次触发出现在化学名称 « But»10HN 中，可能是词内子串。

patterns.name: Butyricoccus 词首子串
patterns.context: 肠道微生物属名 Butyricicoccus 中出现 But 子串；与独立转折词 But 不同。

patterns.name: As 片段
patterns.context: 作为化学式 GaAs 中元素符号 As 出现。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in multilingual European Parliament records, on proper names, institution or agenda names, and ordinary words beginning with O/o; there are also activations on numbers and many sporadic subwords. The pattern may be influenced by word-initial position and tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: O-initial names related to member states or places
patterns.context: European Parliament speeches contain personal names, place names, institution names, or agenda/document titles beginning with O; the O occurs mid-sentence or sentence-initially, often with unusual capitalization or following subword fragments.

patterns.name: O-initial words in parliamentary proceedings and formal speeches
patterns.context: Ordinary words beginning with o/O appear within sentences, especially in formal speeches, agendas, or statements; the same passage may also contain O-initial proper names.

patterns.name: Number immediately following O
patterns.context: Numbers appear in agenda items, dates, or sequence numbers after a period; an O-initial word may be nearby, but activation falls on the number.

patterns.name: Sporadic subword activation at tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Short subword fragments occur within or at the beginning of words in multiple languages, with no stable meaning; they often co-occur in the same passage as the O-initial words above.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary records; may reflect tokenization or spelling features

2_1199.description: 激活集中于欧洲议会多语种记录中 O/o 起始的专名、机构议题名及普通词，另有数字和大量零碎子词激活；模式可能受词首及分词边界影响。

patterns.name: 成员国/地名相关的 O 起始名称
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言中出现以 O 起始的人名、地名、机构名或议题/文件名；目标 O 位于句中或句首，常有特殊大小写或后续子词片段。

patterns.name: 议事与正式发言中的 O 起始词
patterns.context: 句中出现以 o/O 开始的普通词，尤其在正式议事发言、议程或陈述中；同一段也可能含 O 起始专名。

patterns.name: O 后紧接数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在句点后的议题、日期或序号中，附近可能有 O 起始词，但激活标在数字上。

patterns.name: 分词边界处的零碎子词激活
patterns.trigger: 如 « k»3、« te»2、« v»2 等散布于芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语、匈牙利语、荷兰语和波兰语文本
patterns.context: 多语种词内部或词首出现短子词片段，未显示稳定词义；往往与上述 O 起始词同段共现。
patterns.domain: 多语种议事记录；可能反映分词或拼写特征

en.description: Primarily activates on the uppercase letter O: in multilingual European Parliament texts, it often occurs at the beginning of a proper name or sentence-initial word; it also activates on O in the patent chemical formula AgCuO.

patterns.name: O-initial uppercase proper names or word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on an uppercase O at the beginning of a word, followed by a proper name or an uppercase word at the beginning or within a sentence; O need not stand alone as a word.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament speeches; also chemical formulas in patent technical texts

patterns.name: O in a chemical formula
patterns.context: O occurs in the chemical formula for silver copper oxide, followed by a stoichiometric number; it is not an ordinary uppercase word initial.

2_1199.description: 主要对大写字母 O 激活：欧洲议会多语种文本中常位于专名或句首词开头；另在专利化学式 AgCuO 中对 O 激活。

patterns.name: O 开头的大写专名或词形
patterns.trigger: “O” 后接大写字母或专名片段，如 «O»10slon、«O»10mbudsmani、«O»9uld、«O»9lemme、«O»9tsustame、«O»9laszország、«O»9ma、«O»9ost、«O»9ssétia
patterns.context: 激活落在词首大写 O 上，后续接专名或句首/句中大写词；并不要求 O 独立成词。
patterns.domain: 多语种欧洲议会发言；另有专利技术文本中的化学式

patterns.name: 化学式中的 O
patterns.context: O 出现在银铜氧化物化学式中，后接化学计量数字；不是普通词首大写词。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and terminology patterns
en.description: Some activations cluster around the fixed mathematical-paper expression “in the sense of”; the rest are distributed across intraword fragments in multilingual European Parliament texts and chemical formulas, with no unified semantic interpretation so far.

patterns.name: Cu/O fragments in chemical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in silver copper oxide formulas; activation covers the element symbols and the digits following them.

patterns.name: “sense of” expression in mathematical literature
patterns.context: Appears after a mathematical term or definition in “in the sense of …,” specifying the meaning of a definition, concept, or name; most often occurs mid-sentence.

patterns.name: Intraword subword fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Triggers are scattered within or at the beginnings of words in continuous Finnish text, across several different word forms; the local context is insufficient to infer a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Dutch intraword fragments and Oostzee environmental issues
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within or at the beginnings of Dutch words; this passage specifically discusses projects, environmental protection, and the Baltic region.

patterns.name: Hungarian intraword fragments and Olaszország
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within or at the beginnings of Hungarian word forms; this passage mentions crisis response measures and Italy.

patterns.name: Ombudsman in a Dutch title
patterns.context: Appears in the Dutch title of a special report by the European Ombudsman, with multiple words and intraword fragments marked.

2_1199.concept: 混合的词片段与术语模式
2_1199.description: 激活一部分集中在数学论文固定用语“in the sense of”；其余分布于多语种欧洲议会文本的词内片段及化学式，暂无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 化学式中的 Cu/O 片段
patterns.context: 出现在银铜氧化物化学式中；激活覆盖元素符号及其后的数字。

patterns.name: 数学文献中的 sense of 用语
patterns.context: 数学术语或定义后出现 “in the sense of …”，用于指明某定义、概念或命名的意义；多出现在句中。

patterns.name: 芬兰语中的词内子词片段
patterns.context: 触发分散在芬兰语连续文本的词内或词首，涉及多个不同词形；局部上下文不足以归纳为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段及 Oostzee 环境议题
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语词语内部或词首；该段具体谈及项目、环境保护及波罗的海地区。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段及 Olaszország
patterns.context: 激活分布于匈牙利语词形内部或词首；该段提到危机应对措施及意大利。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语标题中的 Ombudsman
patterns.context: 出现在欧洲监察专员特别报告的荷兰语标题中，多个词及词内片段均被标记。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on character-level fragments, especially O in chemical formulas; they also cover code punctuation, Finnish word fragments, biomedical abbreviations, random strings, and mathematical notation, making a single semantic theme difficult to infer.

patterns.name: Oxygen symbol O in chemical formulas
patterns.context: O occurs in inorganic chemical formulas, material compositions, or similar chemical notation; it also activates in a few garbled texts, though it is unclear whether the trigger is the same.
patterns.domain: Electrochemistry, superconductivity, photocatalysis, and garbled text

patterns.name: Symbols and code punctuation
patterns.context: In C function declarations, annotated function names, or comments, commas and fragments of function names activate.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Occurs in subword fragments of continuous Finnish words, alongside spaces and commas; activations fall on multiple suffixes or intraword fragments.

patterns.name: SFCAs and butyric fragments
patterns.context: Appears in a biomedical abstract on fecal sample testing methods, involving SFCAs and 2-ethylbutyric acid.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments in random strings
patterns.context: In high-entropy, nearly random identifiers or encoded strings, activations are scattered across single letters and short substrings, with no clear semantic context.

patterns.name: Symbols in garbled legal text
patterns.context: In damaged, barely legible legal document fragments, markers fall on slashes and letters.

patterns.name: log and k in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in asymptotic estimate formulas, where log, the variable k, O notation, and punctuation are marked.

patterns.name: Unmarked ordinary prose
patterns.context: Activation markers mainly fall on adjacent chemical formulas or keywords, rather than ordinary semantic content in the current passage.

2_1199.description: 激活主要落在字符级片段，尤其是化学式中的 O；但也覆盖代码标点、芬兰语词片段、生物医学缩写、随机字符串及数学记号，难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 化学式中的氧符号 O
patterns.trigger: «O»，尤其是 AgCu«O»、Cu«O»、Ti«O»2；另有异常噪声串中的 «O»
patterns.context: O 位于无机化学式、材料组成或类似化学记号中；少数乱码文本中也激活，无法确认是否同一触发条件
patterns.domain: 电化学、超导、光催化及乱码文本

patterns.name: 符号与代码标点
patterns.context: 在 C 语言函数声明或被标注的函数名、注释中，逗号及函数名片段被激活

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 在芬兰语连续词语的子词片段中出现，伴随词间空格和逗号；激活落在多个词缀或词内片段上

patterns.name: SFCAs 与 butyric 的片段
patterns.context: 出现在粪便样本检测方法的生物医学摘要中，涉及 SFCAs 及 2-ethylbutyric acid

patterns.name: 随机字符串中的字母数字片段
patterns.context: 高熵、近似随机的标识符或编码字符串中，激活散布于单字母及短子串，缺少明显语义上下文

patterns.name: 乱码法律文本中的符号
patterns.context: 字符损坏、难以辨读的法律文档片段中，标记落在斜线及字母字符上

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 log 与 k
patterns.context: 出现在渐近估计公式中，log、变量 k、O 记号及标点被标记

patterns.name: 未标记的普通叙述
patterns.trigger: 未见可辨识的共同触发子串
patterns.context: 激活标记主要落在相邻的化学式或关键词上，而非当前片段中的普通语义内容

en.concept: Subword fragments and local features of academic text
en.description: Activations occur across several types of segmented fragments: ro/bro in glial and medical terms, the suffix -ian in mathematical terms, English function words, formula symbols, Portuguese code comments, Finnish word fragments, and several domain-specific expressions. No single trigger condition explains all instances.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments related to “ro”
patterns.context: Occurs within words related to glial cells, neural myelin, or medical terminology; some instances are morpheme-level segmentation fragments, not complete words.

patterns.name: “-ian” suffix fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of nouns related to mathematicians or mathematical structures.

patterns.name: Common English function words and word fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in English academic sentences; some are common function words, while others are content words or intraword fragments, with no single stable collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and local formula fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in local expressions in formulas related to perfect matchings, Pfaffians, and matrices.

patterns.name: Uppercase Portuguese fragments in C code comments
patterns.context: Appears in the main-function comment in C code, “INÍCIO DA FUNÇÃO PRINCIPAL”; the trigger positions are segmented fragments of uppercase Portuguese words.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Finnish
patterns.context: Triggered by subword segments of continuous Finnish words; the context discusses insufficient progress and the Oslo process.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, Finnish political text

patterns.name: Gene pathway enrichment and overlap descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses pathway analysis, overlap among gene members, and names that are similar but not identical.

patterns.name: butyrate fragment in short-chain fatty acid testing
patterns.context: Appears in a description of HPLC measurement methods for short-chain fatty acids in mouse feces.

patterns.name: O in silver copper oxide formulas
patterns.context: O appears in a silver copper oxide formula in patent text, with digits rendered as formula subscripts.

patterns.name: ECG and imaging orientation descriptions
patterns.context: Concerns right-axis deviation, dextrocardia, and posteroanterior chest radiographs, among other imaging or anatomical orientation details.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or clinical studies

patterns.name: Citations and probability-space notation in mathematical text
patterns.context: Occurs in parenthetical reference markers, descriptions of the monotone case, and Hilbert-space and probability-space notation; activation fragments are scattered.

2_1199.concept: 词片段与学术文本局部特征
2_1199.description: 激活分布在多类切分片段上：神经胶质及医学术语中的 ro/bro、数学术语词尾 -ian、英语功能词、公式符号，以及葡萄牙语代码注释、芬兰语词片段和若干学科专用表达。未见能统一解释所有实例的单一触发条件。

patterns.name: “ro”相关词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在神经胶质细胞、神经髓鞘相关词或医学术语的词内；部分实例是词素切分片段，并非完整词。

patterns.name: “-ian”词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学家或数学结构相关名词的词尾。

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词与词片段
patterns.context: 嵌在英语学术句子中；有些是常见虚词，有些是实词或词内片段，未见单一稳定搭配。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式局部
patterns.context: 出现在完美匹配、Pfaffian及矩阵相关公式的局部表达中。

patterns.name: C 代码注释中的葡萄牙语大写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C 代码的主函数注释“INÍCIO DA FUNÇÃO PRINCIPAL”中，触发位置是大写葡萄牙语词的切分片段。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发于芬兰语连续词的子词切分；上下文谈及进展不足及奥斯陆进程。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、芬兰语政治文本

patterns.name: 基因通路富集与重叠表述
patterns.context: 讨论通路分析、基因成员重叠及名称相似但不完全相同。

patterns.name: 短链脂肪酸检测中的 butyrate 片段
patterns.context: 出现在小鼠粪便中短链脂肪酸的 HPLC 测定方法描述中。

patterns.name: 银铜氧化物化学式中的 O
patterns.context: O 出现在专利文本的银铜氧化物化学式中，数字为化学式下标的文本呈现。

patterns.name: 心电图与影像方位描述
patterns.context: 围绕右轴偏移、右位心及胸片后前位等影像或解剖方位信息。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的引用及概率空间符号
patterns.context: 分别出现在括号内的文献标记、单调情形说明，以及 Hilbert 空间和概率空间记号中；激活片段分散。

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and contrast markers
en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual intraword fragments, mathematical symbols, and a few contrastive expressions; Portuguese word fragments and “Mas” are most recurrent, alongside isolated biomedical terms, early-life, and Slavic names.

patterns.name: Portuguese conjunctions or verb endings
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activations fall on intraword fragments or common grammatical words; many different word forms occur and cannot be grouped by a single meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament, forums, and philosophical discourse

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and probability notation
patterns.context: Mathematical font symbols in probability expressions, especially probability operators and indicator-function notation.

patterns.name: Contrastive word “Mas”
patterns.context: Sentence-initial conjunction in Portuguese, introducing a contrast or response.
patterns.domain: Forums, philosophical discourse, and parliamentary dialogue

patterns.name: English contrastive word “contrary”
patterns.context: The contrastive word in the fixed expression “On the contrary.”

patterns.name: English contrastive word “but”
patterns.context: Introduces a limitation or counterexample after a preceding claim.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in English biomedical terms
patterns.context: Activation occurs within the biomedical term “oligodendroglial”; no other comparable evidence is apparent.

patterns.name: life in an English phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the compound expression “early-life environment,” referring to the environment in early life.

patterns.name: Č in a Slavic name
patterns.context: The accented initial letter in the proper name “Željko Čajkovski.”

2_1199.concept: 异质的词片段与转折标记
2_1199.description: 激活分布于多语种词内片段、数学符号及少数转折表达；最重复的是葡萄牙语材料中的词片段和“Mas”，另有生物医学术语、early-life与斯拉夫人名等孤例。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语接续词或动词词尾
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语句子中，激活落在词内片段或常见语法词上；多种不同词形，无法归并到单一词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、论坛及哲学论述

patterns.name: 数学符号与概率记号
patterns.context: 概率表达式中的数学字体符号，尤其是概率算子及指示函数记号。

patterns.name: 转折词“Mas”
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中转折或回应前的句首连接词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、哲学论述及议会对话

patterns.name: 英语转折词“contrary”
patterns.context: 固定表达“On the contrary”中，激活落在转折词上。

patterns.name: 英语转折词“but”
patterns.context: 给出前述论断之后引出限制或反例。

patterns.name: 英语生物医学词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在“oligodendroglial”这一生物医学术语内部；未见其他同类证据。

patterns.name: 英语短语中的 life
patterns.context: 出现在复合表达“early-life environment”中，指生命早期环境。
patterns.domain: 表观遗传与肥胖研究综述

patterns.name: 斯拉夫人名中的 Č
patterns.context: 专名“Željko Čajkovski”中带变音符号的首字母。

en.description: The most stable recurring cue is expressions indicating contrast or relative relations within sentences, especially English “on the contrary” and Italian “rispetto a”; there are also legal and policy comparison contexts. The remaining activations are scattered across formulas, Lithuanian/Czech fragments, and medical phrases, and are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: In-sentence concessive/contrastive connectors
patterns.context: Introduces contrast, an exception, a reason, or a relative relation in an argument; the clearest examples are Italian “rispetto a” and English “on the contrary,” but French «car» also activates, so the pattern cannot be reduced entirely to a single connector.

patterns.name: Relational words in legal and policy language
patterns.context: Compares rules or interventions, or introduces a concessive clause in legal or policy statements; Italian parliamentary text.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Italian legal and policy discussions

patterns.name: Indicator function in a sparse formula
patterns.context: A conditional indicator-function notation appears in a mathematical formula, with the condition written as “[ y_k=x_k”; this is the highest activation in the batch, with a more specific local trigger unlike the other examples.

patterns.name: Lithuanian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in a Lithuanian parliamentary speech; the strongest marker falls on the word form “žinias” (knowledge), alongside several participial fragments, with no clear semantic or syntactic commonality.

patterns.name: Forms of address and emphasis words in Czech speeches
patterns.context: In a Czech parliamentary speech, forms of address to the audience and word-form fragments meaning “this” are marked; no clear connection between the two triggers is apparent.

patterns.name: Ukrainian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Several word-form/subword fragments at the beginning of a Lithuanian text activate, especially “žinias”; there is insufficient evidence to establish a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Cancer and cell-experiment terminology in medicine
patterns.context: A breast cancer tissue and cell experiment abstract; activation is scattered across terms and contrastive expressions, so it is unclear whether the terms themselves are a common trigger.

patterns.name: Medical imaging and anatomical expressions
patterns.context: Describes 3D ultrasound, anatomical planes, and fetal nuchal edema; the marked words do not show a clear shared domain-specific terminology pattern.

patterns.name: Contrastive expressions in biomedical results
patterns.context: After stating liver copper levels or changes in angiogenesis, the text introduces an opposite or contrasting result; the contrast phrase is the same English expression as in paragraph 4.

patterns.name: Contrastive expressions in cold-atom physics
patterns.context: After describing timescales and dipole coupling, the text shifts to another behavior at longer times; the contrast phrase is used as in other genres.

2_1199.concept: 对照与关系表达（不完全）
2_1199.description: 最稳定的重复线索是句中表示对照或相对关系的表达，尤其英语“on the contrary”和意大利语“rispetto a”；此外有法律政策比较语境。其余激活分散于公式、立陶宛语/捷克语片段及医学词句，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 句内让步/对照连接词
patterns.trigger: «ris»2pet«to»9« a»3« qu»1elle；«ris»2pet«to»9« ag»1«li»3；«On the« contrary»9；«al»1 contrario（本批未标出）；«car»9
patterns.context: 在论述中引出对照、例外、原因或相对关系；最明显的是意大利语“rispetto a”和英语“on the contrary”，但法语«car»也被激活，不能完全归入单一连接词。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言、科研论文

patterns.name: 法律政策措辞中的关系词
patterns.context: 法律或政策陈述中比较规则、干预措施，或引入让步从句；意大利语议会文本。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，意大利语法律政策讨论

patterns.name: 稀疏公式中的指示函数
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现带条件的指示函数记号，条件写作“[ y_k=x_k”；此处为全批最高激活，局部触发更具体、与其他例子不相似。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词形片段
patterns.context: 嵌在立陶宛语议会发言中；最强标记落在“žinias”（知识）词形上，周围同时有多个分词片段，缺乏明确的语义或句法共性。

patterns.name: 捷克语演讲称呼与强调词
patterns.context: 捷克语议会演讲中，对听众的称呼以及“这个/此”一类词形片段被标记；两处触发彼此未见明确联系。

patterns.name: 乌克兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语文本开头的若干词形/子词片段激活，尤其是“žinias”；没有足够证据确定统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学中的癌症与细胞实验术语
patterns.context: 乳腺癌组织与细胞实验的摘要语境；激活分散在术语及转折表达上，无法确认术语本身是共同触发因素。

patterns.name: 医学图像与解剖学表达
patterns.context: 描述三维超声、解剖平面及胎儿颈部水肿；所标记词并未显现清晰共同的领域术语模式。

patterns.name: 生物医学结果中的转折表达
patterns.context: 先陈述肝脏铜含量或新生血管变化，再转入相反或对照结果；与段4的同一英语短语一致。

patterns.name: 冷原子物理中的转折表达
patterns.context: 描述时间尺度与偶极耦合后，转入较长时间下的另一行为；转折短语与其他文体中的用法相同。

en.description: Primarily responds to the “ro” fragment in the fib- stem; it also responds to comparative structures with similar and the contrastive expression contrary. Several Lithuanian subword fragments and mathematical typesetting symbols occur only in single passages, with unclear patterns.

patterns.name: fibro/fibroid stem
patterns.context: “ro” occurs within a word, followed by different endings; examples include fibroids, fibroin, and fibroproliferative. Activation clusters near segmentation boundaries and does not require a particular meaning.

patterns.name: similar collocations
patterns.context: similar occurs in comparative or analogical structures; activation falls on the word fragment and nearby collocates.

patterns.name: Counter-expectation contrast phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the contrastive expression “On the contrary” or “on the contrary.”

patterns.name: Lithuanian intraword fragments and function words
patterns.context: The marked fragments are distributed within or at word boundaries in continuous Lithuanian text; a single example is insufficient to determine a more specific morphological or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Symbol fragments in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical font or symbol notation in formulas; markers fall on fragments of typesetting commands or symbols.

2_1199.concept: 词内片段与论述连接词
2_1199.description: 主要响应 fib- 词干中的“ro”片段；另对 similar 的比较结构及 contrary 转折语有反应。立陶宛语若干子词片段和数学排版符号仅见于单段，规律不明。

patterns.name: fibro/fibroid 词干
patterns.context: “ro”位于单词中，后接不同词尾；包括 fibroids、fibroin、fibroproliferative。激活集中在分词边界附近，并不要求某个固定语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: similar 搭配
patterns.context: 比较或类比结构中出现 similar；激活落在词内片段及其附近的搭配词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、数学论文

patterns.name: 反预期转折短语
patterns.context: 出现在 “On the contrary” 或 “on the contrary” 这一转折表达中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、数学证明

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段及功能词
patterns.context: 这些被标记的片段分布在立陶宛语连续文本的词内或词边界；无法从单例确定更具体的词法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议会发言

patterns.name: 数学排版中的符号片段
patterns.context: 出现在公式的数学字体或符号记号中；标记落在排版命令或符号的子词片段上。

en.concept: Local word-form and symbol triggers in multilingual text
en.description: The most stable pattern is contrary in “On the contrary,” found in mathematical research and medical abstracts; other scattered triggers include Lithuanian policy words, the French parliamentary time word demain, formula symbols P/I, and chromatography-column terminology.

patterns.name: English contrastive phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “On the contrary,” usually introducing a statement that opposes or contrasts with the preceding text; this word is the strongest and most recurrent trigger.
patterns.domain: ArXiv proofs or research prose, PubMed scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Lithuanian knowledge vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in Lithuanian parliamentary text alongside EU policy words such as “kompetenciją” and “naujoves.”

patterns.name: French political time word
patterns.context: Refers to tomorrow or the following day in French parliamentary text, in the context of meeting arrangements, voting, or an agenda.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, French parliamentary speeches and agendas

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols P and I
patterns.context: Appear in formulas as a probability symbol and an indicator-function symbol, respectively; activation falls on local symbol tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, mathematical or information theory formulas

patterns.name: Chromatography column terminology fragments
patterns.context: An analytical chromatography methods description mentions a precolumn, analytical column, and specific column names.

2_1199.concept: 多语文本中的局部词形与符号触发
2_1199.description: 最稳定的模式是“On the contrary”中的 contrary，见于数理研究与医学摘要；另有立陶宛语政策词、法语议会时间词 demain、公式符号 P/I 及色谱柱术语等零散触发。

patterns.name: 英文转折短语
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “On the contrary” 中，通常引出与前文相反或补充对照的陈述；该词是最强、重复出现的触发点。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 证明或研究叙述、PubMed 科学摘要

patterns.name: 立陶宛语知识词汇
patterns.context: 位于立陶宛语议会文本中，与“kompetenciją”“naujoves”等欧盟政策词汇并列。

patterns.name: 法语政治时间词
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中指向明天或次日，处于会议安排、投票或议程语境。

patterns.name: 数学符号 P 与 I
patterns.context: 出现在公式中，分别作为概率符号与指示函数符号；激活落在符号的局部 token 上。

patterns.name: 色谱柱术语片段
patterns.context: 分析色谱方法描述中，提及预柱、分析柱及具体色谱柱名称。

en.description: Primarily responds to the contrastive phrase “on the contrary” in English academic text, and also to “just” in Swedish parliamentary text; there is one additional instance of Lithuanian “žinias.” These triggers are not consistent in language or context.

patterns.name: Contrastive phrase
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning or middle of a sentence, introducing an opposite, contrasting, or contrary result after a prior statement; especially evident in paragraphs 3, 5, 9, and 10.
patterns.domain: Academic argumentation, physics and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Swedish just
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speeches, means “just/recently” or “exactly,” often followed by a verb or occurring near references to meetings, discussions, or votes.

patterns.name: Lithuanian žinias
patterns.context: Occurs in a coordinated Lithuanian noun phrase listing “knowledge” and innovation in relation to EU objectives.

2_1199.description: 主要响应英语学术文本中的转折短语“on the contrary”，也响应瑞典语议会文本中的“just”；另有一次立陶宛语“žinias”。这些触发词在语言、语境上并不统一。

patterns.name: 对比转折短语
patterns.context: 位于句首或句中，在此前陈述后引出相反、对照或反向结果；第3、5、9、10段尤为明显。
patterns.domain: 学术论证、物理学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语议会发言中，表示“刚刚/正好”，常接动词或与会议、讨论、投票等表述相邻。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语 žinias
patterns.context: 出现在立陶宛语并列名词短语中，列举欧盟目标相关的“知识”和创新。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议会记录

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual word fragments: Swedish just (just now, precisely, exactly), Lithuanian ir, the final но in Russian равно, and English On the contrary. Swedish patterns are the majority, but the other fragments have no obvious semantic connection to them.

patterns.name: Word-level suffix “just”
patterns.context: In Swedish contexts, usually the standalone adverb just; occurs in structures such as “har just röstat,” “det var just därför,” and “just nu,” meaning just now, precisely, or exactly.

patterns.name: Lithuanian intraword fragment “ir”
patterns.context: Embedded in Lithuanian word forms, especially in “žinias ir naujoves,” where it is the conjunction “ir” (and); this passage also activates intraword fragments such as “Euro” and “pos.”

patterns.name: Russian word-final/intraword “но”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of “равно,” in a Russian Q&A about an object becoming a null object; short fragments such as “По” and “и” also activate in the same passage.

patterns.name: English contrastive connector “contrary”
patterns.context: Occurs in the contrastive phrase “On the contrary” in an academic abstract; nearby are comparative expressions such as “similar” and “as that of.”

2_1199.description: 激活分布于多语种词片段：瑞典语 just（刚刚、正是、恰好），立陶宛语 ir，俄语 равно 的词尾 но，以及英语 On the contrary。瑞典语模式占多数，但其余片段与之缺乏明显语义共同点。

patterns.name: 词内后缀“just”
patterns.context: 瑞典语语境中，通常是独立副词 just；出现在“har just röstat”“det var just därför”“just nu”等结构，意为刚刚、正是或恰好。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段“ir”
patterns.context: 嵌在立陶宛语词形中，尤其“žinias ir naujoves”中作为连接词“ir”（和）；本段还激活“Euro”“pos”等词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 立陶宛语议会文本

patterns.name: 俄语词尾/词内“но”
patterns.context: 出现在“равно”一词末尾，周围是俄语关于对象变为空对象的问答；同段还激活“По”“и”等短片段。

patterns.name: 英语对比连接词“contrary”
patterns.context: 出现在学术摘要的转折短语“On the contrary”中；附近还有“similar”“as that of”等比较表达。
patterns.domain: PubMed 英语生物医学摘要

en.description: Activations cluster around two types of local expressions: the contrastive phrase “on the contrary” in academic discourse, and Swedish “just,” meaning just now or currently, in parliamentary records; Lithuanian “ir” appears once as well.

patterns.name: Contrastive phrase “on the contrary”
patterns.context: The phrase occurs at the beginning or middle of a sentence to introduce a statement that opposes, contrasts with, or corrects the preceding text; the main marked word is contrary.

patterns.name: Swedish just
patterns.context: Means “just now/exactly” in Swedish parliamentary speeches, as in “har just avslutats,” “Vi har just diskuterat,” and “just nu”; appears in descriptions of proceedings or the current point in time.

patterns.name: Lithuanian conjunction ir
patterns.context: Occurs in lists or coordinate structures, such as “žinias ir naujoves,” meaning “and”; the passage also contains markers on inflectional endings.

2_1199.description: 激活集中在两类局部表达：学术论述中的转折短语“on the contrary”，以及议会记录中表示刚刚、当前的瑞典语“just”；另见一次立陶宛语“ir”。

patterns.name: 转折短语“on the contrary”
patterns.context: 该短语出现在句首或句中，用来引出与前文相反、对照或修正的陈述；被标记的主要是 contrary。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（数学、生物医学、物理）

patterns.name: 瑞典语 just
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中表示“刚刚／正好”，如“har just avslutats”“Vi har just diskuterat”“just nu”；出现于议事过程或当前时点的叙述。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会瑞典语口语记录

patterns.name: 立陶宛语连接词 ir
patterns.context: 出现在列举或连接成分中，如“žinias ir naujoves”，意为“和”；该段同时出现格变化词尾的标记。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会立陶宛语文本

en.description: All passages show strong activation on the Ros- prefix in proper names, while subsequent spelling and contextual domains vary. Names include given names, surnames, team or organization names, and place names.

patterns.name: Ros prefix in proper names
patterns.context: The token occurs at the beginning of a proper name, such as a given name or surname, or a team, organization, or place name. No specific syntactic position is required; examples occur in lists, signatures, narratives, and legal documents.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper names; includes Wikipedia, legal documents, emails, paper abstracts, and literary texts

2_1544.concept: 专名中的 Ros- 前缀
2_1544.description: 全部段落都在专名的 Ros- 前缀处强激活，后续拼写和上下文领域各异；专名包括人名、姓氏、球队或机构名及地名。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Ros 前缀
patterns.context: 该 token 出现在专名开头；专名可为人名或姓氏，也可为球队、机构或地名。上下文不要求特定句法位置，名单、署名、叙述和法律文书中均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域专名；涵盖维基百科、法律文书、邮件、论文摘要和文学文本

en.description: The most stable trigger is the “Ros” fragment in names or other proper nouns, followed by varied endings and appearing across multiple corpora. Other name fragments and a few non-name internal substrings also activate, with no single semantic category accounting for them.

patterns.name: Ros- in surnames
patterns.context: Occurs in names of people, clubs, or organizations; activation is concentrated on the tokenized Ros fragment, while suffixes and surrounding contexts vary widely
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and sports entries, legal documents, email contacts, academic papers

patterns.name: Other fragments in names
patterns.context: Other parts of names show sporadic positive activation in name lists or body text, but less consistently than the Ros- fragment; this may be related to proper names and their tokenization
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, emails, paper metadata

patterns.name: Similar strings in non-name words
patterns.context: Does not fully match the primary Ros- surname pattern; some instances are internal word substrings or proper names, and activation positions do not align with a consistent semantic category
patterns.domain: Sports entries, legal documents, mathematics papers, encyclopedia narratives

2_1544.concept: 姓名中的 Ros- 字串
2_1544.description: 最稳定的触发是姓名或专名中的“Ros”片段，后接多种词尾并出现在多类语料中。另有其他姓名片段及少量非姓名词内子串激活，无法归结为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 姓氏 Ros-
patterns.context: 出现在人名、俱乐部名或机构名中；激活集中在被切分标记的 Ros 片段，后缀及其余上下文变化很大
patterns.domain: 百科人物与体育条目、法律文书、邮件联系人、学术论文

patterns.name: 姓名中的其他片段
patterns.context: 人名列表或正文人名中，姓名其他部分也有零星正激活，但不如 Ros- 片段稳定；可能与专名及其分词形式有关
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、邮件、论文元数据

patterns.name: 非姓名词中的相似字串
patterns.context: 与主要 Ros- 姓氏模式不完全吻合；部分是词内子串或专名，激活位置与语义类别不一致
patterns.domain: 体育条目、法律文书、数学论文、百科叙述

en.description: Activation is concentrated on several lexical fragments: Ros in proper names, approving in approval contexts, and isolated words such as Connie, dial, and electrical. The latter examples span different domains and contexts, with no unified syntactic or topical pattern.

patterns.name: Ros string and its continuations
patterns.context: The Ros string in a name or other proper noun, usually an internal word fragment after tokenization; full spellings vary, suggesting a specific subword fragment trigger.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, emails, and lists

patterns.name: Approving in approval resolutions
patterns.context: Occurs in formal approval or regulatory resolution language, followed by objects such as rules or orders.

patterns.name: Connie as a name
patterns.context: Used as a form of address in dialogue or as a name in an email recipient list.

patterns.name: Dial in phone instructions
patterns.context: Occurs in conference-call arrangements, followed by “in instructions” after a hyphen.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in electrical
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “membrane electrical noise” in a medical research abstract.

2_1544.description: 激活集中于若干词汇片段：专名中的 Ros、审批语境的 approving，以及 Connie、dial、electrical 等孤立词。后几项跨领域且上下文各异，未见统一句法或主题模式。

patterns.name: Ros 字符串及其续接
patterns.context: 姓名或专名中的 Ros 字符串，且通常是分词后的词内片段；完整拼写不一致，可能是特定子词片段触发。

patterns.name: 批准决议中的 approving
patterns.context: 出现在正式审批或法规决议表述中，后接规则、命令等宾语。

patterns.name: Connie 人名
patterns.context: 作为对话称呼或邮件收件人名单中的姓名。

patterns.name: 数字拨号词 dial
patterns.context: 出现在电话会议安排中，连字符后接“in instructions”。

patterns.name: electrical 的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学研究摘要中，位于“membrane electrical noise”短语内。

en.description: Primarily activates on the letter string “Ros” in proper names, including people, teams, places, and dramatic characters; a separate “cano” fragment appears in canoe, volcano, and metaphorical usage. No clear corresponding pattern is evident for the approval plan in the email or sermon in the novel.

patterns.name: “Ros” fragment in proper names
patterns.context: Embedded in different proper nouns; it is not tied to a fixed word boundary or meaning, and following characters vary, as in “Ros Hasni,” “Rosengård,” “Roselyn,” and “Rosyth.”
patterns.domain: Proper names such as people, clubs, and places, across Wikipedia, legal texts, novels, and other texts

patterns.name: “cano” string
patterns.context: Occurs within complete words such as canoes, volcano, and volcanic; topics include boats and volcanoes, as well as metaphorical usage.
patterns.domain: Novel narratives, volcano-related descriptions; word-form string matching

patterns.name: Subword fragment in names at the start of paragraphs or entries
patterns.context: A name is repeated at the beginning of an entry and contains the “Ros” fragment; the strongest specific activation falls on “Ros.”

patterns.name: Team names containing “Ros” in sports entries
patterns.context: The Ros substring occurs in club or team names; also seen in the team name “«Ros»9engård” containing Ros.
patterns.domain: Football season overviews and sports club histories

patterns.name: Proper names containing “Ros” in dramatic dialogue or literary texts
patterns.context: The spelling of Shakespeare’s character Rosencrantz contains Ros; the same passage also discusses drama and prose dialogue.

patterns.name: “Ros” in general names
patterns.context: Ros occurs within a name; the fragment may cross into a following morpheme and does not form a stable semantic category.

2_1544.concept: 字母串片段 Ros（兼有 cano）
2_1544.description: 主要激活于专名中的字母串“Ros”，覆盖人名、队名、地名和戏剧人物名；另有独立的“cano”片段，见 canoe、volcano 及比喻用法。邮件中的批准方案和小说中的 sermon 暂无明确对应模式。

patterns.name: 专名片段“Ros”
patterns.context: 嵌在不同专有名词中；不是固定单词边界或特定词义，后续字符各不相同，如“Ros Hasni”“Rosengård”“Roselyn”“Rosyth”。
patterns.domain: 人名、俱乐部名、地名等专名，跨 Wikipedia、法律、小说及其他文本

patterns.name: “cano”字符串
patterns.context: 出现在完整词内部：canoes、volcano、volcanic 等；所处主题包括船只及火山，也有比喻用法。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、火山相关说明；词形字符串匹配

patterns.name: 段落或条目起始姓名的子词片段
patterns.context: 姓名在条目开头重复出现，且含有“Ros”片段；其中较强的具体激活落在“Ros”。

patterns.name: 体育条目中的队名包含“Ros”
patterns.context: 俱乐部或队伍专名中出现 Ros 子串；另见带 Ros 的队名“«Ros»9engård”。
patterns.domain: 足球赛季介绍及体育俱乐部历史

patterns.name: 戏剧对白或文学文本中的专名含“Ros”
patterns.context: 莎士比亚人物 Rosencrantz 的词形中出现 Ros；同段还有戏剧与 prose dialogue 讨论。

patterns.name: 一般姓名中的“Ros”
patterns.context: 人名内部出现 Ros；片段可能跨越后续词素，未形成稳定语义类别。
patterns.domain: 人物传记及法律裁判文本

en.concept: Appearance or judgment introduced by seemed
en.description: The main pattern is the English word “seemed” and nearby expressions, especially “seemed to” and “seemed as if,” used to convey observation, speculation, or judgment in novels, legal texts, and news. Passages 5 and 8 show no clear corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: Seemed followed by a description or judgment
patterns.context: “Seemed” shows the strongest activation, often followed by “to” or “as if” to describe how a person or thing appears; sometimes followed by like or somewhat of a.
patterns.domain: Novel narratives, legal documents, news reports

patterns.name: Seemed unable to act or concentrate
patterns.context: Seemed is followed by a judgment about insufficient ability, inability, or unwillingness to do something.

patterns.name: Narrative use of seemed to challenge
patterns.context: “Seemed to” introduces an action or posture with a challenging quality.

patterns.name: Seemed like a good idea
patterns.context: “Seemed like” is followed by an evaluation of a decision or action.

patterns.name: Seemed somewhat of a foregone conclusion
patterns.context: “Seemed” is followed by a judgment that the outcome was already settled.

2_1544.concept: seemed 引出的表象或判断
2_1544.description: 主模式是英语词“seemed”及其相邻表达，尤其“seemed to”“seemed as if”，用于呈现观察、推测或判断，涵盖小说、法律和新闻。第5、8段没有明显对应触发词。

patterns.name: seemed 后接描述或判断
patterns.context: “seemed”受到最强激活，常见后续为“to”或“as if”，引出人物、事物看起来如何；有时后接 like 或 somewhat of a。
patterns.domain: 小说叙事、法律文书、新闻报道

patterns.name: 似乎无法行动或无法专注
patterns.context: 似乎后接能力不足、无法或不愿做某事的判断。

patterns.name: seemed to challenge 的叙事用法
patterns.context: “seemed to”引出带有挑战意味的动作或姿态。

patterns.name: 似乎是个好主意
patterns.context: “seemed like”后接对某项决定或行为的评价。

patterns.name: seemed somewhat of a foregone conclusion
patterns.context: “seemed”后接对结果已成定局的判断。

en.description: Strong activation falls on the paragraph transition word “Finally,” the phrases “simplest prototype/hub,” and the mathematical symbol “tau.” The first occurs across several genres, while the latter two are limited to specific contexts. Activation locations in passages 1 and 9 show no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Finally as a paragraph transition marker
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of a paragraph or at the beginning of a sentence after a line break, followed by a comma and introducing a final item, conclusion, or new topic.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository, discussion, and email texts

patterns.name: Simplest prototype or configuration
patterns.context: Occurs in “I will start with the simplest prototype” or “the simplest hub possible,” describing a simplified approach to be built or tested.

patterns.name: Mathematical group element tau
patterns.context: Occurs in a definition of robotic-arm symmetry and a group G, as an element of the set {1, tau}.

2_1544.concept: 不明显的词汇/符号触发
2_1544.description: 强激活分别落在段落推进词“Finally”、短语“simplest prototype/hub”和数学符号“tau”上；前者跨多类文体，后两者各限特定语境。第1、9段激活处没有明显共同触发模式。

patterns.name: Finally 段落转折标记
patterns.context: 出现在段落末尾或换行后的句首，后接逗号并引出最后一项、结论或新话题。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、讨论和邮件文本

patterns.name: simplest 原型或配置
patterns.context: 出现在“I will start with the simplest prototype”或“the simplest hub possible”中，修饰开始构建或测试的简化方案。

patterns.name: 数学群元素 tau
patterns.context: 出现在对机械臂对称性及群 G 的定义中，作为集合 {1, tau} 的元素。

en.description: Primarily activates on the here substring across words such as there, where, nowhere, and here, and across code, academic, and narrative contexts; also activates on the part substring in tripartite and partisanship.

patterns.name: here suffix in here
patterns.context: The target string is split at token boundaries, with activation on here; it appears in different spellings or word boundaries such as there, where, nowhere, and in here, usually inside a sentence.
patterns.domain: Multidomain texts, code, and ordinary narratives

patterns.name: part suffix in part
patterns.context: Activation falls on the part substring, appearing in the tokenization of the anthrax toxin term tripartite and the political word partisanship.

2_1544.description: 主要激活于 here 子串，跨越 there、where、nowhere、here 等词及代码、学术、叙事语境；另在 tripartite、partisanship 中激活于 part 子串。

patterns.name: here 中的后缀 here
patterns.context: 目标字符串被拆分到 token 边界，激活落在 here；可见于 there、where、nowhere、in here 等不同拼写或词界中，通常处于句子内部。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本、代码与普通叙述

patterns.name: part 中的后缀 part
patterns.context: 激活落在 part 子串，分别出现在 anthrax toxin 术语 tripartite 和政治词 partisanship 的分词中。

en.concept: Internal fragments and sporadic formatting features
en.description: The clearest repeated cross-domain pattern is the -omes/-ome fragment inside longer words. Other sporadic triggers include code help text, patent boilerplate, part in legal definitions, and Portuguese pronouns, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: -omes/-ome word-form fragment
patterns.context: The trigger is usually inside a longer word, often at the word ending or the boundary between a stem and suffix; surrounding semantics and syntax vary widely. In passage 1, «thym» occurs in thymus and thymocytes; in passage 6, «onucle» occurs in isonucleosides. These may be responses to the same kind of internal word fragment, but the evidence is weak.
patterns.domain: Across genres including biomedical, mathematical, dictionary, news, patent, and code texts; this fragment pattern does not depend on a specific domain.

patterns.name: Python command help output
patterns.context: In Python function definitions and command-line help text, responses fall on code keywords, output statements, and help menu items; activation does not correspond to just one word fragment.
patterns.domain: Python code and CLI documentation on Github.

patterns.name: Emphasis word in patent legal boilerplate
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed phrase “either alone or in any combination thereof” in a patent background section, describing prior art alone or in combination.

patterns.name: part in a legal definition
patterns.context: Occurs in “as part of an electronic address,” meaning a component; although the homograph is the same as in passage 2, the local syntax and meaning differ.

patterns.name: Portuguese interrogative expression
patterns.context: Occurs in the Portuguese sentence “Eu fiz a conversão aí mas”; activation falls on the first-person pronoun, with insufficient evidence to determine whether the trigger is the language itself or a specific collocation.

2_1544.concept: 词内片段与零散格式特征
2_1544.description: 最明显的跨领域重复模式是长词内部的 -omes/-ome 片段；另有代码帮助文本、专利套语、法律定义中的 part，以及葡萄牙语代词等零散触发，未形成统一语义规律。

patterns.name: -omes/-ome 词形片段
patterns.trigger: «omes»（如 transcript«omes»、micros«omes»、bi«omes»、hom«omes»、h«omes»）；以及第 1 段中的 «thym»、第 6 段中的 «onucle»
patterns.context: 触发位置多在较长单词内部，常见于词尾或词干与后缀交界；周围语义和句法差异很大。第 1 段的 «thym» 位于 thymus、thymocytes 中，第 6 段的 «onucle» 位于 isonucleosides 中，可能是同类词内片段响应，但证据较弱。
patterns.domain: 跨生物医学、数学、词典、新闻、专利和代码等文体；该片段模式不依赖特定领域。

patterns.name: Python 命令帮助输出
patterns.context: Python 函数定义及命令行帮助文本中，响应落在代码关键字、输出语句和帮助菜单项上；激活并非只对应某个单词片段。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Python 代码与 CLI 文档。

patterns.name: 专利法律套语中的强调词
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景技术的固定表述“either alone or in any combination thereof”中，描述现有技术单独或组合的情形。

patterns.name: 法律定义中的 part
patterns.context: 出现在“as part of an electronic address”中，表示某个组成部分；与第 2 段的同形词虽相同，局部句法和语义不同。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语疑问表达
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语句子“Eu fiz a conversão aí mas”中；激活落在第一人称代词，未见足够证据判断是否由语言本身或具体搭配触发。

en.description: Activation is distributed across where/thereunder in legal texts, Gib in Gibby/Gibraltar, out in technical texts, the subword fragment in Committees, and line breaks, indentation, and paper citations; no single meaning accounts for all of them.

patterns.name: Locative/relational preposition where
patterns.context: Introduces conditions, locations, or relative clauses in legal texts; passage 3 has thereunder in a clause.

patterns.name: Gib fragment in place names
patterns.context: In passage 2, it is part of the place name Gibby Beam; in passage 10, it is embedded in Gibraltar.

patterns.name: out output marker
patterns.context: The string out occurs in code or technical texts: passage 4 has program output, passage 5 has it in a paper-title author name, and passage 9 has it as a C code label.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code Q&A, computer science paper citations, Github source code

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Committees
patterns.context: Occurs in the name Armed Services Committees; activation falls on the internal tees substring.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or internal segmentation marker
patterns.context: Activation occurs near line breaks or indentation; it may be related to formatted text or code block boundaries, but not all line breaks trigger it.

patterns.name: Internal token fragment out
patterns.context: Occurs in English technical citations such as paper titles and author names, with activation involving subword tokenization; partially overlaps with the out string in passages 4 and 9.

2_1544.description: 激活分散于法律文本中的 where/thereunder、Gibby/Gibraltar 内的 Gib、技术文本中的 out，以及 Committees、换行缩进和论文引文的子词片段；尚无单一语义能解释全部。

patterns.name: 地点/方位介词 where
patterns.context: 法律文本中引出条件、地点或关系从句；段3为条款中的 thereunder。

patterns.name: Gibby 地名片段
patterns.context: 段2中是地名 Gibby Beam 的组成部分；段10中嵌在 Gibraltar 一词内。

patterns.name: out 输出标记
patterns.context: 位于代码或技术文本中的 out 字符串：段4是程序输出，段5出现在论文标题作者名中，段9是 C 代码标签。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码问答、计算机论文引用、Github 源码

patterns.name: Committees 词内片段
patterns.context: 国会委员会名称 Armed Services Committees 中；激活落在词内的 tees 子串。

patterns.name: 句首或句内切分标记
patterns.context: 换行或缩进附近出现激活；可能与格式化文本、代码块边界有关，但并非所有换行都触发。

patterns.name: 切分词内片段 out
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题、作者名等英文技术引文中，激活涉及子词切分；与段4、9的 out 字符串部分重合。

en.description: Activation positions are distributed across different word forms and contexts: Gib- proper names, Cout- names, the place name beam, the Portuguese word ending ciente, and here in legal contexts. Apart from proper-name fragments, no unified semantic or syntactic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Gibco brand or name fragment
patterns.context: Proper names beginning with the string Gib- occur; commonly the Gibco BRL reagent brand, but also names of people, places, or organizations, with activation concentrated on Gib and subsequent subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods and reagents, transportation research, parliamentary texts, etc.

patterns.name: Cout- initial surnames or names
patterns.context: Occurs in author names or bibliographic names in references, or in proper names; nearby text often includes citation formatting, publication titles, or author lists.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, computer science papers, bibliographies

patterns.name: Place name containing beam
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name Gibby Beam, preceded by a list of gullies on a moor; the broader sentence mentions landforms and their names.

patterns.name: Portuguese word ending -iente
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-ending fragment «ciente» in Portuguese, meaning that someone is informed; the same passage also mentions the name of an MEP, Banotti.

patterns.name: here in a legal sentence
patterns.context: Activation falls on here; occurs after a case citation, contrasting the facts of an earlier case and recounting the evidence in the present case.

2_1544.description: 激活位置分散在不同词形和语境：Gib- 专名、Cout- 姓名、beam 地名、葡语 ciente 词尾及法律语境 here；除专名片段外，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: Gibco 商标或名称片段
patterns.context: 出现字符串 Gib- 起始的专名；常见于 Gibco BRL 试剂商标，也见人名/地名或机构名，激活集中在 Gib 及其后续子词片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法与试剂、交通研究、议会文本等

patterns.name: Cout- 开头的姓氏或名称
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献中的作者姓名或书目姓名，或专名；周围常有引用格式、出版物标题或作者列表。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、计算机科学论文、书目

patterns.name: 带 beam 的地名
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Gibby Beam 中，前文列举 moor 上的沟谷名称；更广泛的句子提及地貌特征及其命名。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾 -iente
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语 «ciente» 的词尾片段，句中表示某人知情；同段还出现议员姓名 Banotti。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

patterns.name: 法律句中的 here
patterns.context: 激活落在 here；出现在判例引证后，对比先前案件事实并转述本案证据。

en.description: Activations often fall on letter fragments such as Gib, Coy, and out, scattered across proper names, common words, and texts from different fields. There are also activations on word fragments in a poem and within Argentine, with no unified semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: gib/related strings within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on the string Gib in proper names or words; capitalization, word boundaries, and following characters vary, suggesting subword fragments rather than complete-word triggers.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, academic papers, literary texts

patterns.name: C + oy fragments within words
patterns.context: Occurs in the Coy module name and the personal name Wil-E-Coyote; strong activations concentrate within the string Coy.

patterns.name: Other within-word fragment out
patterns.context: Activations fall on letter fragments in the surname Coutinho and the word Courts, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments without shared semantics
patterns.context: Activations occur on common word fragments in a poem and in the classification label Argentine; apart from occurring within words, the trigger conditions are unclear.

2_1544.description: 激活多落在 Gib、Coy、out 等字母片段上，分散于专名、普通词及不同领域文本；另有诗句词片段与 Argentine 内的激活，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 单词内部的 gib/关联词段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或词语中的 Gib 字符串；大小写、词界及其后续字符不同，可能是子词片段而非完整词触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文、文学文本

patterns.name: C + oy 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Coy 模块名及人名 Wil-E-Coyote 中；强激活集中于字符串 Coy 的内部。

patterns.name: 其他词内片段 out
patterns.context: 激活落在 Coutinho 姓氏和 Courts 一词的字母片段中，未见明确共同语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、书目列表

patterns.name: 其他无共同语义的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在诗句中的普通词片段，以及分类标签 Argentine 中；除位于词内外，触发条件不明。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the spelling fragment Cun, found in names or proper nouns such as Cunard, Cunha, and Cunliffe. There are also sporadic activations on fragments within English words and on title and proper-name tokens, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Cun-related names and terms
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the spelling fragment Cun, occurring in different words such as Cuna, Cunha, and Cunard; the triggering form may involve within-word subwords or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Within-word English fragments and common suffixes
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments within longer English words, with no unified semantics; some fragments have no clear connection to the Cun pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in titles and proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on local tokens in proper names, title words, or cited references, with no shared contextual conditions.

2_1544.concept: Cun 字符串及零散子词
2_1544.description: 主要对 Cun 拼写片段敏感，涉及 Cunard、Cunha、Cunliffe 等姓名或专名；另有若干英文词内片段及标题、专名 token 的零散激活，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: Cun 相关姓名与词项
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Cun 拼写片段，出现在 Cuna、Cunha、Cunard 等不同词中；触发形式可能包含词内子词或分词边界。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段与常见后缀
patterns.context: 在较长英文词的词内片段上激活，未见统一语义；其中部分片段与 Cun 模式无明显关联。

patterns.name: 标题与专名中的零散片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、标题词或引用文献中的局部 token，缺少共同上下文条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to there introducing an existential statement (there are/is); other activations fall on fragments within proper names or abbreviations such as Cunard and Cunha. The latter pattern is weaker, and some instances are unexplained.

patterns.name: Cun/Cun- strings in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments within proper names, especially the shipping company Cunard and the Portuguese name Cunha.

patterns.name: Existential sentences with there
patterns.context: there is immediately followed by are/is, often introducing a question, drawback, or state; activations concentrate on there and are relatively strong.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in various proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments within names, abbreviations, or words, with no shared semantics or consistent syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, patents, emails, and medical style texts

2_1544.description: 主要响应句中引出存在陈述的 there（there are/is）；另有激活落在 Cunard、Cunha 等专名或缩写的内部片段，后者规律较弱，部分实例无法解释。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cun/Cun- 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的分词片段上，尤其是 Cunard 航运公司及葡萄牙人名 Cunha。

patterns.name: 句中 there 后的存在句
patterns.trigger: « there»10 are；« there»10 is；« there»9 are；« there»8 is
patterns.context: there 后紧接 are/is，常引出问题、缺点或状态；激活集中在 there，强度较高。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、法律论证

patterns.name: 多种专名中的内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在名称、缩写或词语内部的片段，未见共同语义或一致句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛、专利、邮件及医学出版规范文本

en.description: Activations often fall on subword fragments within different languages, proper names, and common words; there is also the English “there are” construction. Across medical, legal, maritime, email, sports, crypto, Russian Q&A, Italian, and encyclopedia texts, no stable shared semantic or domain pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Cunard word-form fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name Cunard, while C and the suffix ard are not marked in context; appears with varying strength in Enron emails.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subwords in proper names or personal names, while surrounding letters and common words are not marked.

patterns.name: Fragments of medical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in medical descriptions and terminology related to antibody patterns.

patterns.name: Financial/crypto vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within cryptocurrency project names or words such as “decentralization”.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Russian answers
patterns.context: Occurs in Russian Q&A text, including explanations following code examples.

patterns.name: Italian safety vocabulary fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within words related to workplace safety, health, and history.

patterns.name: Determiner construction before an English noun
patterns.context: “there” is followed by “are”, introducing a statement that the number of options of a given kind is limited.

2_1544.description: 激活多落在不同语言、专名及普通词内部的子词片段；另有英语“there are”结构。跨医学、法律、航运、邮件、体育、加密、俄语问答、意大利语和百科文本，未见稳定共享的语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: Cunard词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Cunard 中，且 C 和后缀 ard 在上下文中未标记；在 Enron 邮件里以不同强度出现。

patterns.name: 人名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或人名的内部子词上，周围字母及普通词未标记。

patterns.name: 医学术语的片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学描述及抗体模式相关术语中。

patterns.name: 金融/加密词汇片段
patterns.context: 激活位于加密货币项目名或“decentralization”等词的内部。

patterns.name: 俄语回答中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在俄语问答正文中，包含代码示例后的解释。

patterns.name: 意大利语安全词汇片段
patterns.context: 出现在工作安全、健康及历史相关词语内部。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术/会议文本

patterns.name: 英语名词前的限定结构
patterns.context: “there”后接“are”，引出某类选择数量有限的陈述。

en.description: All examples show strong activation on there, especially in existential or evaluative constructions such as there is/are/was/would be; subsequent content covers drawbacks, needs, risks, limitations, scarcity, and hypothetical outcomes.

patterns.name: Existential/evaluative constructions with there
patterns.context: there functions as a dummy subject in existential clauses or introduces an evaluation, need, risk, limitation, knowledge gap, or outcome; activation concentrates on there rather than field-specific vocabulary.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, encyclopedias, genomics and medical literature

patterns.name: Problems or improvement needs in background sections
patterns.context: After describing the advantages, current state, or limitations of an existing approach or technology, there is/are introduces drawbacks, needs, or room for improvement.

patterns.name: Risks or possibilities in background sections
patterns.context: there is/are is followed by nouns such as possibility or risk, indicating that an event is impossible or that a risk remains.

patterns.name: Statements about limitations or growing demand
patterns.context: After describing material or manufacturing constraints, states that options are limited or that industry demand consequently increases.

patterns.name: Knowledge gaps and scarcity
patterns.context: Notes insufficient relevant knowledge, then uses there are to indicate that very few items are currently available.

patterns.name: Outcome introduced by a hypothetical condition
patterns.context: After an economic or policy hypothetical introduced by if, there would be introduces an inferred outcome.

2_1544.description: 全部样例都在 there 上强激活，尤其是 there is/are/was/would be 存在或判断句式；后续内容涵盖缺点、需求、风险、限制、稀缺及假设结果。

patterns.name: there 后的存在/判断句式
patterns.context: there 用作存在句或引出判断、需求、风险、限制、知识缺口、结果的主语占位成分；激活集中在 there，而不是某个特定领域词汇。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、百科、基因组学与医学文献

patterns.name: 背景中的问题或改进需求
patterns.trigger: «there»10 are also «drawbacks»；«there»10 is a need；«there»10 is always room for improvement；«there»10 are two «major» «shortcomings»
patterns.context: 先描述已有方案或技术的优点、现状或局限，再以 there is/are 引出缺点、需求或改进空间。

patterns.name: 背景中的风险或可能性
patterns.trigger: «there»10 is no possibility；«there»10 is always some risk
patterns.context: there is/are 后接 possibility、risk 等名词，说明某种事件不可能发生或仍有风险。

patterns.name: 有限性或需求增长的陈述
patterns.trigger: «there»10 are a limited number；«there»10 grew a demand
patterns.context: 在材料或制造限制之后，陈述可选项有限或行业需求随之增长。

patterns.name: 知识缺口及稀缺性
patterns.context: 说明相关知识不足，并由 there are 引出目前可用对象数量很少。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 假设条件引出的结果
patterns.context: 在 if 引导的经济或政策假设之后，以 there would be 引出推演结果。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is there, especially after a comma or period and followed by is, would, or similar forms to make an existential or concluding statement. Other activations are scattered across local vocabulary and subwords, with no consistent theme.

patterns.name: there within a sentence and following evaluation
patterns.context: After a period or comma, continues with an explanation of a situation, conclusion, need, or controversy, often in the form “there is/was/would …”; there is a dummy subject.
patterns.domain: Expository texts, academic abstracts, news narratives, patent backgrounds, and technical discussions

patterns.name: there in less common contexts
patterns.context: there also occurs, but the following structure or function does not fully match a typical existential/evaluative sentence; other activations involve various words or subwords.
patterns.domain: Science-fiction discussions, medical titles and ethnic names, literary criticism, business emails

patterns.name: there in a time-design context
patterns.context: Capitalized There at the start of a sentence, followed by “just are too many”, indicating that there are too many items of a kind; activations also involve a subword of idiosyncrasies.

2_1544.description: 最稳定的触发是 there，尤其句中逗号或句号后接 is、would 等构成存在句或结论句；其他激活分散于局部词汇与子词，未见一致主题。

patterns.name: 句中 there 及后续判断
patterns.context: 句号或逗号之后，接续说明某种情况、结论、需求或争议，常见形式为“there is/was/would …”；主语为形式主语 there。
patterns.domain: 说明文、学术摘要、新闻叙述、专利背景及技术讨论

patterns.name: 少见语境中的 there
patterns.context: 同样出现 there，但后续结构或功能不完全符合典型的存在句/判断句；其余激活也涉及多种词汇或子词。
patterns.domain: 科幻讨论、医学标题与民族名称、文学评论、商业邮件

patterns.name: 时间设计语境中的 there
patterns.context: 句首大写 There，后接“just are too many”，表示某类事物过多；激活还涉及 idiosyncrasies 的子词。

en.concept: True/false question templates and medical word fragments
en.description: Items 1–9 focus on mathematical Q&A asking whether a number or variable is prime or composite, and on true/false answers, with sporadic arithmetic fragments. Item 10 activates on a fragment within a biomedical term and differs from the mathematical question pattern.

patterns.name: Prime/composite judgment template
patterns.context: Math questions ask whether a variable or number is prime/composite, often using the template “Is [object] a prime/composite number?” The object may be introduced by an earlier equation or definition.

patterns.name: Sporadic numerical values and symbols in equations
patterns.context: Occurs in equations, variable definitions, or negative-number expressions; appearances are sparse, with no consistent association with a specific value or operation.

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in medical descriptions related to lung infections and autoimmune syndromes; activation falls on a subword fragment within a term.

2_1544.concept: 判断题模板与医学词片段
2_1544.description: 1–9集中于数学问答中判断数或变量是否为素数、合数及其真假回答，另有零散算式片段；10激活生物医学术语内部片段，与数学题型不同。

patterns.name: 素数/合数判断模板
patterns.context: 数学题中询问某变量或数是否为素数/合数，常见模板为“Is [对象] a prime/composite number?”；对象可由前文算式或定义引入。

patterns.name: 算式中的零散数值与符号
patterns.context: 出现在算式、变量定义或负数表达式中；仅零星出现，未见它们与某一特定数值或运算稳定相关。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在肺部感染及自身免疫综合征相关的医学叙述中，激活落在术语内部的子词片段。

en.description: Primarily responds to composite in number-theory questions, especially “Is … a composite?”; responds more weakly to prime questions and related question structures. Also activates within the identifier CANCELED and in a data-modeling recommendation passage, where triggers are scattered and difficult to unify with the mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: Substring in a cancellation identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in the enum constant CANCELED, with surrounding code comments explaining that an operation was canceled; appears only within that identifier.

patterns.name: composite in composite questions
patterns.context: Occurs in template questions asking whether an integer is composite, such as “Is ... a composite?” or “Is ... a composite number?”; preceded by the variable to be assessed and followed by a question mark or number.

patterns.name: prime in prime questions
patterns.context: Occurs in the template “Is ... a prime number?” asking whether an arithmetic expression is prime.

patterns.name: Question structure beginning with Is
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical template questions, introducing an assessment of an expression or variable; the relevant passages often contain prime/composite vocabulary.

patterns.name: Question punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs at the expression or sentence-final punctuation in mathematical judgment questions; only a few instances are marked, with no evidence of a stable independent trigger.

patterns.name: Data-modeling recommendation passage
patterns.context: Occurs in a StackExchange answer discussing data models/query design, clarifying comments, and grouping records by patient; activations are scattered across multiple common discourse words.

2_1544.description: 主要响应数论问句中的 composite，尤其“Is … a composite?”；较弱地响应 prime 问句和相关问句结构。另在 CANCELED 标识符内部及一段数据建模建议语篇中激活，后者触发分散，难与数学模式统一。

patterns.name: 取消标识符中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在枚举常量 CANCELED 中，周围代码注释说明操作被取消；只见于该标识符内部。

patterns.name: composite 问句中的 composite
patterns.context: 出现在判断整数是否为合数的模板问句“Is ... a composite?”或“Is ... a composite number?”中；前接待判断的变量，后接问号或 number。

patterns.name: prime 问句中的 prime
patterns.context: 出现在询问算术表达式是否为素数的模板“Is ... a prime number?”中。

patterns.name: 句首 Is 的问句结构
patterns.context: 位于数学模板问句中，开启对表达式或变量性质的判断；相关段中常与 prime/composite 词汇同现。

patterns.name: 问句中的疑问标点
patterns.context: 出现在数学判断问句的表达式或句末标点处；仅少数实例被标记，未显示为稳定独立触发条件。

patterns.name: 数据建模建议语篇
patterns.context: 出现在 StackExchange 回答中，讨论数据模型/查询设计、评论澄清及按患者归并记录；触发分散在多个常见语篇词上。

en.description: The main pattern is there as the subject of an existential clause, often followed by is/are or a modal verb and frequently introduced by a condition such as If. There is also the negative construction there is no. The activation on part in the fourth passage does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: there as the subject of an existential clause
patterns.context: there is followed by a copula, expressing existence, occurrence, or an outcome; the preceding text often states a condition or hypothesis (e.g., If…), though it can also occur in a statement or inference.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, forum discussions, technical texts, academic papers, and legal documents

patterns.name: there linked to a preceding conditional
patterns.context: A conditional clause or limiting condition comes first, followed by there introducing existence, an outcome, or a possibility under that condition; a comma may separate the conditional clause from the main clause.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English argumentation and expository texts

patterns.name: Fixed negative existential construction there is no
patterns.context: there is followed by is no, denying the existence of something, the need for something, or the existence of a conclusion; activation in passage 8 is weak (9).
patterns.domain: Forums, technical descriptions, and academic argumentation

patterns.name: there with would/could modals
patterns.context: there is followed by a modal verb, expressing an outcome or judgment under a hypothetical condition.
patterns.domain: EU policy argumentation and legal documents

patterns.name: Local activation on the conditional marker If
patterns.context: If occurs at the start of a conditional clause; many passages that follow contain existential there, but in passage 10 the if-clause and there are not in the same main clause.

patterns.name: Anomalous local pattern in passage 4
patterns.context: part occurs in “the central part of interest”, not in a there construction; other marked tokens may be nearby common words.

2_1544.description: 主模式是 there 作存在句主语，常接 is/are 或情态动词，且常由 If 等条件引出；另有 there is no 否定结构。第4段的 part 激活与此不符。

patterns.name: there 作存在句主语
patterns.trigger: «there»10 is / are / would be / could be
patterns.context: there 后接系动词，表示存在、发生或某种结果；前文常先提出条件或假设（如 If…），但也可出现在陈述或推论中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、论坛讨论、技术文本、学术论文与法律文书

patterns.name: there 与前置条件句衔接
patterns.context: 条件从句或限定条件先行，随后以 there 引出条件下的存在、结果或可能性；条件从句与主句之间可有逗号。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语论述与说明文

patterns.name: there is no 固定否定存在结构
patterns.context: there 后接 is no，否定某物存在、某事有必要或某结论存在；段 8 的激活较弱（9）。
patterns.domain: 论坛、技术说明与学术论述

patterns.name: there 与 would/could 情态搭配
patterns.context: there 后接情态动词，表达假设条件下的结果或判断。
patterns.domain: 欧盟政策论述与法律文书

patterns.name: 条件标记 If 的局部激活
patterns.context: If 位于条件从句开头；多段后续有 there 存在句，但段 10 的 if 从句与 there 不在同一主句中。

patterns.name: 段 4 的异常局部模式
patterns.context: part 出现在 “the central part of interest” 中，并非 there 句式；其余标记可能是邻近的普通词语。

en.concept: Unclear; clause-initial there and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Strong activation positions vary: five passages contain there/there is at the start of an independent clause in existential constructions; five others fall respectively on nuncios, carbendazim, polyendocrinopathy, Gonfloni, and part, spanning historical, medical, and physics contexts.

patterns.name: Sentence- or clause-initial there
patterns.context: Often occurs at the beginning of a new clause after a comma or period, introducing an existential statement, outcome, or evaluation; followed by a be verb or similar construction
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, including Q&A, forums, parliamentary speeches, and religious argumentation

patterns.name: Within-word fragment end
patterns.context: Activation falls on a character fragment within an English word, not on a standalone word; one word is a compound name, the other a medical term

patterns.name: Within-word fragment ios
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word-final letter fragment; the context discusses German papal envoys

patterns.name: Within-word fragment on
patterns.context: Activation falls on a substring within a researcher's surname

patterns.name: Within-word fragment part
patterns.context: The complete English word part, describing the central portion of interest

2_1544.concept: 不明显；分句起始 there 与零散词片段
