2_1544.description: 强激活位置多样：五段位于分句起始的 there/there is 存在句；另五段分别落在 nuncios、carbendazim、polyendocrinopathy、Gonfloni、part 中，涵盖历史、医学、物理等语境。

patterns.name: 句首或分句起始的 there
patterns.trigger: «there»10；第2、6段为小写 there，第8、9、10段为 there’s / There is
patterns.context: 常出现在逗号或句号后的新分句开头，引出存在句、结果或判断；后面接 be 动词或类似结构
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言，包括问答、论坛、议会发言及宗教论述

patterns.name: 词内片段 end
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词内部的字符片段，而非独立词；一个词是化合物名称，另一个是医学术语

patterns.name: 词内片段 ios
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾字母片段中；上下文谈及德国教廷使节

patterns.name: 词内片段 on
patterns.context: 激活落在研究者姓氏的词内子串中

patterns.name: 词内片段 part
patterns.context: 完整英文词 part，描述感兴趣的中心部分

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on commas following quoted strings or phrases, across papers, code, queries, and abstracts. Also includes isolated code identifier fragments, comment words, the pornographic title word Bi, and a passage about character sets that does not fit these patterns.

patterns.name: Phrase boundary with a comma after a preposition or introductory word
patterns.context: A comma immediately follows a single-quoted string or phrase; many high activations fall on the comma, often at the end of a longer parameter or phrase.
patterns.domain: Paper prose, code, configuration/queries, and medical abstracts; cross-domain punctuation pattern

patterns.name: b in a Vue component name
patterns.context: In Vue template/script code, the component name double-bounce activates on the b inside the identifier.

patterns.name: dings in a variable/identifier
patterns.context: In code comments describing dings, activation falls on the initial d and following ings; adjacent to callback and request code in the same passage.

patterns.name: Bi in an adult pornographic title
patterns.context: In the title phrase “Bisexual Dink's Bi Sex 2 Rectal Stretch”, the title word Bi receives the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Split lastHost identifier
patterns.context: In the configuration object property _globals.lasthost, activation falls on fragments of the property name split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Narrative quoted phrase following a single quote
patterns.context: In abstract titles or quotations, single quotes enclose the contrasting phrase “something old, something new”; something also activates more weakly, besides the comma.

2_1622.concept: 引号/字符串边界及代码片段
2_1622.description: 主要在带引号字符串或短语结束后的逗号处强激活，跨论文、代码、查询和摘要。另有孤立的代码标识符片段、注释词、色情标题词 Bi，以及字符集讨论段无法归入这些模式。

patterns.name: 介词/引导词后接逗号的短语边界
patterns.context: 逗号紧接在单引号括住的字符串或短语之后；多处高激活落在逗号上，且常见于较长参数/短语的结束处。
patterns.domain: 论文 prose、代码、配置/查询及医学摘要；跨领域的标点模式

patterns.name: Vue 组件名中的 b
patterns.context: Vue 模板/脚本代码中的组件名 double-bounce，激活集中在标识符内部的 b。

patterns.name: 变量/标识符中的 dings
patterns.context: 代码注释描述 dings 时，激活落在单词开头 d 和后续 ings；与同段的回调及请求代码相邻。

patterns.name: 成人色情标题中的 Bi
patterns.context: 标题短语 “Bisexual Dink's Bi Sex 2 Rectal Stretch” 中，标题词 Bi 获得最强激活。

patterns.name: 被拆分的 lastHost 标识符
patterns.context: 配置对象属性 _globals.lasthost 中，激活落在被分词拆开的属性名片段。

patterns.name: 单引号后接叙述性引用短语
patterns.context: 摘要标题或引述中，单引号包住对照性短语 “something old, something new”；除逗号外，something 也有较弱激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code punctuation and identifiers, quoted strings, technical fields, and title text; isolated strong activations also occur on the initial Bi and individual code tokens. The examples lack a stable shared semantics and may combine formatting with local lexical features.

patterns.name: Dotted identifiers in code
patterns.context: Triggers dots and nearby code identifiers, properties, or call chains; no specific programming language is required.

patterns.name: Quotes and string values
patterns.context: Quotes enclose strings, titles, or parameter values, often adjacent to punctuation such as commas and parentheses.

patterns.name: Bi prefix in proper nouns
patterns.context: Initial Bi appears in proper nouns or titles; the two examples are from different semantic domains, so it is unclear whether the same lexical feature drives them.
patterns.domain: Adult comic titles and biomedical titles

patterns.name: Numbers and structured values
patterns.context: Numbers, dates, or configuration fields embedded in names, code, or technical descriptions.
patterns.domain: String titles, code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Terms related to interaction
patterns.context: Academic discussion of unit interactions and their state distributions; appears only in this passage.

patterns.name: Asynchronous callbacks and requests
patterns.context: JavaScript-style code describing request callbacks and timer behavior.

patterns.name: Nitric oxide and pain in medical titles
patterns.context: Medical abstract titles and subsequent discussion.

patterns.name: HTML templates and Vue component tags
patterns.context: Tag boundaries and script sections in HTML/Vue single-file components.

patterns.name: SQL/PHP query construction
patterns.context: Creating database queries through chained calls and setting parameters.

patterns.name: Repeated charset field
patterns.context: Discusses how to handle server responses when no character set is specified; the field name appears multiple times.

patterns.name: B- prefix in proper names
patterns.context: Hyphenated compounds in component or project names; the passage also contains Vue component code.

patterns.name: Possible markup or tokenization spurious pattern
patterns.context: Scattered high-activation tokens in code snippets, without enough context to support a unified semantic interpretation.

2_1622.concept: 代码/文本边界与局部模式
2_1622.description: 激活分散于代码标点与标识符、引号字符串、技术字段及标题文本；另有 Bi 词首和个别代码 token 的孤立强激活。各例缺少稳定共同语义，可能混合了格式与局部词汇特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的点号标识符
patterns.context: 触发点号及其周边的代码标识符、属性或调用链；不要求特定编程语言。

patterns.name: 引号与字符串值
patterns.context: 引号包围字符串、标题或参数值，且常与逗号、括号等标点相邻。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Bi 前缀
patterns.context: 词首 Bi 出现在专名或标题中；两例语义领域不同，无法确认是否由相同词汇特征驱动。
patterns.domain: 成人漫画标题与生物医学标题

patterns.name: 数字及结构化取值
patterns.context: 数字、日期或配置字段嵌在名称、代码或技术说明中。
patterns.domain: 字符串标题、代码与技术问答

patterns.name: 交互作用相关术语
patterns.context: 关于单元相互作用及其状态分布的学术论述；仅此段出现。

patterns.name: 异步回调与请求
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格代码描述请求回调和定时器行为。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 nitric oxide 与 pain
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题及其后续论述。

patterns.name: HTML 模板与 Vue 组件标记
patterns.context: HTML/Vue 单文件组件的标签边界和脚本区。

patterns.name: SQL/PHP 查询构造
patterns.context: 通过链式调用创建数据库查询并设置参数。

patterns.name: 重复出现的 charset 字段
patterns.context: 讨论未指定字符集时如何处理服务器返回内容；字段名多次出现。

patterns.name: 专有名称中的 B- 前缀
patterns.context: 组件或项目名称中的连字符复合词；该段还包含 Vue 组件代码。

patterns.name: 可能的标记或分词伪模式
patterns.context: 代码片段中零散的高激活 token，缺少足够上下文支持统一语义解释。

en.description: Activations are scattered across tag boundaries, code identifiers and calls, word fragments and punctuation, as well as terms, experimental conditions, and directional descriptions in scientific text; email headers and web comments are also covered. No stable semantic pattern unifies these varied contexts.

patterns.name: HTML/XML tag structure
patterns.context: Activates near tag boundaries, closing tags, and following line breaks; also includes indentation in HTML/template code

patterns.name: Specific name strings
patterns.context: In mixed-case identifiers or string values, activation is concentrated on name fragments and adjacent punctuation

patterns.name: Relational words and punctuation in text
patterns.context: Sentences in scientific discussion describing interactions among system units, states, and results; activations also occur near commas and quotation marks

patterns.name: Chemical names and values
patterns.context: Near compound names, dosage units, and experimental conditions in chemical/biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Phrases and English word fragments
patterns.context: A web comment contains the quoted phrase “we solve for x”, contrasted with Google

patterns.name: Medical topic word fragments
patterns.context: Technical terms in titles or short titles are split into multiple word fragments

patterns.name: Call and callback fragments in code
patterns.context: Comments or calls involving callbacks, delayed execution, and repeated requests in JavaScript code

patterns.name: Email header fields
patterns.context: Date, time, recipient, and address fields in email headers

patterns.name: Direction- and perception-related words
patterns.context: Experimental results describing hamsters searching for a nest box in an unfamiliar location and determining direction

2_1622.description: 激活分散于标签边界、代码标识符与调用、词语片段和标点，以及科学文本中的术语、实验条件和方向描述；还覆盖邮件头与网页评论。未见能统一解释这些不同场景的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标签结构
patterns.context: 在标签边界、闭合标签及标签后的换行附近激活；也包括 HTML/模板代码中的缩进

patterns.name: 特定名称字符串
patterns.context: 大小写混合的标识符或字符串值中，激活集中在名称片段及其相邻标点

patterns.name: 文本中的关系性词语与标点
patterns.context: 科学论述中描述系统单元相互作用、状态及结果的句子；逗号和引号附近也有激活

patterns.name: 化学名称及数值
patterns.context: 化学/生物医学摘要中，化合物名、剂量单位及实验条件附近

patterns.name: 短语与英文词片段
patterns.context: 网页评论中出现引号内的短语“we solve for x”，并与 Google 对照

patterns.name: 医学主题词片段
patterns.context: 标题或短标题中的专业术语被拆分成多个词片段

patterns.name: 代码中的调用与回调片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中出现回调、延迟执行及重复请求的注释或调用

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: 邮件头中的日期、时间、收件人和地址字段

patterns.name: 方向与感知相关词语
patterns.context: 描述仓鼠在陌生地点寻找巢箱并判断方向的实验结果

en.concept: Mathematical expressions and task text, with some medical abstract activations
en.description: Primarily responds to combinations of coefficients, variables, multiplication signs, and exponents in algebraic expressions, along with mathematical instructions around them; also responds to digit-count questions. A few PubMed title and abstract fragments concern topics such as research, maternal-infant attachment, hallucinations, or fractures, and are difficult to unify with the mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: Multiplication signs and variables in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Appears in polynomials, monomials, or calculations, often adjacent to coefficients, variables, and exponents; sometimes embedded in problems asking for expansion or differentiation.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebraic calculations and calculus problems

patterns.name: English operation instructions in math problems
patterns.context: A natural-language prompt requests a specific mathematical task, followed by an expression, number, or variable; instruction words appear alongside the operands.

patterns.name: Large integers and digit-count questions
patterns.context: Large numbers often serve as coefficients in algebra problems; a few problems directly ask for the number of digits in a value.

patterns.name: Abstract topic words in PubMed paper titles
patterns.context: Title-like phrases or abstract openings containing nominalized topics, study subjects, or clinical questions; no clear mathematical context.
patterns.domain: PubMed Abstracts, biomedical paper titles and abstracts

patterns.name: Study design and participant descriptions in abstracts
patterns.context: Abstract text describing study methods, evaluation objectives, and participant characteristics.

2_1622.concept: 数学表达式与任务文本，兼有医学摘要触发
2_1622.description: 主要响应代数算式中系数、变量、乘号和幂次的组合，以及围绕它们的数学指令；也响应位数题。另有少量PubMed标题与摘要片段，涉及研究、母婴依恋、幻觉或骨折等主题，难与数学模式统一。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的乘号与变量
patterns.context: 出现在多项式、单项式或算式中，常与系数、变量、指数相邻；有时嵌在要求展开或求导的题目里。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，代数计算与微积分题

patterns.name: 数学题中的英文运算指令
patterns.context: 由自然语言提出具体数学任务，后接表达式、数字或变量；指令词与运算对象共同出现。

patterns.name: 大整数与数字位数提问
patterns.context: 大数常作为代数题中的系数；少数题直接询问某数的特定位数。

patterns.name: PubMed论文标题中的抽象主题词
patterns.context: 标题式短语或摘要开头，包含名词化主题、研究对象或临床问题；没有明显数学语境。
patterns.domain: PubMed Abstracts，生物医学论文标题与摘要

patterns.name: 摘要中的研究设计与受试者描述
patterns.context: 摘要正文叙述研究方法、评估目的及受试者特征。

en.description: Activations most consistently accompany numbers, numbering, and nearby numeric or formatting tokens, especially the visible 46 and sample sizes or proportions in research abstracts; they also appear in varied formats such as equations, chemical formulas, code, and line breaks. It is unclear whether they arise from the same specific token mechanism.

patterns.name: Number 46 and its context
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on numbers or number-related subwords; in passages 1, 4, 6, 8, and 9, 46 occurs in body-text number sequences or percentages, while passages 5, 7, 9, and 10 also contain salient numbers, numbering, or code contexts. Different tokenizations may make the visible trigger positions inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary corpus, including medical abstracts, philosophy texts, physics, math problems, electronic texts, and code

patterns.name: Number lists or numbering
patterns.context: Numbering, values, equations, or machine-generated continuous markers; passage 2 also has strong activation directly near “46”
patterns.domain: Numbering fragments in philosophy texts, medical abstracts, ebook metadata, math problems

patterns.name: Statistical values in academic abstracts
patterns.context: Values embedded in study samples, proportions, or demographic information; surrounded by abstract-style research descriptions

patterns.name: Special symbols, formatting, and fragment boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near the start of text fragments, line breaks, punctuation, or code formatting; triggers may also relate to numbers, tokenization, or formatting tokens
patterns.domain: Paper title fragments, Gutenberg ebook headers, shell scripts

patterns.name: Numeric parameters in technical text
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in chemical formulas, mathematical expressions, or hardware/frequency parameters; evidence is sparse, so it is unclear whether this matches the general number pattern
patterns.domain: Particle detector papers, math problems, hardware test scripts

2_1622.concept: 数字与结构化文本标记
2_1622.description: 激活最稳定地伴随数字、编号及其周围的数值/格式 token，尤其是可见的46及研究摘要中的样本量或比例；也见于公式、化学式、代码和换行等不同格式，尚不能确定是否由同一具体 token 机制造成。

patterns.name: 数字46及其前后文
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在数字或数字相关子词上；段1、4、6、8、9的46位于正文数字序列或百分比中，段5、7、9、10另有显著数字、编号或代码环境。不同 token 化形式可能使可见触发位置不完全一致
patterns.domain: 跨学科语料，包括医学摘要、哲学文本、物理、数学题、电子文本与代码

patterns.name: 数字列表或编号
patterns.context: 编号、数值、公式或类似机器生成的连续标记；段2还在“46”附近直接出现强激活
patterns.domain: 哲学文本中的编号残片、医学摘要、电子书元数据、数学题

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的统计数值
patterns.context: 数值嵌在研究样本、比例或人口统计信息中；周围是摘要式研究描述

patterns.name: 特殊符号、格式与片段边界
patterns.trigger: 段3的“3D Bioprinting Using a Tem…”，段7的多重换行“↵↵↵”，段10的“#!/bin/bash”及注释标记“#”
patterns.context: 文本片段开头、换行、标点或代码格式附近出现激活；触发可能与数字、切分或格式 token 共同相关
patterns.domain: 论文标题残片、古登堡电子书页眉、shell 脚本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的数字参数
patterns.context: 数字嵌在化学式、数学表达式或硬件/频率参数中；证据较零散，无法确定是否与一般数字模式相同
patterns.domain: 粒子探测器论文、数学题、硬件测试脚本

en.description: Activations are distributed across terms and symbols from various domains: common factors, prime factorization, astronomical spectra and coordinates, dark energy, electromagnetic polarizability, beam geometry, as well as email deal language and encyclopedia subheadings. There is no clear unified word or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: common
patterns.context: Means a common factor/greatest common divisor in mathematical contexts; elsewhere, common modifies neoplasm in a medical context.

patterns.name: Prime factors and subscripts in formulas
patterns.context: Describes prime factorization of integers; activation is concentrated on formula structures with subscripts and related qualifiers.

patterns.name: Astrophysical notation and measurements
patterns.context: In astronomical spectral observations, terms such as spectral lines, absorption features, and equivalent width occur alongside mathematical notation.

patterns.name: deal/Cal' numbered text
patterns.context: Email compares good and bad deals and uses a number after Cal' to label related items.

patterns.name: Dark energy and sound-speed parameters
patterns.context: Discusses inhomogeneous dark energy models and their clustering parameters.

patterns.name: Biography subheadings
patterns.context: A biographical encyclopedia entry moves from an introduction to life and education sections; the strongest activation falls at the start of a subheading.

patterns.name: Electromagnetic polarizability
patterns.context: Discusses interactions between constituent particles and photons, and lists electric and magnetic polarizabilities.

patterns.name: Sky direction and coordinates
patterns.context: Compares the areas of observed sky regions and gives celestial coordinates or latitude.

patterns.name: Geometric distance from a point to the beam axis
patterns.context: Uses centimeter measurements to specify the position of particle trajectories relative to the beam axis and interaction point.

2_1622.description: 激活分布在多种领域术语与符号中：共同因子、素因子分解、天体光谱和坐标、暗能量、电磁极化率、束流几何，以及邮件交易措辞和百科小标题。没有明显统一的专属词或句法模式。

patterns.name: common
patterns.context: 在数学语境中表示共同因子/最大公因数；另有医学语境中 common 修饰 neoplasm。

patterns.name: 公式中的素因子与下标
patterns.context: 描述整数的素因子分解，激活集中在带下标的公式结构及相关限定词。

patterns.name: 天体物理记号与量值
patterns.context: 天体光谱观测中，谱线、吸收特征和等效宽度等术语与数学记号相邻。

patterns.name: deal/Cal'编号文本
patterns.context: 邮件中比较交易好坏，并以 Cal' 后的编号标记相关事项。

patterns.name: 暗能量与声速参数
patterns.context: 讨论非均匀暗能量模型及其聚集参数。

patterns.name: 人物简介小标题
patterns.context: 人物百科条目在简介后进入生平与教育小节；最强激活落在小标题开头。

patterns.name: 电磁极化率
patterns.context: 讨论组成粒子与光子的相互作用，并列举电、磁极化率。

patterns.name: 天区方位与坐标
patterns.context: 比较观测天区的面积并给出天体坐标或纬度。

patterns.name: 点到束轴的几何距离
patterns.context: 用厘米量值规定粒子轨迹相对束流轴和相互作用点的位置。

en.concept: Proper names and number fragments in academic text
en.description: Activations are scattered across years in academic text (especially 2008), virus strains/subtypes, botanical names, physics and astronomy terms, as well as medical abstracts, cited author names, and title fragments; there is no consistent single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: 2008 year marker
patterns.context: Four-digit year appears in literature citations, study periods, or seasonal records; other years also occur without activation, so the condition is not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, citations, and date records

patterns.name: Bacterial/viral strain and subtype markers
patterns.context: Alphanumeric combinations represent influenza subtypes or rotavirus genotypes, often near virus, infection, or seasonal contexts.

patterns.name: Specific botanical names
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenization-split fragments of plant genus or species names, near descriptions of plant growth.

patterns.name: Physics term magnetic
patterns.context: Appears in a physics abstract about electrons on a toroidal surface subject to a constant magnetic field.

patterns.name: Pocket and Love title fragments
patterns.context: A book-like or title-like phrase follows a date: “Pocket of Love: Julia”; activation is distributed across the date and title words.

patterns.name: Author-name fragments in citations
patterns.context: In astrophysics references, activation falls on tokenization-split author names or citation-marker fragments.

patterns.name: Lexical activations in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Liver failure, drug toxicity, and paper citation contexts; activations are scattered across ordinary medical narrative words and citation words rather than consistent terminology.

patterns.name: Treatment and year fragments
patterns.context: An abstract about neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy for rectal cancer, with activations involving disease descriptions and the study year.

patterns.name: Gene delivery phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in “following adenovector gene delivery”, describing transgene expression kinetics after gene delivery; nearby words show no clear activation.

patterns.name: Astronomical spectral terms with no clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Several methods- and iron spectral line-related words activate in a stellar spectroscopy abstract, with no stable local condition shared with other fragments.

2_1622.concept: 学术文本中的专名与数字片段
2_1622.description: 激活分散于学术文本中的年份（尤其2008）、病毒株/分型、植物学名、物理与天文术语，以及医学摘要、引文姓名和标题片段；没有一致的单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 2008 年份标记
patterns.context: 四位年份出现在文献引用、研究时间范围或季节记录中；其他年份也出现但未标记，故条件并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、引用与日期记录

patterns.name: 细菌/病毒株与分型标记
patterns.context: 字母数字组合表示流感亚型或轮状病毒基因型，常与病毒、感染或季节语境相邻。

patterns.name: 特定植物学名词
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的植物属名或种名片段中，邻近植物生长描述。

patterns.name: 物理学术语 magnetic
patterns.context: 出现在电子处于环面表面、受恒定磁场作用的物理摘要中。

patterns.name: 口袋与 Love 标题片段
patterns.context: 日期后接类似书名或标题的短语“Pocket of Love: Julia”；激活分布于日期及标题词。

patterns.name: 引用中的作者名片段
patterns.context: 天体物理文本的参考文献中，激活落在被拆分的作者姓名或引用标记片段。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的词汇性激活
patterns.context: 肝衰竭、药物毒性及论文引文语境；激活零散分布于普通医学叙述词和引文词，而非一致术语。

patterns.name: 治疗与年份片段
patterns.context: 直肠癌新辅助放化疗研究摘要，激活涉及病症描述及研究年份。

patterns.name: 基因递送短语
patterns.context: 位于“following adenovector gene delivery”中，描述基因递送后的转基因表达动力学；其余邻近词未明显激活。

patterns.name: 无明显共同触发的天体光谱词
patterns.context: 恒星光谱分析摘要中若干方法与铁谱线相关词被激活，未见与其他片段稳定共享的局部条件。

en.description: All fragments activate on today (strength 9–10), across contexts such as current devices, technology applications, data rates, observations, and clinical practice; no additional stable thematic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: today as a temporal adverb
patterns.context: today occurs mid-sentence or at the end, indicating current technology, devices, uses, observations, or conditions; activation is concentrated on today itself rather than a fixed collocation
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical/research abstracts, astronomy papers

2_1622.description: 所有片段都激活 today（强度9–10），涵盖当前设备、技术应用、数据速率、观测值及临床实践等不同语境；看不出额外稳定的主题触发模式。

patterns.name: today 作为时间状语
patterns.context: today 出现在句中或句末，表示当前技术、设备、用途、观测或状况；激活集中在 today 本身，而非固定搭配
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学/科研摘要、天文学论文

en.description: All fragments contain highlighted today, mainly situating technology, uses, practices, or research in the present; a few uses refer to a specific transaction date, and one has the possessive form today’s.

patterns.name: today emphasizing the present
patterns.context: today means “now, currently” in a sentence or phrase, often at the end or modifying current needs, uses, or conditions; it is the strongest trigger in many passages.
patterns.domain: Technology descriptions, patent background, academic papers, business emails, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Today's date or transaction day
patterns.context: today refers to the specific current date and relates to commercial time calculations such as scheduling annuity start and end dates or transaction days.

patterns.name: Possessive form today's
patterns.context: today is followed by a possessive marker and refers to the contemporary environment; the context discusses engine emissions and environmental requirements.

2_1622.description: 所有片段都包含高亮的 today，主要用于把技术、用途、实践或研究放在当下语境中；少数用法指具体交易日期，另有 today’s 所有格形式。

patterns.name: today 强调当下
patterns.context: today 在句中或短语中表示“现今、目前”，常位于句末或修饰当下的需求、用途、状况；在多段中是最强触发词。
patterns.domain: 科技说明、专利背景、学术论文、商业邮件及百科文本

patterns.name: 今天的日期或交易日
patterns.context: today 指具体的当前日期，并与安排年金起止日期、交易日等商业时间计算有关。

patterns.name: today's 所有格形式
patterns.context: today 后接所有格标记，指当代环境；上下文谈发动机排放和环保要求。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the token “today”, especially when describing the current-period use, presence, or applicability of technology, devices, applications, or processes; it occurs across domains and genres, with some variation in syntactic position.

patterns.name: today indicating the current period
patterns.context: Used as a temporal adverb mid-sentence or at the end to indicate the current-period use or presence of a system, technology, practice, application, or state; common structures include “used today”, “available to use today”, and “in clinical use today”.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, papers, patent background, technical discussions, news, and email

2_1622.description: 激活集中于词元“today”，尤其是用于说明技术、设备、应用或流程在当前时期的使用、存在或适用状况；跨领域与文体出现，句法位置略有变化。

patterns.name: today 表示当前时期
patterns.context: 在句末或句中作时间副词，表示某种系统、技术、做法、应用或状态在当前时期的使用或存在；常见于“used today”“available to use today”“in clinical use today”等结构。
patterns.domain: 百科、论文、专利背景、技术讨论、新闻及邮件等多种文体

en.concept: Anaphoric expressions referring to preceding text
en.description: All segments contain expressions referring back to preceding content. The most consistent trigger is above-mentioned (sometimes hyphenated); there is also one instance of above-described. Other sporadic activations have no stable shared pattern.

patterns.name: above-mentioned anaphora
patterns.context: Used in patent or academic text to refer back to an object, problem, method, or feature introduced earlier; in this combination, mentioned often activates more strongly than above.
patterns.domain: Patent background and description; academic papers

patterns.name: above-described anaphora
patterns.context: Refers back to a method described earlier in patent text; like above-mentioned, it is an anaphoric expression, but uses the verb described.

patterns.name: Other activations in adjacent text
patterns.context: These activations occur in several technical contexts, but show no clear shared local trigger pattern and are often adjacent to anaphoric phrases.
patterns.domain: Patent, medical, and physics academic text

2_1622.description: 所有段都包含对前文内容的回指表达，最一致的触发是 above-mentioned（可带连字符）；另有一次 above-described。其他零散激活无稳定共同模式。

patterns.name: above-mentioned 回指
patterns.context: 专利或学术文本中用来回指前文已介绍的对象、问题、方法或特征；在该组合中 mentioned 往往比 above 激活更强。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与说明、学术论文

patterns.name: above-described 回指
patterns.context: 专利文本中回指前文描述的方法；模式与 above-mentioned 同属回指表达，但具体动词为 described。

patterns.name: 相邻文字中的其他激活
patterns.context: 这些激活出现在若干技术语境中，但没有明显共同的局部触发模式，且多与回指短语相邻。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学与物理学术文本

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions in patent text that refer back to preceding content, especially combinations of above-/afore- with mentioned or described; also responds to paired references latter/former in code comments. Mathematical numeral-symbol segments remain unexplained.

patterns.name: Anaphoric phrases in patent text
patterns.context: Refers back to an object, problem, method, device, or functional group described earlier in a patent specification; often appears in standardized technical phrasing within or at the start of a sentence.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Relational reference in code
patterns.context: Compares multiple objects mentioned earlier in the same context and uses latter and former to disambiguate the references.

patterns.name: Isolated numeral and symbol sequences
patterns.context: No recognizable natural-language anaphoric structure; activations fall on mathematical data or formatted sequences.

2_1622.concept: 技术文本中的前文回指
2_1622.description: 主要响应专利文本中回指前文的表达，尤以 above-/afore- 与 mentioned、described 的组合为强；也响应代码注释中成对指代的 latter/former。数学数字符号段未能解释。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的回指短语
patterns.context: 在专利说明书中回指先前描述的对象、问题、方法、装置或官能团；多出现在句中或句首的规范化技术表述里。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景及技术说明

patterns.name: 代码中的关系指代
patterns.context: 比较同一语境中先前提及的多个对象，并用后者、前者消解指代。

patterns.name: 孤立的数字与符号序列
patterns.context: 没有可辨认的自然语言回指结构；激活落在数学数据或排版序列中。
patterns.domain: 数学语料、格式化数字文本

en.description: Most segments use above after preceding content to refer back to it and modify a noun; the remaining segments involve former/latter contrasts, the converse of a theorem, and evaluation of an endpoint in a medical context, without a clear shared trigger form.

patterns.name: Anaphoric use of above
patterns.context: After a problem, condition, formula, result, or goal has been introduced, above refers back to it; commonly paired with nouns such as mentioned, problems, objects, inequality, formulas, results, and object.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and technical descriptions, mathematics papers, formula annotations, medical papers, and Q&A text

patterns.name: former/latter contrast
patterns.context: Immediately compares two previously listed items, indicating that the latter covers or differs from the former.

patterns.name: Converse of a mathematical theorem
patterns.context: In mathematical discussion, a proposition is called the converse of a theorem, with discussion words such as proved and stated appearing near the theorem name.

patterns.name: appropriate endpoint collocation
patterns.context: Discusses which endpoint is most appropriate when measuring the MIC of antifungals; evaluative wording such as most useful also appears.

2_1622.description: 多数片段在前文内容之后用 above 回指并修饰名词；其余片段涉及 former/latter 对照、定理的 converse，以及医学语境中 endpoint 的评价，缺少共同的明确触发形式。

patterns.name: above 的回指用法
patterns.context: 在先前提出问题、条件、公式、结果或目标之后，用 above 回指前文；常与 mentioned、problems、objects、inequality、formulas、results、object 等名词连用。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与技术说明、数学论文、公式注释、医学论文及问答文本

patterns.name: former/latter 对照
patterns.context: 紧接着比较前文列出的两者，指出后者覆盖或区别于前者。

patterns.name: 数学定理的 converse
patterns.context: 数学论述中将命题称为某定理的逆向命题，并在定理名称附近出现 proved、stated 等论述词。

patterns.name: appropriate endpoint 搭配
patterns.context: 讨论 antifungals 的 MIC 测量时，评价何种 endpoint 最合适；同时出现 most useful 等评价措辞。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions in patent style that refer back to preceding content, such as “above-mentioned” or “above-described,” often before nouns such as problems, method, and element; the core trigger is often mentioned/described and may involve above and a hyphen.

patterns.name: Patent anaphora referring to preceding problems
patterns.context: In patent specifications, “above” in a compound expression is immediately followed by a hyphen and “mentioned” or “described”; it usually refers to a problem, feature, method, or element discussed earlier. Activations fall mainly on “mentioned” or “described,” and also include “above” and the hyphen.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and invention description

patterns.name: Synonymous form: above-described disadvantage
patterns.context: In the patent background construction “another method is proposed to solve the above-mentioned disadvantage,” described replaces mentioned and refers to a singular disadvantage.

2_1622.concept: 专利中的上述回指表达
2_1622.description: 主要响应专利文体中回指前文内容的“above-mentioned”或“above-described”表达，常见于 problems、method、element 等名词前；触发核心多为 mentioned/described，且可涉及 above 与连字符。

patterns.name: 专利回指前述问题
patterns.trigger: «above»«-»«mentioned»、«above»«-»«described»；常见完整子串为“the above-mentioned problems”“the above-described method/element”
patterns.context: 专利说明书中，复合表达中的“above”紧接连字符及“mentioned”或“described”；通常回指前文已讨论的问题、特征、方法或元件。激活主要落在“mentioned”或“described”上，也涵盖“above”及连字符。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景及发明说明

patterns.name: 近义形式：above-described disadvantage
patterns.context: 在“为解决上述缺点而提出另一方法”的专利背景句式中，以“described”替代“mentioned”，且回指单数缺点。

en.description: All segments activate on “above-mentioned” or a similar anaphoric expression in patent technical text, especially combinations of above with mentioned/described, referring to content stated earlier.

patterns.name: “above-mentioned” anaphora in patents
patterns.context: In USPTO background paragraphs, refers back to problems, features, disadvantages, goals, studies, or corrections already stated; common collocations include “the above-mentioned problems,” “the above-described disadvantage,” and “above-mentioned characteristics/OTP fuel incremental correction.”

2_1622.description: 所有段落都在专利技术文本中激活“above-mentioned”或近似回指表达，尤其是 above 与 mentioned/described 的组合，用来指向前文所述内容。

patterns.name: 专利中的“above-mentioned”回指
patterns.context: 在 USPTO 背景技术段落中，回指前文已经陈述的问题、特征、缺点、目标、研究或校正；常见搭配包括“the above-mentioned problems”“the above-described disadvantage”“above-mentioned characteristics/OTP fuel incremental correction”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术及技术说明文体

en.description: All segments activate on “following.” Its context is often the following plus a noun, indicating reasons, facts, items, or questions to be listed next; domains and styles vary.

patterns.name: following introducing subsequent text
patterns.context: Common in structures such as “the following reasons/facts/pages/property/questions”; the word is followed by a list, explanation, or body text, usually near a colon, and can also precede nouns such as pages.
patterns.domain: Formal or explanatory styles, including legal opinions, email notices, books, patent text, and educational questions

2_1622.description: 所有段都激活于“following”，其上下文多为 the following 加名词，表示即将列出理由、事实、项目或问题；领域和文体多样。

patterns.name: following引出后文
patterns.context: 常见于“the following reasons/facts/pages/property/questions”一类结构；该词后接列举、说明或正文内容，通常位于冒号附近，也可接 pages 等名词。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、邮件通知、书籍、专利文本、教育题目等正式或说明性文体

en.description: Primarily responds to “following” and the patent-style anaphoric phrase “above mentioned”; common contexts include introducing a subsequent list or question, describing something, or citing patent background. Years, patent templates, and legal expressions are weaker accompanying phenomena.

patterns.name: following trigger
patterns.context: Items such as reasons, questions, objects, or lists follow “the following”; the context is usually a sentence introducing subsequent content.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, company emails, patent specifications, and operations notices

patterns.name: Fixed phrase above-mentioned
patterns.context: Used in patent backgrounds or specifications to refer back to technology, objects, or problems already mentioned.

patterns.name: Numerical years and letter fragments
patterns.context: Appears near formatted text such as email dates or titles; in this group, its strength is lower than that of the core triggers and may be an incidental pattern.

patterns.name: Other introductory expressions in patent narrative
patterns.context: Patent text mentions the purpose of the invention, technical solutions, or references to prior applications; these share the patent-template context with above-mentioned but are not necessarily direct triggers.

patterns.name: Legal conclusion context
patterns.context: Opinions discuss the prosecution’s closing argument and the court’s ruling; these markers do not show the same stable pattern as the main phrase.

2_1622.concept: 文档中的前后文指引语
2_1622.description: 主要响应“following”和专利文体中的“above mentioned”回指短语；常见于引出后续清单、问题、描述或专利背景引用。年份、专利模板语和法律用语为较弱伴随现象。

patterns.name: following 触发词
patterns.context: “the following”之后将列出理由、问题、对象或清单；语境通常位于引出后续内容的句子中。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、公司邮件、专利说明书及运维通知

patterns.name: above-mentioned 固定短语
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中用来回指前文已提及的技术、对象或问题。

patterns.name: 数字年份与字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件日期或标题等格式化文本附近；本组中强度低于核心触发词，可能是附带模式。

patterns.name: 专利叙述中的其他引导语
patterns.context: 专利文本中出现发明目的、技术方案或对既有申请的引用；与 above-mentioned 同属专利模板语境，但未必是直接触发因素。

patterns.name: 法律结论语境
patterns.context: 判决中讨论检方闭庭陈述及法院裁决；这些标记并未显示与主要短语相同的稳定模式。

en.description: Strongly responds to reference and specification boilerplate in patent text, especially following introducing subsequent content, above-mentioned referring back, and present invention; also responds to following in legal and Q&A contexts.

patterns.name: following introducing subsequent text
patterns.context: Follows the definite article the and points to a description, expression, or reason given next; not limited to patent text
patterns.domain: Legal text, mathematical Q&A, patent specifications

patterns.name: above-mentioned anaphora
patterns.context: The hyphenated compound above-mentioned refers back to an object, problem, or study already mentioned; sometimes appears before a noun

patterns.name: present invention in patent boilerplate
patterns.context: Patent text uses the present invention to refer to the disclosed invention, often adjacent to statements of purpose, solutions, or advantages

patterns.name: Other patent boilerplate expressions
patterns.context: Fixed expressions in patent paragraphs concerning embodiments, technical fields, or persons skilled in the art; not fully explained by following, above-mentioned, or present invention

2_1622.description: 强烈响应专利文本中的指代与说明书惯用语，尤其是 following 引出后文、above-mentioned 回指前文，以及 present invention；也在法律和问答语境中响应 following。

patterns.name: following 引出下文
patterns.trigger: «following»10，常见于“the following [detailed] description”或“the following expression”
patterns.context: 位于定冠词 the 后，指向随后给出的描述、表达式或理由；并不局限于专利文本
patterns.domain: 法律、数学问答、专利说明书

patterns.name: above-mentioned 回指
patterns.context: 连字符复合词 above-mentioned 回指前文已提到的对象、问题或研究；有时出现在名词前

patterns.name: 专利说明书惯用语中的 present invention
patterns.context: 专利文本中以 the present invention 指称所披露的发明，常与目的、方案或优点陈述相邻

patterns.name: 其余专利惯用措辞
patterns.trigger: «These»1、“«the»1 «above»8 «mentioned»10”前后的技术性说明，以及“«skilled»2 in the «art»6”
patterns.context: 专利段落中有关实施例、技术领域或本领域技术人员的固定表达；无法由 following、above-mentioned 或 present invention 完全解释

en.description: All segments strongly activate on “following”: it points to subsequent content, such as reasons, expression, pages, variables, description, information, or questions. It occurs across domains and styles, and each local context contains subsequent content.

patterns.name: following introducing subsequent text
patterns.context: “following” directly modifies a noun denoting subsequent content or introduces items to be listed next; the noun may appear in the same sentence or on the next line.
patterns.domain: Formal styles including legal opinions, academic text, books, patents, business rules, and emails

2_1622.description: 所有段都在“following”处强激活：它指向后文内容，如 reasons、expression、pages、variables、description、information 或 questions。跨领域和文体出现，局部上下文均有后续内容。

patterns.name: following 引出后文
patterns.context: “following”直接修饰表示后续内容的名词，或引出接下来要列出的事项；名词可在同一句或下一行出现。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、学术文本、书籍、专利、商业规则与邮件等正式文体

en.description: Strongly responds to the following, especially when the phrase introduces subsequent reasons, variables, information, expressions, methods, pages, or detailed descriptions; may also respond to Q: and line-break formatting in Q&A posts.

patterns.name: following introducing subsequent content
patterns.context: The phrase is followed by reasons, variables, information, description, pages, expression, methods, term, and similar items, usually indicating content to be listed, explained, or presented next; in some samples following has the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: Legal text, papers, Q&A, patents, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Fixed legal expression following reasons
patterns.context: Opinions use this construction before stating the reasons for upholding a decision; following is scored 10 in segment 1 and 9 in segment 6.

patterns.name: questions heading and question format
patterns.context: Q&A posts use Q: to mark a question, followed by following pointing to code, an expression, a method, or a concept. The Q&A format may co-occur with the phrase following.

patterns.name: Listing variables and information
patterns.context: following introduces variables affected in a study or information required by rules.

patterns.name: Patent descriptive boilerplate
patterns.context: Patent text uses following to introduce a detailed description of an embodiment of the invention.

patterns.name: following pages
patterns.context: In general exposition, refers to several pages that come next; the surrounding context in this example also mentions reading related substances and their properties.

2_1622.description: 强烈响应 the following，尤其该短语用于引出后续理由、变量、信息、表达式、方法、页面或详细说明；还可能响应问答帖的 Q: 与换行格式。

patterns.name: following 引出下文内容
patterns.context: 短语后接 reasons、variables、information、description、pages、expression、methods、term 等，通常表示接下来列举、说明或展示的内容；部分样本中 following 激活强度最高。
patterns.domain: 法律、论文、问答、专利及一般说明文

patterns.name: following reasons 固定法律表述
patterns.context: 判决在说明维持裁决的理由前使用该句式；段 1 的 following 标为 10，段 6 为 9。

patterns.name: questions 标题与提问格式
patterns.trigger: “Q:” 后换行；以及 “What … the following?”, “Is there … the following expression?”, “Consider the following”, “term for the following”
patterns.context: 问答帖以 Q: 标记问题，随后用 following 指向代码、表达式、方法或概念。问答格式与 following 短语可能共同出现。

patterns.name: 列举变量与信息
patterns.context: following 后引出研究中受影响的变量或规则要求提供的信息。

patterns.name: 专利描述惯用语
patterns.context: 专利文本中以 following 引出对发明实施例的详细说明。

patterns.name: following pages
patterns.context: 一般论述中指接下来的若干页；该例中 surrounding context 还提到阅读相关物质及其性质。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical terms (especially disease or procedure names beginning with Muco-), cycle in medical titles, and specialized texts on cell transplantation, mass spectrometry, rehabilitation, muscle mechanics, and galaxy formation; no unified semantic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Abbreviated forms of Mucolipidosis III
patterns.context: A disease name beginning with Mucolipidosis and involving type II/III appears in a medical title; activation is concentrated on subword fragments of its spelling.

patterns.name: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma terminology
patterns.context: A tumor variant name begins with Mucoepidermoid and is followed by a descriptor such as variant.

patterns.name: Mucocutaneous ureterostomy terminology
patterns.context: Muco-cutaneous appears in a medical title, followed by a procedure name such as ureterostomy.

patterns.name: Cycle in medical titles
patterns.context: A title or abstract describes a biological process, experiment, or tissue cycle; here, these are the Krebs cycle and the cycle of the seminiferous epithelium.

patterns.name: Tissue cells and transplantation
patterns.context: Discusses heart failure, loss of cardiomyocytes, and transplantation of functional cells.

patterns.name: Precision mass spectrometry instrumentation terminology
patterns.context: Describes gas chromatography–combustion–isotope ratio mass spectrometry for stable isotope analysis and its sensitivity.

patterns.name: Rehabilitation needs and family members
patterns.context: The title focuses on the needs, priorities, and desired rehabilitation outcomes of family members of young stroke patients.

patterns.name: Muscle mechanics parameters
patterns.context: Explains cross-bridge parameters and muscle-fiber mechanical behavior, with examples of elastic response and rapid recovery.

patterns.name: Galaxy merger formation
patterns.context: Discusses massive galaxy formation, quenching, and dry mergers of existing red galaxies.

2_1746.description: 激活分散于医学术语（尤其若干以 Muco- 开头的病名/手术名）、医学标题中的 cycle，以及细胞移植、质谱、康复、肌肉力学和星系形成等专业文本；未见统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: Mucolipidosis III 缩写形态
patterns.context: 医学标题中出现以 Mucolipidosis 开头、涉及 II/III 型的病名；激活集中在分词拼写片段上。

patterns.name: 黏液表皮样癌术语
patterns.context: 肿瘤变体名称以 Mucoepidermoid 开头，后接 variant 等描述。

patterns.name: 黏膜皮肤造口术术语
patterns.context: 医学标题中出现 Muco-cutaneous，后接 ureterostomy 等手术名称。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的周期
patterns.context: 标题或摘要中描述生物过程、实验或组织周期；此处分别为 Krebs cycle 与 seminiferous epithelium 的 cycle。

patterns.name: 组织细胞与移植
patterns.trigger: «transplantation»3 of «functional» and «healthy cardiac» cells；«death» of «cardiac» cells
patterns.context: 讨论心衰、心肌细胞损失及功能细胞移植。

patterns.name: 精密质谱仪器术语
patterns.context: 描述稳定同位素分析的气相色谱—燃烧—同位素比质谱技术及其灵敏度。

patterns.name: 康复需求与家庭成员
patterns.context: 标题关注年轻卒中患者家庭成员的需求、优先事项及期望康复结果。

patterns.name: 肌肉力学参数
patterns.context: 解释交桥参数与肌纤维机械行为，举例说明弹性响应和快速恢复。

patterns.name: 星系并合形成
patterns.context: 讨论大质量星系形成、淬火及既有红色星系的干并合。

en.description: Activations are distributed across varied medical and related text fragments: terms beginning with Muc/Muc(o), titles about metabolism and cycles, isotope analysis techniques, the abbreviation AL or the string ALASKA, and members in a rehabilitation context; no shared trigger condition covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Mucolipidosis naming fragment
patterns.context: A disease name in medical text is split into subword fragments, followed by a type or other clinical description.

patterns.name: Medical terms beginning with Muc(o)-
patterns.context: Appears at the start of medical terms; followed respectively by the histological term “epidermoid” and the procedural term “cutaneous ureterostomy,” not necessarily forming a complete muco- word.

patterns.name: Metabolism and biochemical title terms
patterns.context: A title discusses liver metabolism or activity in the Krebs cycle.

patterns.name: Morphological patterns and cycle-related terms
patterns.context: A title describes morphological responses following drug treatment, changes in cell associations, and an epithelial cycle.

patterns.name: Isotope analysis technique fragment
patterns.context: Describes 13C-labeled compounds and high-precision gas chromatography–combustion–isotope ratio mass spectrometry.

patterns.name: Uppercase ALCO/RSC strings
patterns.context: An isolated uppercase abbreviation or code-like string is followed by a line break and the beginning of body text; context is insufficient to determine its meaning.

patterns.name: AL amyloidosis terminology
patterns.context: AL modifies amyloidosis, followed by a description related to B-cell lymphoma.

patterns.name: ALASKA Medicaid string
patterns.context: The uppercase regional or program name ALASKA is concatenated with MEDICAID, resembling a beneficiary category label.

patterns.name: Family members term
patterns.context: Refers to family members of young adult patients in a stroke rehabilitation context.

2_1746.description: 激活分布在医学及相关文本的多种片段：含Muc/Muc(o)开头术语、代谢与周期标题、同位素分析技术、AL缩写或ALASKA字符串，以及康复语境的members；未见能覆盖全部片段的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: Mucolipidosis 命名片段
patterns.context: 医学文本中疾病名称被分词切开的片段，后接分型或其他临床描述。

patterns.name: Muc(o)-开头的医学术语
patterns.context: 出现在医学术语开头；分别接肿瘤组织学词尾“epidermoid”和手术术语“cutaneous ureterostomy”，不一定构成完整的 muco- 词。

patterns.name: 代谢与生化标题词
patterns.context: 标题讨论肝脏代谢或 Krebs cycle 的活动。

patterns.name: 形态模式与周期相关词
patterns.context: 标题描述药物处理后的形态反应、细胞关联变化及上皮周期。

patterns.name: 同位素分析技术片段
patterns.context: 描述 13C 标记化合物及高精度气相色谱—燃烧—同位素比质谱技术。
patterns.domain: 分析化学、生物医学方法

patterns.name: 大写 ALCO/RSC 字符串
patterns.context: 孤立的大写缩写或代码式字符串，后接换行和正文开头；上下文不足以确定含义。

patterns.name: AL amyloidosis 术语
patterns.context: AL 修饰 amyloidosis，后接与 B 细胞淋巴瘤相关的描述。

patterns.name: ALASKA 医疗补助字符串
patterns.context: 大写地域或项目名称 ALASKA 与 MEDICAID 连写，类似受益人类别标签。

patterns.name: 家庭成员词
patterns.context: 在卒中康复语境中指年轻成人患者的家庭成员。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on “Control of/over” and, more broadly, “of” constructions in title-like text; trigger terms span multiple disciplines and also occur in titles about diseases, morphology, research progress, institution names, and genetic associations.

patterns.name: Control of in titles
patterns.context: A title or title-like phrase begins with “Control of …”; followed by the research subject, such as tumor, organelle size, or spin angular momentum.
patterns.domain: Paper titles in biomedicine, physics, and other fields

patterns.name: Control over in titles
patterns.context: A title-like phrase begins with “Control over …”, followed by a process or object.

patterns.name: of phrases in titles
patterns.context: A title or title-like phrase contains of, linking a research topic, subject, or associated entities; Control need not precede it.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, abstract titles, and institution names

2_1746.concept: 标题中的 of 结构
2_1746.description: 激活主要集中于标题式文本中的“Control of/over”以及较广泛的标题“of”结构；触发词覆盖多个学科，也见于疾病、形态、研究进展、机构名和遗传关联标题。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Control of
patterns.context: 标题或标题式短语以“Control of …”开头；后接研究对象，如 tumor、organelle size、spin angular momentum。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、物理学等论文标题

patterns.name: 标题中的 Control over
patterns.context: 标题式短语以“Control over …”开头，后接过程或对象。

patterns.name: 标题中的 of 短语
patterns.context: 标题或标题式短语中出现 of，连接研究主题、对象或关联双方；不要求前面有 Control。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要标题及机构名称

en.description: The most consistent signal is the “ifer” fragment occurring across words; there is also one “multip” fragment, a Control over phrase, and sporadic high-response words in patent technical text, with the latter categories difficult to group together.

patterns.name: “ifer” subword fragment
patterns.context: The fragment is embedded in different words; visible full forms include cruciferous, coniferous, proliferative, Leifer, and the mathematician’s name Soifer.
patterns.domain: Biology, mathematics, names, and general text

patterns.name: “multip” subword fragment
patterns.context: Appears in Python extension module registration code.

patterns.name: “Control over” phrase
patterns.context: A sentence-initial phrase followed by control over silica nanoshell permeability.

patterns.name: Sporadic high-response words in technical text
patterns.context: Appear respectively in descriptions of an electron-beam magnetic field, optical communications circuit precision, and groundwater accessibility; there is no shared local syntactic or semantic trigger pattern.

2_1746.concept: ifer 字符片段及零散模式
2_1746.description: 最稳定的线索是跨词出现的“ifer”片段；另有一次“multip”片段、Control over 短语及专利技术文本中的零散高响应词，后几类难以归并。

patterns.name: “ifer”词片段
patterns.context: 词片段嵌在不同词中；部分可见完整词形为 cruciferous、coniferous、proliferative、Leifer，另有数学人名 Soifer。
patterns.domain: 生物学、数学、人名及一般文本

patterns.name: “multip”词片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 扩展模块注册代码中。

patterns.name: “Control over”短语
patterns.context: 句首短语，后接对二氧化硅纳米壳渗透的控制。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的零散高响应词
patterns.context: 分别出现在电子束磁场描述、光通信电路精度描述及地下水可及性描述中；缺乏共同的局部句法或语义触发模式。

en.description: In all fragments, Thus introduces an inference, conclusion, or subsequent explanation in formal scientific and technical text across different fields; the domains and specific content vary, but the activation pattern is consistent.

patterns.name: Inter-sentence causal or inferential marker
patterns.context: The preceding text presents research results, a problem, an observation, or technical background, followed by “Thus” introducing a conclusion, inference, proposal, or subsequent explanation; activation is concentrated on the word itself.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper abstracts, research reports, and patent background descriptions

2_1746.description: 所有片段均在不同领域的正式科技文本中，以 Thus 引出前文的推论、结论或后续说明；领域和具体内容各异，激活模式一致。

patterns.name: 句间因果或推论标记
patterns.context: 前文陈述研究结果、问题、观察或技术背景，随后用“Thus”引出结论、推论、方案或后续说明；激活集中在该词本身。
patterns.domain: 科学论文摘要、研究报告及专利背景说明

en.description: All fragments use “Thus,” after providing supporting context to introduce a conclusion or subsequent discussion; topics and styles differ, but the core trigger form is consistent.

patterns.name: Inference in scientific discourse
patterns.context: The preceding text presents research results, mechanisms, clinical background, or a problem, followed by “Thus,” introducing an inference, research significance, or next step; activation is concentrated on Thus.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project texts

patterns.name: Introducing a conclusion in legal argument
patterns.context: The preceding text cites precedent, rules of evidence, or court conduct, followed by “Thus,” introducing a legal conclusion or subsequent judgment.

patterns.name: Introducing an inference in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: The preceding text describes material, structural, or process features, followed by “Thus,” introducing a technical explanation derived from those features.

2_1746.description: 所有片段都在前文提供依据后以“Thus,”引出结论或后续论述；主题和文体不同，核心触发形式一致。

patterns.name: 科学论述中的推论转折
patterns.context: 前文陈述研究结果、机制、临床背景或问题，随后以“Thus,”引出推论、研究意义或下一步内容；激活集中在 Thus。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 法律论证中的结论引出
patterns.context: 前文援引判例、证据规则或法院行为，随后用“Thus,”引出法律结论或下文判断。

patterns.name: 专利技术说明中的推论引出
patterns.context: 前文描述材料、结构或工艺特征，随后用“Thus,”引出由这些特征导出的技术说明。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the letter sequence “ange,” often embedded in words such as arrange, range, Llangefni, and phalangeal; there are also sporadic activations on per-related letter fragments and on numbers, punctuation, and line breaks, with weaker regularity in the latter.

patterns.name: Letter sequence containing “ange”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the continuous English or proper-name subword ange; its position varies across contexts, and it is often embedded within a longer word or name.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including web copy, code comments, Wikipedia, email, biomedical text, and patents; covers nearly all fragments.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal “per”-related fragment
patterns.context: Not a stable standalone word trigger; may be adjacent to the ange pattern or occur in the same long word, but the activation positions in fragments 4, 7, and 10 are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Email, biomedical papers, and patent text.

patterns.name: Sporadic letter and number/punctuation activations
patterns.context: Weak activations occur near table values, hyphens, and line breaks, with no consistent contextual condition across fragments; these may be incidental or secondary features.
patterns.domain: Tables, formatted text, and text containing chemical formulas or identifiers.

2_1746.description: 主要对字母序列“ange”敏感，常嵌在 arrange、range、Llangefni、phalangeal 等词中；另有零散的 per 相关字母片段及数字、标点、换行激活，后者规律较弱。

patterns.name: 含“ange”的字母序列
patterns.context: 激活落在英文或专名中连续的字母子串 ange 上；在不同上下文中位置可变，常嵌在较长单词或名称内部。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，包括网页文案、代码注释、维基百科、邮件、生物医学文本和专利；覆盖几乎所有片段。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内“per”相关片段
patterns.context: 并非稳定的独立词触发；可能与 ange 模式相邻或同处长词，但片段4、7、10中的激活位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 邮件、生物医学论文及专利文本。

patterns.name: 零散字母与数字/标点激活
patterns.context: 表格数值、连字符和换行附近出现弱激活，缺乏跨片段一致的上下文条件；可能是偶然或次级特征。
patterns.domain: 表格、格式化文本及含化学式或编号的文本。

en.concept: Introducing supplementary content or an entry
en.description: Most passages use noting after a comma to introduce a supplementary explanation; elsewhere, writing describes creative work, Add indicates a code change, and With begins a track title. These do not have a clear shared semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Introducing supplementary explanation in reporting or narrative
patterns.context: After a main-clause statement, quotation, or argument, the subword noting introduces a related explanation, observation, reason, or subsequent finding; it often follows a comma and can take a that-clause or directly precede a noun phrase.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, email, legal texts, and literary narrative

patterns.name: Writing verb and its collocations
patterns.context: Describes a person writing or creating scripts; the same passage also contains related forms such as writes and writing comics/scripts, but the strong activation is on writing.

patterns.name: Added feature term in a code comment
patterns.context: Appears in a source-code commit note describing the addition of an option to mysqlbinlog; activation is on Add, not the surrounding file path or code markers.

patterns.name: Preposition With in an album track list
patterns.context: Appears in a music album or work listing, beginning a track or collaborative work title; nearby are several parenthetical label and year details.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic music catalogs, record track lists

2_1746.description: 多数段落在逗号后用 noting 引出补充说明；另有 writing 描述创作、Add 表示代码变更，以及曲目标题开头的 With，三者缺乏明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 报道或叙述中引出补充说明
patterns.context: 在主句陈述、引语或论证之后，分词 noting 引出相关说明、观察、理由或随后的发现；常紧邻逗号，也可接 that 从句或直接接名词短语。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、邮件、法律文本及文学叙述

patterns.name: 写作动作词及其搭配
patterns.context: 描述人物从事写作或创作脚本；同段还出现 writes、writing comics/scripts 等相关形式，但强激活标记落在 writing。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、漫画创作介绍

patterns.name: 代码注释中的新增功能词
patterns.context: 位于源码提交说明的注释中，描述为 mysqlbinlog 增加一个选项；激活落在 Add，而非周围文件路径或代码标记。
patterns.domain: GitHub 提交说明、软件开发

patterns.name: 专辑曲目列表中的介词 With
patterns.context: 出现在音乐专辑/作品列表中，作为曲目或合作作品标题的开头；邻近多条括号内的厂牌与年份信息。
patterns.domain: 百科音乐目录、唱片曲目列表

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the present participle focusing when it introduces a topic, object, or scope, across academic, encyclopedic, review, and news text; it also responds to emphasizing in political contexts and to one line-break marker in book dedication formatting.

patterns.name: Present participle focusing introduces the discussion focus
patterns.context: In a sentence or clause, focusing introduces the focus, object, topic, or scope described next; it is often followed by on, but no particular domain is required.
patterns.domain: Expository writing, reviews, academic abstracts, encyclopedias, and news reports

patterns.name: Emphasizing a policy position or capability
patterns.context: Emphasizing introduces a policy orientation, capability, or priority being highlighted; all instances here relate to political figures or public policy.

patterns.name: Supplementary explanation or continuation in a paragraph
patterns.context: A line-break marker occurs at a paragraph boundary or in text layout; the paragraph also contains names, abbreviations, and dedication formatting, so it is unclear whether the line-break marker is an independent trigger.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book front matter, dedications, and formatted text

2_1746.concept: 引出关注重点的分词表达
2_1746.description: 主要对 focusing 这一现在分词引出的主题、对象或范围说明起强反应，跨学术、百科、评论和新闻文本；另对政治语境中的 emphasizing 有反应，并有一例书籍献词排版中的换行标记。

patterns.name: 现在分词 focusing 引出讨论重点
patterns.trigger: «focusing»10；前文常有 discuss、proposal、review、research 或 examines 等表示讨论/研究的词
patterns.context: 在句中或分句中以 focusing 引出接下来说明的重点、对象、主题或范围；其后常接 on，但不要求固定领域
patterns.domain: 说明文、评论、学术摘要、百科与新闻报道

patterns.name: 强调政策立场或能力
patterns.context: 以 emphasizing 引出被强调的政策取向、能力或优先事项；此处均与政治人物或公共政策相关

patterns.name: 段落中的附带说明或续接
patterns.context: 换行标记出现在段落边界或文本排版位置；该段另有名字、缩写和献词格式，无法确定换行标记是否是独立触发因素
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍前置页、献词与排版文本

en.concept: focusing word form and name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “focusing” when it introduces the object of attention in a sentence, across reviews, academic writing, and institutional profiles; three other instances activate on the fragments “ude,” “ole,” and “adding” within names, with no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: focusing and its continuation
patterns.context: A sentence uses focusing to introduce the object of discussion, research, attention, or activity; the subject before it is often a review, researcher, organization, or author.
patterns.domain: Reviews, academic papers, researcher profiles, organization descriptions, and other styles

patterns.name: Specific letter sequences in names
patterns.context: Some triggers are embedded in proper names rather than standalone syntactic words; the surrounding text is respectively a dedication list and a lawyer’s name.
patterns.domain: Book title page/dedication; lawyer listing in a legal judgment

patterns.name: Name fragment in a table
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is embedded in a person’s name in a table entry, near the location “WA” and a description of local youth.

2_1746.description: 主要对句中引出关注对象的“focusing”强烈响应，跨评论、学术与机构介绍；另有三例对姓名内部的“ude”“ole”“adding”片段激活，缺乏明显共同语义。

patterns.name: focusing 及其续接内容
patterns.trigger: «focusing»（含大小写变体时亦见“Focusing”）；后接宾语、介词短语或副词，如“focusing the blame”“focusing further on”“focusing on”“focusing initially on”“focusing in particular on”
patterns.context: 句中以 focusing 引出讨论、研究、注意力或活动所针对的对象；前面常有 review、研究者、组织、作者等主语。
patterns.domain: 评论、学术论文、研究者简介、组织介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 姓名中的特定字母序列
patterns.context: 触发部分嵌在专名中，并非句法上的独立词；周围分别是献词名单和律师姓名。
patterns.domain: 书籍扉页/献词；法律判决中的律师署名

patterns.name: 表格中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在表格条目的人名中，附近是地点“WA”及对当地青年的说明。

en.concept: Partial dependencies and morphological subword fragments
en.description: Activations concentrate on relying in legal arguments and focusing in descriptions of research or activities; there are also local responses to Claude/ude fragments within names and the suffix ism in patriotism, along with several sporadic short words and punctuation activations.

patterns.name: focusing followed by a research object or topic
patterns.context: Appears in clauses describing research, reviews, or organizational activities, followed by a research topic, factor, or activity area
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, medical research, institutional descriptions, and encyclopedic prose

patterns.name: relying followed by a legal basis
patterns.context: In legal arguments, a court or party relies on precedents, rulings, or other legal authority

patterns.name: Subword fragment of the Claude syllable in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in a given name or surname; the highlighted characters are a fragment within the name, not an independent word
patterns.domain: Book credits, names, and email recipient lists

patterns.name: Word ending in patriotism
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the word patriotism in a sentence discussing patriotic motives

patterns.name: Miscellaneous short words and punctuation
patterns.context: Distributed across narratives, the body of judicial opinions, and paragraph or sentence boundaries, with no shared local semantic condition

2_1746.concept: 部分依赖关系与词形片段
2_1746.description: 激活集中于法律论证中的 relying、研究或活动说明中的 focusing；另对姓名内部 Claude/ude 片段及 patriotism 的词尾 ism 有局部反应，也出现若干分散短词与标点激活。

patterns.name: focusing 后接研究对象或主题
patterns.context: 出现在说明研究、综述或组织活动内容的分句中，后接研究主题、因素或活动方向
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、医学研究、机构介绍及百科叙述

patterns.name: relying 后接法律依据
patterns.context: 法律论证中，法院或当事人依据判例、裁决或其他法律权威

patterns.name: 专名中 Claude 音节的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或姓氏中；高亮的是名称内部的字符片段，不是独立词
patterns.domain: 书籍署名、人名及邮件收件人列表

patterns.name: patriotism 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 patriotism 一词末尾，句子讨论爱国主义动机
patterns.domain: 旅行叙述与宗教/社会议题

patterns.name: miscellaneous 短词与标点
patterns.context: 分布于叙述、判决正文、段落或句子边界，缺少共同的局部语义条件

en.description: Activations are distributed across local fragments such as considering, and so, and Mad-ole, as well as quotations, punctuation, and numbering in legal documents; sporadic subword fragments also occur in code, biomedicine, paper abbreviations, and prose, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Participial supplement after considering
patterns.context: “considering” introduces an additional consideration about one’s own experience or an object, followed by a noun phrase
patterns.domain: Travel/personal narratives; computer vision research papers

patterns.name: Mad(e)ole surname fragment
patterns.context: An internal subword fragment of the name Mad-ole, appearing in litigation attorney lists or email contact lists

patterns.name: Fixed expression so on
patterns.context: “and so” indicates continuation of a list or an inferred result; the two examples have different grammatical functions

patterns.name: Sporadic markers in legal citations and litigation language
patterns.context: Near citations, arguments, or circuit court abbreviations in legal opinions; activations fall on ordinary legal words and citation characters

patterns.name: Numbers/symbols in numbering or annotations
patterns.context: Near court docket numbers, dates, citations, or line-break markers, without a unified semantic condition

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments and technical abbreviations
patterns.context: Activations cover local fragments in code variables, type declarations, biomedical sequence abbreviations, and algorithm abbreviations, with no shared lexical or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A; biomedical papers; machine learning papers

patterns.name: Sporadic common words and fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Distributed across religious/travel narratives, entomological prose, and contact names, without a consistent trigger condition

2_1746.description: 激活分散于 considering、and so、Mad-ole 等局部片段，以及法律文书中的引文、标点和编号；另见代码、生物医学、论文缩写与散文中的零散词片段，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: considering 后的分词补充语
patterns.trigger: «considering»10 my own life history；«considering»8 a pair of images
patterns.context: “considering”引出对自身经历或某对象的补充考量，后接名词短语
patterns.domain: 游记/个人叙述；计算机视觉研究论文

patterns.name: Mad(e)ole 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名 Mad-ole 的内部子词片段，出现在诉讼律师名单或邮件联系人名单中

patterns.name: so on 固定表达
patterns.context: “and so”表示列举延续或推导结果；两例语法作用不同

patterns.name: 法律引文与诉讼语句中的零散标记
patterns.context: 法律判决引文、论证或巡回法院缩写附近；激活落在普通法律词及引文字符上

patterns.name: 编号或标注中的数字/符号
patterns.context: 法院案号、日期、引文或换行标记附近，未显示统一语义条件

patterns.name: 特定子词片段与技术缩写
patterns.context: 激活覆盖代码变量、类型声明、生物医学序列缩写和算法缩写中的局部片段，缺少共同的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 编程问答；生物医学论文；机器学习论文

patterns.name: 零散普通词与专名内部片段
patterns.context: 分散出现在宗教/旅行叙述、昆虫学叙述及联系人姓名中，未形成一致触发条件

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and connective expressions
en.description: Activations are distributed across connectives, legal phrasing, narrative expressions, and subword fragments within various words; there is no single stable semantic theme. And, relying, and as each recur locally, while most others are isolated examples.

patterns.name: Additive connective “And”
patterns.context: And introduces an addition, subsequent event, or consideration mid-sentence or at the beginning of a new sentence; common in narrative text.
patterns.domain: Travel writing, narratives, and general descriptions

patterns.name: Participial relying
patterns.context: In legal arguments, indicates reliance on prior case law, often followed by upon.

patterns.name: Split fragments in compound words
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple subwords, activation falls on an internal fragment; examples occur in terms, names, or scale names.

patterns.name: as in narratives
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed/narrative constructions such as “as luck would have it” or “as the day … comes up”.

patterns.name: Basis language in legal citations
patterns.context: States that an administrative decision must be based on an appropriate legal standard; co-occurs with the connectives Thus and even.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper names or classifications
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments of proper or institutional names in classification lists.

patterns.name: Name fragment Keith
patterns.context: A particular person is introduced with most notably in a cast list.

patterns.name: Film/TV character name fragment
patterns.context: A character’s name appears in a paragraph introducing the character and performer.

patterns.name: Place-name fragment Bahia/Baja
patterns.context: A Mexican coastal place name appears in travel descriptions.

patterns.name: Number and ordinal fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within numbers, years, or court citation numbers; no consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, academic references, category lists

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different syntactic environment, and current examples are insufficient to group them under a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Travel writing, law, encyclopedias, medicine, and other fields

2_1746.concept: 异质词片段与连接表达
2_1746.description: 激活分散在连接词、法律措辞、叙事表达及多种词内子词片段；没有单一稳定语义主题。And、relying、as各有局部重复，其余多为孤例。

patterns.name: 转折补充连接词“And”
patterns.context: 句中或新句开头用 And 引入补充、后续事件或考虑；常见于叙述性文本。

patterns.name: 分词 relying
patterns.context: 法律论证中说明裁判依据先前判例，常接 upon。

patterns.name: 复合词中的切分片段
patterns.context: 词被分成多个子词时，激活落在词内片段；分别出现在术语、姓名或量表名称中。
patterns.domain: 学术参考文献、医学摘要

patterns.name: 叙事中的 as
patterns.context: “as luck would have it”或“as the day … comes up”等固定/叙事结构中。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的依据措辞
patterns.context: 说明行政决定需基于适当法律标准；与连接词 Thus、even 同现。

patterns.name: 专名或分类中的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或机构名的内部子词片段，所在文本为分类列表。

patterns.name: 人名片段 Keith
patterns.context: 演员名单中以 most notably 引出特定人物。

patterns.name: 电影/电视人物名片段
patterns.context: 介绍角色及扮演者的段落中出现人物名字。

patterns.name: 地名片段 Bahia/Baja
patterns.context: 旅行描写中出现墨西哥海岸地名。

patterns.name: 数字及序数片段
patterns.context: 数字、年份或法庭引文编号内部的子词片段；没有一致语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、学术参考文献、分类列表

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各自在不同句法环境中出现，现有样本不足以归为同一触发条件。

en.description: All examples show strong activation at “In other words,” followed by a rephrasing or inference from the preceding text, across multiple domains and genres; a few markers elsewhere lack a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Rephrasing marker “In other words”
patterns.context: The preceding text provides an explanation, data, or argument, followed by this phrase introducing a summary, clarification, or inference; this is the most stable and broadly represented trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory prose, patent backgrounds, popular science, and web text

patterns.name: Summary or clarification across domains
patterns.context: A condensation, explanation, or inference from the preceding text follows the rephrasing marker; the activation token itself is “words” in the phrase, not the subsequent content.
patterns.domain: Explanatory texts on medicine, social media terms, trademarks, engineering, business, and research funding

patterns.name: Lexical triggers outside rephrasing positions
patterns.context: These tokens occur elsewhere in context and may reflect weak co-activation, incidental triggers, or contextual effects; examples are insufficient to support a unified independent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains, including academic citations, legal/patent text, and general explanatory prose

2_1746.concept: 改述引导短语“In other words”
2_1746.description: 所有样本均在“In other words”处强激活，后接对前文的改述或推论，跨越多种领域与文体；少量其他位置的标记词缺乏一致模式。

patterns.name: “In other words”改述标记
patterns.context: 前文先给出说明、数据或论述，随后用该短语引出总结、释义或推论；这是最稳定、覆盖面最广的触发模式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明性 prose、专利背景、科普及网络文本

patterns.name: 跨领域的总结或释义内容
patterns.trigger: 短语之后的“over the five-year span”“a gynaecologist in Gur”“trademarks serve to identify”“the related-art cooling method cannot”等
patterns.context: 改述标记后紧接对前文的压缩、解释或推论；激活 token 本身是短语中的“words”，而非这些后续内容。
patterns.domain: 医学、社交媒体条款、商标、工程、商业和科研资助等说明文本

patterns.name: 文中非改述位置的词汇触发
patterns.context: 这些 token 位于上下文其他位置，可能属于弱共激活、偶然触发或上下文效应；现有例子不足以支持统一的独立语义条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域；含学术引文、法律/专利及一般说明文本

en.description: All fragments show their strongest activation at “In other words,” involving explanation, rephrasing, or inference from preceding text; a few fragments also activate on words signaling contrast, exceptions, emphasis, or a new argument, as well as a line-break formatting signal in legal text.

patterns.name: Summary introduced by “In other words”
patterns.context: The phrase appears at the end of the context, followed by an explanation, rephrasing, or inference from the preceding text; it is the strongest trigger shared by all fragments.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal, social media terms, medical, research, patent, and commentary

patterns.name: Inferential connective in legal arguments
patterns.context: In a legal opinion, introduces the question the court will consider next after citing precedent.

patterns.name: Explanatory connective meaning
patterns.context: Introduces an explanation of the previously mentioned policy consequences in commentary.

patterns.name: Emphatic adverbs especially / particularly
patterns.context: Emphasize a particular circumstance or reason when describing falling costs and cautious corporate attitudes.

patterns.name: Contrast and concession word but
patterns.context: First acknowledges a limitation, then explains that it is controlled or mitigated.

patterns.name: Additional qualification except that
patterns.context: States an exception to a general rule in terms of service and explains what users can control.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Now introducing a new claim
patterns.context: Introduces a new policy claim in an opinion piece.

patterns.name: Formatting line break
patterns.context: Activation appears near a line-break marker in paragraph or footnote formatting in legal text; it may co-occur with the paragraph format containing “and so”.

2_1746.description: 所有片段都在“In other words”处出现最强激活，涉及前文的解释、改述或推论；少数片段还激活转折、例外、强调或引入新论点的词，另有法律文本换行格式信号。

patterns.name: “In other words”引述总结
patterns.context: 该短语出现在上下文末尾，后接对前文的解释、改述或推论；是所有片段共有的最强触发。
patterns.domain: 法律、社交媒体条款、医学、科研、专利及评论等多种文体

patterns.name: 法律论证中的推论连接
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，在援引先例后引出法院接下来要判断的问题。

patterns.name: 解释性连接词 meaning
patterns.context: 评论性论述中引出对前述政策后果的说明。

patterns.name: 强调性副词 especially / particularly
patterns.context: 描述成本下降及企业谨慎态度时，用于强调特定情形或原因。

patterns.name: 转折与让步词 but
patterns.context: 先承认存在限制，再转述限制受到控制或缓解。

patterns.name: 补充限定 except that
patterns.context: 服务条款中说明一般规则的例外，并交代用户可控制的事项。

patterns.name: 句首 Now 引出新主张
patterns.context: 评论文章中引入一项新的政策主张。

patterns.name: 格式性换行符
patterns.context: 法律文本的段落或脚注排版中，换行标记附近出现激活；可能与“and so”所在段落格式共同出现。

en.concept: Mixture of local subword fragments and common structures
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of local cues: M-initial word fragments, an internal fragment of the Xerox brand, pronouns and connectives, code indentation/return, numeric commas, and fragments within names; there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Continuation fragment after token “M”
patterns.context: An uppercase M occurs at the beginning or within a word, with the following word fragment marked; sometimes embedded in a code variable.

patterns.name: “Xer” within a brand name
patterns.context: The brand name Xerox appears in explanatory, historical, or legal narratives, with activation concentrated on the internal fragment “er”.

patterns.name: “you” and following collocations
patterns.context: The pronoun you recurs in an informal comic review addressed to readers.

patterns.name: Capitalized “And” and coordination
patterns.context: Connects adjacent clauses in narratives or legal documents.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Appears in name lists, with activation on internal character fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Code indentation and return statements
patterns.context: Indented code and function return statements in JavaScript object configurations.

patterns.name: Comma after a number
patterns.context: Punctuation in numbers, dates, or chemical formulas; fragment [2] also contains an unmarked comma.

patterns.name: Determiners/demonstratives and general connectives
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in ordinary prose, without a consistent local structure.

2_1746.concept: 局部词片段与常见结构混合
2_1746.description: 激活分散在多类局部线索：M开头词片段、Xerox品牌内部片段、代词与连接词、代码缩进/return、数字逗号及人名内部片段；没有单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: token“M”的续词片段
patterns.context: 词首或词内出现大写 M，后续词片段被标记；有时夹在代码变量中。

patterns.name: 品牌名中的“Xer”
patterns.context: 品牌名 Xerox 出现在说明、历史或法律叙述中，激活集中在词内片段“er”。
patterns.domain: 百科、科技评论、法律文书

patterns.name: “you”及后续搭配
patterns.trigger: “you”与“pick”“care”等邻近词；另有普通连接词“and”
patterns.context: 面向读者的口语化漫画评论，代词 you 重复出现。

patterns.name: 大写“And”与并列衔接
patterns.context: 在叙述或法律文书中连接前后分句。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名列表中，激活落在专名的内部字符片段。

patterns.name: 代码缩进与返回语句
patterns.context: JavaScript 对象配置中的缩进代码与函数返回语句。

patterns.name: 数字后的逗号
patterns.context: 数字、日期或化学式中的标点；片段[2]另有逗号但未标记。

patterns.name: 限定词/指示词与通用连接词
patterns.context: 在普通叙述中零散出现，缺少一致的局部结构。

en.concept: Fragments within specific words and code fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the “er” fragment in the name Xerox, including the company, products, and PARC; also responds to “raw” in McGraw-Hill and activates on indentation, return, and bitwise-operation-related fragments in two code passages.

patterns.name: Xerox name and brand contexts
patterns.context: When the text mentions Xerox Corporation, products, copiers, or its research institute; includes the brand name and part of a proper name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news discussions, legal documents, medical project descriptions

patterns.name: Internal fragment of McGraw-Hill
patterns.context: Appears in references, publisher names, or email sender names.

patterns.name: Specific syntax fragments in code
patterns.context: Indentation and keywords in a JavaScript configuration object, or bitwise operations/variable comments in assembly code; no clear connection to Xerox or McGraw-Hill names.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, Github assembly code

2_1746.concept: 特定词内部片段及代码片段
2_1746.description: 主要响应 Xerox 名称中的“er”片段，涵盖公司、产品及 PARC；也响应 McGraw-Hill 中的“raw”，并在两段代码里激活于缩进、return 和位运算相关片段。

patterns.name: Xerox 名称及品牌语境
patterns.context: 在文中提及 Xerox 公司、产品、复印机或其研究机构时；包括品牌名与专名的一部分。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻讨论、法律文书、医学项目描述

patterns.name: McGraw-Hill 名称内部
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献、出版社名称或邮件发件人姓名中。
patterns.domain: 百科参考文献、专利背景、邮件

patterns.name: 代码中的特定语法片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 配置对象中的缩进、关键字，或汇编代码中的位运算/变量注释；与 Xerox、McGraw-Hill 名称无明显关联。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、Github 汇编代码

en.description: Activations fall on varied local strings: er in Xerox, fragments within Russian words, several common English words, code indentation and internal word fragments, as well as parentheses and numbers. No unified semantics or stable contextual condition is evident across corpora.

patterns.name: Token fragment in the Xerox string
patterns.context: Appears in the brand name Xerox/Xerox’s, with unmarked “ox” following the fragment; [1] also contains “X«er»10ox” and discussion of the brand name.
patterns.domain: Brands, legal text, and technology commentary

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: Activation is embedded in Russian words: “имярек” and “ли” in [3], and “ли” in [9]; these are not the same word or clearly semantically related.

patterns.name: Fragments in specific English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on common English words or short words, distributed across narrative, book review, and research prose, with no shared meaning or stable syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, book reviews, academic prose

patterns.name: Code indentation and whitespace
patterns.context: In JavaScript object code, activation is on leading spaces at different indentation levels; the same passage also activates on the code word “return” and “em” in “mnemonic”.

patterns.name: Parentheses and numeric characters
patterns.context: In a legal sentence, parentheses enclose the number 2, and three adjacent characters are each marked as activated.

2_1746.description: 激活落在多种局部字符串上：Xerox 中的 er、俄语词内片段、若干普通英语词、代码缩进与词内片段，以及括号和数字。跨语料未见统一语义或稳定上下文条件。

patterns.name: Xerox 字符串中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在品牌名 Xerox/Xerox’s 中，片段后接未标记的“ox”；[1] 还出现“X«er»10ox”及品牌名讨论。
patterns.domain: 品牌、法律文本及科技评论

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活嵌在俄语单词中：[3] 的“имярек”及“ли”，[9] 的“ли”；不是同一词或明确相同语义。

patterns.name: 特定英语词语中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语词或短词上，分布于叙事、书评和科研散文，未显示共同词义或稳定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、书评、学术散文

patterns.name: 代码缩进与空白
patterns.context: JavaScript 对象代码中，激活的是行首不同层级的空格缩进；同段也激活了代码词“return”及“mnemonic”中的“em”。

patterns.name: 括号及数字字符
patterns.context: 法律句子中，括号包住数字 2，三个相邻字符分别标记激活。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several local characters or words: Russian и, er in Xerox, English and there (also and upon), and indeed in narrative. Contexts and meanings vary substantially, with no unified syntactic or thematic pattern.

patterns.name: Russian «и» character and occurrences within words
patterns.context: In Russian contexts, it appears both as an independent conjunction or interrogative particle and within words; examples occur near punctuation, string searches, and general programming Q&A.

patterns.name: «er» in the Xerox brand name
patterns.context: In English text referring to Xerox copiers or copies, activation falls on the internal character substring «er» in the brand name.

patterns.name: Adjacent collocation and there
patterns.context: In several English prose passages, activation falls on there, often following and; in one legal passage, activation is on upon instead of there.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research abstracts, financial reporting, sports commentary, and legal documents

patterns.name: Causal or emphatic connective indeed
patterns.context: In narrative prose, used as an additional emphasis in a sentence explaining that a child fears their father.

2_1746.description: 激活分布在几类局部字符或词汇上：俄语 и、Xerox 中的 er、英语 and there（另见 and upon）及叙事中的 indeed。各处上下文和语义差异明显，未见统一句法或主题。

patterns.name: 俄语 «и» 字符及其词内出现
patterns.context: 俄语语境中，既出现在独立的连词或疑问小词里，也出现在词内部；可见于标点、字符串搜索及一般编程问答。

patterns.name: Xerox 品牌名中的 «er»
patterns.context: 在提到 Xerox 复印机或副本的英语文本中，激活落在品牌名内部的字符子串 «er»。

patterns.name: and there 相邻搭配
patterns.context: 多段英语散文中激活落在 there，常接在 and 后；法律文书一段则激活 upon，而非 there。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研摘要、财经报道、体育评论及法律文书
