patterns.context: In email metadata headers, From is followed by a colon and the sender’s name or address; unrelated to the email body

patterns.name: demand in a conditional legal statement
patterns.context: In a French parliamentary speech, appears in the structure «on demande à la Commission de donner», meaning that the Commission is asked to take action
patterns.domain: Colloquial French parliamentary speech in EuroParl

patterns.name: suggestion after a rule heading
patterns.context: In a U.S. court rule text, appears in the procedural condition “on suggestion of a party”

patterns.name: from iteration structure in code
patterns.context: In a C# LINQ query, from is followed by a variable, then by in and a data source; activation is actually concentrated on the variable schools, and the preceding code discusses displaying a data grid

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase in a technical description
patterns.context: In a patent technical description, from which introduces the source from which a fuel component is extracted; shares patent style and the phrase with [2], but this passage also has activation near “by way of”

patterns.name: permission in an appeal heading
patterns.context: In a case heading or procedural summary, appears in the fixed legal phrase “Appeal, by permission of a Justice”

2_1913.description: 激活分散于不同语种与文体，包含匈牙利语 jelen 词形、邮件头 From、代码变量及若干法律或专利固定短语；不能由单一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内的 jelen 词干
patterns.trigger: «elen»10（[1] 中紧接着 «j»；[4] 中为 «j«el»3«ent»2ősé«ge»1 a j«elen»10legi）；以及 [8] 的「j«elen»9leg」
patterns.context: 激活集中在匈牙利语 jelen/jelenlegi 一类词的词内片段；[1]、[4]、[8] 的具体形态和上下文不同，常见政治或议会语境，但 [1] 是致谢发言
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 专利引述中的来源关系
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景技术对先前专利或文献的引述中，组成 from which，后接编号或来源信息；注意 [9] 也出现 from which，但激活最高处不在该短语

patterns.name: 邮件头中的发件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件元数据头部中，From 后接冒号和发件人姓名、地址；与邮件正文无关

patterns.name: 法条条件句中的 demand
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，出现在「on demande à la Commission de donner」结构，表示要求委员会采取行动
patterns.domain: EuroParl 法语口语化议会发言

patterns.name: 规则标题后的 suggestion
patterns.context: 美国法院规则文本中，出现在「on suggestion of a party」这一程序条件表述中

patterns.name: 代码中的 from 迭代结构
patterns.context: C# LINQ 查询中，from 后接变量，再接 in 和数据源；激活实际集中在变量 schools 上，且代码前文讨论数据网格显示

patterns.name: 技术说明中的介词短语
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中，from which 引出燃油组分被提取的来源；与 [2] 同有专利文体及短语，但本段另有“by way of”附近的激活

patterns.name: 上诉标题中的 permission
patterns.context: 案件标题或程序摘要中，出现在「Appeal, by permission of a Justice」的固定法律表述

en.description: Primarily responds to the From sender field, forwarded-message separators, and adjacent date/time metadata in email formats; also responds to From/from strings in code Q&A, along with several inconsistent code punctuation and syntax patterns.

patterns.name: Forwarded-email separator
patterns.context: A forwarded email header appears after the email body, often accompanied by “Forwarded by … on …” and a subsequent “From:”; it may also appear between the body and forwarded header.

patterns.name: From in email headers
patterns.context: Appears in or near an email header or forwarded-email header; passage 1 is also in a quoted-printable encoded email header.

patterns.name: from identifier in code
patterns.context: Appears as code syntax or string content, rather than an email sender field.

patterns.name: Email timestamp format
patterns.context: Dates and times are adjacent to email headers or forwarded metadata, with dense punctuation and numeric fields.

patterns.name: Special code punctuation and parameters
patterns.context: Operators, punctuation, color strings, or SQL syntax in code snippets; no common, clear semantic trigger word.

2_1913.concept: 格式边界与 From 字符串
2_1913.description: 主要响应邮件格式中的 From 发件人字段、转发分隔线及邻近的日期时间元数据；另在代码问答中响应 From/from 字符串，以及若干彼此不一致的代码标点和语法。

patterns.name: 转发邮件分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件正文后出现转发邮件头，常伴随“Forwarded by … on …”和后续“From:”；也可在正文与转发头之间出现。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的 From
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头或转发邮件头附近；段1还处于 quoted-printable 编码的邮件头中。

patterns.name: 代码中的 from 标识符
patterns.context: 作为代码语法或字符串内容出现，而非邮件发件人字段。

patterns.name: 邮件时间戳格式
patterns.context: 日期、时间与邮件头或转发元数据相邻，标点和数字字段密集。

patterns.name: 特殊代码标点与参数
patterns.context: 代码片段中的运算符、标点、颜色字符串或 SQL 语法；没有共同的明显语义触发词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across ordinary function words, punctuation, code/format separators, and various intra-word fragments; they span scientific, parliamentary, legal, coding, and email texts. The two legal passages are nearly duplicates; no stable semantic or morphological commonality is apparent in the rest.

patterns.name: Grammatical words, separators, and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary sentences, French/Dutch parliamentary texts, legal texts, email headers, or code; activations are scattered, with no stable semantic collocation
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, code, and formatted text

patterns.name: Fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Annotations cluster on fragments inside different words, without showing a consistent morphological or semantic category
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, encyclopedias, legal texts, patents, code, email

patterns.name: JSON key-value fragments
patterns.context: In JSON-style objects, adjacent to quotation marks, colons, and strings

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary proper names and word fragments
patterns.context: Dutch titles and parliamentary records; fragments span complete words and parts of words

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speech, activations fall within fragments of multiple words

patterns.name: Fixed legal phrases
patterns.context: Adjacent to legal expressions such as “findings of fact,” “of law,” and “held in abeyance”; the two passages are almost identical

patterns.name: Code identifiers and query syntax
patterns.context: C#-style object member assignments and LINQ query fragments

patterns.name: Email header fields
patterns.context: A quoted-printable email header containing a date and sender name

2_1913.description: 激活位置分散于普通功能词、标点、代码/格式分隔符及多种词内片段；涵盖科研、议会、法律、代码和邮件。法律两段近乎重复，其余看不出稳定语义或词形共性。

patterns.name: 语法词、分隔符及标点
patterns.context: 出现在普通句子、法语/荷兰语议会文本、法律文本、邮件头或代码中；激活位置分散，未见稳定的语义搭配
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、代码及格式化文本

patterns.name: 特定词内的片段
patterns.context: 标注集中在不同单词的内部片段，未显示一致的词形或语义类别
patterns.domain: 科研论文、百科、法律、专利、代码、邮件

patterns.name: JSON键值片段
patterns.context: JSON样式对象中，紧邻引号、冒号及字符串

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会专名与词片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语标题及议会记录，片段横跨完整词和词内部分

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中，激活落在多个词的内部片段

patterns.name: 法律固定短语
patterns.context: 与“findings of fact”“of law”“held in abeyance”等法律语句相邻；两段内容几乎重复

patterns.name: 代码标识符与查询语法
patterns.context: C#样式对象成员赋值及 LINQ 查询片段

patterns.name: 邮件头字段
patterns.context: quoted-printable 邮件头，包含日期、发件人姓名

en.description: Activations occur in experimental methods and measurements, patent technical parameters and formulations, analytical calibration, medical case counts, and a few historical texts and code fragments; there is no single clear semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and instrument measurements in papers
patterns.context: Describes sample preparation, reaction treatment, instrument measurements, or experimental steps, often using past tense, passive voice, and specific parameters.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, especially chemistry and materials experiments; passages 1, 2, 6

patterns.name: Technical parameters and compositional constraints in patents
patterns.context: In patent background or claims contexts, describes technical phenomena, formulation proportions, or patent ownership.

patterns.name: Study design and standard samples
patterns.context: Describes experimental design, calibration matrices, and standards and blank samples.
patterns.domain: Analytical methods research in PubMed abstracts; passage 8

patterns.name: Counting expressions in case proportions
patterns.context: Reports case counts in numerator/denominator form, in clinical treatment or outcome descriptions.

patterns.name: The phrase partnership
patterns.context: Describes entering a partnership with someone after a transfer of newspaper management rights; no obvious experimental or patent context.

patterns.name: JSON key from
patterns.context: Used as a JSON object key in a code snippet, with quotation marks, a colon, and json-schema-traverse nearby.

2_1913.description: 激活分布于实验方法与测量、专利技术参数和配方、分析校准、医学病例计数，以及少数历史文本和代码片段；没有单一明确的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 论文中的实验流程与仪器测量
patterns.trigger: « mixture»、« pellets»、« spectra»、« resolution»、« heated»、« reaction»、« monitored»、« filtration»
patterns.context: 描述样品制备、反应处理、仪器测量或实验步骤，常见过去时、被动语态与具体参数。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，尤其化学与材料实验；段1、2、6

patterns.name: 专利中的技术参数与成分限定
patterns.trigger: « number» of « prints»、« particle size»、« resolution»、« developing»；«%» by « weight»；« issued» « patents»
patterns.context: 专利背景或权利要求语境中，说明技术现象、配方比例或专利权属。

patterns.name: 统计设计与标准样品
patterns.context: 描述实验设计、校准矩阵及标准品和空白样品。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的分析方法研究；段8

patterns.name: 病例比例中的计数表达
patterns.context: 以分子/分母形式报告病例数，并处于临床治疗或结局描述中。

patterns.name: 短语 partnership
patterns.context: 描述报纸经营权交接后与某人合伙；未见明显实验或专利语境。

patterns.name: JSON 键名 from
patterns.context: 代码片段中作为 JSON 对象的键名，附近有引号、冒号及 json-schema-traverse。

en.concept: English function words and local syntactic structures
en.description: Activations are widely scattered: common English function words occur across domains; specific lexical items also appear in chemical experimental procedures, legal proceedings, patent references, and medical counts, while a few triggers come from subword fragments or formatting whitespace.

patterns.name: Grammatical function words and common connective structures
patterns.context: Appears in various syntactic positions, including coordination, prepositional phrases, passive constructions, and quantity expressions; specific words vary by passage.

patterns.name: Experimental steps and reaction-process vocabulary
patterns.context: Chemical experimental methods describe procedures such as heating, stirring, cooling, separating, or treating mixtures.

patterns.name: Motions and applications in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Contexts in which a court may take procedural action at a party’s request, on motion, or on its own initiative.

patterns.name: Introducing or referential relations in technical literature
patterns.context: Patent specifications cite prior patents and use relational words to connect technical sources or device descriptions.

patterns.name: Counting and proportion expressions
patterns.context: Describes statistical results using total case counts, subsets, or proportions.

patterns.name: Participle or word-form fragment
patterns.context: Appears once in a historical narrative describing a newspaper as bribed or corrupted.

patterns.name: Build-system template placeholder
patterns.context: Indented whitespace in a Makefile command line; surrounded by variable expansion and BSD Ports build rules.

patterns.name: Stem fragment within a word boundary
patterns.context: Found only near scientific notation or citation identifiers; the triggering fragment itself has no clear shared semantic meaning.

2_1913.concept: 英语功能词与局部语法结构
2_1913.description: 激活分布很散：常见英语功能词在多领域出现；另在化学实验流程、法律程序、专利指引和医学计数中出现特定词项，少数触发来自词片段或格式空白。

patterns.name: 语法功能词与常见连接结构
patterns.context: 在多种句法位置出现，包括并列、介词短语、被动结构和数量表达；具体词项因段而异。

patterns.name: 实验步骤与反应过程词汇
patterns.context: 化学实验方法中描述加热、搅拌、冷却、分离或处理混合物的流程。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的动议与申请
patterns.context: 法院可依当事人申请、动议或自行决定采取程序措施的语境。

patterns.name: 技术文献中的引出或指向关系
patterns.context: 专利说明书引述既有专利，并用关系词连接技术来源或装置说明。

patterns.name: 计数与比例表达
patterns.context: 以病例总数、子集或比例说明统计结果。

patterns.name: 分词或词形片段
patterns.context: 单次出现在描述报纸遭贿赂或腐化的历史叙述里。

patterns.name: 构建系统模板占位符
patterns.context: Makefile 命令行中的缩进空白；周围是变量展开与 BSD 端口构建规则。

patterns.name: 分词边界内的词干片段
patterns.trigger: «g»、«ib»、«and»（分别嵌在 g/mol、gib、v&?and? 文本片段中）
patterns.context: 仅见于科学记号或引用标识符附近，触发片段本身不构成清晰共同语义。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several types of phrases: abeyance, writ of mandate, and several function words in legal documents; out of in medical proportions; and in academic coordination; and organizations in an organizational survey.

patterns.name: abeyance in legal contexts
patterns.context: In legal documents, indicates that an application or proceeding is suspended, commonly in the collocation “held in abeyance”; the same text fragment is repeated.

patterns.name: Legal collocation of mandate
patterns.context: Appears in “writ of mandate,” referring to a writ; nearby context involves a court, parties, or a legal claim.

patterns.name: out of in quantity expressions
patterns.context: Introduces sample or case counts with out of, commonly used to report proportions; activation strength falls on different tokens in the phrase.

patterns.name: and in technical academic text
patterns.context: A coordinating conjunction in academic explanations, appearing in lists of experimental methods, research results, or scientific objects.

patterns.name: Other function-word activations in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears separately in legal sentences at “Relators,” “This application,” “In this petition,” and “the action”; no uniform local collocation is evident.

patterns.name: organizations in an organizational survey
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of surveyed organizations that consider mentoring important; the trigger falls near the noun phrase.

2_1913.description: 激活分散在多类短语：法律文书中的 abeyance、writ of mandate及若干功能词；医学比例中的 out of；学术并列中的 and；另见组织调查中的 organizations。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 abeyance
patterns.context: 法律文书中，表示申请或程序暂缓，常见搭配为“held in abeyance”；相同文本片段重复出现。

patterns.name: mandate 的法律搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“writ of mandate”中，指令状；相邻语境涉及法院、当事人或诉讼请求。

patterns.name: 数量表达中的 out of
patterns.context: 以 out of 引出样本或病例数，常用于报告比例；触发强度落在短语不同 token 上。

patterns.name: 技术性学术文本中的 and
patterns.context: 学术说明中的并列连接词，出现在实验方法、研究结果或科学对象并列中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天体物理学术文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的其他功能词激活
patterns.context: 法律句子中分别出现在“Relators”“This application”“In this petition”“the action”等位置；未见统一的局部搭配。

patterns.name: 组织调查中的 organizations
patterns.context: 报告受访组织中认为导师制重要的比例，触发落在名词短语附近。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across Finnish word-internal fragments, fragments of place and personal names, and words such as schematic, conference, evidence, proteasome, and rectification. Some word-internal triggers may involve local subword morphology, but no semantic or formatting pattern unifies all examples.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual word-internal fragment uh
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs inside words, in Finnish forms such as «uhreiksi» and «uhke»; the context is ordinary words in complete sentences.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment Ts in a proper noun
patterns.context: The fragment occurs inside the proper noun Tsukuba, preceded by Mount and followed by Ropeway; the standalone proper-noun heading is followed by a line break.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in Japanese names
patterns.context: Multiple marked fragments occur within romanized personal names; the names are then repeated on the following line, where the repetitions also activate strongly.

patterns.name: schematic in figure descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in patent figure descriptions and scientific paper captions, describing a schematic or schematic view.

patterns.name: conference at sentence end
patterns.context: Appears in promotional product copy describing where a portable interactive whiteboard can be used, as the final item in a list of locations, immediately before a period.

patterns.name: Disease-treatment wording
patterns.context: The phrase “evidence-based treatments” discusses treatment options; activation falls on evidence.

patterns.name: Biomedical proteasome
patterns.context: A word-internal substring forms proteasome, in scientific descriptions of the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway and mitotic protein proteolysis.

patterns.name: Cryogenic air distillation
patterns.context: A word-internal substring forms rectification, referring to cryogenic air rectification to produce oxygen and nitrogen.

2_2055.description: 强激活分散在芬兰语词内片段、地名和人名片段，以及 schematic、conference、evidence、proteasome、rectification 等不同词中；部分词内触发可能涉及局部子词形态，但没有覆盖全部例子的统一语义或格式规律。

patterns.name: 跨语言词内片段 uh
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在词内部，分别位于芬兰语 «uhreiksi» 和 «uhke» 一类词形中；上下文为完整句子中的普通词语。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段 Ts
patterns.context: 片段位于专名 Tsukuba 内部，前有 Mount，后接 Ropeway；独立专名标题后有换行。

patterns.name: 日文人名内部片段
patterns.context: 多个被标记的片段分布在罗马字人名内部；姓名随后以换行重复，重复处也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 图示中的 schematic
patterns.context: 出现在专利附图说明及科研论文图注中，描述示意图或示意视图。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、科研论文图注

patterns.name: 句末 conference
patterns.context: 出现在介绍便携式交互白板使用场所的产品宣传句中，作为地点列举的末项并紧接句号。

patterns.name: 疾病治疗措辞
patterns.context: 短语 “evidence-based treatments”，讨论治疗方案；激活落在 evidence。

patterns.name: 生物医学 proteasome
patterns.context: 词内子串组成 proteasome，处于泛素-蛋白酶体通路及有丝分裂蛋白水解的科研描述中。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学项目摘要

patterns.name: 空气低温精馏
patterns.context: 词内子串组成 rectification，指空气低温精馏以生产氧和氮。

en.concept: Word fragments and local vocabulary mix
en.description: Activations often fall on English st-initial subwords (staphylococcal, stencil, sturgeon, stopper) and Finnish fragments. Other sporadic items come from medicine, promotional copy, software instructions, and patents, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of medial st morphemes
patterns.context: English words are split into st-initial subwords or contain similar st subword sequences; activation concentrates on word-initial st, while the complete word varies with context.

patterns.name: Finnish uh- forms
patterns.context: Occurs in Finnish sentences, continued as «ke» (uhke) and «rei» (uhreiksi); the trigger position is word-internal.

patterns.name: Local modifiers or phrases in research abstracts
patterns.context: In biomedical research abstracts, activation falls on fragments of English compounds or terms; these fragments do not represent the same medical concept.

patterns.name: conference in promotional copy
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence describing portable interactive whiteboard use, in a list of locations.

patterns.name: schematic in document figure descriptions
patterns.context: A patent figure-description sentence describing a schematic of an automatic document feeder.

patterns.name: Marked en in a Finnish sentence
patterns.context: Occurs in a long Finnish sentence, near other Finnish forms; no clear trigger condition shared with other passages is apparent.

patterns.name: Stem or affix fragments in Finnish passages
patterns.context: A Finnish sentence about a country being affected and suffering; activation is distributed across multiple word-internal fragments and cannot be summarized by a single fragment.

patterns.name: Interactive-learning phrases in promotional copy
patterns.context: Describes a portable interactive whiteboard and uses such as classrooms and meetings; activation positions are scattered.

patterns.name: Interface terms in instructions
patterns.context: Instructions for copying graphics and creating a new template; besides the repeated st subword pattern, these weaker local activations also occur.

patterns.name: Zoological terms and morphology
patterns.context: A study of sex identification in great blue herons; activation falls both on subword fragments in the species name and on methodological terms.

patterns.name: Patent figure numbers and descriptive terms
patterns.context: Figure numbers and figure descriptions in a patent for an automatic document feeder; activations on figure numbers are not clearly related to English word fragments.

patterns.name: Local words in other biomedical abstracts
patterns.context: Two different medical abstracts describe staphylococcal toxin research and pregnancy complications related to the placenta; the highly activated words differ.

2_2055.concept: 词片段与局部词汇混合
2_2055.description: 激活多落在英文 st 起始子词（staphylococcal、stencil、sturgeon、stopper）及芬兰语片段；另有分散的医学、宣传、软件说明和专利词项，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 中间词素 st 的子词切分
patterns.trigger: « st»10；同时出现 «aphyl»、«encil»、«ur»、«opper» 等后续片段
patterns.context: 英文词被拆成以 st 开头的子词，或含有类似 st 子词序列；激活集中在词首 st，具体完整词随语境变化。

patterns.name: 芬兰语 uh- 词形
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语句子中，分别接续为 «ke»（uhke）和 «rei»（uhreiksi）；触发位置在词内。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的限定词或词组局部
patterns.context: 生物医学研究摘要中，激活落在英文复合词或术语片段；这些片段并非同一医学概念。

patterns.name: 宣传文案中的 conference
patterns.context: 介绍互动白板便携使用场景的句子，在列举地点时出现。

patterns.name: 文档示意图说明中的 schematic
patterns.context: 专利图示说明句，描述自动送纸器的示意图。

patterns.name: 芬兰语句中标记的 en
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语长句中，附近为其他芬兰语词形；未见与其他段落共享的清楚触发条件。

patterns.name: 芬兰语段落中的词干或词缀片段
patterns.trigger: « kö»7；另有 « maiden»4、« kä»2、« kärs»3、« jout»7
patterns.context: 芬兰语关于国家受影响与受苦的句子；激活分布在多个词内片段，无法由单一片段概括。

patterns.name: 宣传文案中的交互式学习词组
patterns.context: 描述便携式互动白板及其课堂、会议等用途；这些激活位置彼此分散。

patterns.name: 操作说明中的界面词
patterns.context: 指导用户复制图形并创建新模板；除重复的 st 子词模式外，还有这些较弱局部激活。

patterns.name: 动物学术语及形态学
patterns.context: 研究大蓝鹭性别鉴定，激活既落在物种名称的子词片段，也落在方法术语。

patterns.name: 专利图示数字与描述词
patterns.context: 自动文档送纸器专利的图号和图示描述；图号激活与英文词片段不明显相关。

patterns.name: 其他生物医学摘要局部词
patterns.context: 两个不同医学摘要分别描述葡萄球菌毒素研究与胎盘相关妊娠并发症；高激活词各异。

en.description: In most passages, highlights concentrate on word-initial st fragments across words with no apparent semantic relation. There is also a draw fragment in code and an internal fragment of complications in a medical text; neither is explained by the st pattern.

patterns.name: Segmented fragment of the string st
patterns.context: The letter sequence st occurs, with activation on the subword or word-initial fragment st; subsequent letters and word meanings are not fixed. Complete words across passages include stencil, sturgeon, staphylococcal, stapes, staphylococci, stedelijke, sturen.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes technical instructions, medical abstracts, Dutch parliamentary/philosophical text, and code

patterns.name: draw stem across word boundaries
patterns.context: The draw stem occurs in code identifiers; both instances appear in identifiers such as draw_likelihood_closure / draws.

patterns.name: Other highlighted word fragments
patterns.context: In passage 5, strong activation falls on an internal subword fragment of complications, not st or draw; the surrounding text discusses placenta-mediated pregnancy complications.
patterns.domain: Medical abstract on racial disparities and pregnancy complications

2_2055.description: 多数段落的高亮集中在词首 st 片段，涵盖多种无明显语义关联的词；另有代码中的 draw 片段，以及一段医学文本中 complications 的内部片段，后两者无法由 st 模式解释。

patterns.name: 字符串 st 的切分片段
patterns.context: 出现字母序列 st，激活落在子词或词首片段 st 上；后续字母和词义并不固定。各段中的完整词包括 stencil、sturgeon、staphylococcal、stapes、staphylococci、stedelijke、sturen。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；包括技术说明、医学摘要、荷兰语议会/哲学文本和代码

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 draw 词干
patterns.context: 代码标识符中的 draw 词干；两处均出现在 draw_likelihood_closure / draws 一类标识符中。

patterns.name: 其他高亮词片段
patterns.context: 第 5 段的强激活落在 complications 一词的中间子词片段，而非 st 或 draw；周围讨论胎盘介导的妊娠并发症。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，种族差异与妊娠并发症

en.description: Activations mainly concentrate on internal subword fragments of specific words: Silicon, proteasome, Grenoble, sturgeon, Kitahara, Synchronous, and schematic. The trigger words span chemistry, biomedicine, place names, personal names, patent terminology, and paper figure descriptions, with no unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in Silicon
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a chemical name or entry, followed by Valley Manufacturing Group Members, or repeated after a line break and followed by « hydr»«ide»; activation falls on a token fragment of Silicon.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in proteasome
patterns.context: Occurs in ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, with activation concentrated on an internal token of proteasome.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Grenoble
patterns.context: An initial fragment of Grenoble, the French city, appearing in a location or institutional address list.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography entries, institutional addresses, academic paper affiliations

patterns.name: stur in a term or proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “Gender identification in great sturgeon,” with activation spanning an internal fragment of sturgeon.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract titles or topic phrases

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in the name Kitahara
patterns.context: The name Sota Kitahara is repeated on adjacent lines, with activation concentrated on an internal fragment of the surname Kitahara.

patterns.name: Syn in a patent title
patterns.context: Occurs in the technical title “Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers,” with activation concentrated on a word-initial fragment of Synchronous.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in schematic
patterns.context: Occurs in the figure description “Inset shows a schematic illustration,” with activation on schematic.

2_2055.description: 激活主要集中在特定词的内部子词片段：Silicon、proteasome、Grenoble、sturgeon、Kitahara、Synchronous、schematic。触发词分属化学、生物医学、地名、人名、专利术语及论文图示说明，未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: Silicon 的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学名称或条目开头，后接 Valley Manufacturing Group Members，或在换行后重复并接 « hydr»«ide»；激活落在 Silicon 的 token 片段上。

patterns.name: proteasome 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 ubiquitin-proteasome pathway 中，激活集中于 proteasome 的词内 token。

patterns.name: Grenoble 的词内片段
patterns.context: 作为法国城市 Grenoble 的开头片段，出现在地点地址或机构地址列表中。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、机构地址、学术论文作者单位

patterns.name: 术语或专名中的 stur
patterns.context: 出现在短语 “Gender identification in great sturgeon” 中，激活覆盖 sturgeon 的内部片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要标题或主题短语

patterns.name: 人名 Kitahara 的词内片段
patterns.context: 人名 Sota Kitahara 在相邻行重复出现，激活集中于姓氏 Kitahara 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 专利标题中的 Syn
patterns.context: 出现在技术标题 “Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers” 中，激活集中于 Synchronous 的词首片段。

patterns.name: schematic 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在实验图示说明“Inset shows a schematic illustration”中，激活于 schematic。

en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented subwords in technical text: prominent fragments include prote, Silicon, and Syn. It also responds to patent boilerplate, rare proper nouns, and code identifiers, making it difficult to reduce to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: prote fragment in technical or scientific terms
patterns.context: Terms are segmented into prote-initial subwords; these occur in the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway and biotechnology.

patterns.name: Segmentation fragments in Silicon
patterns.context: Silicon is split into the two subwords Sil and icon; it may refer to Silicon Valley, silicon hydride, or Silicon Photonics.

patterns.name: Syn-initial segmented fragment
patterns.context: Syn occurs in segmented technical proper names: Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers, Respiratory Syncytial Virus.

patterns.name: Field-introducing phrase in patent text
patterns.context: The conventional patent expression “related to the field of,” followed by the name of a technical field.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper names or rare words
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented subwords in names or rare words such as Grenoble and strophanthin, with no clear shared context.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and spreadsheet operations
patterns.context: Code contains segmented variable/class identifiers and a call to retrieve the last row number of a spreadsheet.

2_2055.concept: 技术文本中的子词片段
2_2055.description: 激活分散于技术文本中的拆分子词：突出 prote、Silicon、Syn 等片段，也响应专利套语、罕见专名及代码标识符；难以归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 技术或科学术语中的 prote 片段
patterns.context: 术语被切分为以 prote 开头的子词；分别出现在泛素-蛋白酶体通路和生物技术领域。

patterns.name: Silicon 的分词片段
patterns.context: Silicon 被拆分为 Sil 与 icon 两个子词；可指 Silicon Valley、silicon hydride 或 Silicon Photonics。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、专利；科技语境

patterns.name: Syn 开头的分词片段
patterns.context: Syn 出现在被切分的专有技术名称中：Automotive Synchronous Rectifiers、Respiratory Syncytial Virus。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的字段引入语
patterns.context: 专利惯用表达“related to the field of”，后接技术领域名称。

patterns.name: 专有名称或罕见词的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Grenoble 和 strophanthin 等专名或罕见词的拆分子词上，没有明显共同语境。
patterns.domain: 科研设施描述、医学摘要

patterns.name: 代码标识符与表格操作
patterns.context: 代码中出现拆分的变量/类标识符以及获取电子表格末行号的调用。

en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is the phrase “the advent of,” used to introduce a newly emerging drug, technology, method, or other thing. Two other examples activate on word-initial advent in adventurous and adventitious, respectively in historical narrative and biosafety text.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “the advent of”
patterns.context: Appears after the definite article the and before of, introducing something newly emerging or gradually gaining prominence; appears at varying strengths
patterns.domain: Primarily academic papers, research grant texts, and patent backgrounds; also general narrative

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in adventurous
patterns.context: The word adventurous is segmented, with activation on word-initial advent; the context describes maritime privateers

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in adventitious
patterns.context: The word adventitious is segmented and followed by agents, referring to microorganisms that enter accidentally or from outside

2_2055.description: 最强且反复出现的模式是短语“the advent of”，用于引出新出现的药物、技术、方法或事物。另有两例激活落在 adventurous、adventitious 的词首 advent，分别见于历史叙事和生物安全文本。

patterns.name: 固定短语“the advent of”
patterns.context: 出现在定冠词 the 后，后接 of，引入新出现或逐渐兴起的事物；不同强度均出现
patterns.domain: 主要为学术论文、科研资助文本及专利背景，也见一般叙述

patterns.name: adventurous 的词内片段
patterns.context: 词语 adventurous 被拆分标记，激活落在词首 advent；语境描述海上私掠者

patterns.name: adventitious 的词内片段
patterns.context: 词语 adventitious 被拆分标记，后接 agents，指偶然进入或外来的微生物
patterns.domain: 动物设施与生物安全科研文本

en.concept: Multilingual word forms and text fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text and code: prominent features include Hungarian ő (especially in Erdős), Chinese “常/异常” and anomaly messages, code identifiers, and the medical title word Validation. Other activations involve legal headings, web terminology, and sporadic English forms, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Chinese character “常”
patterns.context: “常” appears as part of a word or phrase: in “常亮” in passage 1, and in “异常” in passages 5 and 7.

patterns.name: Hungarian ő
patterns.context: Occurs in Hungarian forms, including “következő” and the name “Erdős”.

patterns.name: Chinese requests and anomaly messages
patterns.context: The Chinese prompt “请求转换异常，请重试” occurs, as do references to an anomaly and its resolution in a Japanese sentence.
patterns.domain: Chinese user prompts in code, Japanese web text

patterns.name: Code identifiers and punctuation
patterns.context: A Java-style always-on window flag expression and the end of a PHP code block; triggers are scattered across identifiers and symbols.

patterns.name: ő in a mathematical name
patterns.context: Occurs where mathematics texts mention Erdős, whether in a theorem, proof, or reference to the name.

patterns.name: Validation in titles
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a PubMed abstract or title, followed by the study subject or measurement instrument name.

patterns.name: Sporadic English forms and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Occur in mathematical discussion, citations, hyphenated expressions, and scale names; no stable shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, legal texts, biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: EuroParl agenda transitions
patterns.context: The chair’s title and a transition phrase meaning “the next item” in Hungarian parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Legal document section headings
patterns.context: An uppercase section heading in a court opinion, followed by party names and argumentation.

patterns.name: Network and probability terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of coupled networks, oscillator interactions, and probability approximations.

2_2055.concept: 多语种词形与文本片段
2_2055.description: 激活分散于多语种文本与代码：突出匈牙利语 ő（尤见 Erdős）、中文“常/异常”及异常提示、代码标识符、医学标题 Validation；另有法律标题、网络术语和零散英文词形，未呈现单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 中文“常”字
patterns.context: “常”作为词或短语的一部分出现；第1段在“常亮”中，第5、7段在“异常”中。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 ő
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语词形中，包括“következő”以及人名“Erdős”。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语议会文本、数学论文

patterns.name: 中文请求与异常提示
patterns.context: 中文提示语中出现“请求转换异常，请重试”，以及日文句子中出现异常及其解决相关表述。
patterns.domain: 代码中的中文用户提示、日文网页文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与标点
patterns.context: Java 风格窗口常亮标志表达式，以及 PHP 代码块结束处；触发分散在标识符和符号上。

patterns.name: 数学人名中的 ő
patterns.context: 出现在数学文本提及 Erdős 的位置，不论是定理、证明还是人名引述。

patterns.name: Validation 标题词
patterns.context: 出现在 PubMed 摘要或标题开头，后接研究对象或测量工具名称。

patterns.name: 零散英文词形与语法片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在数学论述、引用、连字符表达以及量表名称中；未见稳定共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、法律文本、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: EuroParl 议程过渡语
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议事文本中的主席称谓和“下一项”过渡句。

patterns.name: 法律文书段落标题
patterns.context: 法院意见书中大写章节标题后接当事人姓名及论证叙述。

patterns.name: 网络与概率术语
patterns.context: 描述耦合网络、振子相互作用及概率近似时出现。

en.description: The most stable trigger is `func` in Swift/Go code declarations, especially Swift method definitions. There are also segmented occurrences of function and activations on surrounding types and member identifiers, across mathematical and programming-instruction contexts.

patterns.name: Swift method declarations
patterns.context: Function declarations or method definitions in Swift code; common forms include `private func`, `override open func`, `static func`, `class func`, extension methods, and protocol/type-related code.

patterns.name: Go function declarations
patterns.context: A method in Go code declared with `func`, followed by parameters and a return type; here it is a method on a proxy interface.

patterns.name: Swift type- or member-related words
patterns.context: Local fragments of Swift types, API names, members, or technical terms; activations occur sporadically, with no stable independent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Mathematical discussion of the function concept
patterns.context: In an English question, `function` is split into `func` and `ions` while discussing the mean-value property of harmonic functions; the trigger fragment matches the code keyword.

patterns.name: JavaScript explanation of the function concept
patterns.context: English text explaining the scope and binding of inner JavaScript functions; the natural-language word function occurs, but the strongest activation still falls on the code form `func`.

2_2055.description: 最稳定的触发是 Swift/Go 代码声明中的 `func`，尤其 Swift 方法定义；另有被拆分的 function 词及周边类型、成员标识符激活，覆盖数学与编程说明语境。

patterns.name: Swift 方法声明
patterns.context: Swift 代码中的函数声明或方法定义；常见于 `private func`、`override open func`、`static func`、`class func`、扩展方法及协议/类型相关代码。

patterns.name: Go 函数声明
patterns.context: Go 代码中以 `func` 声明带接收者的方法，后接参数与返回类型；此处是代理接口的方法。

patterns.name: Swift 类型或成员相关词
patterns.context: Swift 类型、API 名称、成员或技术术语的局部片段；激活分散出现，未见稳定的独立触发条件。

patterns.name: 函数概念的数学讨论
patterns.context: 英文问题中 `function` 被拆分为 `func` 与 `ions`，讨论非调和函数的均值性质；触发片段与代码关键字同形。

patterns.name: 函数概念的 JavaScript 说明
patterns.context: 英文解释 JavaScript 内层函数的作用域及绑定；出现自然语言单词 function，但最高激活仍落在代码形态 `func`。

en.concept: Functions and test markers in code
en.description: Strong responses mainly concentrate on the function declaration marker func in code, especially Swift, and also respond significantly to the Jasmine testing framework name. Other activations involve scattered code syntax tokens, injector identifiers, and network terminology.

patterns.name: Swift function declarations
patterns.context: Function declarations in Swift code, especially the function name after func; includes ordinary methods and operator overloading.

patterns.name: Jasmine testing identifier
patterns.context: Jasmine occurs in test code or testing instructions, near testing terms such as spy, mock, controller, and fixtures.

patterns.name: Other programming syntax tokens
patterns.context: Closing braces, empty function bodies, or Angular injector identifiers in code; trigger positions and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Network-device terminology
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the phrase “network kit” in discussions of router configuration and network devices.

patterns.name: JavaScript function binding
patterns.context: Text and example code explaining how to bind an inner function to the parent this context.

2_2055.concept: 代码中的函数与测试标记
2_2055.description: 强响应主要集中在代码中的函数声明标记 func（尤见 Swift），也对 Jasmine 测试框架名称有显著响应；另有若干分散的代码语法 token、注入器标识符及网络术语激活。

patterns.name: Swift 函数声明
patterns.context: Swift 代码中的函数声明，尤其是 func 后的函数名；包括普通方法及运算符重载。

patterns.name: Jasmine 测试标识符
patterns.context: 测试代码或测试说明中出现 Jasmine，邻近 spy、mock、controller、fixtures 等测试术语。

patterns.name: 其他编程语法 token
patterns.context: 代码中的闭合花括号、空函数体或 Angular 注入器标识符；触发位置和上下文各异。

patterns.name: 网络设备术语
patterns.context: 讨论路由器配置及网络设备时，出现在“network kit”短语末尾。

patterns.name: JavaScript 函数绑定
patterns.context: 说明将内层函数绑定到父级 this 上下文的文字及示例代码。

en.description: Activations occur most consistently on kit and contexts involving kits or equipment sets. There are also notable responses to an algolia search URL on HN, patent descriptions of skincare product packaging and dispensing, and mixture in semi-supervised learning.

patterns.name: “kit” and kit-related expressions
patterns.context: kit refers to a set of equipment, parts, or materials ready for use; modifiers and uses vary by context.
patterns.domain: Network configuration, electronics, development tools, biomedicine, automotive modification

patterns.name: algolia in Hacker News search URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in an hn.algolia.com search URL; query is followed by a search term or parameters.
patterns.domain: Hacker News forum posts and links

patterns.name: Skincare packaging and cream dispensing
patterns.context: Describes a device for packaging and applying or dispensing cosmetics and care products.

patterns.name: mixture in semi-supervised learning
patterns.context: mixture refers to a mixture of class-conditional distributions, used in theoretical discussion of semi-supervised classification.

2_2055.description: 激活最一致地出现在 kit（套件、成套设备）及其用途语境；另对 HN 的 algolia 搜索网址、专利中的护肤品包装分配描述，以及半监督学习里的 mixture 有明显反应。

patterns.name: “kit”及套件类表达
patterns.context: kit 指可供使用的一组设备、部件或材料；修饰语和用途因语境而异。
patterns.domain: 网络配置、电子产品、开发工具、生物医学、汽车改装

patterns.name: Hacker News 搜索 URL 中的 algolia
patterns.context: 出现在 hn.algolia.com 搜索网址中；query 后接搜索词或参数。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 论坛帖子及链接

patterns.name: 护肤品包装与膏霜分配
patterns.context: 描述包装并涂布或分配化妆品、护理产品的装置。

patterns.name: 半监督学习中的 mixture
patterns.context: mixture 指类别条件分布的混合，用于半监督分类的理论讨论。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are distributed across SY/SYN letter strings, SQL and URL symbols, legal and academic formatting, insurance copy, medical terminology, and automotive modification terms. There is no single stable semantics; some triggers may be only subwords or punctuation.

patterns.name: SY/SYN strings
patterns.context: Case-sensitive letter sequences appearing in code identifiers, initials, or product names; tokenization boundaries may split the same string.
patterns.domain: Code, astronomy papers, legal texts, automotive product descriptions, medical literature

patterns.name: SQL punctuation and syntax fragments
patterns.context: SQL-injection-style strings and punctuation around code, parameter separators, and similar locations; the same passage also contains SY identifiers.

patterns.name: Specific English subword fragments

patterns.context: 与 small-scale 或 genome-wide scale 等规模、范围表达搭配。

patterns.name: 医学专业词汇
patterns.context: 医学病例描述、疾病研究或生理机制讨论中，术语及其邻近位置激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed 与 NIH 医学文本

patterns.name: 未婚性行为与婚姻语境
patterns.context: 非正式个人叙述中，连接关于夫妻共同生活及等待婚后性生活的句子；触发位置本身不足以确认为稳定词义模式。

en.concept: Polysemous responses to mix / py / lux subword fragments
en.description: Activations are concentrated mostly in different forms of the mix word family and MixIn in code; there are also responses to the :py: directive fragment in Python/Sphinx and the medical term-initial fragment in luxatio.

patterns.name: py directive in Python documentation
patterns.context: In Python source comments or docstrings, a reStructuredText/Sphinx directive or name contains `py`; activation often falls on `py`.

patterns.name: mix word-form fragments
patterns.context: The mix word family appears in ordinary contexts, discussing sexual relationships, financial diversification, statistical distributions, physical mixtures, or academic and startup culture.

patterns.name: MixIn class-name fragment
patterns.context: Camel-case `MixIn` in a Python network-server class name, related to multiple inheritance in socket servers.

patterns.name: Medical term luxatio
patterns.context: A case report describes shoulder luxatio erecta and mentions fractures and nerve injury.

2_2055.concept: 词片段 mix / py / lux 的多义响应
2_2055.description: 激活最集中于 mix 词族的不同词形及代码中的 MixIn；另对 Python/Sphinx 的 :py: 指令片段和医学 luxatio 词首有响应。

patterns.name: Python 文档中的 py 指令
patterns.context: Python 源码注释或文档字符串中，reStructuredText/Sphinx 指令或名称包含 `py`；激活常落在 `py`。

patterns.name: mix 的词形片段
patterns.context: 普通语境中出现 mix 词族；分别谈性关系、金融多元化、统计分布、物理混合物或学术与创业文化。

patterns.name: MixIn 类名片段
patterns.context: Python 网络服务器类名中的驼峰式 `MixIn`，与 socket server 多重继承相关。

patterns.name: 医学术语 luxatio
patterns.context: 病例报告描述肩关节 luxatio erecta，并提及骨折及神经损伤。

en.description: Strongly responds to mixture(s) and domain-specific collocations, and also to py in Python documentation markers; an isolated response to the substring csytan in forum text may reflect a different pattern.

patterns.name: Mixtures and domain-specific collocations
patterns.context: Denotes a mixture composed of multiple components, objects, or distributions; nearby there are often specific categories or modifiers, such as “binary”, “of Student-$t$’s”, “of von Mises pdfs”, and “heterogeneous mixture”.
patterns.domain: Academic contexts such as physics, statistical modeling, neuroscience, and astronomy; may also occur in legal company names

patterns.name: Python documentation markers
patterns.context: Appears in Python documentation roles or markers in Sphinx/reStructuredText style, such as “:py:class:`rst`” and “:py:mod:`td.da.const`”; activation does not depend on the semantics of “mixture”.

patterns.name: csytan substring
patterns.context: Appears in isolation after a code fence in HackerNews text; no identifiable semantics or connection to other patterns is evident.
patterns.domain: Online forum text containing a code fence

2_2055.concept: 多模式词形与标记响应
2_2055.description: 强烈响应 mixture(s) 及相关领域搭配，也响应 Python 文档标记中的 py；另对论坛文本中的 csytan 子串有孤立响应，可能反映不同模式。

patterns.name: 混合物及其领域搭配
patterns.context: 表示由多个成分、对象或分布构成的混合物；附近常有具体类别或限定语，如“binary”“of Student-$t$’s”“of von Mises pdfs”“heterogeneous mixture”。
patterns.domain: 物理、统计建模、神经科学、天文学等学术语境；也可出现在法律公司名称中

patterns.name: Python 文档标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Sphinx/reStructuredText 风格的 Python 文档角色或标记中，如“:py:class:`rst`”“:py:mod:`td.da.const`”；激活不依赖“mixture”语义。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与 Python 文档

patterns.name: csytan 子串
patterns.context: 孤立地出现在 HackerNews 文本里的代码围栏之后；未见可确认的语义或与其他模式的联系。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛文本，含代码围栏

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across medical subword fragments (e.g., C, the y in palsy), the name Hart, formula-boundary punctuation, and sporadic word fragments. The segments lack consistent semantic or grammatical triggers, and the weak activations cannot be reliably categorized.

patterns.name: Word-initial C and following fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the capital letter C and following subword fragments in different medical terms; there is no clear shared meaning or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Final or internal y
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter y in medical terms, appearing in cerebral palsy and dysembryoplastic; other fragments containing y are unmarked, so this does not support a general y pattern.

patterns.name: Syntactic or formula-boundary punctuation
patterns.context: Activation occurs on semicolons at the ends of formulas in mathematical Q&A and in formulas or symbolic expressions in papers; it may be sensitive to specific formula-boundary punctuation.

patterns.name: Hart in names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Hartlib and Hartigan, both parts of the names of a historical figure or tennis player; it is unclear whether this detects a specific string or a name component.

patterns.name: Boundary fragment up
patterns.context: Appears in “came up with” and “set up,” both with up in phrasal verbs; activation is weaker than the primary markers.

patterns.name: Biomedical morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Several consecutive morphemes or subword fragments in tumor names activate; this fits the medical topic, but the same pattern does not appear in other medical passages.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Appears on the closing parenthesis after the abbreviation “(CP)” for cerebral palsy; it is isolated and lacks a confirmed shared pattern.

patterns.name: Result or relation words
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of treatment effects, method steps, and mathematical arguments; the grammatical functions differ, so these cannot yet be grouped into a reliable trigger category.

patterns.name: Technical term fragments and quantifiers
patterns.context: Sporadically falls on materials-physics terms, historical time expressions, and tennis score symbols; the topics and contexts differ.

2_2191.description: 强激活分散在医学词片段（如 C、palsy 中的 y）、人名 Hart、公式边界标点及零散词片段上。各段缺少一致的词义或语法触发条件，多个弱激活也无法可靠归类。

patterns.name: 词首 C 与后续词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在大写字母 C 及其后的词片段上，组成不同医学词汇；没有明显统一的词义或固定搭配。

patterns.name: 词尾或内部的 y
patterns.context: 激活位于医学术语的 y 字母上，分别出现在 cerebral palsy 和 dysembryoplastic 中；另有其他片段中的 y 未标记，不能据此概括为普遍的 y 模式。

patterns.name: 句法或公式边界标点
patterns.context: 在数学问答公式末尾的分号，以及论文公式或符号表达中的分号处激活；可能对特定公式边界标点敏感。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学问答、ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 人名中的 Hart
patterns.context: 在人名 Hartlib 和 Hartigan 中激活，均为历史人物或网球选手姓名的一部分；是否识别特定字符串或人名成分不明。

patterns.name: 边界词片段 up
patterns.context: 分别出现在“came up with”和“set up”中，都是短语动词里的 up；激活强度低于主要标记。

patterns.name: 生物医学词素片段
patterns.context: 在肿瘤名称中激活若干连续词素或词片段；与医学主题相符，但其他医学段落未呈现同样模式。

patterns.name: 数学符号的右括号
patterns.context: 出现在 cerebral palsy 缩写“(CP)”之后的右括号，孤立出现，缺乏可确认的共同模式。

patterns.name: 结果或关系词
patterns.context: 分别出现在治疗效果描述、方法步骤描述和数学论述中，语法功能不同，暂不能归为一个可靠的触发类别。

patterns.name: 技术名词片段与数量词
patterns.context: 零散地落在材料物理名词、历史时间表述以及网球比分符号上，主题和语境不同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across varied subword fragments. The most prominent is word-final y, especially in medical terms; other activations occur in medical compounds, ordinary word subwords, formula punctuation, and image markers. They vary across domains, position, and meaning.

patterns.name: Word-final y
patterns.context: Activation falls on y at the end of a word, especially when the stem or earlier part is split into multiple subword fragments; it also occurs at the ends of ordinary words.

patterns.name: Number and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: In formulas, markup, or symbol-containing text, activation falls on dollar signs, semicolons, and within image markers; segment 4 also involves an alphanumeric filename fragment.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, mathematics papers, web/image markup

patterns.name: English internal or final fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across fragments of medical terms or compounds split by the tokenizer, with no fixed position; segment 5 includes an internal y.

patterns.name: Subword boundaries in ordinary words
patterns.context: A small number of activations occur on subword fragments of common words or proper names, without stable semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, patent background, historical encyclopedia, mathematics papers

2_2191.description: 激活分散于多种分词片段：突出的是词尾 y（尤见医学术语），另见医学复合词、普通词子词、公式标点及图像标记。跨领域且位置和语义不稳定。

patterns.name: 词尾 y
patterns.trigger: «y»10（第2、3段）；«y»10 出现在 «C»3ere«bral»2« pals»1«y»10；第8段为 «y»9
patterns.context: 激活落在单词末尾的 y，尤其在词干或前部已分成多个子词片段时；也出现在普通单词末尾。

patterns.name: 数字与标点边界
patterns.context: 公式、标记语言或含符号的文本中，激活落在美元符号、分号及图像标记内部；第4段还涉及字母数字文件名片段。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、数学论文、网页/图像标记

patterns.name: 英文词内或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在被分词器拆开的医学术语或复合词片段上，位置不固定；第5段包含词内 y。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、肿瘤学标题

patterns.name: 普通词的子词边界
patterns.context: 少量激活出现在常见词或专名的子词片段上，未显示稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、专利背景、历史百科、数学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across several contexts: separately marked y in medical words, y in filenames and proper names, diagnosis-related words, mathematical code symbols, and forgiven in religious narrative. No single stable meaning explains them.

patterns.name: Continuation y in disease names
patterns.context: Preceded by separately marked word-initial fragments, forming complete medical terms such as «C»ere«bral» pals«y», «D»y«semb»ry«oplastic», and «C»aries.

patterns.name: Internal y subword in English words
patterns.context: Occurs within a word rather than as a standalone word; neighboring subwords form a filename or proper name, as in «y»j«bm»...

patterns.name: y in a specific name or word form
patterns.context: The letter y occurs in the proper name John Dury, amid a historical account of a 17th-century correspondence network.

patterns.name: PD diagnostic context and crossroads
patterns.context: Discussion of personality disorder diagnosis; activation concentrates on related words and their split subwords.

patterns.name: Symbols and parentheses in mathematical code
patterns.context: Near symbols such as variable substitutions, trigonometric conditions, and parentheses in mathematical expressions or code snippets.

patterns.name: Forgiveness in religious narrative
patterns.context: First-person narrative mentions the forgiveness of sins; other religious-context words include burdens of the heart and miracles.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在多种场景：医学词语中拆分标注的 y、文件名及专名中的 y，另有诊断相关词、数学代码符号，以及宗教叙述里的 forgiven。无法由单一稳定语义解释。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中 y 的续写
patterns.context: 前面为拆分标注的词首，组成完整医学术语，如 «C»ere«bral» pals«y»、«D»y«semb»ry«oplastic»、«C»aries。

patterns.name: 英文词内部的 y 子词
patterns.context: 出现在词中而非独立词，前后子词共同构成文件名或专名；如 «y»j«bm»...

patterns.name: 特定专名或词形中的 y
patterns.context: 字母 y 位于专名 John Dury 中，周围是 17 世纪通信网络的历史叙述。

patterns.name: PD 的诊断语境与 crossroads
patterns.context: 人格障碍诊断的讨论；激活集中在相关词及其拆分子词上。
patterns.domain: 医学/心理学资助项目文本

patterns.name: 数学代码中的符号与括号
patterns.context: 数学表达式或代码片段中，变量替换、三角函数条件及括号等符号附近。

patterns.name: 宗教叙述中的 forgiveness
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中提到罪获得赦免；同时出现心中负担、奇迹等宗教语境词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords in disease or sports names, copy in emails, image filenames, forgiven in religious text, and semicolons and equals signs after formulas in mathematical/scientific text; local triggers differ, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments of the term “Cerebral palsy”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the disease name split into multiple tokens; one example is followed by “improvement achieved by…”, another by the abbreviation “(CP)” and epidemiological description.

patterns.name: Name of a sport
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword tokens in the sport name “Archery”; the sentence introduces the sport.

patterns.name: copy in an email phrase
patterns.context: “copy” appears in parentheses, referring to a copy of a memo attached to an email; strong activation is concentrated on the word.

patterns.name: Image filename/path tokens
patterns.context: A sequence resembling an image filename follows a Markdown image marker; activation falls on several path/filename fragments.
patterns.domain: Markup or image references in PubMed Central documents

patterns.name: Equals sign in a formula
patterns.context: In a discussion of trigonometric values, the equals-sign token «=» is adjacent to a formula representing ±1; the newline token is also marked.

patterns.name: Forgiven in religious narrative
patterns.context: A first-person account of faith describes sins being forgiven; activation falls on “forgiven”.

patterns.name: Semicolon after a genetic transfer step
patterns.context: A technical sentence first describes a selection step and its associated potential function; a semicolon ends that clause and connects it to the subsequent mutation step. Activation falls on the semicolon.

patterns.name: Equals sign in a formula
patterns.context: In a geometry formula, an equals sign connects an expression to zero, followed by a semicolon and a condition; strong activation is on the equals sign and semicolon.

patterns.name: Equals sign in a formula
patterns.context: In a particle-physics sentence, a semicolon follows a formula and connects parallel explanations; activation falls on the semicolon.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在疾病或运动名称的子词、邮件中的 copy、图像文件名、宗教词 forgiven，以及数学／科学文本中公式后的分号和等号；各处局部触发不同，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “Cerebral palsy”术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分成多个 token 的疾病名称上；一例后接 “improvement achieved by…”，另一例接缩写 “(CP)” 及流行病学描述。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目记录

patterns.name: 运动项目名称
patterns.context: 激活落在运动名称 “Archery” 的子词 token 上，句子介绍该运动。

patterns.name: 邮件短语中的 copy
patterns.context: “copy”出现在括号内，指随邮件附上的备忘录副本；强激活集中在该词。

patterns.name: 图像文件名／路径 token
patterns.context: Markdown 图片标记后紧跟类似图像文件名的字符序列，激活落在路径／文件名的若干片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档中的标记或图像引用

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 三角函数取值讨论中，等号 token «=» 与表示 ±1 的公式相邻；同时换行 token 也被标记。

patterns.name: 宗教叙述中的 forgiven
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述信仰经历，描述罪得到宽恕；激活落在 “forgiven”。

patterns.name: 遗传转移步骤后的分号
patterns.context: 技术句子先描述 selection step 及其 associated potential function，分号结束该分句并连接后续 mutation step；激活落在分号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学／遗传算法研究

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 几何学公式中等号连接表达式与零，后接分号和条件说明；强激活在等号及分号。

patterns.name: 公式中的等号
patterns.context: 粒子物理句中公式后以分号连接并列说明，激活落在分号。

en.concept: copy subword and sporadic string features
en.description: Activations mainly fall on copy and words containing copy or appearing in file-copy contexts. They also occur in the tokenization of Cerebral palsy, final y, image-file strings, the fixed expression ROC, and the Observer identifier; these secondary patterns are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: copy subword and file copying
patterns.context: copy occurs in ordinary words, compounds, or file-copy/file-copy contexts, including “colposcopy”, “gonioscopy”, “unit-copy bacterial plasmids”, and “version/copy of the file”; activation falls on the copy token.
patterns.domain: Emails, medical abstracts, research texts, technical documentation; segments 1, 2, 6, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Tokenized spelling of cerebral palsy
patterns.context: “Cerebral palsy” is split into multiple tokens, with activation distributed across the parts of the words, especially the final y.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and NIH project text; segments 3, 4

patterns.name: Word-final y
patterns.context: Activation occurs on word-final y; “Archer«y»” in segment 5 and “y” in the image filename in segment 7 lack shared semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Patent background text, PubMed Central image markup; segments 5, 7

patterns.name: Letter sequence jbm
patterns.context: Occurs in image markup and non-natural-language strings resembling filenames such as “![](yjb m00...)”; appears in the same segment as word-final y.
patterns.domain: Image/file markup in PubMed Central documents; segment 7

patterns.name: under in ROC
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed statistical expression “areas under the ROC curves”.
patterns.domain: Statistical results in medical abstracts; segment 10

patterns.name: Observer identifier
patterns.context: Appears twice as a system/component name in file-copy and failure-recovery instructions.

2_2191.concept: copy 子词及零散字符串特征
2_2191.description: 激活主要落在 copy 及含 copy 的词或文件副本语境，也出现在 Cerebral palsy 的分词、词尾 y、图像文件串、ROC 固定表达和 Observer 标识上；这些旁支难以统一解释。

patterns.name: copy 子词及文件复制
patterns.context: copy 出现在普通词、复合词或文件复制/副本语境中，包括“colposcopy”“gonioscopy”“unit-copy bacterial plasmids”“version/copy of the file”；激活落在 copy 的 token 上。
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学摘要、科研文本、技术文档；段1、2、6、8、9、10

patterns.name: 脑性瘫痪的分词拼写
patterns.context: “Cerebral palsy”被拆成多个 token，激活分布在词的各部分，尤其是结尾 y。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与 NIH 项目文本；段3、4

patterns.name: 词尾 y
patterns.context: 激活出现在词尾 y；段5 的“Archer«y»”及段7 图像文件名中的“y”，缺少共同的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 专利背景文本、PubMed Central 图像标记；段5、7

patterns.name: 字母序列 jbm
patterns.context: 出现在图像标记及文件名“![](yjb m00...)”一类的非自然语言串中；与词尾 y 同段出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档中的图像/文件标记；段7

patterns.name: ROC 下的 under
patterns.context: 出现在“areas under the ROC curves”这一固定统计表达中。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要中的统计结果；段10

patterns.name: Observer 标识
patterns.context: 在文件复制和故障恢复说明中作为系统/组件名称出现两次。

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and code patterns
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments such as spinal and sph in medical text, code identifiers and formatted calls, Portuguese word forms, and email and parliamentary expressions; no single semantic pattern covers all the fragments.

patterns.name: spinal vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in the medical phrases “cerebrospinal fluid” and “spinal cord”; nearby words often include fluid, cord, and injury.

patterns.name: Greek-letter sequence sph
patterns.context: Occurs within medical terms, continuing as “sphygmomanometer” and “sphincter”; it is not a standalone word.

patterns.name: Copy of a document: copy
patterns.context: Appears in “copy attached” or “colposcopy centre”, with meanings related to copying or the name of an examination.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final ar
patterns.context: Embedded in Portuguese word forms such as “gostaríamos” and “libertar”; occurs in parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Code formatting function
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++-style code calls, near format strings or buffers.

patterns.name: Numbers and code identifiers
patterns.context: Part of array sizes, structs, or function names, near underscore identifiers and code.

patterns.name: Exception or unknown-type identifier
patterns.context: Appears in switch/case branches and error-message strings.

patterns.name: Wording in a statistical analysis title
patterns.context: Located at the end of a medical paper title, describing the study design or analysis method.

patterns.name: English formal correspondence
patterns.context: An email quotes a previous memo and proposes arrangements.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and term fragments
patterns.context: Appears in research on urinary incontinence treatment, including a parenthetical abbreviation, expanded terminology, and patient descriptions.

patterns.name: Health programs and affected populations
patterns.context: Introduces rehabilitation goals and populations with stroke, spinal cord injury, or amputation.

patterns.name: Ingestion incident in a medical case
patterns.context: A case report describes mercury ingestion and the patient’s work repairing blood-pressure gauges.

patterns.name: Biochemical experiment and brain-tissue measures
patterns.context: Describes a rat experiment, infusion of artificial cerebrospinal fluid, and changes in biochemical measures in brain tissue.

patterns.name: Quotation about releasing captured persons
patterns.context: Quotes a political statement demanding the release of still-imprisoned missing persons, with a Portuguese equivalent.

2_2191.concept: 异质文本词段与代码模式
2_2191.description: 激活分散于医学文本中的 spinal、sph 等词段、代码标识符与格式化调用、葡语词形及邮件和议会表达；未见能覆盖全部片段的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: spinal 词汇
patterns.context: 出现在医学短语“cerebrospinal fluid”和“spinal cord”中；周围常有 fluid、cord、injury 等词。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、退伍军人康复研究

patterns.name: 希腊字母 sph
patterns.context: 位于医学术语内部，分别接续为“sphygmomanometer”和“sphincter”；不是独立词。

patterns.name: 复制件 copy
patterns.context: 出现在“copy attached”或“colposcopy centre”中，语义与复制或检查名称有关。

patterns.name: 葡语词尾 ar
patterns.context: 嵌在葡语词形中，如“gostaríamos”“libertar”；处于议会发言语境。

patterns.name: 代码格式化函数
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 风格代码调用中，邻近格式串或缓冲区。

patterns.name: 数字与代码标识符
patterns.context: 作为数组大小、结构体或函数名的一部分，邻近下划线标识符与代码。

patterns.name: 异常或未知类型标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 switch/case 分支和错误消息字符串中。

patterns.name: 统计分析标题用语
patterns.context: 位于医学论文标题末尾，描述研究设计或分析方式。

patterns.name: 英文公文表达
patterns.context: 邮件引用此前备忘录并提出安排事项。

patterns.name: 医学缩写与术语碎片
patterns.context: 出现在尿失禁治疗研究中，含括号缩写、术语展开及患者描述。

patterns.name: 健康项目与受影响人群
patterns.context: 介绍康复目标及中风、脊髓损伤或截肢人群。

patterns.name: 医学病例中的摄入事件
patterns.context: 病例报告描述汞摄入及患者维修血压计的情境。

patterns.name: 生化实验与脑组织指标
patterns.context: 描述大鼠实验、人工脑脊液输注及脑组织中的生化指标变化。

patterns.name: 引述释放被俘人员
patterns.context: 引述一项要求释放仍被囚禁失踪人员的政治表述，并附葡语对应内容。

en.concept: Lexical fragments and compound suffixes (especially like)
en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments, like compounds, and several proper names and domain terms. The like suffix recurs across multiple topics, but the other triggers lack a shared semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: “erry” in strings
patterns.context: English names or proper nouns contain spellings such as Jerry, Morley, and Ferry; activation may fall on an internal word fragment rather than a whole word.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographical entries, place or transportation entries

patterns.name: Suffix in the term for banner blindness
patterns.context: Discusses banner blindness and forms a hyphenated like compound after banner.

patterns.name: “like” compound suffix
patterns.context: like attaches to a noun or adjective to form an analogical, similarity, or modifying compound; it appears across different fields.

patterns.name: “cord” in a medical term
patterns.context: Medical context such as spinal cord injury; the visible fragment joins spinal and cord.

patterns.name: Proper name Warburg
patterns.context: Medical text mentions the Warburg effect; activation falls on the latter part of the surname.

patterns.name: Liquid-liquid extraction terminology
patterns.context: Introduces liquid-liquid extraction by a synonymous name; activation falls on a short word and term fragments.

2_2191.concept: 词汇片段与复合词后缀（尤其 like）
2_2191.description: 激活分散于词内片段、like复合词及若干专名和领域术语；like后缀跨多个主题重复出现，但其余触发缺少共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 字符串中包含或切分出“erry”
patterns.context: 英文人名或专名中出现 Jerry、Morley、Ferry 等拼写；激活可能落在词内片段，而非完整单词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、地名或交通条目

patterns.name: 广告盲视术语中的后缀
patterns.context: 讨论广告盲视，并在 banner 后以连字符构成 like 复合词。

patterns.name: “like”复合词后缀
patterns.context: like 附着在名词或形容词后构成类比、相似或修饰性复合词；不同领域均出现。

patterns.name: 医学研究术语中的“cord”
patterns.context: 脊髓损伤等医学语境；可见片段把 spinal 与 cord 连写。

patterns.name: Warburg 专名
patterns.context: 医学文本提及 Warburg effect，激活落在姓氏后半部分。

patterns.name: 液液萃取术语
patterns.context: 以同义名称介绍 liquid-liquid extraction；激活落在短词及术语片段。

en.concept: Heterogeneous structural and word-internal fragment triggers
en.description: Activations span email-list address punctuation and fields, code quotes, newlines, and import paths, as well as word-internal fragments in multilingual parliamentary text; these patterns have no apparent shared meaning or genre condition.

patterns.name: Email addresses and mailing lists
patterns.context: Multiple email addresses are listed consecutively, often with commas, newlines, names, or organization names; activation is distributed across address components and separators

patterns.name: Quotes, newlines, and import statements in code
patterns.context: Program code repeatedly contains line delimiters, string quotes, import statements, and package paths; path fragments also activate
patterns.domain: Github code, including C header files, Java imports, and Go package declarations

patterns.name: Sentence-final words in French political text
patterns.context: In an EU narrative, «stable» at the end of a sentence or phrase receives the strongest activation; nearby content concerns a single currency

patterns.name: Internal fragments of German compounds or long words
patterns.context: In German parliamentary sentences, activation falls on internal subword fragments of compounds and long words, without a shared meaning or fixed part of speech

patterns.name: Danish word fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on word-final fragments in Danish parliamentary text; the examples are insufficient to establish stable lexical conditions

2_2191.concept: 异质的结构与词内片段触发
2_2191.description: 激活覆盖邮箱列表的地址标点与字段、代码的引号换行及导入路径，以及多语种议会文本中的词内片段；这些模式表面上并无统一词义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址与邮箱名单
patterns.trigger: «@»、«.»、«com»、«edu»，以及人名与尖括号邮箱格式
patterns.context: 连续列举多个邮箱地址，常伴随逗号、换行、姓名或组织名；激活分布在地址组成部分及分隔符上
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的收件人/联系人列表

patterns.name: 代码中的引号、换行与导入语句
patterns.context: 程序代码中重复出现行界定符、字符串引号、导入语句和包路径；路径片段也有激活
patterns.domain: Github 代码，包含 C 头文件、Java 导入和 Go 包声明

patterns.name: 法语政治文本中的句末词语
patterns.context: 欧盟叙述中，句末或短语收尾处的 «stable» 获得最强激活；邻近内容谈论单一货币

patterns.name: 德语复合词或长词内部片段
patterns.context: 德语议会句子中，激活落在复合词、长词的内部子词片段，并非统一的词义或固定词类

patterns.name: 丹麦语词语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在丹麦语议会文本的词尾片段；样例不足以确认稳定的词法条件

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word-internal fragments and whole words: case/briefcase, brokers, German compounds, hard(er), probands/probiotics, Newcastle, and conservative. They span domains and contexts, with no stable unified meaning.

patterns.name: Word-internal suffixes or boundary fragments
patterns.context: Triggers fall on parts of longer words or paths rather than stable whole words; examples include “briefcase”, “case”, “probands”, “probiotics”, “brokers”, and “Verteidigungsunion”.
patterns.domain: Legal, code, email, news, and academic texts

patterns.name: “briefcase” and related contexts
patterns.context: One is a briefcase in an evidence list; another is a commentary containing a nuclear strike threat. Their only commonality is “briefcase”; the other contexts differ.

patterns.name: Final segment of a German compound
patterns.context: In German political text, activation lies near an internal boundary in the compound “Verteidigungsunion”.

patterns.name: Email address and encoded string
patterns.context: An address appears in an email header, containing a split-marked domain and escape characters.

patterns.name: case in a code path
patterns.context: A comment for a generated file lists a source-file path containing “case”; activation also covers slashes and fragments in the path.

patterns.name: hard(er) in an astronomy term
patterns.context: Describes a predicted slope as bluer and harder than the observed slope; activation falls mainly on the comparative expression.

patterns.name: Schizophrenia sample terminology
patterns.context: Appears in “schizophrenic probands”, referring to probands in the study sample.

patterns.name: Probiotic word form
patterns.context: Appears in “probiotics”, discussing fungi, the host immune system, and the gastrointestinal tract.

patterns.name: Newcastle in a disease name
patterns.context: A place-name or disease-name fragment remains at the start of an abstract, which then shifts to a trial of surgery for cerebral hemorrhage.

patterns.name: Conservative-related wording
patterns.context: Describes a political figure in one instance and conservative treatment for cerebral hemorrhage in another; the meanings and fields differ, as do the activation locations.

2_2191.description: 激活分散在若干词内片段与完整词上：case/briefcase、brokers、德语复合词、hard(er)、probands/probiotics、Newcastle及conservative。跨领域且上下文差异明显，未见稳定统一语义。

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词边界片段
patterns.context: 触发落在较长词或路径的一部分，并非稳定的完整词；例如“briefcase”“case”“probands”“probiotics”“brokers”“Verteidigungsunion”。
patterns.domain: 法律、代码、邮件、新闻、学术文本

patterns.name: “briefcase”及相关语境
patterns.trigger: “briefcase”[1,6]；另有“briefcase”相邻的“stolen credit cards”[1]、“nuclear”与“infinite damage”[6]
patterns.context: 一个是证物清单中的公文包，另一个是带有核打击威胁的评论；共同点只是出现“briefcase”，其余语境不同。

patterns.name: 德语复合词末段
patterns.context: 德语政治文本中，激活位于复合词“Verteidigungsunion”的内部边界附近。

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址与编码字符串
patterns.context: 地址出现在邮件头，包含被拆分标记的域名和转义字符。

patterns.name: 代码路径中的 case
patterns.context: 生成文件的注释列出一个包含“case”的源文件路径；激活还覆盖路径中的斜杠及片段。

patterns.name: 天文学术语中的 hard(er)
patterns.context: 形容预测斜率比观测斜率更蓝、更硬；激活主要落在比较级表达上。

patterns.name: 精神分裂症样本术语
patterns.context: 出现在“schizophrenic probands”中，指研究样本的先证者。

patterns.name: 益生菌词形
patterns.context: 出现在“probiotics”中，讨论真菌与宿主免疫系统及胃肠道。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的 Newcastle
patterns.context: 作为摘要开头残留的地名或疾病名称片段，随后转入脑出血手术试验。

patterns.name: 保守派相关措辞
patterns.context: 一次描述政治人物，一次描述脑出血的保守治疗；词义和领域不同，且激活位置也不同。

en.description: The clearest recurring cue is English times/timescales, especially in discussions of time required, duration, or scale. Activations also occur across Hungarian fragments, Spanish por, German and citation fragments, as well as financial, WASM, and philosophical contexts; overall, the pattern is mixed.

patterns.name: times in English compounds
patterns.context: In English, times follows phrases describing duration, cost, or scale; examples include standalone times and tokenized forms of timescales.

patterns.name: Internal/cross-word tokenization of times
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized word fragments, with no stable shared semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final and internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates within or at the ends of Hungarian words; it occurs in continuous inflected text, but the specific morphological functions vary.

patterns.name: Spanish preposition por
patterns.context: por appears in academic narration introducing a philosophy lecturer or the subject under discussion.

patterns.name: Accurate/reliable financial information
patterns.context: Requests accurate information about financial conditions.

patterns.name: WASM runtime
patterns.context: Discusses server-side runtimes for running WASM outside a browser; the strongest marker falls on the end of runtimes.

patterns.name: Drilling time in a patent
patterns.context: Geothermal steam wells require substantial drilling time and are expensive.

patterns.name: The term “semantic problem”
patterns.context: A Spanish philosophy paper discusses a problem in semantics and its prior treatment.

patterns.name: Fragments of paper citation identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of ArXiv citation identifiers; there is no clear semantic cue.

patterns.name: Possible character-level or tokenization noise
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across fragments within multilingual words, from which no consistent meaning or grammatical function can be determined.

2_2191.concept: 英文 times 及多语词片
2_2191.description: 最清楚的重复线索是英语 times/timescales，尤其谈论耗时、持续时间或尺度；此外激活散布于匈牙利语词片、西班牙语 por、德语及引文碎片，并有财务、WASM和哲学语境，整体模式混杂。

patterns.name: 英语复合词中的 times
patterns.context: 英语中 times 接在描述持续时间、成本或尺度的词组后；既包括独立的 times，也包括 timescales 的切分形式。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、天体物理学论文

patterns.name: times 的词内/跨词切分
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词片段上，未见稳定的共同语义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 德语议会报告、天体物理学参考文献

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾及词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在匈牙利语单词内部或词尾；出现于词形变化丰富的连续文本中，但具体词法功能并不一致。

patterns.name: 西班牙语介词 por
patterns.context: por 出现在介绍哲学讲授者或讨论对象的学术叙述中。

patterns.name: 精确/可靠财务信息
patterns.context: 要求取得关于财务状况的准确信息。

patterns.name: WASM 运行时
patterns.context: 讨论浏览器之外运行 WASM 的服务器端运行时；最强标记落在 runtimes 的词尾。

patterns.name: 专利钻井耗时
patterns.context: 地热蒸汽井需要大量钻井时间，且成本较高。

patterns.name: 术语“semantic problem”
patterns.context: 西班牙语哲学论文中谈及语义学问题及其既有讨论。

patterns.name: 论文引文标识片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 ArXiv 文献引用标识的内部片段；无明确语义线索。

patterns.name: 疑似字符级或分词噪声
patterns.context: 激活分布在多语言词内部的碎片上，无法从片段独立确定一致词义或语法功能。

en.concept: Word forms/subword fragments and due to
en.description: High activations often fall on within-word fragments split into subwords, especially in Italian, Finnish, Hungarian, Dutch, and French. In English, the due in due to stands out, along with a few instances of times. Patterns vary substantially across corpora, parts of speech, and semantics.

patterns.name: Italian word-form boundary components
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, activation falls within words split across subwords, especially on affixes or stem fragments; no stable sentence-level semantic condition is apparent

patterns.name: Finnish compound-word/word-form fragments
patterns.context: Finnish inflected forms and long compounds are split into multiple tokens; activation concentrates on within-word fragments

patterns.name: Hungarian within-word fragments
patterns.context: Stems, affixes, or within-word fragments spanning tokens in agglutinative Hungarian forms; no clear semantic constraint

patterns.name: Dutch word-form fragments and public hearing terms
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal fragments of Dutch compounds and inflected/derived words, especially words meaning “public hearing” and “organization”

patterns.name: English due to collocation
patterns.context: In English, due to introduces a reason, followed by explanations involving performance, contracts, or costs. There are also activations in adjacent passages that may be affected by word-form segmentation

patterns.name: times in expressions of time/frequency
patterns.context: In the English phrase “numerous times before,” times denotes the number of repeated occurrences; due to does not appear in this passage

patterns.name: Category term in a French statistical definition
patterns.context: When explaining categorical variables and their groupings of values, activation falls on a subword fragment within “catégorielle”; other nearby activations are weaker

patterns.name: Final fragment of a Finnish regulatory term
patterns.context: In parliamentary text discussing continued supervision of member-state markets, activation falls on a long within-word fragment of the compound “valvontakyvyn”; may overlap with other Finnish within-word fragment patterns

patterns.name: Final fragment of a Dutch organization term
patterns.context: In a sentence stating that a public hearing has been organized, activation falls on an internal word-form fragment of the verb “georganiseerd”

patterns.name: English segmented fragment after due to
patterns.context: Describes software being unavailable due to poor performance; strong activation corresponds to due, immediately followed by to

patterns.name: English segmented fragment after due to
patterns.context: In a comment on football transfer prices and contract years, due to introduces the reason for an offer

patterns.name: English segmented fragment after due to
patterns.context: When discussing the cost-effectiveness of rooftop solar, due to introduces labor costs as the reason

patterns.name: English WASM plural ending
patterns.context: Discusses server-side WASM runtimes; high activation falls on times in a technical plural noun phrase

2_2191.concept: 词形/词片段与 due to
2_2191.description: 高激活多落在被子词切分的词内片段，特别是意大利语、芬兰语、匈牙利语、荷兰语和法语；英语中突出 due to 的 due，以及少数 times。跨语料、词类和语义差异较大。

patterns.name: 意大利语词形边界成分
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，激活落在跨子词切分的词内部，尤其是词缀或词干片段；未见稳定的句义条件
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语政治文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语复合词/词形片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语词形变化和长复合词被切分成多个 token；激活集中于词内片段

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语黏着词形中的词干、词缀或跨 token 词内片段；无明显语义限制
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语政治文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词形片段及公开听证会词语
patterns.context: 激活分布于荷兰语复合词与屈折/派生词的内部片段，尤其是“公开听证会”“组织”等词

patterns.name: 英语 due to 搭配
patterns.context: 英语中 due to 引出原因；后接性能、合同或成本等原因说明。另有相邻段内可能受词形切分影响的激活

patterns.name: 时间/次数表达中的 times
patterns.context: 英语短语“numerous times before”中，times 表示反复发生的次数；本段未出现 due to

patterns.name: 法语统计学定义中的类别词
patterns.context: 解释分类变量及其取值分组时，激活落在“catégorielle”的词内片段；其他邻近激活较弱

patterns.name: 芬兰语监管词的尾部片段
patterns.context: 议会文本讨论继续监督成员国市场时，激活落在复合词“valvontakyvyn”的长词内片段；可能与其他芬兰语词内片段模式重叠

patterns.name: 荷兰语组织词尾部片段
patterns.context: 公共听证会已被组织的句子中，激活落在动词“georganiseerd”的内部词形片段

patterns.name: 英语 due to 之后的切分片段
patterns.context: 描述软件因性能差而不可用；强激活对应 due，且其后紧接 to

patterns.name: 英语 due to 之后的切分片段
patterns.context: 足球转会价格及合同年份的评论中，due to 引出报价理由

patterns.name: 英语 due to 之后的切分片段
patterns.context: 讨论太阳能屋顶的成本效益时，due to 引出人工成本这一原因

patterns.name: 英语 WASM 复数词尾
patterns.context: 讨论服务器端 WASM 运行时；高激活落在 times，语境为技术复数名词短语

en.description: Activation often falls on suffixes or final fragments of words across languages, especially Italian infinitives and Estonian inflected words. It also appears on French medical word endings, Java class-name endings, and sporadic English word fragments, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Italian inflected word endings
patterns.context: In Italian, endings or parts of word forms are split into multiple tokens; common in infinitive verbs, and also seen in nouns and adjectives. Activation does not always fall on the complete ending.
patterns.domain: Italian European Parliament and philosophical texts

patterns.name: Estonian word endings
patterns.context: In inflected Estonian words, activation falls on endings or nearby fragments after segmentation; in segment 4 it appears in expressions such as “tuleviku nimel,” while in segment 3 it falls on a later part of the same word.

patterns.name: Fragments within program identifiers
patterns.context: In Java package and class names, activation falls on the end of camel-case class names rather than on ordinary word endings in sentences.

patterns.name: French medical word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on a final fragment of “opératoires,” in a medical account of an uncomplicated postoperative recovery.

patterns.name: Final parts of English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal final part of a comparative adjective and on a separate adverb; the two instances have no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition.

2_2191.description: 激活常落在多语种词的后缀或末尾片段，尤其意大利语不定式、爱沙尼亚语屈折词；也出现在法语医学词尾、Java 类名末尾及英语零散词片段，未见稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 意大利语屈折词尾
patterns.trigger: »ere«、»e«、»i«、»a» 等，尤其长词中的词尾片段，如« red»2«ige»2«re»10、« av»1«via«re»10、« pot»1«ote«re»10
patterns.context: 意大利语中词尾或词形的一部分被切成多个 token；常见于不定式动词，也见于名词或形容词。激活不总落在完整词尾上。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会意大利语、哲学文本

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词尾
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语屈折词中，激活落在分词后的词尾或词尾附近；第4段出现在“tuleviku nimel”一类表达中，第3段则落在同一词的后续部分。

patterns.name: 程序标识符内部片段
patterns.context: Java 包名和类名中，激活落在驼峰式类名的末尾，而非句子中的普通词尾。

patterns.name: 法语医学词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在“opératoires”的词尾片段，处于手术后恢复顺利的医学叙述中。

patterns.name: 英语词的末尾部分
patterns.context: 激活分别落在比较级形容词的词内末尾和独立副词上；两处没有明显共同的句法或语义条件。

en.description: Activation primarily targets within-word or word-final subword fragments across languages, with Italian infinitive -re most prominent; French word endings also recur. Other instances include sporadic English, Dutch, and technical-term fragments, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Italian infinitive ending
patterns.context: Italian infinitive ending -re; strongest in “esprimere” and “potere,” and also occurs in final fragments of words such as “iniziare” and “ricordare”

patterns.name: French word-final fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments occurring at the ends of French words; involve nouns and adjectives, not the same complete word or a fixed meaning
patterns.domain: Academic texts, European Parliament texts, and medical texts

patterns.name: Other Italian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across subword fragments of verbs, nouns, and adjectives in Italian parliamentary sentences; apart from the word-final pattern, no clear consistent semantic condition

patterns.name: English -ing fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in “veiling,” meaning to obscure; no other similar trigger appears in the current examples

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a long Dutch word
patterns.context: Occurs in the plural ending of a word meaning “responsible person”; only one example

patterns.name: French nominal ending
