patterns.context: 标点用于结束表达式、分隔参数/字段或闭合代码块；激活位置随语料切片而变化

patterns.name: 代码中的属性与调用结构
patterns.context: 标识符处在对象属性、方法调用或类型/字段声明等代码结构中，且多与标点边界共现

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量与下标上标
patterns.context: 变量嵌在带下标、上标、求和/序列或函数记号的公式中；局部激活也落在逗号、括号和公式边界
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文、数学问答

patterns.name: 物理公式中的参数记号
patterns.context: 物理量或参数出现在公式后接说明文字的学术段落中

en.concept: Salient terms and markers in technical documents
en.description: Activations occur in fixed disclosure and citation wording in patents, patent numbers, chemical, biochemical, and lens-processing terminology, as well as LaTeX boundaries and mathematical/physical symbols in ArXiv formulas and sale in emails; no single meaning explains all instances.

patterns.name: Fixed wording for disclosed content in patent specifications
patterns.context: Patent backgrounds or specifications introduce prior art or cite references, often at the beginning of a sentence or in fixed legal wording, such as “The disclosures of …”; also includes adjacent contexts such as specifications and claims.

patterns.name: Patent document titles and number citations
patterns.context: Citations to Japanese or other patent documents, with nearby patent office, publication number, year, and identifier.

patterns.name: Closing alignment environments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematics, a formula fragment or summation expression is followed by a line break, an aligned-environment closing marker, and a display-math closing marker.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and operator notation
patterns.context: Mathematical fonts, symbols with subscripts, Hamiltonians, or equality notation occur inside formulas; not necessarily at the end of a passage.

patterns.name: Compound modifiers in chemical substance names
patterns.context: Water-soluble compounds, reactants, and processing steps are listed in patent claims or technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Glycosidic bonds and enzyme activity terminology
patterns.context: Describes hydrolysis of alpha-1,4 bonds between maltose residues and alpha-glucosidase activity.

patterns.name: Lens-processing terminology
patterns.context: Discusses lens edge-finishing steps, contours, and finished-product quality.

patterns.name: Trade terminology in company email
patterns.context: A brief internal email mentions a system trade to Aquila on a certain date.

patterns.name: Trigonometric functions and matrix-index expressions
patterns.context: Formulas contain cosine, indexed variables, or matrix elements; no context clearly connects this pattern to the others.

patterns.name: Superconductivity/particle operator notation
patterns.context: Physical formulas containing spin up/down arrows, creation and annihilation operators, and Hamiltonian symbols.

2_2329.concept: 技术文档中的显著术语与标记
2_2329.description: 激活分布在专利固定披露与引文措辞、专利编号、化学及生化和镜片加工术语，另见ArXiv公式的LaTeX边界与数学/物理符号，以及邮件中的sale；没有单一词义能解释全部。

patterns.name: 专利说明书中披露内容的固定措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中介绍现有技术、引用文献，常出现在句首或固定法律措辞中，如“The disclosures of …”；也包括说明书、claims 等相邻语境。

patterns.name: 专利文献名称及编号引用
patterns.context: 引用日本专利或其他专利文献，附近出现专利局、公布号、年份及编号。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的对齐环境收尾
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中，公式片段或求和表达式之后出现换行、aligned 环境结束符及显示公式结束符。

patterns.name: 数学符号与算符记号
patterns.context: 公式内部出现数学字体、带下标的符号、哈密顿量或等式等记号；未必处于段落收尾。

patterns.name: 化学物质名称中的复合修饰
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或技术描述中列举水溶性化合物、反应物及处理步骤。
patterns.domain: USPTO 化学/材料专利文本

patterns.name: 糖苷键与酶活性术语
patterns.context: 描述麦芽糖残基间 alpha-1,4 键的水解及 alpha-glucosidase 活性。

patterns.name: 镜片加工术语
patterns.context: 讨论镜片边缘精加工步骤、轮廓和成品质量。
patterns.domain: USPTO 光学/制造专利背景

patterns.name: 公司邮件中的交易用语
patterns.context: 简短内部邮件提及某日向 Aquila 的系统交易。

patterns.name: 三角函数与矩阵索引表达式
patterns.context: 公式中包含余弦、带索引的变量或矩阵元素；未见与其他模式明确相连的上下文。

patterns.name: 超导/粒子算符记号
patterns.context: 含自旋上下箭头、产生湮灭算符及哈密顿量符号的物理公式。

en.concept: Sales-related words and a few form-based triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to sales, sell, selling, and other sales-related words and contexts involving marketing, sales training, closing deals, and delivery; two outlier triggers are the place name Jalore and the question mark in a URL query parameter.

patterns.name: sales/sales-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations concentrate in sentences discussing sales, pitching, sales skills, sales training, or sales volume; sometimes the word itself is central, and sometimes it occurs in a compound or collocation.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, Enron business email, Pile-CC training materials

patterns.name: Business discussions of selling, marketing, and delivery
patterns.context: Focuses on how products or services are sold or marketed, whether sales succeed, or how the sales process works; activation words often occur near salespeople, customers, support, pricing, or delivery.

patterns.name: Place name Jalore
patterns.context: Appears in a historical narrative mentioning a person advancing toward Jalore and being recalled there; the context is unrelated to sales or marketing.

patterns.name: q in URL query parameters
patterns.context: Appears in code or link examples where a question mark introduces URL query parameters; activation centers on the question mark rather than the surrounding link text.
patterns.domain: HackerNews technical discussions and code examples

2_2329.concept: 销售相关词及少数词形触发
2_2329.description: 主要响应 sales、sell、selling 等销售词及营销、销售培训、成交和交付语境；另有 Jalore 地名与 URL 查询参数问号两类离群触发。

patterns.name: sales／销售相关词汇
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在讨论销售、推销、销售能力、销售培训或销售量的语句中；有时词本身是中心词，有时处于复合词或搭配中。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、Enron 商务邮件、Pile-CC 培训材料

patterns.name: 售卖、营销与交付的业务讨论
patterns.context: 围绕产品或服务如何销售、营销，销售是否成功或销售流程如何运作；激活词常与销售人员、客户支持、价格或交付相邻。

patterns.name: Jalore 地名
patterns.context: 出现在历史叙述中，提及人物向 Jalore 推进及被召回至该地；上下文并非销售或营销。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科历史条目

patterns.name: URL 查询参数中的 q
patterns.context: 出现在代码或链接示例里，问号引出 URL 查询参数；激活集中于问号，而非周围的链接文字。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论及代码示例

en.description: All passages contain a form of sales or an adjacent word in a buying/selling context; the core response is to sales, selling, seller, salesman, and related product marketing, transactions, and sales-volume contexts, across forums, email, legal, and industry text.

patterns.name: sales forms and sales-related words
patterns.context: Highly sensitive to sales and its derived forms; no fixed syntactic position or particular type of sale is required.
patterns.domain: Forums, business email, legal text, news narratives, and other genres

patterns.name: Marketing and sales processes
patterns.context: Discusses how products or services are promoted, sold, or delivered, or focuses on sales models and sales volume; sales terms co-occur with commercial-context words such as market, product, affiliate, and delivery.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions of products, applications, and business models

patterns.name: Sales department contact details
patterns.context: Sales appears as part of an email address in sentences inviting contact for questions or inquiries; here it does not denote an ordinary sales action.

patterns.name: Energy trading and regulatory disclosures
patterns.context: Sales occur near purchase transactions, prices, exemptions, disclosures, and other regulatory or trading information.
patterns.domain: Enron email and energy regulatory materials

patterns.name: Buyers and sellers in contract disputes
patterns.context: Describes consumers purchasing goods, a salesperson’s understanding, or whether the parties reached an agreement.

patterns.name: Dealer sales and industry customers
patterns.context: Describes trucks as a best-selling product and the share of dealer sales attributable to oil and gas operators.

2_2329.concept: 销售与商业交易
2_2329.description: 所有段落都含 sales 词形或紧邻的买卖语境词；核心响应是 sales、selling、seller、salesman 等及产品营销、交易、销售额相关上下文，覆盖论坛、邮件、法律和行业文本。

patterns.name: sales 词形及销售相关词
patterns.context: 对 sales 及其派生形式高度敏感；不要求固定句法位置，也不要求它表示特定类型的销售。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、商务邮件、法律文本、新闻叙述等多种文体

patterns.name: 市场营销与销售流程
patterns.context: 围绕产品或服务如何推广、售卖、交付，或销售模式及销售额展开讨论；销售词与 market、product、affiliate、delivery 等商业语境词共现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 产品、应用和商业模式讨论

patterns.name: 销售部门联系方式
patterns.context: sales 作为邮箱地址的一部分，出现在邀请联系咨询或查询的句子中；此处并非普通语义上的销售动作。

patterns.name: 能源交易及监管披露
patterns.context: 销售与采购交易、价格、豁免披露等监管或交易信息相邻。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及能源监管材料

patterns.name: 买卖双方与合同争议
patterns.context: 描述消费者购买商品、销售人员的理解，或买卖双方是否达成合意。

patterns.name: 经销商销售额与行业客户
patterns.context: 描述卡车作为畅销商品，以及经销商销售中来自油气运营商的比例。

en.concept: Gestational-age expressions and incidental subword fragments
en.description: The most stable pattern is “weeks gestation” in obstetric texts. Other high activations are scattered across within-word fragments: ity, use, akes, ender, spanning different meanings and styles, with no consistent semantics or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Gestational weeks and age
patterns.context: Describes pregnant women at a specific gestational week or stage, often near thresholds such as 20 or 17 weeks

patterns.name: Within-word string ity
patterns.context: Activation falls on a letter fragment within a word; occurs in comity, Garrity, and MIA, with different meanings and contexts

patterns.name: Within-word string use
patterns.context: Activation falls on the use substring within museums, in a tagged social-media topic
patterns.domain: Online comments, discussions of race relations

patterns.name: Within-word string handshake
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending fragment of handshakes, in discussions about handshakes and gender

patterns.name: Within-word string ender
patterns.context: Activation falls within the word slender, describing a person's appearance

2_2329.concept: 孕龄表达及偶然词片段
2_2329.description: 最稳定的模式是产科文本中的 weeks gestation。其余高激活分散在词内片段：ity、use、akes、ender，涉及不同词义与文体，未见一致语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 妊娠周数与孕龄
patterns.context: 描述孕妇在妊娠特定周数或孕龄阶段，常见于20周、17周等阈值附近
patterns.domain: 产科医学研究、专利背景

patterns.name: 词内字符串 ity
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字母片段；对应 comity、Garrity、MIA，词义和上下文不相同
patterns.domain: 法律文本、人物传记、网页文本

patterns.name: 词内字符串 use
patterns.context: 激活落在 museums 一词内部的 use 子串，出现在带标签的社交媒体话题中
patterns.domain: 网络评论、种族关系讨论

patterns.name: 词内字符串 handshake
patterns.context: 激活落在 handshakes 的词尾片段，出现于关于握手与性别的讨论

patterns.name: 词内字符串 ender
patterns.context: 激活落在 slender 一词内部，描述人物体貌

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and tokenization boundaries
en.description: Activations mainly fall on segmented string fragments: Amity, Muse/museums, several proper names, and technical terms; there is also sporadic follow-up. Domains and semantics vary widely, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary in the string Amity
patterns.context: Amity is split into multiple subword tokens; occurs in school or treatment-program names

patterns.name: Internal fragments of the string Museums
patterns.context: Museums is split within the word, with activations concentrated on the muse/use fragments; occurs in hashtags, category headings, or category entries

patterns.name: Split fragments in place names or proper names
patterns.context: Subword fragments in proper names are marked, including place names, personal names, and titles; no stable shared semantics are apparent

patterns.name: Fragments within specific word forms
patterns.context: Technical terms in texts about bacterial resistance are split into subwords; activations fall within gene or drug names

patterns.name: aff fragment in legal citations
patterns.context: The surname Schaffer is tokenized in case citations, with activation on the medial aff fragment

patterns.name: Split fragments in musician names
patterns.context: Names in music-competition lists are split into multiple subwords; activation fragments are scattered and vary in strength

patterns.name: Title fragments in bibliography entries
patterns.context: Activations occur near work titles and italic/underline markup in bibliography lists; there is also the name fragment Shay

patterns.name: Muse in jazz discographies
patterns.context: The record label Muse in parentheses in a discography is split; its spelling resembles muse/museums in paragraphs 4 and 5

patterns.name: The follow fragment in ordinary words
patterns.context: The word post-treatment follow-up is split in a research abstract; activation is weak

2_2329.concept: 特定子词片段与分词边界
2_2329.description: 激活主要落在被拆分的字符串片段上：Amity、Muse/museums、若干专名及专业术语；另有零星的 follow-up。领域和语义差异很大，难以归为同一语义类别。

patterns.name: Amity 字符串的分词边界
patterns.context: Amity 被拆成多个子词 token；位于学校名称或治疗项目名称中

patterns.name: Museums 字符串的内部片段
patterns.context: Museums 在单词内部被切分，激活集中于 muse/use 片段；出现在话题标签、分类标题或分类条目中

patterns.name: 地名或专名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 专名中的子词片段被标记，包括地名、人名及作品名；未见稳定的共同语义

patterns.name: 特定词形内部的片段
patterns.context: 细菌耐药相关文本中的专业术语被拆成子词；激活落在基因名或药物名内部

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 aff 片段
patterns.context: 判例引述中姓氏 Schaffer 被分词，激活落于中间的 aff 片段

patterns.name: 音乐人姓名中的切分片段
patterns.context: 音乐竞赛名单中的人名被切成多个子词；激活片段分散且强度不一

patterns.name: 书目条目中的作品名片段
patterns.context: 书目列表中作品标题及斜体/下划线标记附近出现激活，另有姓名片段 Shay

patterns.name: 爵士唱片目录中的 Muse
patterns.context: 唱片目录括号内的唱片厂牌 Muse 被拆分；与第4、5段的 muse/museums 字形相似

patterns.name: 普通词语中的 follow 片段
patterns.context: 研究摘要中 post-treatment follow-up 一词被拆分，激活很弱

en.description: The most prominent pattern is the within-word fragment «align» in malignant/non-malignant in medical contexts; proper names such as Amity and Maysville, as well as marriage-related contexts, also trigger activation. Other activations are scattered across diverse terms and styles, without a unified context.

patterns.name: malignant/non-malignant contrast
patterns.context: Embedded in the stems of malignant/non-malignant; commonly occurs in contrasts between malignant and non-malignant lesions, cells, or tissues.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, patent background, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Amity project name
patterns.context: Triggered by the proper name “Amity,” in the context of NIH project descriptions analyzing data from prior projects.

patterns.name: May’sville place name
patterns.context: Triggered by the place name “Maysville” in parentheses as a product origin, alongside the U.S. state abbreviation KY.

patterns.name: May and marriage-related context
patterns.context: Occurs in a private email discussing a father's name and whether someone will get married; the same passage also contains ordinary thought and referential-word activations.

patterns.name: Various low-intensity term and component triggers
patterns.context: Scattered words, punctuation, spaces, or within-word fragments across passages; some occur in medical discussion, others in email, project descriptions, product copy, or patent text, with no shared specific contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes email, biomedicine, project descriptions, product descriptions, and patents

2_2329.concept: malignant／non-malignant 词干片段
2_2329.description: 最突出的模式是医学语境中 malignant／non-malignant 的词内片段 «align»；另有 Amity、Maysville 等专名及婚姻语境触发。其余激活零散分布于多种词项和文体，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: malignant／non-malignant 对照
patterns.context: 嵌在 malignant／non-malignant 这组词的词干中；常见于描述恶性与非恶性病变、细胞或组织的对照。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景、科研项目说明

patterns.name: Amity 项目名称
patterns.context: 触发于项目专名 “Amity”，出现在 NIH 项目说明对既有项目数据进行分析的语境中。

patterns.name: May’sville 地名
patterns.context: 触发于产品产地括号中的地名 “Maysville”，并与美国州缩写 KY 同现。

patterns.name: May 与婚姻语境
patterns.context: 在谈及父亲姓名、某人是否会结婚的私人邮件中出现；同段还含普通思考与指代词激活。

patterns.name: 多种低强度词项与成分触发
patterns.context: 各段中零散出现的词、标点、空格或词内片段；有些位于医学论述，有些来自邮件、项目说明、商品文案或专利文本，未见共同的具体语境条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；包括邮件、生物医学、项目说明、商品描述和专利

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the within-word fragment align in malignant/non-malignant in medical contexts, and also covers premalignant and definitions of tumor abbreviations; there are occasional activations on non-medical word forms such as Masons and Museums.

patterns.name: malignant/non-malignant contrast
patterns.context: In medical texts, occurs alongside or in contrast with malignant, often modifying effusions, lesions, cells, tissues, diagnoses, and similar terms; activation is concentrated on the align portion.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, patent background, and research abstracts

patterns.name: premalignant word form
patterns.context: Describes the precancerous nature of a lesion, in contexts involving symptoms, risk, or patient concerns.

patterns.name: malignant abbreviation entry
patterns.context: A tumor name is defined in an abbreviation list; activation falls within malignant in that name.

patterns.name: Masons in a proper name
patterns.context: An ordinary spelling fragment in the U.S. Navy ship name USS Masons; no malignancy or medical semantics.

patterns.name: museums in a social-media hashtag
patterns.context: Within-word fragment in the hashtag #Museumsrespond; unrelated to the medical context.

2_2329.concept: 医学恶性相关词形片段
2_2329.description: 主要对医学语境中 malignant/non-malignant 的词内片段 align 强烈响应，也覆盖 premalignant 和肿瘤缩写定义；另有 Masons、Museums 等非医学词形偶发激活。

patterns.name: malignant/non-malignant 对照
patterns.context: 在医学文本中与 malignant 并列或对照，常修饰 effusions、lesions、cells、tissues、diagnoses 等；激活集中在 align 部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景和研究摘要

patterns.name: premalignant 词形
patterns.context: 描述病变的癌前性质，出现在有关症状、风险或患者担忧的语境中。

patterns.name: malignant 缩写表项
patterns.context: 缩写表中给出肿瘤名称定义；激活落在该名称的 malignant 内部。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Masons
patterns.context: 美国海军舰名 USS Masons 中的普通拼写片段；无恶性或医学语义。

patterns.name: 社交媒体话题中的 museums
patterns.context: 标签 #Museumsrespond 的词内片段；与医学语境无关。

en.description: All fragment activations are concentrated within words or abbreviations containing M, such as Moser, MCI, malignant, Movember, and MBA; no stable thematic or syntactic condition is apparent, and activation may primarily respond to specific within-word subword fragments.

patterns.name: Strings containing m-related letters
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment or character sequence after M; includes full words, proper names, and abbreviations, without requiring a fixed syntactic or semantic context.
patterns.domain: Mixed: academic, medical, patent, literary, online texts, etc.

2_2329.concept: M 开头词的词内片段
2_2329.description: 所有片段的激活都集中在带 M 的词或缩写内部：如 Moser、MCI、malignant、Movember、MBA；未见稳定的主题或句法条件，可能主要响应特定词内子词片段。

patterns.name: 含 m 相关字母串
patterns.trigger: M«oser», M«CI», M«oser», «M»1…«oser», non-m«align», M«ovember», M«BA»
patterns.context: 激活落在 M 之后的子词片段或词内字符序列；包含完整词、专名、缩写，且不要求固定句法或语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 混合：学术、医学、专利、文学、网络文本等

en.description: Activates mainly on stem fragments in medical words such as malignant and malignancies, especially align after m; there are also sporadic character fragments such as isf, standalone S, use, and A in Q&A, spanning domains without a unified semantics.

patterns.name: malign/malignant word forms
patterns.context: Activation often falls on stem fragments in medical terms such as malignant, malignancies, and non-malignant; contexts include contrasts between positive and non-positive lesions, as well as malignant tumors and diagnoses.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, clinical research, and medical patent background

patterns.name: isf string fragment
patterns.context: Occurs as a character fragment within English words or in software configuration keys; there is no consistent semantic or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Literary texts, film descriptions, software configuration

patterns.name: Possessive/plural s
patterns.context: In uppercase contract-clause headings, activation falls on the final letter of plural or possessive forms.

patterns.name: Museums character fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in “Museums” in a hashtag about race relations related to Ferguson; semantically inconsistent with the medical word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Letter in a Q&A title
patterns.context: In music-album promotional copy mentioning that an event concluded with a Q&A session, activation falls on the A in Q&A.

2_2329.concept: malign 词干识别
2_2329.description: 主要激活于 malignant、malignancies 等医学词的词干片段，尤其是 m 后的 align；另有 isf、单独的 S、use、Q&A 中 A 等零散字符片段，跨领域且缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: malign/malignant 词形
patterns.trigger: «align»、«malign»，尤其是 «align» 前接未标记的“m”或在词内拆分出的“m”；见“m«align»9ant”“M«align»9ant”“m«isf»…（非此类）”等
patterns.context: 激活多落在 malignant、malignancies、non-malignant 等医学词汇的词干片段上；既有阳性与非阳性病变的对照，也有恶性肿瘤、诊断等上下文。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、临床研究与专利医学背景

patterns.name: isf 字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文单词内部的字符片段或软件配置键中；没有一致的语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 文学文本、电影简介、软件配置

patterns.name: 所有格/复数 s
patterns.context: 合同条款标题的全大写文本中，激活落在复数或所有格形式的末尾字母。

patterns.name: Museums 字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Ferguson 相关种族关系话题标签中的“Museums”字样；语义上与医学词形模式不相符。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或社交媒体文本

patterns.name: 问答标题字母
patterns.context: 音乐专辑宣传文案提到活动以问答环节结束时，激活落在 Q&A 的 A。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the Magento name and its PHP namespace; activation also occurs in misfortune/Misfit, image-orientation handling code, and code containing Boolean values and color arrays, with weaker associations in the latter cases.

patterns.name: Magento namespaces and identifiers
patterns.context: Magento brand name or Magento in PHP namespaces and class names; occurs in code, documentation, or link text.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in “Misfortune”
patterns.context: misfortune occurs in English poetry or prose; another instance is Misfit in a game plot summary.

patterns.name: Image and TIFF orientation information
patterns.context: A code comment describes converting image orientation based on Orientation metadata in TIFF.

patterns.name: Magento string value in a configuration fragment
patterns.context: In XML configuration, a Magento helper-class namespace occurs as a string value.

patterns.name: Color arrays and Boolean values
patterns.context: Code fragments with variable assignments and arrays of color names; not clearly related to the themes of the other high-activation fragments.

2_2329.concept: Magento 名称与代码标识符
2_2329.description: 最稳定的触发因素是 Magento 名称及其 PHP 命名空间；另在 misfortune/Misfit、图像方向处理代码和含布尔值、颜色数组的代码中激活，后几类关联较弱。

patterns.name: Magento 命名空间与标识符
patterns.context: Magento 品牌名或 PHP 命名空间、类名中的 Magento；出现在代码、文档或链接文本中。

patterns.name: “Misfortune”词内片段
patterns.context: 英文诗歌或散文中出现 misfortune；另一次为游戏剧情简介中的 Misfit。

patterns.name: 图像及 TIFF 方向信息
patterns.trigger: « to»1« transform»6 the« i»1«am»1«ge»2 at right« orientation»1；«t»«iff»«Orientation»
patterns.context: 代码注释描述按 TIFF 元数据中的 Orientation 转换图像方向。

patterns.name: 配置片段中的 Magento 字符串值
patterns.context: XML 配置中，Magento 帮助类命名空间作为字符串值出现。

patterns.name: 颜色数组与布尔值
patterns.context: 变量赋值及颜色名称数组的代码片段；与其他高激活片段主题不明显相同。

en.description: All fragments activate on the internal substring agent in Magento or magenta: the former is typically M-agent-o, the latter m-agent-a. The former commonly occurs in Magento code and discussions, the latter in color lists and printing patent text.

patterns.name: agento string in the name Magento
patterns.context: The trigger point is at an internal segmentation of the brand name Magento, spelled M + agent + o; it also occurs at the segmentation of magenta, spelled m + agent + a. Activation is stronger in Magento.
patterns.domain: Magento code, Q&A, and links; also printing/color patent text

patterns.name: Magento namespaces and class names in code
patterns.context: Occurs in Magento PHP classes, namespaces, configuration, or API-related text; often adjacent to backslashes, identifiers, and code punctuation.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: magenta color name
patterns.context: Part of the color word magenta, in four-color printing descriptions or color lists; surrounding text mentions colors such as cyan, yellow, red, green, and blue.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background text, GitHub color arrays

2_2329.concept: 品牌/颜色词中的 agent 子串
2_2329.description: 所有片段均激活在 Magento 或 magenta 的内部子串 agent 上：前者通常为 M-agent-o，后者为 m-agent-a。前者常见于 Magento 代码与讨论，后者见于颜色列表及印刷专利文本。

patterns.name: Magento 名称中的 agento 字符串
patterns.context: 触发点位于品牌名 Magento 的内部切分处，拼写为 M + agent + o；也出现在缩写 magenta 的拼写切分处，拼写为 m + agent + a。Magento 中强度更高。
patterns.domain: Magento 代码、问答和链接；另有印刷/颜色专利文本

patterns.name: 代码中的 Magento 命名空间与类名
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento PHP 类、命名空间、配置或 API 相关文本中；常邻接反斜线、标识符及代码标点。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: magenta 颜色名称
patterns.context: 作为 magenta 这一颜色词的一部分，出现在印刷四色说明或颜色列表中；周围提及 cyan、yellow、red、green、blue 等颜色。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景文本、GitHub 颜色数组

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on agent→o in the string Magento and agent→a in the color name magenta; they also occur in Magento namespaces and product/API discussions. There are also sporadic activations on line breaks, XML tags, and word endings in auth and categories.

patterns.name: Magento/Magent(o) identifiers
patterns.context: The character fragment agent is followed by o or a; occurs in both the Magento brand/namespace and the color name magenta.
patterns.domain: Magento code, product discussions; color descriptions

patterns.name: magenta in color tables
patterns.context: Occurs in color lists or four-color printing/color-key sequences, often alongside color names such as cyan, yellow, and black.
patterns.domain: Program data, patent descriptions of color and printing

patterns.name: Magento product and API discussions
patterns.context: Q&A about Magento stores, products, categories, or APIs; not all related words themselves are marked as activations.

patterns.name: Magento PHP namespaces and object-management code
patterns.context: Magento namespace class names in PHP code, often adjacent to calls such as objectManager and create.

patterns.name: Line-leading newline markers
patterns.context: Line breaks in code, XML, or Q&A snippets; they occur in multiple passages, but many line breaks are unmarked, so they cannot independently explain the main activations.

patterns.name: xliff closing tag in XML
patterns.context: Occurs in the closing tag “</xliff>” in an XML fragment.

patterns.name: auth identifier
patterns.context: Part of a PHP property or variable name, adjacent to object creation and a Backend class.

patterns.name: Plural ending in a category word
patterns.context: Occurs in the misspelling catogories in a question title.

2_2329.concept: Magento/颜色名中的 agent 子串
2_2329.description: 强激活主要落在 Magento 字符串中的 agent→o，以及颜色名 magenta 中的 agent→a；也见于 Magento 命名空间、产品/API 讨论。另有零星换行、XML 标签和 auth、categories 词尾激活。

patterns.name: Magento/Magent(o) 标识
patterns.context: 字符片段 agent 后紧接 o 或 a；既出现在 Magento 品牌/命名空间中，也出现在颜色名 magenta 中。
patterns.domain: Magento 代码、产品讨论；颜色说明

patterns.name: 颜色表中的 magenta
patterns.context: 位于颜色列表或印刷四色/色键序列中，前后常有 cyan、yellow、black 等颜色名。
patterns.domain: 程序数据、专利中的颜色与印刷描述

patterns.name: Magento 产品与 API 讨论
patterns.trigger: Magento/Magent(o) 名称，如“Magento”“M«agent»o”，以及“simple product”“Custom API”
patterns.context: 围绕 Magento 商店、产品、分类或 API 的问答；并非所有同主题词本身都标记为激活。

patterns.name: Magento PHP 命名空间与对象管理代码
patterns.context: PHP 代码中的 Magento 命名空间类名，常与 objectManager、create 等调用相邻。

patterns.name: 行首换行标记
patterns.context: 代码、XML 或问答片段的换行位置；多段出现，但也有大量未标记换行，不能单独解释主要激活。

patterns.name: XML 中的 xliff 结束标记
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 片段的闭合标签“</xliff>”中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 XML/本地化文本

patterns.name: auth 标识
patterns.context: 作为 PHP 属性或变量名的一部分，邻近对象创建与 Backend 类。

patterns.name: 类别复数词尾
patterns.context: 出现在问题标题中的拼写变体 catogories。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on internal fragments of Magento/Mage identifiers; fragments of magenta in color sequences also activate, especially alongside cyan and yellow. The two uses share similar orthographic fragments but occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: Mage/Magento identifiers in Magento
patterns.context: Occurs in Magento namespaces, class names, API/product terms, or titles; common forms include Magento\…, Mage\…, and Mage - …. Activation is concentrated on internal fragments of the brand name and does not require a fixed syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Magento developer Q&A, PHP code, technical titles

patterns.name: Lowercase m suffix in color abbreviations
patterns.context: In RGB/printing color abbreviations or sequences of color names, adjacent to items such as cyan, yellow, and black; not in a Magento context.
patterns.domain: Code examples, patent descriptions of color and printing

2_2329.concept: Mage/Magenta 字形片段
2_2329.description: 激活主要落在 Magento/Mage 标识符的内部片段；另在颜色序列里的 magenta 片段也激活，尤其与 cyan、yellow 等并列时。两种用法共享相似字形片段，但语境不同。

patterns.name: Magento 中的 Mage/Magento 标识符
patterns.trigger: «M»«agent»«o»（有时开头为 «Mag»ento），以及相关的 «Catal»og、«Design» 等
patterns.context: 出现在 Magento 的命名空间、类名、API/产品术语或标题中；常见形式为 Magento\…、Mage\…、Mage - …。激活集中在品牌名的内部片段，不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: Magento 开发问答、PHP 代码、技术标题

patterns.name: 颜色缩写中的小写 m 后缀
patterns.context: 在 RGB/印刷色彩缩写或颜色名称序列中，紧邻 cyan、yellow、black 等颜色项；并非 Magento 语境。
patterns.domain: 代码示例、专利中的颜色与印刷说明

en.concept: Malta place name and sporadic high activations
en.description: The most stable pattern is the place name Malta appearing across languages and styles. Other activations are scattered across news reading, mathematical formulas, programming Q&A, and number lists, with no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Place name Malta
patterns.context: The country/place name Malta appears in English or other European-language texts and activates in varied contexts, including diplomacy, sports, history, and schools.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, history books, military history, sports news, school entries

patterns.name: Teenagers and news reading
patterns.context: Sentences discuss teenagers reading news online and its possible effects.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign and numbers appear at the end of a polynomial equation; activation is concentrated on expression symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Buffers in code Q&A
patterns.context: A question asks how to obtain a buffer's value; the answer mentions Buffer.from(array) and array code.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in number sequences
patterns.context: Long numbers are split into multiple tokens in comma-separated, bracketed numeric lists.

2_2729.concept: Malta 地名及零散高激活
2_2729.description: 最稳定的模式是不同语言和文体中出现地名 Malta；其余激活分散在新闻阅读、数学公式、编程问答和数字列表中，未见共同的明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Malta 地名
patterns.context: 英文或其他欧洲语言文本中出现国家/地名 Malta；在外交、体育、历史、学校等不同上下文中均触发
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、历史书籍、军事史、体育新闻、学校条目

patterns.name: 青少年与新闻阅读
patterns.context: 句子谈论青少年在线阅读新闻及其可能影响

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 多项式方程末尾出现负号及数值；激活集中于表达式符号和数字

patterns.name: 代码问答中的缓冲区
patterns.context: 询问如何取得 buffer 的值，答案提到 Buffer.from(array) 和数组代码

patterns.name: 数字序列中的数值片段
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的方括号数值列表中，长数字被拆分为多个 token

en.description: Primarily responds to the word Malta; also responds to opening square brackets that begin arrays or lists in various code or data snippets, often at the start of structured content or nested data.

patterns.name: Place name Malta
patterns.context: Appears as a country or place name in political, historical, military, or sports texts; activation falls on the complete word Malta.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary texts, historical fiction, naval history, football biographies

patterns.name: Opening brackets in code
patterns.context: Square brackets open arrays/lists or nested records in code or serialized data; activation falls on the opening bracket.

2_2729.description: 主要响应词语 Malta；另在多种代码或数据片段中响应开启数组/列表的左方括号，常处于结构化内容或嵌套数据开头。

patterns.name: 地名 Malta
patterns.context: 在政治、历史、军事或体育文本中作为国家或地点名出现；激活落在完整词 Malta 上。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、历史小说、海军史、足球传记

patterns.name: 代码中的数组起始括号
patterns.context: 代码或序列化数据中，方括号开启数组/列表或嵌套记录；激活落在左方括号上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、GitHub 代码

en.concept: Boundaries and fields in structured text
en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of formatted text: arrays/lists beginning with square brackets are most prominent. Other examples include PHP identifiers, slash-delimited paths, mixed alphanumeric machine fields, names, Polish political sentences, email templates, news links, and email address books.

patterns.name: Opening array bracket
patterns.context: Square brackets appear in code or data sequences, especially at the start of array/list elements; activation is often strongest on the opening bracket.

patterns.name: PHP-related identifiers
patterns.context: PHP tags or PHP project/component names, near PHP and related code identifiers.

patterns.name: Slash-delimited paths
patterns.context: Strings with paths, namespaces, or addresses separated by slashes; the slash and adjacent path fragments may activate.
patterns.domain: Source comments/file paths, email address books, URLs

patterns.name: Long mixed alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Continuous machine-formatted fields or instructions made up of numbers, letters, and separators; activation falls on multiple fragments within the field.

patterns.name: Names and signature lists
patterns.context: Personal names are comma-separated in software component lists or author/contributor lists.

patterns.name: Polish political text
patterns.context: Polish sentences discuss the country, political systems, and EU accession; high activation occurs on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Email marketing template
patterns.context: A revenue/rating email template with image placeholders and a “click here” link.
patterns.domain: Marketing or notification emails in Enron mail

patterns.name: News article links and paywall prompts
patterns.context: A news URL is followed by an article prompt, especially copy for a paywall-free link.

patterns.name: Email recipient address book
patterns.context: Email headers or contact-list fields continuously list companies, departments, email addresses, and contact names.

2_2729.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与字段
2_2729.description: 激活分布于多种格式化文本：方括号起始的数组/列表最突出；另见 PHP 标识符、斜杠路径、混合字母数字机器字段，以及人名、波兰语政治句、邮件模板、新闻链接和邮箱地址簿。

patterns.name: 数组开括号
patterns.context: 代码或数据序列中出现方括号，尤其是数组/列表元素开始处；强度常在左方括号最高

patterns.name: PHP相关标识符
patterns.context: PHP 标签或 PHP 项目/组件名称中，PHP及相关代码标识符附近

patterns.name: 斜杠分隔路径
patterns.context: 路径、命名空间或地址以斜杠分隔的字符串；斜杠与邻近路径片段均可能激活
patterns.domain: 源码注释/文件路径、邮件地址簿、URL

patterns.name: 混合字母数字的长标识符
patterns.context: 数字、字母与分隔符组成的连续机器格式字段或指令；激活落在字段内部多个片段
patterns.domain: 数值数据、汇编/低级代码

patterns.name: 人名与署名列表
patterns.context: 软件组件清单或作者/贡献者名单中，个人姓名以逗号分隔

patterns.name: 波兰语政治文本
patterns.context: 波兰语句子谈及国家、政治制度及欧盟加入；高激活出现在词内片段

patterns.name: 邮件营销模板
patterns.context: 带图片占位符和“点击此处”链接的收益/评级邮件模板
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的营销或通知邮件

patterns.name: 新闻文章链接与付费墙提示
patterns.context: 新闻 URL 后接文章正文提示，尤其是免付费墙链接文案

patterns.name: 邮件收发人地址簿
patterns.context: 连续列出公司、部门、邮箱及联系人姓名的邮件头或通讯录字段

en.description: Activations occur across varied texts and often fall on fragments within segmented words, especially Leibman in names/email addresses, medical terms, and nanomaterials terms. Other examples include code numbers and punctuation, Polish fragments, and book layout numbering. No single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Numeric tokens in a buffer example
patterns.context: In code Q&A, array syntax occurs next to a Buffer.from example; activation falls on square brackets and numbers/punctuation.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in names and author lists
patterns.context: Names appear in project author lists or email recipient lists, with some names split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Leibman fragment in an institutional address
patterns.context: Leibman appears as part of an address identifier in an email address or corporate-directory-style address.

patterns.name: ib fragment in medical narratives or terminology
patterns.context: Embedded in subword segmentation of disease names or medical terms; occurs in personal accounts of illness or lists of disease terms.
patterns.domain: Personal health emails, NIH medical texts

patterns.name: ribbons fragment in a nanomaterials term
patterns.context: In the materials term “graphene nanoribbons,” activation falls on an internal fragment of nanoribbons.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in Polish words
patterns.context: In Polish sentences, letter fragments occur within words meaning “my country” and similar.

patterns.name: temporomandibular fragment in disease terminology
patterns.context: A long medical term in a list of chronic pain conditions is split into multiple subword tokens.

patterns.name: Typography spaces near section headings/numbers
patterns.context: Indentation spaces, page numbers, and section numbering appear at transitions from body text to chapter headings; there is no clear semantic condition shared with other triggers.

2_2729.description: 激活分布于多种文本，常落在被切分的词内片段，尤其姓名/邮件地址中的 Leibman、医学词及纳米材料词；另见代码数字标点、波兰语片段和书籍排版编号。缺少单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 缓冲区示例中的数字 token
patterns.context: 代码问答中，数组语法紧邻 Buffer.from 示例；激活落在方括号及数字/标点上。

patterns.name: 姓名与作者名单中的字母片段
patterns.context: 人名出现在项目作者名单或邮件收件人列表中，部分姓名被切分为子词 token。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的 Leibman 片段
patterns.context: 邮箱地址/企业目录式地址中，Leibman 作为地址标识的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 医学叙述或术语中的 ib 片段
patterns.context: 嵌在疾病名称或医学相关词的子词切分中；出现于疾病个人叙述或疾病术语列表。
patterns.domain: 个人健康邮件、NIH 医学文本

patterns.name: 纳米材料术语中的 ribbons 片段
patterns.context: “graphene nanoribbons”材料术语中，激活落在 nanoribbons 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 波兰语词中的字母片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，字母片段嵌在表示“我的国家”等词语里。

patterns.name: 疾病术语中的 temporomandibular 片段
patterns.context: 慢性疼痛病症列表中的长医学术语，被切成多个子词 token。

patterns.name: 排版空格及章节/数字附近
patterns.context: 正文转章标题时出现缩进空格、页码和章节编号；没有明显与其他触发词相同的语义条件。

en.description: The most stable commonality is an opening square bracket: it introduces citations, labels, placeholders, or array data across varied corpora and formats. A few slash-delimited terms/paths and unrelated words also activate.

patterns.name: Square brackets introducing citations or labels
patterns.context: Square brackets begin bibliographic citations, entity labels, descriptive markers, or placeholders for unreadable content; the bracketed contents vary.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, and research abstracts; code documentation and NIH project texts

patterns.name: Square brackets introducing arrays or data items
patterns.context: Square brackets begin lists, nested arrays, or groups of data records.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and GitHub numeric data

patterns.name: Slash-delimited compound terms or paths
patterns.context: Slashes connect domain terms, property names, or code path fragments; not every occurrence is accompanied by square brackets.
patterns.domain: Research titles and C++ code comments

patterns.name: Local sporadic word activations
patterns.context: Words appear in different syntactic positions, with no recurring semantic or contextual condition; difficult to summarize as an independent stable pattern.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, project descriptions, forum discussions

2_2729.concept: 方括号引入结构化内容
2_2729.description: 最稳定的共同点是方括号开头：它引出引文、标签、占位符或数组数据，涵盖多种语料与格式。另有少量斜线分隔的术语/路径及彼此无关的词语激活。

patterns.name: 方括号引入引用或标签
patterns.trigger: «[» 后接引文编号、机构缩写、化学式或占位标签，如「[9HBW]」「[9MP]」「[9unreadable]」「[9begin_description]」
patterns.context: 方括号作为文献引注、实体标签、描述标记或不可读内容占位符的开头；括号内内容各异
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、科研摘要、代码文档及 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 方括号引入数组或数据项
patterns.context: 方括号开始列表、嵌套数组或成组的数据记录
patterns.domain: 编程问答与 GitHub 数值数据

patterns.name: 斜线分隔的复合术语或路径
patterns.context: 斜线连接领域术语、性质名称或代码路径片段；并非所有出现都伴随方括号
patterns.domain: 科研标题与 C++ 代码注释

patterns.name: 局部零散词语激活
patterns.context: 各词出现在不同句法位置，缺少重复的语义或上下文条件，难以归纳为独立稳定规律
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、项目说明、论坛对话

en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented word forms: internal combustion engines and combustion, display illumination or eyes, torque, wartime suffering, HTML closing tags, syndrome names, and strings in probability problems; overall, they lack unified semantics.

patterns.name: combustion engine terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in technical descriptions of internal combustion engines, fuels, hot gas generators, or engine control; strong activation often falls on the segmented form of “combustion.”
patterns.domain: Patent technical background, engines and combustion

patterns.name: Eye- and vision-related words
patterns.context: Appears in “no eye strain,” describing display advantages, and in descriptions of light emitted by display devices; the triggering forms are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Torque
patterns.context: Appears in a mechanical patent description of torque transmitted between a drive wheel, splined shaft, and actuator.

patterns.name: Adjectives expressing fear or suffering
patterns.context: Describes the hardship caused by disease and death during war.

patterns.name: Webpage title closing tag
patterns.context: Occurs near the HTML fragment </h>, alongside a clock icon and Chinese webpage text; activation here is clearly marked as much stronger than in the other examples.

patterns.name: Knobloch syndrome-related terminology
patterns.context: A clinical abstract lists congenital abnormalities, developmental delay, and other symptoms, then names the syndrome.

patterns.name: String in a mathematical probability problem
patterns.context: A letter sequence whose probability is to be found in a problem about drawing letters without replacement.

2_2729.description: 激活散见于拆分词形：内燃机与燃烧、显示器发光或眼部、转矩、战争苦难、HTML闭合标签、综合征名称及概率题字串；总体缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: combustion engine terminology
patterns.context: 出现在内燃机、燃料、热气发生器或发动机控制的技术描述中；强激活常落在被拆分标记的“combustion”上。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，发动机与燃烧

patterns.name: 眼部与视觉相关词
patterns.context: 分别出现在显示器优点的“no eye strain”以及显示设备发光的描述中；触发形式不完全一致。

patterns.name: 转矩
patterns.context: 出现在驱动轮、花键轴与致动器之间传递转矩的机械专利描述中。

patterns.name: 畏惧或痛苦的形容词
patterns.context: 修饰战争中疾病与死亡造成的艰难经历。

patterns.name: 网页标题闭合标记
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML 片段的 </h> 标记附近，另有钟表图标和中文网页文本；此处激活强度标记明显高于其余样例。

patterns.name: Knobloch 综合征相关术语
patterns.context: 临床摘要列出先天异常、发育迟缓等表现后，出现综合征名称。

patterns.name: 数学概率题中的字符串
patterns.context: 在从字母中无放回抽取的概率题中，作为待求概率的字母序列。

en.concept: The letter X and technical-text word forms
en.description: Primarily sensitive to uppercase or lowercase X and technical word forms followed by a hyphen, especially X-ray; also activates on X-shaped, standard names, and fragile X-related wording. Other activations include patent boilerplate, code comments, and several isolated word forms.

patterns.name: X in X-ray terminology
patterns.context: The letter X is followed by a hyphen and ray/rays in descriptions of X-ray technology, equipment, or materials; the letter X itself activates strongly.
patterns.domain: Research papers and patents on crystallography, detectors, imaging, and lithographic materials

patterns.name: X-type structures or names
patterns.context: X is the initial letter of a compound name or shape label, followed by a hyphen and a number or by shaped; this differs from the X-ray usage.
patterns.domain: Medicinal chemistry abstracts; home automation standards lists

patterns.name: X in other biomedical contexts
patterns.context: X appears in the disease name “fragile X mental retardation”; there is also local activation on myc in an oncogene name.

patterns.name: Common technical phrasing in patent texts
patterns.context: Common sentence patterns and functional descriptions in patent backgrounds or specifications; no clear X-related trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Source file header format
patterns.context: A BOM, C-style comment opener, and copyright notice at the beginning of a file.

patterns.name: Other sporadic term activations
patterns.context: Appear near oligomerization, figure descriptions, protein property descriptions, and a registered trademark symbol, without forming a shared local semantic pattern.

2_2729.concept: 字母 X 及技术文本词形
2_2729.description: 主要对大写或小写 X 及其后接连字符的技术词形敏感，尤其是 X-ray；也激活 X-shaped、标准名、脆性X相关表述。另有专利套语、代码注释与若干孤立词形激活。

patterns.name: X-ray相关术语中的 X
patterns.context: 字母 X 后接连字符和 ray/rays，出现在 X-ray 技术、设备或材料描述中；字母 X 本身激活强
patterns.domain: 科研论文与专利，涉及晶体学、探测器、成像及光刻材料

patterns.name: X 型结构或名称
patterns.context: X 作为复合名称或形状标签的首字母，后接连字符和数字或 shaped；与 X-ray 用法不同
patterns.domain: 药物化学摘要；家居自动化标准列表

patterns.name: 其他生物医学中的 X
patterns.context: X 出现在疾病名称“fragile X mental retardation”中；另有癌基因名称中 myc 的局部激活

patterns.name: 专利文本中的常见技术表述
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书的常见句式、功能描述；未见明显 X 相关触发

patterns.name: 源码文件头格式
patterns.context: 文件开头的 BOM、C 风格注释起始符及版权声明

patterns.name: 其他零散术语激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在寡聚化、示意图说明、蛋白质性质描述和注册商标符号附近，未形成共同局部语义模式

en.description: Activations cover scientific terminology such as Raman spectroscopy characterization, bandgap, and nanomedicine, while also strongly covering Hacker News separator lines. Other activations include link fragments and sporadic word fragments, without a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Raman spectroscopy terminology
patterns.context: Raman appears in descriptions of materials or sample characterization and detection methods; the first passage also lists IR spectroscopy.
patterns.domain: Materials science, nanomedicine, and PubMed scientific abstracts/papers

patterns.name: Optical bandgap terminology
patterns.context: In a discussion of the optical properties of amorphous oxide semiconductors compared with amorphous silicon, activation falls on components of bandgap.

patterns.name: Hacker News separator
patterns.context: In Hacker News text, appears as a standalone separator line after a link or question and before a username or post body; this is the strongest shared activation location in this group of fragments.

patterns.name: Sporadic substrings in paths or links
patterns.context: Activation falls on URLs, web paths, or hyphen-delimited title/path fragments, with no stable word meaning or semantic context.
patterns.domain: Hacker News links and webpage text

patterns.name: Sporadic English fragments
patterns.context: Isolated common English words or word fragments near Hacker News questions, comments, titles, or usernames; not explained by the Raman or separator patterns.

patterns.name: Nanomedicine stem
patterns.context: Occurs in a paper describing AuNP properties and their use in detection; activation covers only the stem fragment of nanomedicine.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment within a term
patterns.context: In a materials description from a polymer composite membrane paper, activation falls on a local fragment of composite rather than a stable complete term.

2_2729.description: 激活既覆盖 Raman 光谱表征及 bandgap、nanomedicine 等科学术语，也强烈覆盖 Hacker News 的分隔行；另有链接片段和零散词片段，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: Raman 光谱术语
patterns.context: Raman 出现在材料或样品的表征、检测方法描述中；第1段还同列 IR spectroscopy。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、纳米医学及 PubMed 科学摘要/论文

patterns.name: 光学带隙术语
patterns.context: 讨论非晶氧化物半导体相较于非晶硅的光学性质时，激活落在 bandgap 的组成部分。

patterns.name: Hacker News 分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 文本中，作为链接或提问内容之后、用户名或帖子正文之前的独立分隔行；这是该类片段里最强激活的共同位置。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 网页/评论语料

patterns.name: 路径或链接中的零散子串
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL、网址路径或被连字符分隔的标题/路径片段中，未见稳定的词义或语义上下文。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 链接与网页文本

patterns.name: 零散英文片段
patterns.context: 在 Hacker News 问句、评论、标题或用户名附近，孤立分布于常见英文词或词片段上；不能由 Raman 或分隔符模式解释。

patterns.name: 纳米医学词干
patterns.context: 出现在介绍 AuNP 性质及其用于检测的论文正文中；激活只覆盖 nanomedicine 的词干片段。

patterns.name: 术语内部词尾
patterns.context: 聚合物复合膜论文的材料描述中，激活落在 composite 的局部词片段，而非稳定的完整术语。

en.concept: Word-form feature biased toward le/leu fragments
en.description: Activations most consistently fall on word-internal fragments beginning with le/leu, especially in biomedical vocabulary, but also occur in forum usernames and ordinary words. Other sporadic triggers include amino acids, pharmacological terms, experimental conditions, and link formats, so they do not form a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fragments in leucine-related words
patterns.context: Strong activation often falls on word-internal fragments beginning with le/leu; in medical passages these commonly occur in leucyl, leukotriene, leakage, leucine, and similar words. They also occur in usernames or ordinary word fragments in forum passages, so semantic relatedness is not required.
patterns.domain: Across PubMed, patents, HackerNews, and PubMed Central; both biomedical terminology and forum text

patterns.name: Phenylalanine-related word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in amino acid names or their segmented spellings, often alongside leucyl/leucine fragments; found in biochemical reagent or experiment descriptions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and nutrition intervention papers

patterns.name: Drug, inhibition, and biochemical terms
patterns.context: Scattered word-internal fragments occur in drug names, pharmacological effects, and assay measurements; this is not a single fixed term and is absent from some medical passages.

patterns.name: Stress conditions and materials testing terms
patterns.context: Dental material tests involving thermal cycling and mechanical loading; activation is concentrated on test conditions and the microleakage fragment.

patterns.name: Fragments near forum links and formatting markers
patterns.context: HackerNews posts contain URLs, separator lines, or code fences nearby; these markers co-occur with adjacent username fragments, but not consistently across passages.

patterns.name: Industrial and geopolitical word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in link titles and post text discussing Chinese industrialization, manufacturing, and the Cold War; these are topic-specific fragments in a single passage.

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental stimuli and responses
patterns.context: Describes neutrophil responses, stimuli, and oxygen free radical generation; co-occurs with leucyl/phenylalanine fragments in the same passage.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, pharmacology and immunology experiments

patterns.name: Proteolytic enzymes and inhibitors
patterns.context: Discusses reaction rates of papain, cathepsin B, and inhibitors; activation falls on fragments of enzyme and inhibitor names.

patterns.name: Leukotriene antagonist terminology
patterns.context: A patent defines leukotriene receptor antagonist properties; activation is distributed across the terminology and its definitional legal wording.

patterns.name: Nutrition intervention formulation terms
patterns.context: Lists intervention ingredients such as maltodextrin, labeled galactose, and whey protein hydrolysate.

2_2729.concept: 偏向 le/leu 词片段的词形特征
2_2729.description: 激活最稳定地落在 le/leu 开头的词内片段，尤其生物医学词汇，但论坛用户名和普通词中也出现；另有氨基酸、药理术语、实验条件及链接格式等零散触发，不能归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 亮氨酸相关词中的片段
patterns.context: 强激活多落在 le/leu 开头的词内片段；医学段中常见于 leucyl、leukotriene、leakage、leucine 等词，论坛段中也出现在用户名或普通词片段里，并不要求词义相关。
patterns.domain: 跨 PubMed、专利、HackerNews、PubMed Central；生物医学术语与论坛文本均有

patterns.name: 苯丙氨酸相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在氨基酸名称或其被分词切开的拼写中，常与 leucyl/亮氨酸片段并列；属于生化试剂或实验描述语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及营养干预论文

patterns.name: 药物、抑制及生化术语
patterns.context: 激活散落于药物名称、药理作用和检测指标的词内片段；不是单一固定术语，且未在全部医学段出现。

patterns.name: 应力条件与材料测试词
patterns.context: 围绕冷热循环和机械加载的牙科材料测试；激活集中于测试条件及 microleakage 词片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，材料/牙科实验

patterns.name: 论坛链接及格式标记附近的片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖文中出现 URL、分隔线或代码围栏附近；这些标记与相邻用户名片段共同出现，但并非各段都相同。

patterns.name: 工业与地缘政治词片段
patterns.context: 出现在讨论中国工业化、制造业和冷战的链接标题及帖子文字中，属于单段的主题性词片段。

patterns.name: 生物医学实验刺激物与反应
patterns.context: 描述中性粒细胞反应、刺激物及氧自由基生成；与同段的 leucyl/phenylalanine 片段并存。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，药理与免疫实验

patterns.name: 蛋白水解酶与抑制剂
patterns.context: 讨论 papain、cathepsin B 及抑制剂的反应速率，激活落在酶名和抑制剂名称片段。

patterns.name: 白三烯拮抗剂术语
patterns.context: 专利中界定白三烯受体拮抗性质，激活分布于术语及其定义性法律措辞。

patterns.name: 营养干预配方词
patterns.context: 列举富集麦芽糊精、标记半乳糖及乳清蛋白水解物等干预成分。

en.concept: le subword tokens and formatting fragments
en.description: In most passages, le occurs at the beginning of words or at subword boundaries, especially in HackerNews usernames. Other sporadic activations include leucine, ix, URL substrings, X identifiers, comment separators, and slashes in PHP comments, with no single shared semantic feature.

patterns.name: English word-initial le subword token
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a word or at a subword boundary, followed by different letters to form words; appears in ordinary words, usernames, and identifiers.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; HackerNews comments, research texts, code

patterns.name: le in usernames
patterns.context: Appears in usernames after HackerNews comment separators and before comment text; activation is strong, but username suffixes vary.

patterns.name: Word-initial leucine
patterns.context: The amino acid leucine appears in a research sentence, with le at the beginning and subsequent subword tokens also activating.

patterns.name: Slashes in PHP comments
patterns.context: A long run of slashes forms a comment separator at the beginning of a PHP file; activation is on the slashes rather than an obvious le substring.

patterns.name: ix list item
patterns.context: In a parenthesized Roman-numeral list, ix marks an item; the adjacent item is viii, and the sentence concerns manufacturing costs.

patterns.name: y and combin in URLs
patterns.context: Multiple URL substrings are marked in Hacker News link domains and paths; they occur in the same passage as username le but show no direct relation.

patterns.name: X identifiers
patterns.context: An uppercase X is followed by a product name or identifier; the two contexts differ, so it is uncertain whether they reflect the same trigger feature.
patterns.domain: HackerNews software discussions; GitHub PHP code comments

patterns.name: Special separators
patterns.context: Appears in separator lines between HackerNews comments; the exact character forms differ across passages.

2_2729.concept: le 子词元及格式碎片
2_2729.description: 多数段落在词首或子词元边界出现 le，尤其是 HackerNews 用户名；另有 leucine、ix、URL 子串、X 标识符、评论分隔符及 PHP 注释斜线等零散激活，未能归入同一语义特征。

patterns.name: 英文词首 le 子词元
patterns.context: 出现在词首或子词元边界，后面接不同字母构成单词；既见于普通词，也见于用户名、标识符。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；HackerNews 评论、科研文本、代码

patterns.name: 用户名中的 le
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 评论分隔线后、评论正文前的用户名中；激活较强，但用户名后缀各异。

patterns.name: leucine 词首
patterns.context: 科研句子中出现氨基酸 leucine，le 位于词首，后续子词元也有激活。

patterns.name: PHP 注释中的斜线
patterns.context: PHP 文件开头，长串斜线构成注释分隔线；激活的是斜线而非明显的 le 子串。

patterns.name: 列表项 ix
patterns.context: 括号罗马数字列表中，ix 标记一项；相邻项为 viii、句子内容为制造成本等。

patterns.name: URL 中的 y 与 combin
patterns.context: Hacker News 链接域名及路径中，多个 URL 子串被标记；与用户名 le 同段出现但未见直接关系。

patterns.name: X 标识符
patterns.context: 大写 X 后接产品名或标识符；两处语境不同，是否为同一触发特征不确定。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 软件讨论；GitHub PHP 代码注释

patterns.name: 特殊分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 评论之间的分隔行；不同段中具体字符形式不同。

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous text. More prominent examples include fragments beginning with y in HackerNews comment usernames, URL substrings, and structural delimiters, but activations also cover quotations, legal titles, biological terms, and sporadic subword fragments. No unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Username fragments beginning with y
patterns.context: Usernames beginning with y appear in the text, especially after HackerNews comment separators «~~~» or «------»; in Ubuntu IRC excerpts, they occur within chat usernames.
patterns.domain: Primarily HackerNews usernames and comment threads; also Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: URL substrings
patterns.context: Activations fall on short fragments within URLs or adjacent text. Complete words and positions vary across excerpts; no shared, clear semantic meaning or fixed boundary is apparent.
patterns.domain: Web links, blog links, and URLs in IRC

patterns.name: Document structure and title markers
patterns.context: Appears in Markdown-style separators, comment separators, or legal document table-of-contents headings; the exact format varies across examples.
patterns.domain: HackerNews post formatting, legal tables of contents

patterns.name: Academic citation fragments
patterns.context: Appears near author names or literature citations in ArXiv text, including «et al.», «Martín-Moreno», and citation keys.

patterns.name: Biological term substrings
patterns.context: Appears in morphological descriptions, genetic analyses, and tetrad-related terminology; activations cover both within-word fragments and complete words.

patterns.name: Short words or phrases in comments
patterns.context: Ordinary words or technical-term substrings in comment bodies; their contexts do not form a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across paper identifiers, section headings, or terms, with no consistent triggering condition apparent.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, FreeLaw tables of contents, and other text

2_2729.description: 激活分布于异质文本；较显眼的是 HackerNews 评论用户名中的 y 开头片段、网址局部和结构分隔符，但同时覆盖引文、法律标题、生物术语及零散词片段，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: y 开头的用户名片段
patterns.context: 文本中出现以 y 开头的用户名，尤其是 HackerNews 评论分隔线「~~~」或「------」之后；Ubuntu IRC 段中则出现在聊天用户名内部。
patterns.domain: 主要为 HackerNews 用户名及评论串；另见 Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: 网址中的局部片段
patterns.context: 被激活的是网址或 URL 邻近文本内部的短片段，不同段落中完整词语和位置各异；缺少共同的明确语义或固定边界。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、博客链接及 IRC 中的网址

patterns.name: 文档结构与标题标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Markdown 式分隔符、评论分隔线或法律文档目录标题中；各例具体格式不同。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖子格式、法律目录

patterns.name: 学术引文片段
patterns.context: 出现在 ArXiv 文本的作者名或文献引用附近，包括「et al.」「Martín-Moreno」及引用键。

patterns.name: 生物学术语局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在形态描述、遗传分析及四分体相关术语中；激活覆盖词内片段和完整词。

patterns.name: 评论中的短词或词组
patterns.context: 评论正文中的普通词语或技术词局部片段；各词所处语境不构成统一模式。

patterns.name: 数值及其他零散片段
patterns.context: 散见于论文编号、章节标题或术语中，未见一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、FreeLaw 目录及其他文本

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to Hacker News comment-author positions, especially username tokens beginning with y; often accompanied by the comment separator ~~~. There are also several sporadic activations in body text. Garbled fragments in Ubuntu IRC cannot be reliably linked to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Hacker News comment usernames
patterns.context: Appears in the username position after a comment separator and before the comment body. Usernames vary, with strong activations concentrated on the initial y.

patterns.name: Comment separators
patterns.context: Appears as a separator between Hacker News comments; in some excerpts, it activates alongside the initial y in a username.

patterns.name: Sporadic body-text tokens
patterns.context: Appears on local tokens in body text, links, or sentences, with no obvious shared semantic condition; activations are generally weaker than those on initial username y.

patterns.name: Garbled Korean fragments
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC excerpts contain garbled Korean, URLs, and chat usernames; activations fall near the garbled text and URLs/usernames, making the specific trigger difficult to determine.

2_2729.description: 主要对 Hacker News 评论作者名位置、尤其以 y 开头的用户名 token 强烈响应；常伴随评论分隔符 ~~~。正文中另有若干零散激活，Ubuntu IRC 乱码片段无法与主模式可靠对应。

patterns.name: Hacker News 评论用户名
patterns.trigger: 作者名开头的 «y»10，后接 «areally»、«Closer»、«ummyfajitas»、«oshyosh»、«en223» 等
patterns.context: 出现在评论分隔符后、评论正文前的用户名位置；用户名本身各不相同，强激活集中在其开头的 y。

patterns.name: 评论分隔符
patterns.context: 作为 Hacker News 评论之间的分隔标记出现；部分段中与用户名开头的 y 同时激活。

patterns.name: 零散的正文 token
patterns.context: 出现在正文、链接或句子中的局部 token，没有显而易见的共同语义条件；多为弱于用户名开头 y 的激活。

patterns.name: 乱码韩文片段
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 片段含乱码韩文、网址及聊天用户名；激活落在乱码文本和 URL/用户名附近，难以确定具体触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to “on the order of” introducing an order of magnitude in technical text; it also activates on sporadic subword fragments in usernames after Hacker News separators. The two patterns appear to lack a shared semantic basis.

patterns.name: order in order-of-magnitude expressions
patterns.context: Introduces an order of magnitude for a quantity, size, current, or error; the phrase describes an approximate range for some quantity in a sentence.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background and NIH research text

patterns.name: Username fragments after Hacker News separators
patterns.context: Appears after the “~~~” separator in Hacker News text, as a username or a username subword fragment; the trigger position varies, often falling at the beginning or within a username.

2_2729.concept: 数量级短语与用户名片段
2_2729.description: 主要对技术文本中引出数量级的“on the order of”敏感；另在 Hacker News 的分隔符后，对用户名中的零散子词片段激活，二者表面上缺少共同语义。

patterns.name: 数量级表达中的 order
patterns.context: 用来引出数量、尺寸、电流或误差的数量级；该短语在句中描述某个量的大致范围。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景及 NIH 科研文本

patterns.name: Hacker News 分隔符后的用户名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 文本的“~~~”分隔符之后，属于用户名或用户名的分词片段；触发位置不固定，常落在用户名开头或内部。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on substrings within Danish, Dutch, Swedish, and English words, and also occur in technical terms, URL domain fragments, and legal table-of-contents numbering/headings. Word forms and positions vary considerably across excerpts.

patterns.name: Subwords within Danish words
patterns.context: Markers fall within Danish words or inflected forms, often combining with unmarked affixes to form complete words; «y» is especially strong in [1].

patterns.name: Subwords within Dutch words
patterns.context: Markers identify contiguous or dispersed subword fragments in Dutch words; surrounding text supplies the word’s meaning and form.

patterns.name: Fragments in English compound terms
patterns.context: Activations occur in gene-testing and communications-engineering terms and their constituent fragments, not just in one fixed term.

patterns.name: URL domain fragments
patterns.context: Strong activations fall on character fragments in URL domains, surrounded by a FreeBSD vendor discussion.

patterns.name: Legal table-of-contents heading markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on Roman-numeral chapter numbers and the beginnings of uppercase legal headings, in a table-of-contents layout.

patterns.name: Boundary-/external-related word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish and Danish parliamentary sentences, fragments occur within word forms meaning external, further, or opinion; context is needed for each word, and a shared semantic trigger cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Scattered within-word fragments
patterns.context: A few activations are distributed across within-word fragments in different languages and vocabulary, with insufficient evidence to group them into a more specific common pattern.

2_2729.description: 激活多落在丹麦语、荷兰语、瑞典语及英语词内子串，也见于技术术语、URL域名片段和法律目录编号/标题；不同段的词形与位置差异较大。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内部子词
patterns.context: 标记落在丹麦语词或词形内部，常与其余未标记词缀组合成完整词；«y»在[1]尤强。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内部子词
patterns.context: 标记的是荷兰语词的连续或分散子词片段，词义和词形由周边文本补全。

patterns.name: 英语复合术语中的片段
patterns.trigger: mult«icolor»2 spectral k«ary»10«otyping»1；« digital»、« phase»、« locked»、« M»1-«ary»9« phase»、«PS»5K
patterns.context: 激活出现在基因检测、通信工程术语及其构成词片段中，并非只落在单一固定术语上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利技术文本

patterns.name: URL域名片段
patterns.context: 高激活落在网址域名的字符片段中，周边是FreeBSD供应商讨论。

patterns.name: 法律目录标题标记
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马数字章节编号及大写法律标题开头，呈现目录式排版。

patterns.name: 边界/外部相关词形片段
patterns.context: 在瑞典语、丹麦语议会句子中，片段位于表示外部、进一步或意见的词形内部；需结合各词上下文，不能确认是同一语义触发。

patterns.name: 散见词内片段
patterns.trigger: « T»1jenesteyd…、« und»1、« gang»3bare、« gef»1asc«ine»1erd、« molecular»1« cytogenetic»1
patterns.context: 少量激活分布在不同语言及词汇的词内片段，缺乏足够证据归为更具体的共同模式。
patterns.domain: 议会、哲学及生物医学文本

en.concept: Cross-lingual word fragments and forum boundary markers
en.description: Activations primarily fall on within-word substrings in several languages, including Finnish, Swedish, Dutch, and one English biomedical term. Forum text also elicits responses around separators and usernames. No unified semantics or stable syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word Finnish fragments
patterns.context: Appears within Finnish vocabulary, often near inflectional or stem/suffix boundaries; fragments 1 and 5 contain «ys», while others include «oid», «om», and «y»«ä».

patterns.name: Within-word Swedish fragments
patterns.context: Trigger points are embedded in Swedish words, with no stable syntactic or semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word Dutch fragments
patterns.context: Trigger points are dispersed across Dutch vocabulary; some involve inflections or common word fragments.

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word fragments across languages
patterns.context: Different fragments are embedded in Dutch, Danish, or related Scandinavian vocabulary; no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: English biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: Appears in specialized sentences about chromosomal abnormalities, genes, and cytogenetic techniques; markers mostly fall within terms.

patterns.name: Forum separators and username fragments
patterns.context: Appears in HackerNews comment separators, near usernames, or at comment openings; several excerpts mark «y» after a separator/username.

2_2729.concept: 跨语言词片段与论坛边界标记
2_2729.description: 激活主要落在多种语言的词内子串，覆盖芬兰语、瑞典语、荷兰语及一段英语生物医学术语；论坛文本中另对分隔线和用户名附近片段响应。未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语词汇内部，常与词形变化或词干/词尾边界相邻；片段1、5含 «ys»，另有 «oid»、«om»、«y»«ä» 等

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发点嵌在瑞典语单词中，未见稳定的句法或语义条件

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发点分散在荷兰语词汇中，部分涉及词形或常见词片段

patterns.name: 多语词内零散片段
patterns.context: 不同片段嵌在荷兰语、丹麦语或相关斯堪的纳维亚语词汇中；没有明显共同语义

patterns.name: 英语生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于染色体异常、基因及细胞遗传学技术的专业句子中；标记多落在术语词内

patterns.name: 论坛分隔符与用户名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 评论分隔线、用户名附近或评论开头；多段均在分隔线/用户名后标记 «y»

en.description: Activations are distributed across word fragments in different languages and domains: Dutch fys-, Swedish numeral fyra, English username fragments, and biomedical kinesin and karyotyping. No single semantic or stable word-form pattern covers all excerpts.

patterns.name: «ys» within Dutch words
patterns.context: Dutch sentences discuss physical violence; activation occurs within «fysiek».

patterns.name: «ys» within Dutch words and nearby physics context
patterns.context: Dutch context relates to mathematicians, crisis, and solutions; activation occurs within «fysici».

patterns.name: Initial «fy» in Swedish numeral «fyra»
patterns.context: Denotes the number four when discussing proposals, questions, or completion times.

patterns.name: Initial «fy» in Swedish numeral «fyra»
patterns.context: Used in «för drygt fyra år sedan» to express approximately four years ago.

patterns.name: Initial «fy» in Swedish numeral «fyra»
patterns.context: Listed alongside «fem år», meaning four or five years.

patterns.name: «ined» within an English word
patterns.context: A username in a forum post; activation falls within the username, with no clear lexical motivation.

patterns.name: Protein-name fragment «ines»
patterns.context: Context involving intracellular transport, secretory vesicles, and microtubule-associated proteins/motor proteins.

patterns.name: «ary» in a genomic term
patterns.context: Describes a chromosomal analysis method in cancer research.

2_2729.description: 激活分散在不同语言和领域的词片段中：荷兰语 fys-、瑞典语数字 fyra、英文用户名片段，以及生物医学中的 kinesin 和 karyotyping；没有单一语义或稳定词形模式覆盖全部段。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内的「ys」
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子中谈论身体暴力；激活位于「fysiek」的词内

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内的「ys」及邻近物理学语境
patterns.context: 与数学家、危机及解决方案相关的荷兰语语境；激活位于「fysici」的词内

patterns.name: 瑞典语数词「fyra」的开头
patterns.context: 讨论提案、问题或完成时间时，表示数字四

patterns.name: 瑞典语数词「fyra」的开头
patterns.context: 以「för drygt fyra år sedan」表达约四年前

patterns.name: 瑞典语数词「fyra」的开头
patterns.context: 与「fem år」并列，表示四或五年

patterns.name: 英文词内的「ined」
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中的用户名；激活落在用户名内部，具体词法动因不明

patterns.name: 蛋白名称片段「ines」
patterns.context: 细胞内运输、分泌囊泡和微管相关的蛋白/马达蛋白语境

patterns.name: 基因组术语中的「ary」
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤研究中的染色体分析方法

en.description: Strong activations often fall on within-word y/ys/dys fragments, especially in medical terms. There are also multilingual within-word fragments and activations on forum separators and username fragments, without a single semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Substrings containing y
patterns.context: The letter y or ys occurs within words, near the beginning, middle, or end; it does not correspond to a single meaning or part of speech.
patterns.domain: Various text, including Dutch, Swedish, English, and medical terms

patterns.name: Dutch word-final/within-word fragments
patterns.context: Contiguous letter fragments within Dutch words; samples include text related to crises, mathematics, and physics.

patterns.name: Dutch pronoun fragment
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “mijn ogen” (in my eyes).

patterns.name: Within-word Swedish fragments
patterns.context: Fragments are embedded in Swedish words such as “tjänstedirektivet”, “drygt”, and “fyra”.

patterns.name: Forum formatting markers and username fragments
patterns.context: Comment-thread separators and a substring at the beginning of the username “ineedasername”.

patterns.name: dys- fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Appears in medical vocabulary such as “dysallostatic”, “dyspnea”, and “dyskinetic”; other word fragments are also marked in the same excerpt.

2_2729.description: 强激活多落在词内的 y/ys/dys 片段，尤其是医学术语；另有多语种词内片段及论坛分隔符、用户名片段，未形成单一语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 含 y 的子串
patterns.context: 字母 y 或 ys 出现在词内部；可见于词首后续、词中或词尾附近，并非单一词义或词类。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语、瑞典语、英语及医学术语等多种文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语词语内部的连续字母片段；样本中包含危机、数学与物理相关文字。

patterns.name: 荷兰语代词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“mijn ogen”（我的眼中）一类表达中。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在瑞典语词中，如“tjänstedirektivet”“drygt”“fyra”。

patterns.name: 论坛格式标记及用户名片段
patterns.context: 评论串中的分隔符，以及用户名“ineedasername”开头的子串。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 dys- 片段
patterns.context: 出现在医学词汇中，如“dysallostatic”“dyspnea”“dyskinetic”；同段也有其他被标记的词片段。

en.concept: The letter y and fragments containing y
en.description: Activations primarily fall on the letter y or short fragments containing y: Dutch fys-, Swedish fyra, English Dys-, and y in mathematical symbols, passwords, and usernames. Contexts and semantics vary considerably.

patterns.name: Split fragments of the Dutch root fys-
patterns.context: Dutch text contains words about physicists or the body/violence; trigger positions span within-word substrings, and the exact fragments are not identical.
patterns.domain: Dutch philosophy text, European Parliament text

patterns.name: The letter y in Dy
patterns.context: Proper names/symbols in English technical or medical text, and a code-generated string; y is sometimes near the beginning of a word and sometimes a character in a variable or random string.

patterns.name: Swedish fyra (four)
patterns.context: The Swedish number word fyra appears in parliamentary speech discussing four questions, fields, or years.

patterns.name: Dys- spelling fragment
patterns.context: The spelling fragment dyslexic in an English username or title.

patterns.name: y in usernames
patterns.context: Usernames in forum comments; not ordinary lexical use in sentences.

2_2729.concept: 字母 y 及含 y 的片段
2_2729.description: 激活主要落在字母 y 或含 y 的短片段：荷兰语 fys-、瑞典语 fyra、英语 Dys-，以及数学符号、密码串和用户名中的 y。上下文和语义差异较大。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词根 fys- 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语中出现物理学家或身体/暴力相关词，触发位置跨越词内子串；具体触发片段并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语哲学文本、欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: Dy 的字母 y
patterns.context: 英语技术或医学文本中的专名/符号，以及一个代码生成的字符串；有时 y 位于词首附近，有时是变量或随机串中的字符。

patterns.name: 瑞典语 fyra（四）
patterns.context: 瑞典语中的数字词 fyra，见于议会发言提到四个问题、领域或年数的语境。

patterns.name: Dys- 拼写片段
patterns.context: 英语用户名或标题中的 dyslexic 拼写片段。

patterns.name: 用户名中的 y
patterns.context: 论坛评论中的用户名；不像普通句子词汇用法。

en.description: The most consistent evidence is a response to within-word fragments of the letter y, especially in multilingual words. There are also sporadic word fragments, English I, Dutch fys-, Swedish fyra, and activations on forum separators and academic terms, with no unified semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of the string y
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the letter y in English or Swedish words, or on the y in the mathematical symbol D_y; no consistency of meaning or syntax is required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual forum, parliamentary text, and academic papers

patterns.name: English within-word fragment ine
patterns.context: Appears in a Hacker News comment signature; only one instance.

patterns.name: Dutch within-word fragment ik
patterns.context: Located within a Dutch word, near the spelling “schikingen”; only one instance.

patterns.name: English pronoun I
patterns.context: Appears as a first-person subject in a Hacker News comment.

patterns.name: fy in Dutch fysiek
patterns.context: Both instances occur in Dutch words involving physicists or physical violence; there is no shared word meaning.

patterns.name: Swedish fyra (four)
patterns.context: Means “four” in Swedish parliamentary text; two excerpts refer to basic issues and specific fields, respectively.

patterns.name: Other scattered short word fragments
patterns.context: These activations fall on word fragments in different languages, comment separators, mathematical notation, or technical terms, with no clear shared local or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: Dutch, English, Swedish; forum, parliamentary, and academic text

2_2729.description: 最一致的迹象是对字母 y 的词内片段有反应，尤其在多语言词语中；此外还有零散的词片段、英语 I、荷兰语 fys-、瑞典语 fyra，以及论坛分隔符和学术术语等激活，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 字符串 y 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在英文或瑞典语词中的字母 y，或数学符号 D_y 的 y；并不要求词义或句法一致。
patterns.domain: 多语言论坛、议会文本与学术论文

patterns.name: 英文词内 ine 片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 评论署名中；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内 ik 片段
patterns.context: 位于荷兰语词内部，邻近拼写为 “schikingen”；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 英语 I 代词
patterns.context: 在 Hacker News 评论中作为第一人称主语出现。

patterns.name: 荷兰语 fysiek 中的 fy
patterns.context: 两处都在荷兰语词中，涉及物理学家或身体暴力；没有共同词义。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 与 EuroParl 荷兰语文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语 fyra（四）
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中表示“四”；两段分别说基本问题和特定领域。

patterns.name: 其它分散的短词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分别落在不同语言的词片段、评论分隔符、数学记号或技术术语中，缺乏明显共享的局部或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：荷兰语、英语、瑞典语；论坛、议会及学术文本
